blocks.label: detail:hexagon-containing-minimum
blocks.title: A containing local circle is a curvature minimum
blocks.body:
If a local circumdisk of a simple coherent positively oriented polygon
contains every vertex, then
$\kappa_i\le\kappa_{i-1}$ and $\kappa_i\le\kappa_{i+1}$.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_neighbors_le_of_containsAll_of_positiveOrientation
lean.code:
theorem edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_neighbors_le_of_containsAll_of_positiveOrientation
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hregular : DahlbergRegular v)
    (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v) {i : ZMod n}
    (hcontains : EdgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll v i) :
    EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile v (i - 1) ≤ EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile v i ∧
      EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile v (i + 1) ≤ EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile v i := by
  exact ⟨
    edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_pred_le_of_containsAll_of_positiveOrientation
      hsimple hregular horient hcontains,
    edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_succ_le_of_containsAll_of_positiveOrientation
      hsimple hregular horient hcontains⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.containing_curvature_le_neighbors
lean.code:
theorem containing_curvature_le_neighbors
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v) (hregular : DahlbergRegular v)
    (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v) {i : ZMod n}
    (hi : EdgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll v i) :
    SignedMengerProfile v i ≤ SignedMengerProfile v (i - 1) ∧
      SignedMengerProfile v i ≤ SignedMengerProfile v (i + 1) := by
  have hh := edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_neighbors_le_of_containsAll_of_positiveOrientation
    hsimple hregular horient hi
  simp only [signedMengerProfile_eq_inv_edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_of_positiveOrientation
    hsimple horient]
  constructor
  · exact inv_anti₀ (EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_pos hsimple (i - 1)) hh.1
  · exact inv_anti₀ (EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_pos hsimple (i + 1)) hh.2

blocks.tex:
Compare the circle with each neighbouring local circle across their shared
edge $AB$. A rigid motion puts the endpoints at $(-h,0),(h,0)$, where
$h=|B-A|/2>0$, and the polygon interior above the chord. Coherence at the
incident vertices puts both centers at $(0,y)$ with $y\ge0$. Let
$y_\rho$ denote the neighbouring center parameter and $y_\Delta$ that of the
containing circle. The neighbouring third vertex $(x,t)$ has $t>0$ and
satisfies
\[
 x^2+t^2-2y_\rho t=h^2,\qquad
 x^2+t^2-2y_\Delta t\le h^2.
\]
Thus $y_\rho\le y_\Delta$. Since the squared radius is $h^2+y^2$ and both
parameters are nonnegative, the neighbouring radius is at most $r_i$.
Reciprocal radii reverse both inequalities.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-three-contact
blocks.title: Containing three-contact disks through every vertex
blocks.body:
If $n\ge4$ and a polygon has strict convex edge support, every vertex belongs
to a containing circle with at least three distinct contact vertices.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.exists_dahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2_at_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport
lean.code:
theorem exists_dahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2_at_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsupport : StrictConvexEdgeSupport v) (i : ZMod n) :
    ∃ U : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v,
      i ∈ circleContactSet v U.center U.radius := by
  rcases exists_edgeThirdVertex_circle_containsAll_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport
      hn hsupport i with ⟨j, hji, hjnext, hall, hcircle⟩
  have hAB : v i ≠ v (i + 1) :=
    strictConvexEdgeSupport_edge_ne hn hsupport i
  let y := edgeCircumcenterParameter (v i) (v (i + 1)) (v j)
  let O := edgeCircleCenter (v i) (v (i + 1)) y
  let R := normalizedCircleRadius (chordHalfLength (v i) (v (i + 1))) y
  have hcontains : PolygonInClosedDiskR2 v O R := by
    intro k
    exact Metric.mem_closedBall'.mpr ((mem_edgeClosedDisk_iff_dist_le hAB y).mp (hall k))
  have hiNext : i ≠ i + 1 := by
    intro h
    exact hAB (congrArg v h)
  have hthree : 3 ≤ (circleContactSet v O R).card := by
    apply three_le_card_circleContactSet hiNext hji.symm hjnext.symm
    · exact hcircle.2.1
    · exact hcircle.2.2.1
    · exact hcircle.2.2.2
  let U : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v :=
    { center := O
      radius := R
      radius_pos := hcircle.1
      contains := hcontains
      three_contacts := hthree }
  refine ⟨U, ?_⟩
  exact mem_circleContactSet.mpr hcircle.2.1

deps.title: Positive one-turn polygons have strict edge support
deps.label: detail:discrete-edge-support

blocks.tex:
Fix the outgoing edge at the chosen vertex. Parameterize circles through
its endpoints by their centers on the perpendicular bisector. All other
vertices lie strictly to the same side of the edge, so membership in the
disk is a one-sided inequality on this center parameter. Take the largest
of the finitely many required parameters. The resulting disk contains all
vertices, and a maximizing vertex lies on its boundary along with the two
edge endpoints.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-contact-gap
blocks.title: Localization to a gap in the contacts
blocks.body:
For a strictly convex cyclically indexed polygon, let $U,W$ be containing disks with at
least three contacts each. In a cyclic cut, let $p<k<q<n$. If $p,q$ are
contacts of $U$, $k$ is not a contact of $U$, and $k$ is a contact of $W$,
then every contact of $W$ lies in the closed cyclic interval $[p,q]$.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.circleContactSet_subset_of_containingDisk_cutGap
lean.code:
theorem circleContactSet_subset_of_containingDisk_cutGap
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hgeom : StrictConvexCyclicChordGeometry v)
    (U W : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v)
    (c : ZMod n) {p k q : ℕ}
    (hpk : p < k) (hkq : k < q) (hqn : q < n)
    (hpU : Gluck.cyclicLift c p ∈ circleContactSet v U.center U.radius)
    (hqU : Gluck.cyclicLift c q ∈ circleContactSet v U.center U.radius)
    (hkNotU : Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∉ circleContactSet v U.center U.radius)
    (hkW : Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∈ circleContactSet v W.center W.radius) :
    circleContactSet v W.center W.radius ⊆
      Gluck.mapCut c (Finset.Icc p q) := by
  have hgap := hgeom.gap c p k q hpk hkq hqn
  let a := Gluck.cyclicLift c q
  let b := Gluck.cyclicLift c p
  let z := Gluck.cyclicLift c k
  let E := Gluck.mapCut c (Finset.Icc p q)
  have habIndex : a ≠ b := by
    intro h
    have hcast : (q : ZMod n) = (p : ZMod n) := by
      exact add_left_cancel h
    have hmod : q ≡ p [MOD n] :=
      (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff q p n).mp hcast
    exact (Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_trans hpk hkq))
      (hmod.eq_of_lt_of_lt hqn (lt_trans (lt_trans hpk hkq) hqn))
  apply circleContactSet_subset_of_containingDisk_gap U W hqU hpU hkNotU hkW
    hgap.1
  · intro d hdU hda hdb
    exact hgeom.noncollinear a b d habIndex hda hdb
  · exact hgap.2.1
  · intro x hx
    exact hgap.2.2.1 x ((mem_edgeHalfPlane_iff_crossR2_nonneg hgap.1).mp hx)

blocks.tex:
Write $D=\operatorname{power}_U-\operatorname{power}_W$, an affine function
because the quadratic terms cancel. At $p,q$ it is nonnegative, because
these vertices lie on $U$ and in $W$, whereas $D(k)<0$. If $X$ were a
contact of $W$ outside the closed cut, then $D(X)\le0$, since $X$ lies in $U$.
Strict convex chord geometry makes the segment $kX$ cross the chord $pq$ at
a point $Y$, with positive weight on $k$. Affinity gives $D(Y)<0$ using
$kX$, but $D(Y)\ge0$ using $pq$, a contradiction.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-terminal-intervals
blocks.title: Two terminal contact intervals
blocks.body:
Suppose a nonempty family of disks has contact sets of cardinality at least
three, none equal to the whole cyclic index set. Suppose also that every
index is a contact of some member and that the gap-localization property
holds. There exist two members with distinct contact sets, each a cyclic
interval.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.exists_two_cyclicInterval_contacts_ne_of_cutGap_shrink
lean.code:
theorem exists_two_cyclicInterval_contacts_ne_of_cutGap_shrink
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {Disk : Type*}
    (contacts : Disk → Finset (ZMod n))
    (hthree : ∀ U : Disk, 3 ≤ (contacts U).card)
    (hproper : ∀ U : Disk, contacts U ≠ Finset.univ)
    (hchoose : ∀ i : ZMod n, ∃ W : Disk, i ∈ contacts W)
    (hlocalize : ∀ (U W : Disk) (c : ZMod n) {p k q : ℕ},
      p < k → k < q → q < n →
      Gluck.cyclicLift c p ∈ contacts U →
      Gluck.cyclicLift c q ∈ contacts U →
      Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∉ contacts U →
      Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∈ contacts W →
      contacts W ⊆ Gluck.mapCut c (Finset.Icc p q))
    (U₀ : Disk) :
    ∃ U W : Disk,
      Gluck.IsCyclicInterval (contacts U) ∧
      Gluck.IsCyclicInterval (contacts W) ∧
      contacts U ≠ contacts W := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, hUinterval⟩ :=
    exists_cyclicInterval_contacts_of_cutGap_shrink
      contacts hthree hproper hchoose hlocalize U₀
  obtain ⟨c, p, k, q, hcU, hp0, hpk, hkq, hqn, hpU, hqU, hkNotU⟩ :=
    hUinterval.exists_cutGap_in_complement (hthree U) (hproper U)
  obtain ⟨W, hWinterval, hWsub⟩ :=
    exists_cyclicInterval_contacts_subset_cutGap_of_shrink
      contacts hthree hchoose hlocalize U c hp0 hpk hkq hqn hpU hqU hkNotU
  have hIr : Finset.Icc p q ⊆ Finset.range n := by
    intro r hr
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hr
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt hr.2 hqn)
  have hcNotW : c ∉ contacts W := by
    intro hcW
    have hzeroCut : 0 ∈ Gluck.cutFinset c (contacts W) := by
      exact Gluck.mem_cutFinset.mpr
        ⟨Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n), by simpa [Gluck.cyclicLift] using hcW⟩
    have hcutWsub : Gluck.cutFinset c (contacts W) ⊆ Finset.Icc p q :=
      (Gluck.cutFinset_subset_iff c hIr).mpr hWsub
    have hzeroI := Finset.mem_Icc.mp (hcutWsub hzeroCut)
    omega
  refine ⟨U, W, hUinterval, hWinterval, ?_⟩
  intro hUW
  exact hcNotW (hUW ▸ hcU)

deps.title: Localization to a gap in the contacts
deps.label: detail:hexagon-contact-gap

deps.title: Containing three-contact disks through every vertex
deps.label: detail:hexagon-three-contact

blocks.tex:
Cut at a noncontact and take the interval hull of the contacts in this cut.
If the contact set has an internal gap, choose a disk through an index in
that gap. Localization places its contacts in the closed gap. There are at
least three contacts, so a gap between consecutive contacts is a proper
subinterval of the current hull. The cut base remains omitted, and each
replacement strictly decreases the finite hull until the contacts form
a cyclic interval. Its at least three contacts provide an interior contact
that can serve as the base of a new cyclic cut. Properness provides a
complementary gap whose two endpoints are contacts but whose interior contains
a noncontact. Descend inside that closed gap. Every subsequent contact set
stays in the gap and therefore omits the chosen base contact of the first
interval. The second terminal interval consequently has a different contact
set. All descent measures are natural numbers, so termination requires no
analytic limit.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-two-containing
blocks.title: Two distinct containing curvature circles
blocks.body:
A simple positively oriented strictly convex polygon with $n\ge4$ that is
not concyclic has two distinct local circumcircles whose disks contain all
its vertices.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.exists_edgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll_of_containing_contacts_interval
lean.code:
theorem exists_edgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll_of_containing_contacts_interval
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon v)
    (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v)
    (U : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v)
    (hinterval : Gluck.IsCyclicInterval
      (circleContactSet v U.center U.radius)) :
    ∃ i : ZMod n,
      EdgePrevCurvatureCircleData v i = (U.center, U.radius) ∧
      EdgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll v i := by
  obtain ⟨i, hprev, hself, hnext⟩ :=
    hinterval.exists_three_consecutive U.three_contacts
  have hprev' : OnDiskBoundaryR2 v U.center U.radius (i - 1) :=
    Metric.mem_sphere'.mpr (mem_circleContactSet.mp hprev)
  have hself' : OnDiskBoundaryR2 v U.center U.radius i :=
    Metric.mem_sphere'.mpr (mem_circleContactSet.mp hself)
  have hnext' : OnDiskBoundaryR2 v U.center U.radius (i + 1) :=
    Metric.mem_sphere'.mpr (mem_circleContactSet.mp hnext)
  have hdata := edgePrevCurvatureCircleData_eq_of_three_boundaries_of_cross_pos
    hsimple U.radius_pos hprev' hself' hnext' (horient i)
  refine ⟨i, hdata, ?_⟩
  have hcenter : EdgePrevCircleCenterProfile v i = U.center :=
    congrArg Prod.fst hdata
  have hradius : EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile v i = U.radius :=
    congrArg Prod.snd hdata
  simp only [EdgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll]
  intro j
  rw [hcenter, hradius]
  exact U.contains j

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.dahlbergE2Theorem6Lemma5ContainingDisks
lean.code:
theorem dahlbergE2Theorem6Lemma5ContainingDisks
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon v)
    (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v)
    (hsupport : StrictConvexEdgeSupport v)
    (hgeom : StrictConvexCyclicChordGeometry v)
    (hnoncircle : ¬ Concyclic v) :
    Nonempty (DahlbergE2Theorem6ContainingDisksCertificate v) := by
  classical
  let contacts : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v → Finset (ZMod n) :=
    fun U => circleContactSet v U.center U.radius
  have hthree : ∀ U : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v,
      3 ≤ (contacts U).card := by
    intro U
    exact U.three_contacts
  have hproper : ∀ U : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v,
      contacts U ≠ Finset.univ := by
    intro U
    exact circleContactSet_ne_univ_of_not_concyclic U.radius_pos hnoncircle
  have hchoose : ∀ i : ZMod n,
      ∃ W : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v, i ∈ contacts W := by
    intro i
    exact exists_dahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2_at_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport
      hn hsupport i
  have hlocalize :
      ∀ (U W : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v) (c : ZMod n)
        {p k q : ℕ},
        p < k → k < q → q < n →
        Gluck.cyclicLift c p ∈ contacts U →
        Gluck.cyclicLift c q ∈ contacts U →
        Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∉ contacts U →
        Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∈ contacts W →
        contacts W ⊆ Gluck.mapCut c (Finset.Icc p q) := by
    intro U W c p k q hpk hkq hqn hpU hqU hkNotU hkW
    exact circleContactSet_subset_of_containingDisk_cutGap
      hgeom U W c hpk hkq hqn hpU hqU hkNotU hkW
  obtain ⟨U₀, _h0⟩ := hchoose 0
  obtain ⟨U, W, hUinterval, hWinterval, hcontactsNe⟩ :=
    exists_two_cyclicInterval_contacts_ne_of_cutGap_shrink
      contacts hthree hproper hchoose hlocalize U₀
  obtain ⟨i, hdataU, hcontainsU⟩ :=
    exists_edgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll_of_containing_contacts_interval
      hsimple horient U hUinterval
  obtain ⟨j, hdataW, hcontainsW⟩ :=
    exists_edgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll_of_containing_contacts_interval
      hsimple horient W hWinterval
  have hdistinct : EdgePrevCurvatureCirclesDistinct v i j := by
    intro hij
    apply hcontactsNe
    apply circleContactSet_eq_of_circleData_eq
    exact hdataU.symm.trans (hij.trans hdataW)
  exact ⟨⟨i, j, hcontainsU, hcontainsW, hdistinct⟩⟩

deps.title: Positive one-turn polygons have strict edge support
deps.label: detail:discrete-edge-support

blocks.tex:
Use the family of containing three-contact disks. Nonconcyclicity makes
every contact set proper. The preceding lemmas give two different terminal
contact intervals. Each interval contains three consecutive indices, whose
noncollinear vertices determine their unique local circumcircle. Thus each
terminal disk is a local circumdisk. Equal circle data would give equal
contact sets, so the two resulting circles are distinct.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-profile
blocks.title: An admissible hexagon path
blocks.body:
For $0\le s\le1$, put
\[
 \kappa_s=(14,11,10+3s,5,7-3s,3).
\]
This is a continuous path of positive nonconstant admissible profiles.
Its four-vertex levels are exactly
\[
 (5,7-3s)\ \cup\ (11,10+3s),
\]
where an interval is empty if its upper endpoint is no larger than its lower.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.bandProfile
lean.code:
def bandProfile (s : ℝ) : ZMod 6 → ℝ :=
  ![14, 11, 10 + 3 * s, 5, 7 - 3 * s, 3]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.bandProfile_pos
lean.code:
theorem bandProfile_pos {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∀ i, 0 < bandProfile s i := by
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [bandProfile] <;> linarith [hs.1, hs.2]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.bandProfile_admissible
lean.code:
theorem bandProfile_admissible {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    DiscreteFourVertexPos (bandProfile s) := by
  refine ⟨bandProfile_pos hs, Or.inr ?_⟩
  by_cases h : s < 2 / 3
  · refine ⟨(5 + (7 - 3 * s)) / 2, by linarith, ?_⟩
    exact (bandProfile_dfv_iff hs).2 (Or.inl ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
  · refine ⟨(11 + (10 + 3 * s)) / 2, by linarith, ?_⟩
    exact (bandProfile_dfv_iff hs).2 (Or.inr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.continuous_bandProfile
lean.code:
theorem continuous_bandProfile : Continuous bandProfile := by
  apply continuous_pi
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [bandProfile] <;> fun_prop

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.bandProfile_nonconstant
lean.code:
theorem bandProfile_nonconstant (s : ℝ) :
    ¬ ∃ c, ∀ i, bandProfile s i = c := by
  rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
  have h0 := hc 0
  have h5 := hc 5
  norm_num [bandProfile] at h0 h5
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.bandProfile_dfv_iff
lean.code:
theorem bandProfile_dfv_iff {s c : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    DFV (bandProfile s) c ↔
      (5 < c ∧ c < 7 - 3 * s) ∨ (11 < c ∧ c < 10 + 3 * s) := by
  constructor
  · intro hd
    obtain ⟨b₁, b₂, b₃, b₄, h₁₂, h₂₃, h₃₄, h₄, ht⟩ := hd.exists_increasing
    have hb₁ : b₁ ≤ 2 := by omega
    have hb₂ : b₂ ≤ 3 := by omega
    have hb₃ : b₃ ≤ 4 := by omega
    rcases ht with ⟨h1,h2,h3,h4⟩ | ⟨h1,h2,h3,h4⟩
    all_goals
      interval_cases b₁ <;> interval_cases b₂ <;> try omega
    all_goals
      interval_cases b₃ <;> interval_cases b₄ <;> try omega
    all_goals
      norm_num [bandProfile] at h1 h2 h3 h4
      first
      | exact Or.inl ⟨by linarith [hs.1, hs.2], by linarith [hs.1, hs.2]⟩
      | exact Or.inr ⟨by linarith [hs.1, hs.2], by linarith [hs.1, hs.2]⟩
  · rintro (⟨hl, hu⟩ | ⟨hl, hu⟩)
    · refine ⟨0, 3, 4, 5, by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
      norm_num [bandProfile]
      exact ⟨by linarith [hs.1], hl, hu, by linarith⟩
    · refine ⟨0, 1, 2, 5, by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
      norm_num [bandProfile]
      exact ⟨by linarith [hs.2], hl, hu, by linarith⟩

blocks.tex:
Enumerating the four alternating entries in cyclic order gives the stated
two intervals. The lower interval is nonempty for $s<2/3$, while the upper
one is nonempty for $s>1/3$; thus at least one is nonempty throughout the
path. All entries are positive, and the entries $14$ and $3$ preclude a
constant profile.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-no-nine
blocks.title: The separating level is impossible
blocks.body:
For any simple coherent positively oriented realization of $\kappa_s$,
with $0\le s\le1$, the enclosing level $c=1/R$ is different from $9$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.band_enclosing_level_ne_nine
lean.code:
theorem band_enclosing_level_ne_nine {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    {v : ZMod 6 → ℂ} (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hregular : DahlbergRegular v) (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v)
    (hκ : SignedMengerProfile v = bandProfile s) :
    1 / enclosingRadius v ≠ 9 := by
  intro heq
  have hD := enclosingDisk_minimal v
  have hcontacts : ∀ j, OnDiskBoundaryR2 v (enclosingCenter v) (enclosingRadius v) j →
      j = 0 ∨ j = 1 ∨ j = 2 := by
    intro j hj
    have hh := signedMengerProfile_inv_radius_le_of_minimal_boundary_of_cross_pos
      hsimple hregular hD hj (horient j)
    rw [hκ, heq] at hh
    fin_cases j
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)
    · norm_num [bandProfile] at hh
    · change (9 : ℝ) ≤ 7 - 3 * s at hh
      linarith [hs.1]
    · norm_num [bandProfile] at hh
  have hh := curvature_le_level_of_contacts_in_triple hsimple horient hD 1
    (by simpa only [show (1 : ZMod 6) - 1 = 0 by decide,
      show (1 : ZMod 6) + 1 = 2 by decide] using hcontacts)
  rw [hκ, heq] at hh
  norm_num [bandProfile] at hh

deps.title: Contacts confined to three consecutive vertices
deps.label: detail:hexagon-triple

blocks.tex:
If $c=9$, contact curvature is at least $9$. Entries $3,4,5$ of the profile
are smaller than $9$, so all contacts lie among indices $0,1,2$.
The three-contact bound at index $1$ then gives $11=\kappa_1\le c=9$,
a contradiction.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-endpoint-zero
blocks.title: The first endpoint is below the gap
blocks.body: Every such realization of $\kappa_0=(14,11,10,5,7,3)$ has $c\le7$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.band_zero_enclosing_level_le_seven
lean.code:
theorem band_zero_enclosing_level_le_seven
    {v : ZMod 6 → ℂ} (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hregular : DahlbergRegular v) (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v)
    (hκ : SignedMengerProfile v = bandProfile 0) :
    1 / enclosingRadius v ≤ 7 := by
  by_contra hnot
  have hgt : 7 < 1 / enclosingRadius v := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  simp only [one_div] at hgt
  have hD := enclosingDisk_minimal v
  have hc (j) (hj : OnDiskBoundaryR2 v (enclosingCenter v) (enclosingRadius v) j) :
      1 / enclosingRadius v ≤ bandProfile 0 j := by
    rw [← hκ]
    exact signedMengerProfile_inv_radius_le_of_minimal_boundary_of_cross_pos
      hsimple hregular hD hj (horient j)
  have hsub : ∀ j, OnDiskBoundaryR2 v (enclosingCenter v) (enclosingRadius v) j →
      j = 0 ∨ j = 1 ∨ j = 2 := by
    intro j hj
    have hh := hc j hj
    fin_cases j
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)
    all_goals norm_num [bandProfile] at hh; linarith
  have h11 := curvature_le_level_of_contacts_in_triple hsimple horient hD 1
    (by simpa only [show (1 : ZMod 6) - 1 = 0 by decide,
      show (1 : ZMod 6) + 1 = 2 by decide] using hsub)
  rw [hκ] at h11
  norm_num [bandProfile] at h11
  have hsub' : ∀ j, OnDiskBoundaryR2 v (enclosingCenter v) (enclosingRadius v) j →
      j = 0 ∨ j = 1 := by
    intro j hj
    have hh := hc j hj
    fin_cases j
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr rfl
    all_goals norm_num [bandProfile] at hh; linarith
  have h14 := curvature_le_level_of_contacts_in_triple hsimple horient hD 0 (by
    intro j hj
    rcases hsub' j hj with rfl | rfl <;> simp)
  rw [hκ] at h14
  norm_num [bandProfile] at h14
  have hsingle : ∀ j, OnDiskBoundaryR2 v (enclosingCenter v) (enclosingRadius v) j →
      j = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    have hh := hc j hj
    fin_cases j
    · rfl
    all_goals norm_num [bandProfile] at hh; linarith
  have hRle : enclosingRadius v ≤ 0 := by
    apply minimalEnclosingDiskR2_le_of_boundaryContactsInClosedDiskR2
      (C := v 0) hD le_rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [hsingle j hj]
    exact Metric.mem_closedBall'.mpr (by simp)
  exact (not_le_of_gt
    (radius_pos_of_minimalEnclosingDiskR2_of_isSimplePolygon hD hsimple)) hRle

deps.title: The contacts determine the minimum radius
deps.label: detail:hexagon-contact-minimality

deps.title: Contacts confined to three consecutive vertices
deps.label: detail:hexagon-triple

blocks.tex:
Suppose $c>7$. Contact curvature excludes indices $3,4,5$, so the triple at
index $1$ gives $c\ge11$. This excludes index $2$, leaving contacts only at
$0,1$. The triple at index $0$ now gives $c\ge14$, excluding index $1$ too.
All contacts would then be the single vertex $v_0$. A radius-zero disk
contains these contacts, so contact minimality forces $R\le0$, contradicting
positivity of the enclosing radius of a simple polygon.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-endpoint-one
blocks.title: The last endpoint is above the gap
blocks.body: Every such realization of $\kappa_1=(14,11,13,5,4,3)$ has $c\ge11$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.band_one_enclosing_level_ge_eleven
lean.code:
theorem band_one_enclosing_level_ge_eleven
    {v : ZMod 6 → ℂ} (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hregular : DahlbergRegular v) (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v)
    (hκ : SignedMengerProfile v = bandProfile 1) :
    11 ≤ 1 / enclosingRadius v := by
  have hnoncircle : ¬ Concyclic v := by
    intro hcircle
    have hconst := exists_constant_signedMengerProfile_of_concyclic_positiveOrientation
      hsimple hcircle horient
    exact bandProfile_nonconstant 1 (by simpa [hκ] using hconst)
  have hsupport : StrictConvexEdgeSupport v :=
    strictConvexEdgeSupport_of_simple_positiveOrientation hsimple horient
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := dahlbergE2Theorem6Lemma5ContainingDisks
    (by norm_num : 4 ≤ 6) hsimple horient hsupport
    (strictConvexCyclicChordGeometry_of_edgeSupport hsupport) hnoncircle
  by_contra hnot
  have hlt : 1 / enclosingRadius v < 11 := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  simp only [one_div] at hlt
  have hi (i : ZMod 6) (hcontains : EdgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll v i) : i = 5 := by
    have hn := containing_curvature_le_neighbors hsimple hregular horient hcontains
    have hl := signedMengerProfile_le_inv_minimalRadius_of_curvatureDiskContainsAll
      hsimple (enclosingDisk_minimal v) hcontains (horient i)
    rw [hκ] at hn hl
    fin_cases i
    · change (14 : ℝ) ≤ 3 ∧ 14 ≤ 11 at hn
      norm_num at hn
    · norm_num [bandProfile] at hl
      linarith
    · change (10 + 3 * (1 : ℝ)) ≤ 11 ∧ (10 + 3 * (1 : ℝ)) ≤ 5 at hn
      norm_num at hn
    · change (5 : ℝ) ≤ 10 + 3 * 1 ∧ 5 ≤ 7 - 3 * 1 at hn
      norm_num at hn
    · change (7 - 3 * (1 : ℝ)) ≤ 5 ∧ (7 - 3 * (1 : ℝ)) ≤ 3 at hn
      norm_num at hn
    · rfl
  have heq : D.i = D.j := (hi D.i D.contains_i).trans (hi D.j D.contains_j).symm
  exact D.distinct (congrArg (EdgePrevCurvatureCircleData v) heq)

deps.title: A containing local circle is a curvature minimum
deps.label: detail:hexagon-containing-minimum

blocks.tex:
A positively oriented concyclic polygon has constant curvature, so this
realization is not concyclic. There are two distinct containing local
circles. A containing circle occurs at a weak local curvature minimum;
for this profile only indices $1$ and $5$ qualify. Distinct circles require
distinct indices, so one is the circle at index $1$, of radius $1/11$.
Its disk encloses all vertices, hence $R\le1/11$ and $c\ge11$.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-geometric-obstruction
blocks.title: No continuous choice of the actual polygons
blocks.body:
There is no continuous vertex path $s\mapsto v(s)$ on $[0,1]$ such that
each $v(s)$ is a simple coherent positively oriented hexagon with signed
Menger curvature $\kappa_s$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.no_continuous_coherent_hexagon_path
lean.code:
theorem no_continuous_coherent_hexagon_path :
    ¬ ∃ p : ℝ → (ZMod 6 → ℂ), ContinuousOn p (Set.Icc 0 1) ∧
      ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        IsSimplePolygon (p s) ∧ DahlbergRegular (p s) ∧
        PositivePolygonOrientation (p s) ∧ SignedMengerProfile (p s) = bandProfile s := by
  rintro ⟨p, hp, hphysical⟩
  let c : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => 1 / enclosingRadius (p s)
  have hc : ContinuousOn c (Set.Icc 0 1) := by
    apply continuousOn_const.div (enclosingRadius_lipschitz.continuous.comp_continuousOn hp)
    intro s hs
    exact (radius_pos_of_minimalEnclosingDiskR2_of_isSimplePolygon
      (enclosingDisk_minimal (p s)) (hphysical s hs).1).ne'
  obtain ⟨hS0,hR0,hO0,hK0⟩ := hphysical 0 (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨hS1,hR1,hO1,hK1⟩ := hphysical 1 (by norm_num)
  have h0 : c 0 ≤ 7 := band_zero_enclosing_level_le_seven hS0 hR0 hO0 hK0
  have h1 : 11 ≤ c 1 := band_one_enclosing_level_ge_eleven hS1 hR1 hO1 hK1
  obtain ⟨s, hs, heq⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) hc
    (show (9 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (c 0) (c 1) from ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
  obtain ⟨hS,hR,hO,hK⟩ := hphysical s hs
  exact band_enclosing_level_ne_nine hs hS hR hO hK heq

deps.label: detail:hexagon-endpoint-zero

deps.title: The smallest enclosing radius is continuous
deps.label: detail:hexagon-radius-continuous

deps.title: The last endpoint is above the gap
deps.label: detail:hexagon-endpoint-one

blocks.tex:
The function $c(s)=1/R(v(s))$ would be continuous, with $c(0)\le7$ and
$c(1)\ge11$. The intermediate value theorem would give $c(s)=9$ somewhere,
contradicting the separating-level lemma.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-tabachnikov-obstruction
blocks.title: Pointwise realization without global continuous selection
blocks.body:
Each $\kappa_s$ has a realization in the moderate-arc, closed, full-turn,
simple-polygon sense of the discrete converse. There is nevertheless no
choice of lengths giving these properties for every $s\in[0,1]$ whose
realized vertices depend continuously on $s$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.no_continuous_tabachnikov_hexagon_path
lean.code:
theorem no_continuous_tabachnikov_hexagon_path :
    ¬ ∃ lengths : ℝ → (ZMod 6 → ℝ),
      ContinuousOn (fun s => polygonR2 (bandProfile s) (lengths s)) (Set.Icc 0 1) ∧
      ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ModerateArc 0 (bandProfile s) (lengths s) ∧
        closureGap (bandProfile s) (lengths s) = 0 ∧
        turningSum (bandProfile s) (lengths s) = 2 * Real.pi ∧
        IsSimplePolygon (polygonR2 (bandProfile s) (lengths s)) := by
  rintro ⟨lengths, hp, hreal⟩
  apply no_continuous_coherent_hexagon_path
  refine ⟨fun s => polygonR2 (bandProfile s) (lengths s), hp, ?_⟩
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hMA,hE,hT,hS⟩ := hreal s hs
  have hK : SignedMengerProfile (polygonR2 (bandProfile s) (lengths s)) = bandProfile s := by
    funext i
    let k := (i - 1).val
    have hk : (k : ZMod 6) = i - 1 := ZMod.natCast_rightInverse _
    have hh := signedMengerR2_development hMA k
    simpa only [SignedMengerProfile, vertexR2_eq_polygon hE hT,
      Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, hk, sub_add_cancel] using hh
  exact ⟨hS, dahlbergRegular_of_locallyRegular hS
      (locallyRegular_development_moderate hMA (bandProfile_pos hs) hE hT),
    positiveOrientation_of_signedMengerProfile_pos hS
      (by rw [hK]; exact bandProfile_pos hs), hK⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.dahlbergRegular_of_locallyRegular
lean.code:
theorem dahlbergRegular_of_locallyRegular
    {n : ℕ} {v : ZMod n → ℂ} (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hlocal : LocallyRegularR2 v) : DahlbergRegular v := by
  intro i
  obtain ⟨hcross, hcone⟩ := hlocal i
  let C := circumcenterR2 (v i) (v (i - 1)) (v (i + 1))
  have heq := circumcenterR2_equidist hcross
  have hCne : C ≠ v i := by
    intro h
    have hp : dist C (v (i - 1)) = dist C (v i) := heq.1
    rw [h, dist_self] at hp
    exact hsimple.1 (i - 1) (by simpa using (dist_eq_zero.mp hp).symm)
  right
  refine ⟨C, dist C (v i), ⟨dist_pos.mpr hCne, heq.1, rfl, heq.2⟩, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a,b,ha,hb,he⟩ := hcone
  refine ⟨a,b,ha,hb,?_⟩
  dsimp [C]
  rw [he]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.bandProfile_pointwise_realizable
lean.code:
theorem bandProfile_pointwise_realizable {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    RealizesR2 (bandProfile s) :=
  tabachnikovProblem2_all (by norm_num : 4 ≤ 6) _ (bandProfile_admissible hs)

deps.title: Moderate arcs give coherence and exact Menger curvature
deps.label: detail:discrete-coherence

deps.title: No continuous choice of the actual polygons
deps.label: detail:hexagon-geometric-obstruction

blocks.tex:
Pointwise existence follows by applying the discrete converse to the positive
admissible profile. Moderate arcs give local coherence and exact signed
Menger curvature; positivity gives positive consecutive orientation. Thus
any continuous path of realized vertices would satisfy all the hypotheses
of the geometric obstruction. This excludes even a selection assuming only
vertex continuity, without requiring continuous or differentiable lengths.

chapters.title: Projective geometry of the side-tangent construction

blocks.tex:
The companion construction uses the unit circle and its tangent lines. Write
$\langle u,v\rangle=\operatorname{Re}(\overline u v)$ and
$[u,v]=\operatorname{Im}(\overline u v)$, so
$[A,B,C]=[B-A,C-A]$. All indices in a finite fan are cyclic. The projective
map below is a projective automorphism expressed in an affine Klein-model chart; the proof uses preservation of tangent
lines and their half-planes.

blocks.label: st:tangent-intersection
blocks.title: Tangent normals and intersections
blocks.body:
Put $u(\theta)=\cos\theta+i\sin\theta$ and, for unit vectors $u,v$ with
$1+\langle u,v\rangle\ne0$, put
\[
 T(u,v)=\frac{u+v}{1+\langle u,v\rangle}.
\]
Thus $|u(\theta)|=1$, $\langle u(\alpha),u(\beta)\rangle=\cos(\beta-\alpha)$,
and $[u(\alpha),u(\beta)]=\sin(\beta-\alpha)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal
lean.code: noncomputable abbrev normal (θ : ℝ) : ℂ := circlePoint 0 1 θ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cross_normal
lean.code:
lemma cross_normal (α β : ℝ) :
    crossR2 0 (normal α) (normal β) = Real.sin (β - α) := by
  simp [crossR2, Real.sin_sub]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_im
lean.code: @[simp] lemma normal_im (θ : ℝ) : (normal θ).im = Real.sin θ := by simp [normal]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_re
lean.code: @[simp] lemma normal_re (θ : ℝ) : (normal θ).re = Real.cos θ := by simp [normal]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.norm_normal
lean.code:
@[simp] lemma norm_normal (θ : ℝ) : ‖normal θ‖ = 1 := by
  simp [normal]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.inner_normal
lean.code:
lemma inner_normal (α β : ℝ) : ⟪normal α, normal β⟫_ℝ = Real.cos (β - α) := by
  simp [Complex.inner, Real.cos_sub]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.tangentIntersection
lean.code:
noncomputable def tangentIntersection (u v : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ)⁻¹ • (u + v)

blocks.label: st:tangent-equations
blocks.title: The two tangent equations and their continuous extension
blocks.body:
The intersection is symmetric and satisfies
$\langle u,T(u,v)\rangle=\langle v,T(u,v)\rangle=1$.
For $0\le\beta-\alpha<\pi$ its denominator is positive.
The normal map is continuous, and $T$ is jointly continuous wherever its
denominator is nonzero, including $T(u,u)=u$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.inner_tangentIntersection_right
lean.code:
lemma inner_tangentIntersection_right {u v : ℂ} (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) : ⟪v, tangentIntersection u v⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
  rw [tangentIntersection_comm]
  exact inner_tangentIntersection_left hv (by rwa [real_inner_comm])

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.inner_tangentIntersection_left
lean.code:
lemma inner_tangentIntersection_left {u v : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) : ⟪u, tangentIntersection u v⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
  simp only [tangentIntersection, real_inner_smul_right, inner_add_right,
    real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu, one_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hd]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_denominator_pos
lean.code:
lemma normal_denominator_pos {α β : ℝ} (h₀ : α ≤ β) (hπ : β - α < Real.pi) :
    0 < 1 + ⟪normal α, normal β⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [inner_normal]
  have h := Real.cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (sub_nonneg.mpr h₀) le_rfl hπ
  rw [Real.cos_pi] at h
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.continuousAt_tangentIntersection
lean.code:
lemma continuousAt_tangentIntersection {u v : ℂ} (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousAt (fun p : ℂ × ℂ ↦ tangentIntersection p.1 p.2) (u, v) := by
  have hc : ContinuousAt (fun p : ℂ × ℂ ↦ 1 + ⟪p.1, p.2⟫_ℝ) (u, v) :=
    continuousAt_const.add (continuous_fst.inner continuous_snd).continuousAt
  exact (hc.inv₀ hd).smul (continuous_fst.add continuous_snd).continuousAt

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.continuous_normal
lean.code:
lemma continuous_normal : Continuous normal := by
  change Continuous (circleMap 0 1)
  fun_prop

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.tangentIntersection_comm
lean.code:
lemma tangentIntersection_comm (u v : ℂ) :
    tangentIntersection u v = tangentIntersection v u := by
  simp only [tangentIntersection, real_inner_comm u v, add_comm u v]

blocks.tex:
Take the scalar product of the displayed formula with either unit normal.
The denominator is $1+\cos(\beta-\alpha)>0$ on the stated angular range.
The formulas are sums, scalar products and division by a nonzero continuous
function, which also proves continuity at coincident normals.

blocks.label: st:fan-support
blocks.title: Ordered circle points and strict tangent support
blocks.body:
For unit $u,v$ and nonzero tangent denominator,
\[
 [u,v,w]=[u,v]\bigl(1-\langle w,T(u,v)\rangle\bigr).
\]
For $\alpha<\beta<\gamma<\alpha+2\pi$ and $\beta-\alpha<\pi$,
$\langle u(\gamma),T(u(\alpha),u(\beta))\rangle<1$.
The same holds when $\gamma<\alpha<\beta<\gamma+2\pi$.
More generally, for $z(\theta)=c+Re^{i\theta}$,
\[
 [z(\alpha),z(\beta),z(\gamma)]
 =4R^2\sin\frac{\beta-\alpha}{2}\sin\frac{\gamma-\beta}{2}
       \sin\frac{\gamma-\alpha}{2}>0
\]
when $R\ne0$ and the three angles have the first cyclic ordering.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.circlePoint
lean.code: noncomputable abbrev circlePoint (O : ℂ) (R θ : ℝ) : ℂ := circleMap O R θ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_ordered
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_ordered
    (O : ℂ) {R θ₀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ} (hR : R ≠ 0)
    (h₀₁ : θ₀ < θ₁) (h₁₂ : θ₁ < θ₂) (hspan : θ₂ < θ₀ + 2 * Real.pi) :
    0 < crossR2 (circlePoint O R θ₀) (circlePoint O R θ₁)
      (circlePoint O R θ₂) := by
  have hsin₀₁ : 0 < Real.sin ((θ₁ - θ₀) / 2) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hsin₁₂ : 0 < Real.sin ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hsin₀₂ : 0 < Real.sin ((θ₂ - θ₀) / 2) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith)
  rw [crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_half]
  positivity

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_sub
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_sub
    (O : ℂ) (R θ₀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ) :
    crossR2 (circlePoint O R θ₀) (circlePoint O R θ₁) (circlePoint O R θ₂) =
      R ^ 2 * (Real.sin (θ₁ - θ₀) + Real.sin (θ₂ - θ₁) -
        Real.sin (θ₂ - θ₀)) := by
  change crossR2 (circleMap O R θ₀) (circleMap O R θ₁) (circleMap O R θ₂) = _
  unfold crossR2
  simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, circlePoint_re, circlePoint_im]
  rw [Real.sin_sub, Real.sin_sub, Real.sin_sub]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cross_eq_tangent_support
lean.code:
lemma cross_eq_tangent_support {u v : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) (w : ℂ) :
    crossR2 u v w = crossR2 0 u v * (1 - ⟪w, tangentIntersection u v⟫_ℝ) := by
  have hu' : u.re ^ 2 + u.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := Complex.sq_norm u
    rw [hu, Complex.normSq_apply] at h
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hv' : v.re ^ 2 + v.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := Complex.sq_norm v
    rw [hv, Complex.normSq_apply] at h
    nlinarith only [h]
  simp only [tangentIntersection, real_inner_smul_right, inner_add_right]
  field_simp
  simp [crossR2, Complex.inner]
  linear_combination (u.re * w.im - u.im * w.re) * hv' -
    (v.re * w.im - v.im * w.re) * hu'

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.circlePoint_im
lean.code:
@[simp] theorem circlePoint_im (O : ℂ) (R θ : ℝ) :
    (circlePoint O R θ).im = O.im + R * Real.sin θ := by
  change (circleMap O R θ).im = _
  simp [circleMap]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_half
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_half
    (O : ℂ) (R θ₀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ) :
    crossR2 (circlePoint O R θ₀) (circlePoint O R θ₁) (circlePoint O R θ₂) =
      4 * R ^ 2 * Real.sin ((θ₁ - θ₀) / 2) *
        Real.sin ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) * Real.sin ((θ₂ - θ₀) / 2) := by
  rw [crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_sub]
  have hsum : θ₂ - θ₀ = (θ₁ - θ₀) + (θ₂ - θ₁) := by ring
  rw [hsum, sin_add_sin_sub_sin_add]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.circlePoint_add_two_pi
lean.code:
@[simp] theorem circlePoint_add_two_pi (O : ℂ) (R θ : ℝ) :
    circlePoint O R (θ + 2 * Real.pi) = circlePoint O R θ := by
  change circleMap O R (θ + 2 * Real.pi) = circleMap O R θ
  exact periodic_circleMap O R θ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.circlePoint_re
lean.code:
@[simp] theorem circlePoint_re (O : ℂ) (R θ : ℝ) :
    (circlePoint O R θ).re = O.re + R * Real.cos θ := by
  change (circleMap O R θ).re = _
  simp [circleMap]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_support_lt_of_wrapped
lean.code:
lemma normal_support_lt_of_wrapped {α β γ : ℝ} (hγα : γ < α)
    (hαβ : α < β) (hgap : β - α < Real.pi) (hspan : β < γ + 2 * Real.pi) :
    ⟪normal γ, tangentIntersection (normal α) (normal β)⟫_ℝ < 1 := by
  have h := normal_support_lt_of_ordered hαβ hgap hspan
    (by linarith : γ + 2 * Real.pi < α + 2 * Real.pi)
  simpa only [normal, circlePoint_add_two_pi] using h

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_support_lt_of_ordered
lean.code:
lemma normal_support_lt_of_ordered {α β γ : ℝ} (hαβ : α < β)
    (hgap : β - α < Real.pi) (hβγ : β < γ) (hspan : γ < α + 2 * Real.pi) :
    ⟪normal γ, tangentIntersection (normal α) (normal β)⟫_ℝ < 1 := by
  have h := crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_ordered 0 (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
    hαβ hβγ hspan
  rw [cross_eq_tangent_support (norm_normal α) (norm_normal β)
    (normal_denominator_pos hαβ.le hgap).ne', cross_normal] at h
  have hs := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (sub_pos.mpr hαβ) hgap
  nlinarith

deps.title: The two tangent equations and their continuous extension
deps.label: st:tangent-equations

blocks.tex:
Expand the determinant and use $|u|=|v|=1$ for the duality identity.
For three circle points the expansion first gives
$R^2(\sin(\gamma-\beta)+\sin(\beta-\alpha)-\sin(\gamma-\alpha))$;
half-angle identities give the product. Its three factors are positive in
one cyclic turn. Divide the duality identity by
$[u(\alpha),u(\beta)]=\sin(\beta-\alpha)>0$.
For the wrapped case replace $\gamma$ by $\gamma+2\pi$.

blocks.label: st:interior-contact
blocks.title: Interior contacts and positive tangent edges
blocks.body:
For unit $u,v,w$ with $[u,v]>0$ and $[v,w]>0$, define
$\alpha=[u,v]/(1+\langle u,v\rangle)>0$ and
$\beta=[v,w]/(1+\langle v,w\rangle)>0$. Then
\[
 T(u,v)=v-\alpha iv,\qquad T(v,w)=v+\beta iv,
 \qquad T(v,w)-T(u,v)=(\alpha+\beta)iv.
\]
In particular $v$ lies in the open segment joining the two tangent vertices,
and that segment is nonzero and positively directed along $iv$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.tangentIntersection_eq_add
lean.code:
lemma tangentIntersection_eq_add {u v : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) :
    tangentIntersection u v = u + (crossR2 0 u v / (1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ)) • (Complex.I * u) := by
  have hu' : u.re ^ 2 + u.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := Complex.sq_norm u
    rw [hu, Complex.normSq_apply] at h
    nlinarith only [h]
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [tangentIntersection, Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im,
      Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, zero_mul, one_mul, zero_sub, zero_add,
      smul_eq_mul]
  all_goals field_simp
  all_goals simp [crossR2, Complex.inner]
  · linear_combination -v.re * hu'
  · linear_combination -v.im * hu'

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.tangentIntersection_eq_sub
lean.code:
lemma tangentIntersection_eq_sub {u v : ℂ} (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) :
    tangentIntersection u v = v - (crossR2 0 u v / (1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ)) • (Complex.I * v) := by
  rw [tangentIntersection_comm, tangentIntersection_eq_add hv (by rwa [real_inner_comm])]
  simp only [crossR2_swap 0 u v, real_inner_comm v u, neg_div, neg_smul, sub_eq_add_neg]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.tangent_edge_eq_pos_smul
lean.code:
lemma tangent_edge_eq_pos_smul {u v w : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (h₁ : 0 < crossR2 0 u v) (h₂ : 0 < crossR2 0 v w) :
    ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ tangentIntersection v w - tangentIntersection u v =
      ℓ • (Complex.I * v) := by
  have hd₁ := normal_pair_denominator_pos hu hv h₁
  have hd₂ := normal_pair_denominator_pos hv hw h₂
  refine ⟨crossR2 0 u v / (1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ) +
    crossR2 0 v w / (1 + ⟪v, w⟫_ℝ), add_pos (div_pos h₁ hd₁) (div_pos h₂ hd₂), ?_⟩
  rw [tangentIntersection_eq_sub hv hd₁.ne', tangentIntersection_eq_add hv hd₂.ne', add_smul]
  abel

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_pair_denominator_pos
lean.code:
lemma normal_pair_denominator_pos {u v : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hc : 0 < crossR2 0 u v) : 0 < 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ := by
  have huv : u + v ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    have hvu : v = -u := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right he
    rw [hvu] at hc
    simp [crossR2, mul_comm] at hc
  have h := norm_add_sq_real u v
  rw [hu, hv] at h
  have hp := sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr huv)
  nlinarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.contact_mem_openSegment
lean.code:
theorem contact_mem_openSegment {u v w : ℂ} (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hd₁ : 0 < 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ) (hd₂ : 0 < 1 + ⟪v, w⟫_ℝ)
    (h₁ : 0 < crossR2 0 u v) (h₂ : 0 < crossR2 0 v w) :
    v ∈ openSegment ℝ (tangentIntersection u v) (tangentIntersection v w) := by
  let α := crossR2 0 u v / (1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ)
  let β := crossR2 0 v w / (1 + ⟪v, w⟫_ℝ)
  have hα : 0 < α := div_pos h₁ hd₁
  have hβ : 0 < β := div_pos h₂ hd₂
  have hab : 0 < α + β := add_pos hα hβ
  refine ⟨β / (α + β), α / (α + β), div_pos hβ hab, div_pos hα hab, ?_, ?_⟩
  · field_simp
    ring
  · rw [tangentIntersection_eq_sub hv hd₁.ne', tangentIntersection_eq_add hv hd₂.ne']
    change (β / (α + β)) • (v - α • (Complex.I * v)) +
      (α / (α + β)) • (v + β • (Complex.I * v)) = v
    match_scalars <;> field_simp <;> ring

deps.label: st:tangent-equations

blocks.tex:
Positive determinant excludes antipodal unit vectors; the squared norm of
$u+v$ gives $1+\langle u,v\rangle>0$. Expand the two tangent-frame identities.
The coefficients $\beta/(\alpha+\beta)$ and $\alpha/(\alpha+\beta)$ express
$v$ as a strictly interior convex combination. Subtraction gives the edge formula.

blocks.label: st:projective-map
blocks.title: Projective ball normalization
blocks.body:
For $a\in\mathbb C$ and $\sigma>0$ with $\sigma^2+|a|^2=1$, set
\[
 D_a(x)=1-\langle a,x\rangle,\quad
 A_a(x)=\sigma x+\left(\frac{\langle a,x\rangle}{1+\sigma}-1\right)a,
 \qquad B_a(x)=\frac{A_a(x)}{D_a(x)}.
\]
All geometric applications use the positive chart $D_a(x)>0$.

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.denominator
lean.code: def denominator (a x : E) : ℝ := 1 - ⟪a, x⟫_ℝ

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.transform
lean.code:
noncomputable def transform (a : E) (σ : ℝ) (x : E) : E :=
  (denominator a x)⁻¹ • numerator a σ x

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.numerator
lean.code:
noncomputable def numerator (a : E) (σ : ℝ) (x : E) : E :=
  σ • x + (⟪a, x⟫_ℝ / (1 + σ) - 1) • a

blocks.label: st:projective-support
blocks.title: The bilinear identity and tangent half-planes
blocks.body:
The numerator satisfies
$\langle A_a(x),A_a(y)\rangle-D_a(x)D_a(y)
=\sigma^2(\langle x,y\rangle-1)$. Hence, wherever both denominators are nonzero,
\[
 1-\langle B_a(x),B_a(y)\rangle
 =\frac{\sigma^2(1-\langle x,y\rangle)}{D_a(x)D_a(y)}.
\]
Unit normals remain unit, and tangent equations remain tangent equations.
With positive denominators, a strict inequality $\langle x,y\rangle<1$
is equivalent to the same inequality for their images.
If $|a|<1$ and $|x|\le1$, then $D_a(x)>0$.

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one
lean.code:
theorem denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one {a x : E} (ha : ‖a‖ < 1) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) :
    0 < denominator a x := by
  have h := real_inner_le_norm a x
  dsimp [denominator]
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg a, norm_nonneg x]

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.one_sub_inner_transform
lean.code:
theorem one_sub_inner_transform (a x y : E) {σ : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1)
    (hx : denominator a x ≠ 0) (hy : denominator a y ≠ 0) :
    1 - ⟪transform a σ x, transform a σ y⟫_ℝ =
      σ ^ 2 * (1 - ⟪x, y⟫_ℝ) / (denominator a x * denominator a y) := by
  have h := numerator_inner_sub a x y hσ hsq
  simp only [transform, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
  field_simp
  nlinarith only [h]

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.inner_transform_eq_one
lean.code:
theorem inner_transform_eq_one {a u x : E} {σ : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1)
    (hu : denominator a u ≠ 0) (hx : denominator a x ≠ 0)
    (htangent : ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ = 1) :
    ⟪transform a σ u, transform a σ x⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
  have h := one_sub_inner_transform a u x hσ hsq hu hx
  rw [htangent, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_div] at h
  linarith

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.numerator_inner_sub
lean.code:
theorem numerator_inner_sub (a x y : E) {σ : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1) :
    ⟪numerator a σ x, numerator a σ y⟫_ℝ - denominator a x * denominator a y =
      σ ^ 2 * (⟪x, y⟫_ℝ - 1) := by
  have ha : ⟪a, a⟫_ℝ = 1 - σ ^ 2 := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    linarith
  simp only [numerator, denominator, inner_add_left, inner_add_right,
    real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_comm a x, ha]
  field_simp
  ring

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.norm_transform_eq_one
lean.code:
theorem norm_transform_eq_one {a u : E} {σ : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1)
    (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hden : denominator a u ≠ 0) :
    ‖transform a σ u‖ = 1 := by
  have h := one_sub_inner_transform a u u hσ hsq hden hden
  simp only [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu, one_pow, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_div] at h
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (transform a σ u)]

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.inner_transform_lt_one_iff
lean.code:
theorem inner_transform_lt_one_iff {a u x : E} {σ : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1)
    (hu : 0 < denominator a u) (hx : 0 < denominator a x) :
    ⟪transform a σ u, transform a σ x⟫_ℝ < 1 ↔ ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ < 1 := by
  rw [← sub_pos, one_sub_inner_transform a u x hσ hsq hu.ne' hx.ne',
    div_pos_iff_of_pos_right (mul_pos hu hx),
    mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left (sq_pos_of_pos hσ), sub_pos]

blocks.tex:
Expand the numerator and substitute $|a|^2=1-\sigma^2$. Division gives the
normalized identity. Set $x=y$ for preservation of the unit circle; set the
inner product to one for tangent incidence; take signs for strict support.
Finally $\langle a,x\rangle\le|a|\,|x|<1$ on the closed unit ball.

blocks.label: st:projective-orientation
blocks.title: Orientation in the positive chart
blocks.body:
For any $x,y$,
\[
 [B_a(x),B_a(y)]
 =\frac{\sigma\bigl([x,y]+[a,x-y]\bigr)}{D_a(x)D_a(y)}.
\]
In particular, for adjacent unit normals with $[u,v]>0$,
\[
 [B_a(u),B_a(v)]
 =\frac{\sigma[u,v]D_a(T(u,v))}{D_a(u)D_a(v)}>0
\]
provided $|a|<1$ and $D_a(T(u,v))>0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cross_transform_normals
lean.code:
lemma cross_transform_normals {a u v : ℂ} {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1) (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) :
    crossR2 0 (ProjectiveBall.transform a σ u) (ProjectiveBall.transform a σ v) =
      σ * crossR2 0 u v * ProjectiveBall.denominator a (tangentIntersection u v) /
        (ProjectiveBall.denominator a u * ProjectiveBall.denominator a v) := by
  have he : ProjectiveBall.area u v + ProjectiveBall.area a (u - v) =
      crossR2 u v a := by
    simp only [ProjectiveBall.area, crossR2, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
    ring
  have h := ProjectiveBall.area_transform a u v hσ hsq
  rw [he, cross_eq_tangent_support hu hv hd a] at h
  simpa only [crossR2, Complex.zero_re, Complex.zero_im, sub_zero,
    ProjectiveBall.area, ProjectiveBall.denominator, mul_assoc] using h

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.area_numerator
lean.code:
lemma area_numerator (a u v : ℂ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1) :
    area (numerator a σ u) (numerator a σ v) =
      σ * (area u v + area a (u - v)) := by
  have ha : σ ^ 2 + (a.re ^ 2 + a.im ^ 2) = 1 := by
    simpa only [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply, ← pow_two] using hsq
  simp only [area, numerator, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_re,
    Complex.smul_im, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.inner, Complex.mul_re,
    Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp
  linear_combination σ * (1 + σ) * (u.re * v.im - u.im * v.re) * ha

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.area_transform
lean.code:
theorem area_transform (a u v : ℂ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1) :
    area (transform a σ u) (transform a σ v) =
      σ * (area u v + area a (u - v)) / (denominator a u * denominator a v) := by
  have h := area_numerator a u v hσ hsq
  simp only [transform, area, Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul,
    Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
  simp only [area, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im] at h
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev]
  linear_combination (denominator a u)⁻¹ * (denominator a v)⁻¹ * h

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cross_transform_normals_pos
lean.code:
lemma cross_transform_normals_pos {a u v : ℂ} {σ : ℝ} (ha : ‖a‖ < 1)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1) (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hc : 0 < crossR2 0 u v)
    (hx : 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (tangentIntersection u v)) :
    0 < crossR2 0 (ProjectiveBall.transform a σ u) (ProjectiveBall.transform a σ v) := by
  rw [cross_transform_normals hσ hsq hu hv (normal_pair_denominator_pos hu hv hc).ne']
  exact div_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos hσ hc) hx)
    (mul_pos (ProjectiveBall.denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one ha hu.le)
      (ProjectiveBall.denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one ha hv.le))

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.area
lean.code: def area (u v : ℂ) : ℝ := u.re * v.im - u.im * v.re

deps.title: Ordered circle points and strict tangent support
deps.label: st:fan-support

blocks.tex:
The determinant of the two numerators is
$\sigma([x,y]+[a,x-y])$, by direct expansion and the relation between
$\sigma$ and $a$. For unit $u,v$, the numerator in parentheses equals
$[u,v,a]$. Apply the tangent-support identity and use positivity of all factors.
This is why positive denominators are checked at the tangent vertices as well
as at the unit normals.

blocks.label: st:projective-intersection
blocks.title: Projective transport of tangent intersections
blocks.body:
Under the hypotheses of the preceding orientation lemma,
\[
 B_a(T(u,v))=T(B_a(u),B_a(v)).
\]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.transform_tangentIntersection
lean.code:
lemma transform_tangentIntersection {a u v : ℂ} {σ : ℝ} (ha : ‖a‖ < 1)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1) (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hc : 0 < crossR2 0 u v)
    (hx : 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (tangentIntersection u v)) :
    ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (tangentIntersection u v) =
      tangentIntersection (ProjectiveBall.transform a σ u) (ProjectiveBall.transform a σ v) := by
  have hdu := ProjectiveBall.denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one ha hu.le
  have hdv := ProjectiveBall.denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one ha hv.le
  have hu' := ProjectiveBall.norm_transform_eq_one hσ hsq hu hdu.ne'
  have hv' := ProjectiveBall.norm_transform_eq_one hσ hsq hv hdv.ne'
  have hc' := cross_transform_normals_pos ha hσ hsq hu hv hc hx
  have hd := (normal_pair_denominator_pos hu hv hc).ne'
  have hd' := (normal_pair_denominator_pos hu' hv' hc').ne'
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply eq_zero_of_two_inner_eq_zero hc'.ne'
  · rw [inner_sub_right, ProjectiveBall.inner_transform_eq_one hσ hsq hdu.ne' hx.ne'
      (inner_tangentIntersection_left hu hd), inner_tangentIntersection_left hu' hd']
    exact sub_self 1
  · rw [inner_sub_right, ProjectiveBall.inner_transform_eq_one hσ hsq hdv.ne' hx.ne'
      (inner_tangentIntersection_right hv hd), inner_tangentIntersection_right hv' hd']
    exact sub_self 1

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.eq_zero_of_two_inner_eq_zero
lean.code:
lemma eq_zero_of_two_inner_eq_zero {u v z : ℂ} (hcross : crossR2 0 u v ≠ 0)
    (hu : ⟪u, z⟫_ℝ = 0) (hv : ⟪v, z⟫_ℝ = 0) : z = 0 := by
  have hre : crossR2 0 u v * z.re = 0 := by
    simp only [Complex.inner, Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im] at hu hv
    simp only [crossR2, sub_zero]
    linear_combination v.im * hu - u.im * hv
  have him : crossR2 0 u v * z.im = 0 := by
    simp only [Complex.inner, Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im] at hu hv
    simp only [crossR2, sub_zero]
    linear_combination u.re * hv - v.re * hu
  exact Complex.ext ((mul_eq_zero.mp hre).resolve_left hcross)
    ((mul_eq_zero.mp him).resolve_left hcross)

deps.label: st:tangent-equations

deps.title: The bilinear identity and tangent half-planes
deps.label: st:projective-support

blocks.tex:
Both sides have inner product one with the two transformed unit normals.
Their determinant is positive, so these two linear equations have a unique
solution: subtract them and invert the nonsingular two-by-two coefficient
matrix. This proves equality of the actual vertices.

blocks.label: st:projective-field
blocks.title: The labelled balancing field
blocks.body:
For a finite labelled configuration $x_i$ and fixed real coefficients $c_i$, set
\[
 F_x(a)=\sum_i\frac{c_i x_i}{D_a(x_i)}.
\]
The coefficients, including zero coefficients, remain attached to their original labels.

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.field
lean.code:
noncomputable def field (c : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → E) (a : E) : E :=
  ∑ i, (c i / denominator a (x i)) • x i

blocks.label: st:projective-balance
blocks.title: A field zero gives exact projective balance
blocks.body:
If all denominators are nonzero, $\sum_i c_i=0$ and $F_x(a)=0$, then
$\sum_i c_i B_a(x_i)=0$. More explicitly,
\[
 \sum_i\frac{c_i}{D_a(x_i)}=\sum_i c_i+\langle a,F_x(a)\rangle.
\]
For arbitrary weights $w_i$ the numerator sum is
\[
 \sum_iw_iA_a(x_i)=\sigma\sum_iw_ix_i+
 \left(\frac{\langle a,\sum_iw_ix_i\rangle}{1+\sigma}-\sum_iw_i\right)a.
\]

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.sum_smul_transform_eq_zero_of_field_eq_zero
lean.code:
theorem sum_smul_transform_eq_zero_of_field_eq_zero (c : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → E)
    (a : E) (σ : ℝ) (hden : ∀ i, denominator a (x i) ≠ 0)
    (hsum : ∑ i, c i = 0) (hfield : field c x a = 0) :
    ∑ i, c i • transform a σ (x i) = 0 := by
  have hw : ∑ i, c i / denominator a (x i) = 0 := by
    rw [sum_div_denominator c x a hden, hsum, hfield, inner_zero_right, add_zero]
  have he : ∑ i, c i • transform a σ (x i) =
      ∑ i, (c i / denominator a (x i)) • numerator a σ (x i) := by
    simp only [transform, smul_smul, div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [he, sum_smul_numerator]
  change σ • field c x a + (⟪a, field c x a⟫_ℝ / (1 + σ) - _) • a = 0
  simp only [hfield, inner_zero_right, zero_div, hw, sub_self, smul_zero, zero_smul, add_zero]

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.sum_div_denominator
lean.code:
lemma sum_div_denominator (c : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → E) (a : E)
    (hden : ∀ i, denominator a (x i) ≠ 0) :
    ∑ i, c i / denominator a (x i) = (∑ i, c i) + ⟪a, field c x a⟫_ℝ := by
  have hi : ∀ i, c i / denominator a (x i) =
      c i + (c i / denominator a (x i)) * ⟪a, x i⟫_ℝ := by
    intro i
    have hn := hden i
    unfold denominator at hn ⊢
    field_simp
    ring
  simpa only [field, inner_sum, real_inner_smul_right, Finset.sum_add_distrib] using
    Finset.sum_congr (s₁ := Finset.univ) rfl (fun i _ ↦ hi i)

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.sum_smul_numerator
lean.code:
lemma sum_smul_numerator (w : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → E) (a : E) (σ : ℝ) :
    ∑ i, w i • numerator a σ (x i) =
      σ • (∑ i, w i • x i) +
        (⟪a, ∑ i, w i • x i⟫_ℝ / (1 + σ) - ∑ i, w i) • a := by
  simp only [numerator, smul_add, smul_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    inner_sum, real_inner_smul_right]
  simp only [Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul, mul_sub, mul_one, sub_smul, ← mul_div_assoc,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_smul, ← Finset.sum_div, mul_comm]

blocks.tex:
Use $D_a(x_i)+\langle a,x_i\rangle=1$ for the first identity and linearity
for the second. Substitute $w_i=c_i/D_a(x_i)$; both the weighted vector sum
and the weight sum vanish, giving the asserted balance without changing any coefficient.

blocks.label: st:strict-fan
blocks.title: Strict tangential fan
blocks.body:
A strict tangential fan is a cyclic family of unit normals $U_i$ and vertices
$Y_i=T(U_i,U_{i+1})$ with $[U_i,U_{i+1}]>0$ and
$\langle U_j,Y_i\rangle<1$ for $j\ne i,i+1$.
The geometric record also includes $U_{i+1}\in(Y_i,Y_{i+1})$,
$Y_{i+1}-Y_i=\ell_i iU_{i+1}$ with $\ell_i>0$, nonzero edges, and
$[Y_i,Y_{i+1},Y_j]>0$ for every nonincident vertex $j$.
Either finite representatives or $\mathbb Z/n$ may index the same cyclic data.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan
lean.code:
structure IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan [NeZero n] (U Y : ZMod n → ℂ) : Prop where
  unit_normal : ∀ i, ‖U i‖ = 1
  normal_cross_pos : ∀ i, 0 < crossR2 0 (U i) (U (i + 1))
  vertex_eq : ∀ i, Y i = tangentIntersection (U i) (U (i + 1))
  strict_support : ∀ i j, j ≠ i → j ≠ i + 1 → ⟪U j, Y i⟫_ℝ < 1
  contact_interior : ∀ i, U (i + 1) ∈ openSegment ℝ (Y i) (Y (i + 1))
  edge_pos : ∀ i, ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ Y (i + 1) - Y i = ℓ • (Complex.I * U (i + 1))
  edge_ne : ∀ i, Y (i + 1) ≠ Y i
  cross_support : StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsStrictTangentialFan
lean.code:
structure IsStrictTangentialFan {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (U Y : Fin n → ℂ) : Prop where
  unit_normal : ∀ i, ‖U i‖ = 1
  normal_cross_pos : ∀ i, 0 < crossR2 0 (U i) (U (i + 1))
  vertex_eq : ∀ i, Y i = tangentIntersection (U i) (U (i + 1))
  strict_support : ∀ i j, j ≠ i → j ≠ i + 1 → ⟪U j, Y i⟫_ℝ < 1
  contact_interior : ∀ i, U (i + 1) ∈ openSegment ℝ (Y i) (Y (i + 1))
  edge_pos : ∀ i, ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ Y (i + 1) - Y i = ℓ • (Complex.I * U (i + 1))
  edge_ne : ∀ i, Y (i + 1) ≠ Y i
  cross_support : ∀ i j, j ≠ i → j ≠ i + 1 → 0 < crossR2 (Y i) (Y (i + 1)) (Y j)

blocks.label: st:strict-fan-geometry
blocks.title: The elementary data imply all strict-fan properties
blocks.body:
Unit normals, positive successive determinants, tangent intersection identities
and strict nonincident support imply the full strict-fan record.
For an edge $y-x=\ell iu$ with $\langle u,x\rangle=1$,
\[
 [x,y,z]=\ell(1-\langle u,z\rangle).
\]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.isStrictTangentialFan_of_geometry
lean.code:
theorem isStrictTangentialFan_of_geometry {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {U Y : Fin n → ℂ}
    (hu : ∀ i, ‖U i‖ = 1) (hc : ∀ i, 0 < crossR2 0 (U i) (U (i + 1)))
    (hy : ∀ i, Y i = tangentIntersection (U i) (U (i + 1)))
    (hs : ∀ i j, j ≠ i → j ≠ i + 1 → ⟪U j, Y i⟫_ℝ < 1) :
    IsStrictTangentialFan U Y := by
  have he : ∀ i, ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ Y (i + 1) - Y i = ℓ • (Complex.I * U (i + 1)) := by
    intro i
    rw [hy i, hy (i + 1)]
    exact tangent_edge_eq_pos_smul (hu i) (hu (i + 1)) (hu (i + 1 + 1)) (hc i) (hc (i + 1))
  refine ⟨hu, hc, hy, hs, ?_, he, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    rw [hy i, hy (i + 1)]
    exact contact_mem_openSegment (hu (i + 1))
      (normal_pair_denominator_pos (hu i) (hu (i + 1)) (hc i))
      (normal_pair_denominator_pos (hu (i + 1)) (hu (i + 1 + 1)) (hc (i + 1)))
      (hc i) (hc (i + 1))
  · intro i hzero
    obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ, heq⟩ := he i
    have hu₀ : U (i + 1) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      simpa [h] using hu (i + 1)
    have hn := smul_ne_zero hℓ.ne' (mul_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero hu₀)
    apply hn
    rw [← heq, hzero, sub_self]
  · intro i j hji hjnext
    obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ, heq⟩ := he i
    have hi : ⟪U (i + 1), Y i⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
      rw [hy i]
      exact inner_tangentIntersection_right (hu (i + 1))
        (normal_pair_denominator_pos (hu i) (hu (i + 1)) (hc i)).ne'
    rw [cross_of_tangent_edge heq hi]
    exact mul_pos hℓ (sub_pos.mpr (hs j (i + 1) hjnext.symm
      (fun h ↦ hji (add_right_cancel h).symm)))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cross_of_tangent_edge
lean.code:
lemma cross_of_tangent_edge {u x y z : ℂ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hedge : y - x = ℓ • (Complex.I * u)) (hux : ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ = 1) :
    crossR2 x y z = ℓ * (1 - ⟪u, z⟫_ℝ) := by
  change (y - x).re * (z - x).im - (y - x).im * (z - x).re = _
  rw [hedge]
  simp only [Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
    Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, zero_mul, one_mul, zero_sub, zero_add,
    Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, smul_eq_mul, Complex.inner,
    Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im]
  simp only [Complex.inner, Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im] at hux
  linear_combination ℓ * hux

deps.title: Interior contacts and positive tangent edges
deps.label: st:interior-contact

blocks.tex:
The contact lemma supplies positive tangent lengths and interior contacts.
A positive multiple of a rotated unit vector is nonzero. The determinant
identity follows by expanding the inner product; strict support then makes
every nonincident vertex lie strictly to the left of the edge.

blocks.label: st:projective-fan
blocks.title: The finite square perturbation has strict geometry
blocks.body:
Take the square-perturbation angles with $0<\eta\le1$ from the balancing
construction. Apply $B_a$ to their normals and tangent vertices, with
$|a|<1$, $\sigma>0$, $\sigma^2+|a|^2=1$, and positive vertex denominators.
The result is a strict tangential fan. The last angular successor $2\pi$
represents the first normal, so this assertion includes the cyclic seam.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.projective_squareFan_isStrictTangentialFan
lean.code:
theorem projective_squareFan_isStrictTangentialFan {n p q r : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη₁ : η ≤ 1) {a : ℂ} {σ : ℝ} (ha : ‖a‖ < 1)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1)
    (hd : ∀ i : Fin n, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (fanVertex n p q r η i)) :
    IsStrictTangentialFan
      (fun i : Fin n ↦ ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (normal (fanAngle n p q r η i)))
      (fun i : Fin n ↦ ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (fanVertex n p q r η i)) := by
  have hnorm : ∀ i : Fin n, ‖normal (fanAngle n p q r η i)‖ = 1 := fun i ↦ norm_normal _
  have hdn : ∀ i : Fin n, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (normal (fanAngle n p q r η i)) :=
    fun i ↦ ProjectiveBall.denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one ha (hnorm i).le
  have hc := fan_normal_cross_pos hn hp hpq hqr hr hη hη₁
  have hy := fanVertex_eq_cyclic hn hpq hqr hr η
  apply isStrictTangentialFan_of_geometry
  · intro i
    exact ProjectiveBall.norm_transform_eq_one hσ hsq (hnorm i) (hdn i).ne'
  · intro i
    exact cross_transform_normals_pos ha hσ hsq (hnorm i) (hnorm (i + 1)) (hc i)
      (by rw [← hy i]; exact hd i)
  · intro i
    rw [hy i]
    exact transform_tangentIntersection ha hσ hsq (hnorm i) (hnorm (i + 1)) (hc i)
      (by rw [← hy i]; exact hd i)
  · intro i j hji hjnext
    exact (ProjectiveBall.inner_transform_lt_one_iff hσ hsq (hdn j) (hd i)).mpr
      (fanVertex_strict_support hn hp hpq hqr hr hη hη₁ i j hji hjnext)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fanVertex_eq_cyclic
lean.code:
lemma fanVertex_eq_cyclic {n p q r : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n) (η : ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    fanVertex n p q r η i = tangentIntersection (normal (fanAngle n p q r η i))
      (normal (fanAngle n p q r η (i + 1 : Fin n))) := by
  rw [normal_fanAngle_succ hn hpq hqr hr]
  rfl

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fan_normal_cross_pos
lean.code:
lemma fan_normal_cross_pos {n p q r : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n) {η : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη₁ : η ≤ 1) (i : Fin n) :
    0 < crossR2 0 (normal (fanAngle n p q r η i))
      (normal (fanAngle n p q r η (i + 1 : Fin n))) := by
  rw [normal_fanAngle_succ hn hpq hqr hr, cross_normal]
  exact Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi
    (sub_pos.mpr (fanAngle_strictMono (by omega) hη hη₁ (Nat.lt_succ_self _)))
    (fanAngle_step_lt_pi hn hp hpq hqr hη.le hη₁ i)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_fanAngle_succ
lean.code:
lemma normal_fanAngle_succ {n p q r : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n) (η : ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    normal (fanAngle n p q r η (i + 1 : Fin n)) =
      normal (fanAngle n p q r η ((i : ℕ) + 1)) := by
  have h_one : (1 : Fin n).val = 1 := by
    rw [Fin.val_one', Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < n)]
  by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n
  · rw [Fin.val_add, h_one, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hi]
  · have he : (i : ℕ) + 1 = n := by omega
    rw [Fin.val_add, h_one, he, Nat.mod_self, fanAngle_zero,
      fanAngle_end (by omega) hr hpq hqr]
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp

deps.title: The elementary data imply all strict-fan properties
deps.label: st:strict-fan-geometry

deps.title: Ordered circle points and strict tangent support
deps.label: st:fan-support

blocks.tex:
Successive lifted angle gaps lie in $(0,\pi)$, so their sine determinants
are positive. The end angle is $2\pi$ and the starting angle is zero.
The projective support and orientation identities preserve the unit normals,
positive adjacent determinants, all tangent incidences and all nonincident
strict inequalities. Apply the full-geometry lemma.

blocks.label: st:balanced-fan
blocks.title: A balanced strict tangential fan
blocks.body:
Let $n\ge4$, $0<p<q<r<n$, and $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}c_i=0$, with
$c_0>0$, $c_p<0$, $c_q>0$, $c_r<0$.
There is a strict tangential fan $(U,Y)$ with
$\sum_i c_iY_i=0$, preserving all $n$ original labels and coefficients.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.exists_balanced_strictTangentialFan
lean.code:
theorem exists_balanced_strictTangentialFan {n p q r : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n)
    (c : Fin n → ℝ) (hsum : ∑ i, c i = 0)
    (h₀ : 0 < c ⟨0, by omega⟩) (h₁ : c ⟨p, by omega⟩ < 0)
    (h₂ : 0 < c ⟨q, by omega⟩) (h₃ : c ⟨r, hr⟩ < 0) :
    ∃ U Y : Fin n → ℂ, IsStrictTangentialFan U Y ∧ ∑ i, c i • Y i = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hη₁, a, σ, ha, hσ, hsq, hd, hb⟩ :=
    exists_balanced_squareFan hn hp hpq hqr hr c hsum h₀ h₁ h₂ h₃
  exact ⟨fun i ↦ ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (normal (fanAngle n p q r η i)),
    fun i ↦ ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (fanVertex n p q r η i),
    projective_squareFan_isStrictTangentialFan hn hp hpq hqr hr hη hη₁.le ha hσ hsq hd, hb⟩

deps.title: The finite square perturbation has strict geometry
deps.label: st:projective-fan

blocks.tex:
The square-field perturbation theorem supplies $0<\eta<1$ and projective
parameters with positive denominators and exact weighted balance. The preceding
lemma proves that these same transformed normals and vertices satisfy the full
strict tangential geometry; no limiting or collapsed polygon is used as the witness.

chapters.title: The balancing field for the side-tangent construction

blocks.tex:
This chapter supplies the zero used to balance the auxiliary tangential
polygon. Four chosen coefficients alternate in sign. All other coefficients,
including zeros, remain present. First collapse their vertices onto a square
and its side contacts; then move to a strictly ordered finite fan. The
perturbation changes the geometry, not the prescribed coefficients.

blocks.label: st:field-halfplanes
blocks.title: Winding comparison in open half-planes
blocks.body:
Let $\gamma,\eta:[0,1]\to\mathbb C\setminus\{0\}$ be continuous closed loops.
Suppose that for every $t$ there is a real linear functional $L_t$ with
$L_t(\gamma(t))>0$ and $L_t(\eta(t))>0$. Then their winding numbers about zero
are equal. No continuity of the choice $L_t$ is required. For a continuous
real phase $\phi$, the nonvanishing path $e^{i\phi(t)}$ has winding
$(\phi(1)-\phi(0))/(2\pi)$.

lean.name: Complex.phaseCurve_ne_zero
lean.code:
theorem phaseCurve_ne_zero (φ : C(I, ℝ)) (t : I) : phaseCurve φ t ≠ 0 :=
  exp_ne_zero _

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_phaseCurve
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_phaseCurve (φ : C(I, ℝ)) :
    windingNumberAt 0 (phaseCurve φ) (phaseCurve_ne_zero φ) =
      (φ 1 - φ 0) / (2 * Real.pi) := by
  apply windingNumberAt_eq_div_of_lift _ φ
  simp [phaseCurve, norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_eq_of_common_halfPlane
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_eq_of_common_halfPlane (γ η : C(I, ℂ))
    (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ 0) (hη : ∀ t, η t ≠ 0)
    (hγloop : γ 0 = γ 1) (hηloop : η 0 = η 1)
    (hcone : ∀ t, ∃ L : ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, 0 < L (γ t) ∧ 0 < L (η t)) :
    windingNumberAt 0 γ hγ = windingNumberAt 0 η hη := by
  let H : C(I × I, ℂ) :=
    ⟨fun st ↦ (1 - (st.1 : ℝ)) • γ st.2 + (st.1 : ℝ) • η st.2, by fun_prop⟩
  refine windingNumberAt_eq_of_homotopy 0 γ η hγ hη H ?_
    (by simp [H]) (by simp [H]) (by simp [H, hγloop, hηloop])
  intro st hzero
  obtain ⟨L, hLγ, hLη⟩ := hcone st.2
  have hpos : 0 < L (H st) :=
    (convex_halfSpace_gt L.isLinear 0) hLγ hLη
      (sub_nonneg.mpr st.1.property.2) st.1.property.1 (sub_add_cancel _ _)
  simp [hzero] at hpos

lean.name: Complex.phaseCurve
lean.code:
noncomputable def phaseCurve (φ : C(I, ℝ)) : C(I, ℂ) :=
  ⟨fun t ↦ exp ((φ t : ℂ) * Complex.I), by fun_prop⟩

blocks.tex:
The straight homotopy $(1-s)\gamma(t)+s\eta(t)$ remains in the positive
half-plane of $L_t$, so never vanishes. The two input loops make it a homotopy
through closed loops; winding is invariant under this homotopy. The phase
formula follows by using $\phi$ itself as the continuous argument lift.

blocks.label: st:field-convex-zero
blocks.title: A winding obstruction on a convex set
blocks.body:
Let $S\subseteq\mathbb C$ be convex and contain a point $a$. Let $F$ be
continuous on $S$, and let $\gamma$ be a continuous closed loop in $S$ such
that $F\circ\gamma$ never vanishes and has nonzero winding about zero.
Then $F$ vanishes at some point of $S$. The loop need not be a circular
parametrization of the boundary of $S$.

lean.name: Complex.exists_zero_of_windingNumberAt_ne_zero_on_convex
lean.code:
theorem exists_zero_of_windingNumberAt_ne_zero_on_convex
    {S : Set ℂ} (hS : Convex ℝ S) (a : ℂ) (ha : a ∈ S)
    (F : ℂ → ℂ) (hF : ContinuousOn F S) (γ : C(I, ℂ))
    (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ S) (hloop : γ 0 = γ 1) (havoid : ∀ t, F (γ t) ≠ 0)
    (hw : windingNumberAt 0 ⟨F ∘ γ, hF.comp_continuous γ.continuous hγ⟩ havoid ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x ∈ S, F x = 0 := by
  by_contra hnone
  push Not at hnone
  let A : C(I × I, ℂ) :=
    ⟨fun st ↦ (1 - (st.1 : ℝ)) • γ st.2 + (st.1 : ℝ) • a, by fun_prop⟩
  have hA : ∀ st, A st ∈ S := fun st ↦
    hS (hγ st.2) ha (sub_nonneg.mpr st.1.property.2) st.1.property.1
      (sub_add_cancel _ _)
  let H : C(I × I, ℂ) := ⟨F ∘ A, hF.comp_continuous A.continuous hA⟩
  have heq := windingNumberAt_eq_of_homotopy 0
    ⟨F ∘ γ, hF.comp_continuous γ.continuous hγ⟩ (ContinuousMap.const I (F a))
    havoid (fun _ ↦ hnone a ha) H (fun st ↦ hnone _ (hA st))
    (by simp [H, A, Function.comp_def]) (by simp [H, A, Function.comp_def])
    (by simp [H, A, Function.comp_def, hloop])
  exact hw (heq.trans (windingNumberAt_const 0 (F a) (fun _ ↦ hnone a ha)))

blocks.tex:
If $F$ had no zero in $S$, applying $F$ to
$(1-s)\gamma(t)+sa$ would give a nonvanishing homotopy from $F\circ\gamma$
to the constant loop at $F(a)$. Its winding would therefore be zero, a
contradiction. Convexity keeps the entire homotopy in $S$.

blocks.label: st:field-diamond
blocks.title: The diamond and its boundary loop
blocks.body:
For $r\in\mathbb R$, set
\[
 D_r=\{x+iy:|x|+|y|\le r\}.
\]
This set is convex and compact. For $r\ge0$ a closed continuous boundary
loop is
\[
 b_r(t)=\frac{r\,e^{2\pi it}}
 {|\cos(2\pi t)|+|\sin(2\pi t)|},\qquad 0\le t\le1.
\]
It satisfies $|\operatorname{Re}b_r(t)|+|\operatorname{Im}b_r(t)|=r$.

lean.name: Complex.diamondBoundary_mem
lean.code:
theorem diamondBoundary_mem {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (t : I) :
    |(diamondBoundary r t).re| + |(diamondBoundary r t).im| = r := by
  simp only [diamondBoundary, ContinuousMap.coe_mk, smul_re, smul_im, smul_eq_mul,
    abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hr (l1_unitLoop_pos t).le)]
  rw [← mul_add, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (l1_unitLoop_pos t).ne']

lean.name: Complex.diamondBoundary_closed
lean.code:
theorem diamondBoundary_closed (r : ℝ) : diamondBoundary r 0 = diamondBoundary r 1 := by
  simp only [diamondBoundary, ContinuousMap.coe_mk, unitLoop_closed]

lean.name: Complex.isCompact_diamond
lean.code:
theorem isCompact_diamond (r : ℝ) : IsCompact (diamond r) := by
  apply (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) r).of_isClosed_subset
    (isClosed_le (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
  intro z hz
  simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using
    (norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im z).trans hz

lean.name: Complex.convex_diamond
lean.code:
theorem convex_diamond (r : ℝ) : Convex ℝ (diamond r) := by
  have hre : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun z : ℂ ↦ |z.re|) := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (convexOn_norm (convex_univ : Convex ℝ (Set.univ : Set ℝ))).comp_linearMap Complex.reLm
  have him : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun z : ℂ ↦ |z.im|) := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (convexOn_norm (convex_univ : Convex ℝ (Set.univ : Set ℝ))).comp_linearMap Complex.imLm
  simpa [diamond] using (hre.add him).convex_le r

lean.name: Complex.diamond
lean.code: def diamond (r : ℝ) : Set ℂ := {z | |z.re| + |z.im| ≤ r}

lean.name: Complex.diamondBoundary
lean.code:
noncomputable def diamondBoundary (r : ℝ) : C(I, ℂ) :=
  ⟨fun t ↦ (r / (|(unitLoop t).re| + |(unitLoop t).im|)) • unitLoop t, by
    exact (continuous_const.div ((Complex.continuous_re.comp unitLoop.continuous).abs.add
      (Complex.continuous_im.comp unitLoop.continuous).abs)
      (fun t ↦ (l1_unitLoop_pos t).ne')).smul unitLoop.continuous⟩

blocks.tex:
The sum of the two absolute coordinate functions is convex, so its sublevel
sets are convex. The diamond is closed and contained in the Euclidean closed
ball of radius $r$; the empty case causes no difficulty. The displayed
boundary denominator is positive because a unit vector has positive
coordinate one-norm. Its normalization gives the boundary identity, and the
periodicity of the unit circle gives $b_r(0)=b_r(1)$.

blocks.label: st:field-diamond-zero
blocks.title: Four signs force a zero in the diamond
blocks.body:
Let $r>0$ and $F$ be continuous on $D_r$. On $|x|+|y|=r$, assume
\[
\begin{array}{c|c}
 y\ge|x| & \operatorname{Re}F(x+iy)>0\\
 -x\ge|y| & \operatorname{Im}F(x+iy)<0\\
 -y\ge|x| & \operatorname{Re}F(x+iy)<0\\
 x\ge|y| & \operatorname{Im}F(x+iy)>0.
\end{array}
\]
Then $F$ has a zero in $D_r$.

lean.name: Complex.DiamondSigns
lean.code:
structure DiamondSigns (F : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) : Prop where
  top : ∀ z, |z.re| + |z.im| = r → |z.re| ≤ z.im → 0 < (F z).re
  left : ∀ z, |z.re| + |z.im| = r → |z.im| ≤ -z.re → (F z).im < 0
  bottom : ∀ z, |z.re| + |z.im| = r → |z.re| ≤ -z.im → (F z).re < 0
  right : ∀ z, |z.re| + |z.im| = r → |z.im| ≤ z.re → 0 < (F z).im

lean.name: Complex.exists_zero_of_diamondSigns
lean.code:
theorem exists_zero_of_diamondSigns {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hF : ContinuousOn F (diamond r)) (hsigns : DiamondSigns F r) :
    ∃ z ∈ diamond r, F z = 0 := by
  have hmem : ∀ t, diamondBoundary r t ∈ diamond r :=
    fun t ↦ (diamondBoundary_mem hr.le t).le
  let γ : C(I, ℂ) :=
    ⟨F ∘ diamondBoundary r, hF.comp_continuous (diamondBoundary r).continuous hmem⟩
  have hcone : ∀ t, ∃ L : ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, 0 < L (γ t) ∧
      0 < L (phaseCurve reversedPhase t) := diamondSigns_boundaryCone hr hsigns
  have hne : ∀ t, γ t ≠ 0 := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨L, hL, -⟩ := hcone t
    simp [ht] at hL
  have hmodel : phaseCurve reversedPhase 0 = phaseCurve reversedPhase 1 := by
    rw [reversedPhase_eq_swap, reversedPhase_eq_swap, unitLoop_closed]
  have hw := windingNumberAt_eq_of_common_halfPlane γ (phaseCurve reversedPhase)
    hne (phaseCurve_ne_zero reversedPhase) (congrArg F (diamondBoundary_closed r))
    hmodel hcone
  refine exists_zero_of_windingNumberAt_ne_zero_on_convex (convex_diamond r) 0
    (by simpa [diamond] using hr.le) F hF (diamondBoundary r) hmem
    (diamondBoundary_closed r) hne ?_
  exact (hw.trans reversedPhase_winding).trans_ne (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero)
