blocks.tex:
Choose the four ordered witnesses by cyclic shifting. Their zero-sum difference
coefficients give a balanced strict tangential fan. Return it to the original
labels, then apply the exact closure and positive-scaling result. All coefficients
and radii remain fixed throughout this construction.

blocks.label: st:three-lines
blocks.title: Three inward tangent-line equations
blocks.body:
For outward unit edge normals $N_i$, the supporting line is
$L_i=\{z:\langle N_i,z-P_i\rangle=0\}$.
The inward circle equations for edge $i$, center $C$ and radius $r$ are
\[
 \langle N_{i-1},P_i-C\rangle
 =\langle N_i,P_i-C\rangle
 =\langle N_{i+1},P_{i+1}-C\rangle=r.
\]
The previous line may be based at $P_i$ since it contains that vertex.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.ThreeLineCircle
Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.supportingLine
lean.code:
def supportingLine (P N : ZMod n → ℂ) (i : ZMod n) : Set ℂ :=
  {z | ⟪N i, z - P i⟫_ℝ = 0}

blocks.label: st:realization
blocks.title: Exact side-tangent realization
blocks.body:
A realization of a positive radius word $\rho$ consists of a simple strictly
supported polygon $P$, outward unit normals $N$ with
$P_{i+1}-P_i=\ell_i iN_i$ and $\ell_i>0$, and centers $C_i$.
Every polygon vertex is in the inward closed half-plane of each support.
At edge $i$ the three equations hold with $(C_i,\rho_i)$, and their solution
is unique in both center and signed radius. Moreover
$C_i+\rho_iN_i\in(P_i,P_{i+1})$.
Neighboring contacts are permitted on supporting-line extensions; no condition
is imposed that all these circles lie inside every other supporting half-plane.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.RealizesSideTangent
lean.code:
def RealizesSideTangent [NeZero n] (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ P N C : ZMod n → ℂ, IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsSideTangentRealization
lean.code:
structure IsSideTangentRealization [NeZero n] (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ)
    (P N C : ZMod n → ℂ) : Prop where
  radius_pos : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i
  simple : IsSimplePolygon P
  strict_convex : StrictConvexEdgeSupport P
  unit_normal : ∀ i, ‖N i‖ = 1
  oriented_edge : ∀ i, ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ P (i + 1) - P i = ℓ • (Complex.I * N i)
  supporting : ∀ i j, ⟪N i, P j - P i⟫_ℝ ≤ 0
  circles : ∀ i, ThreeLineCircle P N i (C i) (ρ i)
  unique_circle : ∀ i D r, ThreeLineCircle P N i D r → D = C i ∧ r = ρ i
  central_contact : ∀ i, C i + ρ i • N i ∈ openSegment ℝ (P i) (P (i + 1))

blocks.label: st:circle-identification
blocks.title: The exact three-line circle and its uniqueness
blocks.body:
Suppose $\langle u,x\rangle=\langle v,x\rangle=\langle w,y\rangle=1$,
$[u,v]\ne0$, $\langle w,x\rangle<1$, and $q-p=r(y-x)$.
Then $C=p-rx$ solves the inward equations for the three lines with normals
$u,v,w$ based at $p,p,q$, with radius $r$, and this pair $(C,r)$ is unique.
If $v\in(x,y)$, its central contact $p+r(v-x)$ lies in $(p,q)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.threeLineCircle_equations
lean.code:
lemma threeLineCircle_equations {u v w x y p q : ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hux : ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ = 1) (hvx : ⟪v, x⟫_ℝ = 1) (hwy : ⟪w, y⟫_ℝ = 1)
    (hedge : q - p = r • (y - x)) :
    ⟪u, p - (p - r • x)⟫_ℝ = r ∧ ⟪v, p - (p - r • x)⟫_ℝ = r ∧
      ⟪w, q - (p - r • x)⟫_ℝ = r := by
  have hnext : q - (p - r • x) = r • y := by
    calc
      q - (p - r • x) = (q - p) + r • x := by abel
      _ = r • y := by rw [hedge, smul_sub]; abel
  simp only [sub_sub_cancel, hnext, real_inner_smul_right, hux, hvx, hwy, mul_one, and_self]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.threeLineCircle_unique
lean.code:
theorem threeLineCircle_unique {u v w x y p q C : ℂ} {r ρ : ℝ}
    (hcross : crossR2 0 u v ≠ 0) (hux : ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ = 1) (hvx : ⟪v, x⟫_ℝ = 1)
    (hwy : ⟪w, y⟫_ℝ = 1) (hwx : ⟪w, x⟫_ℝ < 1)
    (hedge : q - p = r • (y - x))
    (hC₁ : ⟪u, p - C⟫_ℝ = ρ) (hC₂ : ⟪v, p - C⟫_ℝ = ρ)
    (hC₃ : ⟪w, q - C⟫_ℝ = ρ) : C = p - r • x ∧ ρ = r := by
  have hcenter : C = p - ρ • x := by
    have hz : p - C - ρ • x = 0 := eq_zero_of_two_inner_eq_zero hcross
      (by rw [inner_sub_right, hC₁, real_inner_smul_right, hux]; ring)
      (by rw [inner_sub_right, hC₂, real_inner_smul_right, hvx]; ring)
    linear_combination -hz
  have heq : q - C = r • y + (ρ - r) • x := by
    rw [hcenter]
    calc
      q - (p - ρ • x) = (q - p) + ρ • x := by abel
      _ = r • y + (ρ - r) • x := by rw [hedge, smul_sub, sub_smul]; abel
  rw [heq, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right, hwy] at hC₃
  have hr : ρ = r := by nlinarith
  exact ⟨hr ▸ hcenter, hr⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.prescribedContact_mem_openSegment
lean.code:
lemma prescribedContact_mem_openSegment {u x y p q : ℂ} (r : ℝ)
    (hedge : q - p = r • (y - x)) (hu : u ∈ openSegment ℝ x y) :
    p + r • (u - x) ∈ openSegment ℝ p q := by
  obtain ⟨s, t, hs, ht, hst, he⟩ := hu
  refine ⟨s, t, hs, ht, hst, ?_⟩
  have hq : q = p + r • (y - x) := by rw [← hedge]; abel
  rw [hq, ← he]
  match_scalars
  · exact hst
  · ring
  · linear_combination -r * hst

deps.title: Interior contacts and positive tangent edges
deps.label: st:interior-contact

blocks.tex:
The center displacements from $p,q$ are $rx,ry$, proving the three equations.
Any competing solution $(D,s)$ has $D=p-sx$, since the first two normals are
linearly independent. The third equation becomes
$r+(s-r)\langle w,x\rangle=s$, so strict support forces $s=r$ and $D=C$.
An affine map $z\mapsto p+r(z-x)$ transports the positive barycentric
coordinates of the central contact to the prescribed edge.

blocks.label: st:outward-normals
blocks.title: The edge normals really support the realized polygon
blocks.body:
For $B-A=\ell iu$, one has $[A,B,C]=-\ell\langle u,C-A\rangle$.
Consequently positive oriented edges and strict support imply the outward
normal inequalities $\langle N_i,P_j-P_i\rangle\le0$ for every $i,j$.
A strict fan satisfies its two incident tangent equations; when $n\ge3$ its
next normal obeys $\langle U_{i+2},Y_i\rangle<1$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_support_of_strictSupport
lean.code:
lemma normal_support_of_strictSupport [NeZero n] {P N : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hs : StrictConvexEdgeSupport P)
    (he : ∀ i, ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ P (i + 1) - P i = ℓ • (Complex.I * N i)) :
    ∀ i j, ⟪N i, P j - P i⟫_ℝ ≤ 0 := by
  intro i j
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ, hedge⟩ := he i
  have hc := crossR2_tangent_edge (C := P j) hedge
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · simp [hji]
  by_cases hjs : j = i + 1
  · have hz : crossR2 (P i) (P (i + 1)) (P j) = 0 := by simp [hjs, crossR2, mul_comm]
    nlinarith
  · have hp := hs i j hji hjs
    nlinarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan.inner_left
lean.code:
lemma IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan.inner_left [NeZero n] {U Y : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (h : IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan U Y) (i : ZMod n) : ⟪U i, Y i⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
  rw [h.vertex_eq i]
  exact inner_tangentIntersection_left (h.unit_normal i)
    (normal_pair_denominator_pos (h.unit_normal i) (h.unit_normal (i + 1))
      (h.normal_cross_pos i)).ne'

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.crossR2_tangent_edge
lean.code:
lemma crossR2_tangent_edge {A B C u : ℂ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (he : B - A = ℓ • (Complex.I * u)) :
    crossR2 A B C = -ℓ * ⟪u, C - A⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [crossR2, he]
  simp only [Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
    Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, zero_mul, one_mul, zero_sub, zero_add,
    Complex.inner, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan.next_strict
lean.code:
lemma IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan.next_strict [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    {U Y : ZMod n → ℂ} (h : IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan U Y) (i : ZMod n) :
    ⟪U (i + 1 + 1), Y i⟫_ℝ < 1 := by
  have : Fact (1 < n) := ⟨by omega⟩
  have h₁ : (1 : ZMod n) ≠ 0 := one_ne_zero
  have h₂ : (2 : ZMod n) ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide : 0 < 2) ((ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff 2 n).mp he)
    omega
  exact h.strict_support i (i + 1 + 1) (fun he ↦ h₂ (by linear_combination he))
    (fun he ↦ h₁ (by linear_combination he))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan.inner_right
lean.code:
lemma IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan.inner_right [NeZero n] {U Y : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (h : IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan U Y) (i : ZMod n) : ⟪U (i + 1), Y i⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
  rw [h.vertex_eq i]
  exact inner_tangentIntersection_right (h.unit_normal (i + 1))
    (normal_pair_denominator_pos (h.unit_normal i) (h.unit_normal (i + 1))
      (h.normal_cross_pos i)).ne'

deps.title: The two tangent equations and their continuous extension
deps.label: st:tangent-equations

blocks.tex:
Expand the determinant for the identity. Nonincident vertices give a strict
inequality of the required sign; the edge endpoints give equality.
The two tangent equations follow from the vertex formula. Since $n\ge3$,
$i+2$ is neither $i$ nor $i+1$, and the last inequality is one of the
strict nonincident support inequalities.

blocks.label: st:scaled-realization
blocks.title: Scaled tangential geometry realizes the radii
blocks.body:
Let $n\ge3$, let $\rho_i>0$, and let $(U,Y)$ be a strict tangential fan.
If $P$ is a simple strictly supported polygon with
$P_{i+1}-P_i=\rho_i(Y_{i+1}-Y_i)$, then it realizes the exact side-tangent radii
$\rho_i$, with
\[
 N_i=U_{i+1},\qquad C_i=P_i-\rho_iY_i.
\]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.realizesSideTangent_of_scaledFan
lean.code:
theorem realizesSideTangent_of_scaledFan [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ) (hρ : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i) {U Y P : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hf : IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan U Y)
    (hedge : ∀ i, P (i + 1) - P i = ρ i • (Y (i + 1) - Y i))
    (hs : StrictConvexEdgeSupport P) (hp : IsSimplePolygon P) : RealizesSideTangent ρ := by
  let N : ZMod n → ℂ := fun i ↦ U (i + 1)
  let C : ZMod n → ℂ := fun i ↦ P i - ρ i • Y i
  have he : ∀ i, ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ P (i + 1) - P i = ℓ • (Complex.I * N i) := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ, heq⟩ := hf.edge_pos i
    exact ⟨ρ i * ℓ, mul_pos (hρ i) hℓ, by rw [hedge i, heq, smul_smul]⟩
  refine ⟨P, N, C, hρ, hp, hs, fun i ↦ hf.unit_normal (i + 1), he,
    normal_support_of_strictSupport hs he, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    simpa only [ThreeLineCircle, N, C, sub_add_cancel] using
      threeLineCircle_equations (hf.inner_left i) (hf.inner_right i) (hf.inner_right (i + 1))
        (hedge i)
  · intro i D r hD
    have heq : ⟪U i, P i - D⟫_ℝ = r ∧ ⟪U (i + 1), P i - D⟫_ℝ = r ∧
        ⟪U (i + 1 + 1), P (i + 1) - D⟫_ℝ = r := by
      simpa only [ThreeLineCircle, N, sub_add_cancel] using hD
    exact threeLineCircle_unique (hf.normal_cross_pos i).ne'
      (hf.inner_left i) (hf.inner_right i) (hf.inner_right (i + 1)) (hf.next_strict hn i)
      (hedge i) heq.1 heq.2.1 heq.2.2
  · intro i
    have hc := prescribedContact_mem_openSegment (ρ i) (hedge i) (hf.contact_interior i)
    simpa only [C, N, smul_sub, sub_add_eq_add_sub, add_sub_assoc] using hc

deps.title: The edge normals really support the realized polygon
deps.label: st:outward-normals

deps.title: The exact three-line circle and its uniqueness
deps.label: st:circle-identification

blocks.tex:
The fan's positive tangent edge lengths become positive lengths after multiplication
by $\rho_i$, and the normal-support lemma gives the outward half-planes.
Use the circle-identification lemma with
$(u,v,w,x,y,p,q,r)=(U_i,U_{i+1},U_{i+2},Y_i,Y_{i+1},P_i,P_{i+1},\rho_i)$.
It gives the three equations, unique center and radius, and the required open
central contact simultaneously at every label.

blocks.label: st:constant-case
blocks.title: The constant radius case
blocks.body:
For $n\ge4$ and a constant positive word $\rho_i=r$, a side-tangent realization
exists. The normals may be taken at the equally spaced angles $2\pi i/n$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.exists_strictTangentialFan_of_four_le
lean.code:
theorem exists_strictTangentialFan_of_four_le {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    ∃ U Y : Fin n → ℂ, IsStrictTangentialFan U Y := by
  have h := projective_squareFan_isStrictTangentialFan (n := n) (p := 1) (q := 2) (r := 3)
    hn (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by omega) (η := 1) zero_lt_one le_rfl
    (a := 0) (σ := 1) (by simp) zero_lt_one (by simp)
    (by intro i; simp [ProjectiveBall.denominator])
  exact ⟨_, _, h⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.sideTangentConverse_of_const
lean.code:
theorem sideTangentConverse_of_const [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ)
    (hρ : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i) {r : ℝ} (hconst : ∀ i, ρ i = r) : RealizesSideTangent ρ := by
  obtain ⟨U, Y, hf⟩ := exists_strictTangentialFan_of_four_le hn
  let U' : ZMod n → ℂ := fun i ↦ U ((cyclicLabelEquiv (0 : ZMod n)).symm i)
  let Y' : ZMod n → ℂ := fun i ↦ Y ((cyclicLabelEquiv (0 : ZMod n)).symm i)
  have hf' : IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan U' Y' := isCyclicStrictTangentialFan_of_finite _ hf
  have hb : ∑ i, (ρ (i - 1) - ρ i) • Y' i = 0 := by
    simp only [hconst, sub_self, zero_smul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  obtain ⟨P, he, hs, hp⟩ :=
    exists_strictPolygon_of_balanced_scaling (by omega) hf'.cross_support ρ hρ hb
  exact realizesSideTangent_of_scaledFan (by omega) ρ hρ hf' he hs hp

deps.title: The finite square perturbation has strict geometry
deps.label: st:projective-fan

blocks.tex:
In the finite fan construction take $\eta=1$, $a=0$, and $\sigma=1$.
This gives the regular unit-incircle polygon with all strict fan properties.
Every difference coefficient is zero, so the weighted balance is automatic.
Scale its edges by $r$, integrate, and apply the circle-identification result.

blocks.label: st:converse
blocks.title: The side-tangent converse
blocks.body:
For every $n\ge4$, every admissible positive cyclic radius word has an exact
side-tangent realization. The nonconstant construction includes arbitrary
repeated adjacent radii and keeps all labels.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.sideTangentConverse_of_dfv
lean.code:
theorem sideTangentConverse_of_dfv [NeZero n] (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ)
    (hρ : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i) (h : DFV (radiusDifference ρ) 0) : RealizesSideTangent ρ := by
  obtain ⟨U, Y, P, hf, he, hs, hp⟩ := exists_sideTangent_scaledPolygon ρ hρ h
  exact realizesSideTangent_of_scaledFan (by have := four_le_of_dfv h; omega) ρ hρ hf he hs hp

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.sideTangentConverse
lean.code:
theorem sideTangentConverse [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ)
    (h : SideTangentAdmissible ρ) : RealizesSideTangent ρ := by
  obtain ⟨hρ, hconst | hdfv⟩ := h
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hconst
    exact sideTangentConverse_of_const hn ρ hρ hr
  · exact sideTangentConverse_of_dfv ρ hρ hdfv

deps.title: A closed polygon for the original nonconstant radius word
deps.label: st:scaled-polygon

deps.title: Scaled tangential geometry realizes the radii
deps.label: st:scaled-realization

blocks.tex:
In the nonconstant case the DFV witnesses produce the closed scaled polygon,
whose strict tangential geometry identifies the exact circles. The constant
case is the regular-fan construction. These alternatives exhaust admissibility.

blocks.label: st:metric-tangency
blocks.title: Signed-distance equations imply unique metric tangency
blocks.body:
If $|u|=1$, $r\ge0$, and $\langle u,A-C\rangle=r$, then
\[
 \{z:|z-C|=r\}\cap\{z:\langle u,z-A\rangle=0\}=\{C+ru\}.
\]
Thus every realized circle meets each of its three actual supporting lines at
exactly one point $C_i+\rho_iN_k$, for $k=i-1,i,i+1$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsSideTangentRealization.normal_edge_orthogonal
lean.code:
lemma IsSideTangentRealization.normal_edge_orthogonal [NeZero n]
    {ρ : ZMod n → ℝ} {P N C : ZMod n → ℂ} (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C)
    (i : ZMod n) : ⟪N i, P (i + 1) - P i⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨ℓ, _, he⟩ := h.oriented_edge i
  rw [he, real_inner_smul_right]
  have hz : ⟪N i, Complex.I * N i⟫_ℝ = 0 := by simp [Complex.inner, mul_comm]
  rw [hz, mul_zero]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsSideTangentRealization.tangent_sphere
lean.code:
theorem IsSideTangentRealization.tangent_sphere [NeZero n]
    {ρ : ZMod n → ℝ} {P N C : ZMod n → ℂ} (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C)
    (i k : ZMod n) (hk : k = i - 1 ∨ k = i ∨ k = i + 1) :
    Metric.sphere (C i) (ρ i) ∩ supportingLine P N k = {C i + ρ i • N k} :=
  sphere_inter_normalLine (h.unit_normal k) (h.radius_pos i).le (h.circle_line_distance i k hk)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsSideTangentRealization.circle_line_distance
lean.code:
lemma IsSideTangentRealization.circle_line_distance [NeZero n]
    {ρ : ZMod n → ℝ} {P N C : ZMod n → ℂ} (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C)
    (i k : ZMod n) (hk : k = i - 1 ∨ k = i ∨ k = i + 1) :
    ⟪N k, P k - C i⟫_ℝ = ρ i := by
  rcases hk with hk | hk | hk
  · rw [hk]
    have hz : ⟪N (i - 1), P i - P (i - 1)⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
      simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using h.normal_edge_orthogonal (i - 1)
    rw [show P (i - 1) - C i = (P i - C i) - (P i - P (i - 1)) by abel,
      inner_sub_right, (h.circles i).1, hz, sub_zero]
  · simpa only [hk] using (h.circles i).2.1
  · simpa only [hk] using (h.circles i).2.2

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.sphere_inter_normalLine
lean.code:
lemma sphere_inter_normalLine {u A C : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hd : ⟪u, A - C⟫_ℝ = r) :
    Metric.sphere C r ∩ {z | ⟪u, z - A⟫_ℝ = 0} = {C + r • u} := by
  ext z
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
    Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hz, hl⟩
    have hi : ⟪u, z - C⟫_ℝ = r := by
      rw [show z - C = (z - A) + (A - C) by abel, inner_add_right, hl, hd, zero_add]
    have hnorm : ‖(z - C) - r • u‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
      rw [norm_sub_sq_real, hz, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hr, hu,
        mul_one, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_comm u (z - C), hi]
      ring
    have hzero := norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hnorm)
    linear_combination hzero
  · rintro rfl
    constructor
    · simp [hu, abs_of_nonneg hr]
    · rw [show C + r • u - A = r • u - (A - C) by abel, inner_sub_right,
        real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu, hd]
      ring

blocks.tex:
For a point in the intersection, $\langle u,z-C\rangle=r$, and expansion gives
$|(z-C)-ru|^2=|z-C|^2+r^2-2r\langle u,z-C\rangle=0$.
Conversely $C+ru$ satisfies both equations. Each polygon edge is perpendicular
to its normal, so the previous line can be based at $P_{i-1}$ or $P_i$ without
changing its signed-distance equation. Apply the identity to all three lines.

chapters.title: The discrete forward theorem and the radius characterization

blocks.tex:
Dahlberg's forward theorem concerns a simple polygon whose vertices are locally
regular, including straight vertices. Its conclusion counts constant plateaux
correctly. The convex proof uses actual containing and interior-missing circles;
the remaining case uses the enclosing-circle construction detailed in the next
two chapters. Together these results prove the necessity in the paper's
circumradius characterization.

blocks.label: mf:core-defs
blocks.title: Local regularity and signed curvature
blocks.body:
Write $[A,B,C]=\operatorname{Im}(\overline{B-A}(C-A))$ and
\[
 k_i=\frac{2[P_{i-1},P_i,P_{i+1}]}
 {|P_i-P_{i-1}|\,|P_{i+1}-P_i|\,|P_{i+1}-P_{i-1}|}.
\]
A vertex is regular if it is straight and lies on the segment joining its
neighbours, or its positive-radius circumcircle has center in the closed
vertex cone
$P_i+\{s(P_{i-1}-P_i)+t(P_{i+1}-P_i):s,t\ge0\}$.
A polygon is regular when every vertex is regular. It is concyclic when all
vertices lie on a common circle of positive radius.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.DahlbergRegularAt
Gluck.Forward.DahlbergRegular
lean.code:
def DahlbergRegular {n : ℕ} (v : ZMod n → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, DahlbergRegularAt (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1))

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.SignedMengerProfile
lean.code:
noncomputable def SignedMengerProfile {n : ℕ} (v : ZMod n → ℂ) : ZMod n → ℝ :=
  fun i => Gluck.Discrete.signedMengerR2 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1))

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Concyclic
lean.code:
def Concyclic {n : ℕ} (v : ZMod n → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ O R, 0 < R ∧ ∀ i, dist O (v i) = R

blocks.label: mf:core-extrema
blocks.title: Plateau-aware alternating extrema
blocks.body:
A local maximum at $i$ consists of integers $l,r>0$, $l+r\le n$, such that
$k_{i-m}=k_i$ for $0\le m<l$, $k_{i+m}=k_i$ for $0\le m<r$, and
$k_{i-l},k_{i+r}<k_i$. A local minimum reverses both strict inequalities.
The four-vertex condition requires integer representatives
$a<b<c<d<a+n$ at which there are, respectively, a local maximum, minimum,
maximum, and minimum. The representatives may lie inside extremal plateaux;
the strict exits ensure that different extremal runs are counted separately.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.DahlbergFourVertex
lean.code:
def DahlbergFourVertex {n : ℕ} (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ i₁ i₂ i₃ i₄ : ℕ,
    i₁ < i₂ ∧ i₂ < i₃ ∧ i₃ < i₄ ∧ i₄ < i₁ + n ∧
      DiscreteLocalMax κ (i₁ : ZMod n) ∧
      DiscreteLocalMin κ (i₂ : ZMod n) ∧
      DiscreteLocalMax κ (i₃ : ZMod n) ∧
      DiscreteLocalMin κ (i₄ : ZMod n)

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.DiscreteLocalMin
lean.code:
def DiscreteLocalMin {n : ℕ} (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (i : ZMod n) : Prop :=
  ∃ l r : ℕ, 0 < l ∧ 0 < r ∧ l + r ≤ n ∧
    (∀ m < l, κ (i - (m : ZMod n)) = κ i) ∧
    (∀ m < r, κ (i + (m : ZMod n)) = κ i) ∧
    κ i < κ (i - (l : ZMod n)) ∧ κ i < κ (i + (r : ZMod n))

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.DiscreteLocalMax
lean.code:
def DiscreteLocalMax {n : ℕ} (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (i : ZMod n) : Prop :=
  ∃ l r : ℕ, 0 < l ∧ 0 < r ∧ l + r ≤ n ∧
    (∀ m < l, κ (i - (m : ZMod n)) = κ i) ∧
    (∀ m < r, κ (i + (m : ZMod n)) = κ i) ∧
    κ (i - (l : ZMod n)) < κ i ∧ κ (i + (r : ZMod n)) < κ i

blocks.label: mf:core-marked-maxima
blocks.title: Two disjoint families of weak maxima
blocks.body:
Let $k$ be a nonconstant cyclic word. Suppose $E,F$ are nonempty disjoint
sets of indices, every marked index is a weak maximum relative to its two
neighbours, and equality with either neighbour preserves membership in the
same marked set. Then $k$ has alternating plateau maxima and minima.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.dahlbergFourVertex_of_two_disjoint_marked_weakMaxima
lean.code:
theorem dahlbergFourVertex_of_two_disjoint_marked_weakMaxima
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {P Q : ZMod n → Prop} {p q : ZMod n}
    (hpq : p ≠ q) (hPp : P p) (hQq : Q q)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ z, ¬ (P z ∧ Q z))
    (hweakP : ∀ z, P z → κ (z - 1) ≤ κ z ∧ κ (z + 1) ≤ κ z)
    (hpropPRight : ∀ z, P z → κ z = κ (z + 1) → P (z + 1))
    (hpropPLeft : ∀ z, P z → κ z = κ (z - 1) → P (z - 1))
    (hweakQ : ∀ z, Q z → κ (z - 1) ≤ κ z ∧ κ (z + 1) ≤ κ z)
    (hpropQRight : ∀ z, Q z → κ z = κ (z + 1) → Q (z + 1))
    (hpropQLeft : ∀ z, Q z → κ z = κ (z - 1) → Q (z - 1))
    (hnc : ¬ ∃ c, ∀ z : ZMod n, κ z = c) :
    DahlbergFourVertex κ := by
  let d : ℕ := (q - p).val
  let κ' : ZMod n → ℝ := fun z => κ (z + p)
  let P' : ZMod n → Prop := fun z => P (z + p)
  let Q' : ZMod n → Prop := fun z => Q (z + p)
  have hdpos : 0 < d := by
    apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    intro hd0
    have hqp0 : q - p = 0 := (ZMod.val_eq_zero (q - p)).mp hd0
    apply hpq
    have := congrArg (fun z : ZMod n => z + p) hqp0
    simpa using this.symm
  have hdlt : d < n := ZMod.val_lt (q - p)
  have hdcast : (d : ZMod n) = q - p := by
    exact ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (q - p)
  have hP'0 : P' 0 := by simpa [P'] using hPp
  have hQ'd : Q' (d : ZMod n) := by
    dsimp [Q']
    rw [hdcast]
    convert hQq using 1
    abel
  have hdisjoint' : ∀ z, ¬ (P' z ∧ Q' z) := by
    intro z hz
    exact hdisjoint (z + p) hz
  have hweakP' : ∀ z, P' z →
      κ' (z - 1) ≤ κ' z ∧ κ' (z + 1) ≤ κ' z := by
    intro z hz
    rcases hweakP (z + p) hz with ⟨hl, hr⟩
    constructor
    · dsimp [κ']
      convert hl using 1
      abel_nf
    · dsimp [κ']
      convert hr using 1
      abel_nf
  have hpropP'Right : ∀ z, P' z →
      κ' z = κ' (z + 1) → P' (z + 1) := by
    intro z hz heq
    dsimp [P', κ'] at hz heq ⊢
    have hp := hpropPRight (z + p) hz (by
      convert heq using 1
      abel_nf)
    convert hp using 1
    abel
  have hpropP'Left : ∀ z, P' z →
      κ' z = κ' (z - 1) → P' (z - 1) := by
    intro z hz heq
    dsimp [P', κ'] at hz heq ⊢
  -- … (truncated)

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.exists_strict_drop_backward_of_marked_weakMax
lean.code:
theorem exists_strict_drop_backward_of_marked_weakMax
    {n : ℕ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {P : ZMod n → Prop} {a b : ℕ}
    (hab : a < b)
    (hPb : P (b : ZMod n)) (hnotPa : ¬ P (a : ZMod n))
    (hweakLeft : ∀ j, P j → κ (j - 1) ≤ κ j)
    (hpropLeft : ∀ j, P j → κ j = κ (j - 1) → P (j - 1)) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, a ≤ k ∧ k < b ∧ κ (k : ZMod n) < κ (b : ZMod n) := by
  let A : ZMod n := (a + b : ℕ)
  let μ : ZMod n → ℝ := fun z => κ (A - z)
  let Q : ZMod n → Prop := fun z => P (A - z)
  have hQa : Q (a : ZMod n) := by
    dsimp [Q, A]
    convert hPb using 1
    push_cast
    abel
  have hnotQb : ¬ Q (b : ZMod n) := by
    intro hQb
    apply hnotPa
    dsimp [Q, A] at hQb
    convert hQb using 1
    push_cast
    abel
  have hweakQ : ∀ z, Q z → μ (z + 1) ≤ μ z := by
    intro z hz
    dsimp [Q, μ] at hz ⊢
    convert hweakLeft (A - z) hz using 1
    abel_nf
  have hpropQ : ∀ z, Q z → μ z = μ (z + 1) → Q (z + 1) := by
    intro z hz heq
    dsimp [Q, μ] at hz heq ⊢
    have hp : P (A - z - 1) := hpropLeft (A - z) hz (by
      convert heq using 1
      abel_nf)
    convert hp using 1
    abel
  rcases exists_strict_drop_forward_of_marked_weakMax
      hab hQa hnotQb hweakQ hpropQ with ⟨k, hak, hkb, hdrop⟩
  refine ⟨a + b - k, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
  dsimp [μ, A] at hdrop
  have hk : k ≤ a + b := by omega
  have hidx : ((a + b - k : ℕ) : ZMod n) =
      ((a + b : ℕ) : ZMod n) - (k : ZMod n) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hk]
  have hbidx : ((a + b : ℕ) : ZMod n) - (a : ZMod n) = (b : ZMod n) := by
    push_cast
    abel
  simpa [hidx, hbidx] using hdrop

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.discreteLocalMax_of_weak_neighbors_of_eq_propagates
lean.code:
theorem discreteLocalMax_of_weak_neighbors_of_eq_propagates
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {P : ZMod n → Prop} {i : ZMod n}
    (hPi : P i)
    (hweak : ∀ j, P j → κ (j - 1) ≤ κ j ∧ κ (j + 1) ≤ κ j)
    (hpropRight : ∀ j, P j → κ j = κ (j + 1) → P (j + 1))
    (hpropLeft : ∀ j, P j → κ j = κ (j - 1) → P (j - 1))
    (hnc : ¬ ∃ c, ∀ j : ZMod n, κ j = c) :
    DiscreteLocalMax κ i := by
  classical
  have hrightExists :
      ∃ r : ℕ, 0 < r ∧ r ≤ n ∧ κ (i + (r : ZMod n)) < κ i := by
    by_contra hnone
    have hplateau : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ n →
        κ (i + (m : ZMod n)) = κ i ∧ P (i + (m : ZMod n)) := by
      intro m hm
      induction m with
      | zero =>
          constructor
          · simp
          · simpa using hPi
      | succ m ih =>
          rcases ih (by omega) with ⟨hκm, hPm⟩
          have hle : κ (i + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n)) ≤ κ i := by
            simpa [Nat.cast_add, add_assoc, hκm] using (hweak _ hPm).2
          have heq : κ (i + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n)) = κ i := by
            apply le_antisymm hle
            apply le_of_not_gt
            intro hlt
            exact hnone ⟨m + 1, by omega, hm, hlt⟩
          refine ⟨heq, ?_⟩
          have hstep : κ (i + (m : ZMod n)) = κ (i + (m : ZMod n) + 1) := by
            rw [hκm]
            simpa [Nat.cast_add, add_assoc] using heq.symm
          simpa [Nat.cast_add, add_assoc] using hpropRight _ hPm hstep
    apply hnc
    refine ⟨κ i, fun j => ?_⟩
    let m : ℕ := (j - i).val
    have hmle : m ≤ n := (ZMod.val_lt (j - i)).le
    have hm := (hplateau m hmle).1
    have hidx : i + (m : ZMod n) = j := by
      dsimp [m]
      rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (j - i)]
      abel
    simpa [hidx] using hm
  have hleftExists :
      ∃ l : ℕ, 0 < l ∧ l ≤ n ∧ κ (i - (l : ZMod n)) < κ i := by
    by_contra hnone
    have hplateau : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ n →
        κ (i - (m : ZMod n)) = κ i ∧ P (i - (m : ZMod n)) := by
      intro m hm
      induction m with
      | zero =>
          constructor
          · simp
          · simpa using hPi
      | succ m ih =>
          rcases ih (by omega) with ⟨hκm, hPm⟩
          have hle : κ (i - ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n)) ≤ κ i := by
            have hle' := (hweak _ hPm).1
            rw [hκm] at hle'
  -- … (truncated)

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.exists_strict_drop_forward_of_marked_weakMax
lean.code:
theorem exists_strict_drop_forward_of_marked_weakMax
    {n : ℕ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {P : ZMod n → Prop} {a b : ℕ}
    (hab : a < b)
    (hPa : P (a : ZMod n)) (hnotPb : ¬ P (b : ZMod n))
    (hweakRight : ∀ j, P j → κ (j + 1) ≤ κ j)
    (hpropRight : ∀ j, P j → κ j = κ (j + 1) → P (j + 1)) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, a < k ∧ k ≤ b ∧ κ (k : ZMod n) < κ (a : ZMod n) := by
  classical
  by_contra hnone
  have hwalk : ∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ b - a →
      κ (a + t : ZMod n) = κ (a : ZMod n) ∧ P (a + t : ZMod n) := by
    intro t ht
    induction t with
    | zero =>
        constructor
        · simp
        · simpa using hPa
    | succ t ih =>
        rcases ih (by omega) with ⟨hκt, hPt⟩
        have hle : κ (a + (t + 1) : ZMod n) ≤ κ (a : ZMod n) := by
          calc
            κ (a + (t + 1) : ZMod n) = κ ((a + t : ZMod n) + 1) := by
              congr 1
              ring
            _ ≤ κ (a + t : ZMod n) := hweakRight _ hPt
            _ = κ (a : ZMod n) := hκt
        have hnotlt : ¬ κ (a + (t + 1) : ZMod n) < κ (a : ZMod n) := by
          intro hlt
          apply hnone
          refine ⟨a + (t + 1), by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
          simpa [Nat.cast_add] using hlt
        have heq : κ (a + (t + 1) : ZMod n) = κ (a : ZMod n) :=
          le_antisymm hle (le_of_not_gt hnotlt)
        have heq' : κ (a + (t + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = κ (a : ZMod n) := by
          simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using heq
        refine ⟨heq', ?_⟩
        have hstep : κ (a + t : ZMod n) = κ ((a + t : ZMod n) + 1) := by
          rw [hκt]
          simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc] using heq.symm
        simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc] using hpropRight _ hPt hstep
  have hend := (hwalk (b - a) (by omega)).2
  have hab_le : a ≤ b := Nat.le_of_lt hab
  rw [← Nat.cast_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hab_le] at hend
  exact hnotPb hend

blocks.tex:
Starting at an index in $E$, continue through equal values in each direction.
Nonconstancy prevents this process from traversing the whole cycle. At the
first unequal value the weak maximum inequality makes the exit a strict drop;
equality propagation keeps the entire run in $E$. Repeat for $F$. The runs
are disjoint. On each complementary arc use the strict exit from each of
its two bounding maximum runs. The minimum of the finite arc is therefore
below both endpoint values and lies in its interior;
extending through ties gives a plateau minimum with strict rises on both
sides. The two complementary arcs give the required alternating minima.

blocks.label: mf:core-circle-coordinates
blocks.title: Circle coordinates along a chord
blocks.body:
Translate and rotate a nonzero chord so its endpoints are $-a,a$, with $a>0$.
A circle through them has center $iy$ and radius $\sqrt{a^2+y^2}$.
For a third point $z=x+it$ with $t\ne0$, its circumcircle parameter is
\[
 y_z=\frac{x^2+t^2-a^2}{2t},\qquad
 \operatorname{power}_{y}(z)=x^2+t^2-2yt-a^2.
\]
Its signed curvature is
$\operatorname{sign}(t)/\sqrt{a^2+y_z^2}$, using the chord ordering.
Regularity at either chord endpoint, for the incident triple containing $z$,
selects the nonnegative parameter on the positive-turn branch and the
nonpositive parameter on the negative-turn branch.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.normalizedCircumcenterParameter_nonpos_of_regular
lean.code:
theorem normalizedCircumcenterParameter_nonpos_of_regular {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    {z O : ℂ} {R : ℝ} (hz : z.im < 0)
    (hcircle : CircumcircleR2 z (-a : ℂ) (a : ℂ) O R)
    (hcone : InVertexCone z (-a : ℂ) (a : ℂ) O) :
    normalizedCircumcenterParameter a z ≤ 0 := by
  have hO := eq_normalizedCircleCenter_of_equidistant ha hz.ne
    (hcircle.2.2.1.trans hcircle.2.2.2.symm)
    (hcircle.2.1.trans hcircle.2.2.2.symm)
  rw [hO] at hcone
  exact normalizedCenter_nonpos_of_inVertexCone hcone hz

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.circlePowerR2_normalized_parameter

theorem circlePowerR2_normalized_parameter {a : ℝ} {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    circlePowerR2 (normalizedCircleCenter (normalizedCircumcenterParameter a z)) z
      (normalizedCircleRadius a (normalizedCircumcenterParameter a z)) = 0 := by
  rw [circlePowerR2_normalized]
  unfold normalizedCircumcenterParameter
  field_simp [hz]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.normalizedCircumcenterParameter_nonneg_of_regular
lean.code:
theorem normalizedCircumcenterParameter_nonneg_of_regular {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    {z O : ℂ} {R : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z.im)
    (hcircle : CircumcircleR2 z (-a : ℂ) (a : ℂ) O R)
    (hcone : InVertexCone z (-a : ℂ) (a : ℂ) O) :
    0 ≤ normalizedCircumcenterParameter a z := by
  have hO := eq_normalizedCircleCenter_of_equidistant ha hz.ne'
    (hcircle.2.2.1.trans hcircle.2.2.2.symm)
    (hcircle.2.1.trans hcircle.2.2.2.symm)

  exact normalizedCenter_nonneg_of_inVertexCone hcone hz

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.circumcircleR2_edge_parameter
lean.code:
theorem circumcircleR2_edge_parameter {A B C : ℂ} (hAB : A ≠ B)
    (hcross : Gluck.Discrete.crossR2 A B C ≠ 0) :
    CircumcircleR2 A B C
      (edgeCircleCenter A B (edgeCircumcenterParameter A B C))
      (normalizedCircleRadius (chordHalfLength A B) (edgeCircumcenterParameter A B C)) := by
  have hi := edgeCircle_incident hAB (edgeCircumcenterParameter A B C)
  have ha := chordHalfLength_pos hAB
  refine ⟨normalizedCircleRadius_pos ha.ne' _, hi.1, hi.2, ?_⟩
  exact dist_eq_of_circlePowerR2_eq_zero (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    (circlePowerR2_edge_parameter hAB hcross)

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.normalizedCircumcenterParameter
lean.code:
noncomputable def normalizedCircumcenterParameter (a : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  (z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2 - a ^ 2) / (2 * z.im)

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.signedMengerR2_edge_parameter
lean.code:
theorem signedMengerR2_edge_parameter {A B C : ℂ} (hAB : A ≠ B)
    (hcross : Gluck.Discrete.crossR2 A B C ≠ 0) :
    Gluck.Discrete.signedMengerR2 A B C =
      ((edgeCoordinates A B C).im / |(edgeCoordinates A B C).im|) *
        normalizedCircleCurvature (chordHalfLength A B) (edgeCircumcenterParameter A B C) := by
  have hz := edgeCoordinates_im_ne_zero hAB hcross
  have hi := signedMengerR2_directIsometry (norm_chordUnit hAB) (chordMidpoint A B)
    (-chordHalfLength A B : ℂ) (chordHalfLength A B : ℂ) (edgeCoordinates A B C)
  have he := canonicalChord_endpoints hAB
  unfold transportedChordLeft transportedChordRight at he
  rw [he.1, he.2, directIsometryR2_edgeCoordinates hAB] at hi
  have hn := signedMengerR2_normalized (chordHalfLength_pos hAB) hz
  simpa [edgeCircumcenterParameter] using hi.trans hn

blocks.tex:
The difference of the squared distances to $a$ and $-a$ forces the center's
real part to vanish. Equidistance to $z$ gives the displayed linear equation
for $y_z$. The signed Menger formula and the circle radius identity give the
curvature. Expressing the center as a nonnegative combination of the two
incident edge vectors gives the asserted parameter sign. Thus on each
regular branch equality of curvature determines the parameter uniquely.

blocks.label: mf:core-rigidity
blocks.title: Constant curvature forces a common circle
blocks.body:
For a simple locally regular polygon, equal nonzero curvature at adjacent
vertices gives the same circumcircle. Consequently a constant nonzero
profile makes the polygon concyclic; the identically zero profile is
impossible. Conversely a positively oriented simple concyclic polygon has
constant curvature $1/R$.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.not_constant_signedMengerProfile_of_not_concyclic
lean.code:
theorem not_constant_signedMengerProfile_of_not_concyclic
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon v) (hregular : DahlbergRegular v)
    (hnoncircle : ¬ Concyclic v) :
    ¬ ∃ c, ∀ i : ZMod n, SignedMengerProfile v i = c := by
  rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
  have hc0 : c = 0 :=
    constant_signedMengerProfile_eq_zero_of_not_concyclic hsimple hregular hnoncircle hc
  have hκzero : ∀ i : ZMod n, SignedMengerProfile v i = 0 := by
    intro i
    exact (hc i).trans hc0
  exact not_constant_signedMengerProfile_zero_of_isSimplePolygon hsimple hregular hκzero

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.not_constant_signedMengerProfile_zero_of_isSimplePolygon
lean.code:
theorem not_constant_signedMengerProfile_zero_of_isSimplePolygon {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    {v : ZMod n → ℂ} (hsimple : Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hregular : DahlbergRegular v)
    (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, SignedMengerProfile v i = 0) :
    False := by
  obtain ⟨i, hcoord⟩ :=
    exists_adjacent_equal_lineCoordR2_of_constant_signedMengerProfile_zero
      hsimple hregular hκ (0 : ZMod n)
  have hbase : v (0 : ZMod n) ≠ v ((0 : ZMod n) + 1) := hsimple.1 0
  have hC :
      Gluck.Discrete.crossR2 (v (0 : ZMod n)) (v ((0 : ZMod n) + 1)) (v i) = 0 :=
    all_vertices_cross_eq_zero_of_constant_signedMengerProfile_zero hsimple hκ 0 i
  have hD :
      Gluck.Discrete.crossR2 (v (0 : ZMod n)) (v ((0 : ZMod n) + 1)) (v (i + 1)) = 0 :=
    all_vertices_cross_eq_zero_of_constant_signedMengerProfile_zero hsimple hκ 0 (i + 1)
  have hvi : v i = v (i + 1) :=
    eq_of_crossR2_eq_zero_of_lineCoordR2_eq hbase hC hD hcoord
  exact hsimple.1 i hvi

theorem edgeCommonCircumcircle_of_endpoint_regular_neg_eq {A B P Q : ℂ}
    (hAB : A ≠ B)
    (hPcross : Gluck.Discrete.crossR2 A B P < 0)
    (hQcross : Gluck.Discrete.crossR2 A B Q < 0)

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.concyclic_of_constant_signedMengerProfile_ne_zero
lean.code:
theorem concyclic_of_constant_signedMengerProfile_ne_zero
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon v) (hregular : DahlbergRegular v)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : ∀ i : ZMod n, SignedMengerProfile v i = c) (hc0 : c ≠ 0) :
    Concyclic v := by
  rcases lt_trichotomy c 0 with hcneg | hczero | hcpos
  · exact concyclic_of_constant_signedMengerProfile_neg hsimple hregular
      (fun i => by simpa [hc i] using hcneg) ⟨c, hc⟩
  · exact False.elim (hc0 hczero)
  · exact concyclic_of_constant_signedMengerProfile_pos hsimple hregular
      (fun i => by simpa [hc i] using hcpos) ⟨c, hc⟩

blocks.tex:
The common edge supplies one chord coordinate system. Equal curvature and
the regularity sign restriction give equal center parameters, hence equal
centers and radii. Propagate this equality through the finite cycle. If the
profile vanishes identically, every triple is collinear and regularity puts
the middle vertex between its neighbours. Consecutive nonzero edges then
place the whole polygon on one line. A maximum of its finite line-coordinate
word, together with this betweenness condition, forces equality across an
adjacent edge, contradicting simplicity. The converse follows from the
positive signed-curvature formula on the common circle.

blocks.label: mf:core-containing-disks
blocks.title: Two containing local circumdisks
blocks.body:
For $n\ge4$, a simple, positively oriented nonconcyclic polygon has two
distinct local circumcircles whose closed disks contain all vertices. No
local-regularity hypothesis is needed for this containing-disk statement.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.dahlbergE2Theorem6Lemma5ContainingDisks
lean.code:
theorem dahlbergE2Theorem6Lemma5ContainingDisks
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon v)
    (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v)
    (hsupport : StrictConvexEdgeSupport v)
    (hgeom : StrictConvexCyclicChordGeometry v)
    (hnoncircle : ¬ Concyclic v) :
    Nonempty (DahlbergE2Theorem6ContainingDisksCertificate v) := by
  classical
  let contacts : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v → Finset (ZMod n) :=
    fun U => circleContactSet v U.center U.radius
  have hthree : ∀ U : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v,
      3 ≤ (contacts U).card := by
    intro U
    exact U.three_contacts
  have hproper : ∀ U : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v,
      contacts U ≠ Finset.univ := by
    intro U
    exact circleContactSet_ne_univ_of_not_concyclic U.radius_pos hnoncircle
  have hchoose : ∀ i : ZMod n,
      ∃ W : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v, i ∈ contacts W := by
    intro i
    exact exists_dahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2_at_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport
      hn hsupport i
  have hlocalize :
      ∀ (U W : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v) (c : ZMod n)
        {p k q : ℕ},
        p < k → k < q → q < n →
        Gluck.cyclicLift c p ∈ contacts U →
        Gluck.cyclicLift c q ∈ contacts U →
        Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∉ contacts U →
        Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∈ contacts W →
        contacts W ⊆ Gluck.mapCut c (Finset.Icc p q) := by
    intro U W c p k q hpk hkq hqn hpU hqU hkNotU hkW
    exact circleContactSet_subset_of_containingDisk_cutGap
      hgeom U W c hpk hkq hqn hpU hqU hkNotU hkW
  obtain ⟨U₀, _h0⟩ := hchoose 0
  obtain ⟨U, W, hUinterval, hWinterval, hcontactsNe⟩ :=
    exists_two_cyclicInterval_contacts_ne_of_cutGap_shrink
      contacts hthree hproper hchoose hlocalize U₀
  obtain ⟨i, hdataU, hcontainsU⟩ :=
    exists_edgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll_of_containing_contacts_interval
      hsimple horient U hUinterval
  obtain ⟨j, hdataW, hcontainsW⟩ :=
    exists_edgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll_of_containing_contacts_interval
      hsimple horient W hWinterval
  have hdistinct : EdgePrevCurvatureCirclesDistinct v i j := by
    intro hij
    apply hcontactsNe
    apply circleContactSet_eq_of_circleData_eq
    exact hdataU.symm.trans (hij.trans hdataW)
  exact ⟨⟨i, j, hcontainsU, hcontainsW, hdistinct⟩⟩

deps.label: detail:discrete-edge-support

blocks.tex:
The convexity theorem supplies strict global edge support and cyclic chord
separation. The finite coaxial maximum construction gives a containing disk
through every vertex with at least three contacts. The contact-gap descent
proved in the containing-disk chapter produces two different terminal
contact intervals. Each contains a consecutive triple and therefore defines
an actual local circumcircle. Distinct contact sets give distinct circle
data. No preselected extremum or generic-position condition is required.

blocks.label: mf:core-missing-family
blocks.title: Interior-missing disks and their contact gaps
blocks.body:
For a strictly convex polygon with $n\ge4$, every vertex is a contact of a
positive-radius circle with at least three contacts whose open disk contains
no vertex. This family satisfies the same contact-gap localization property
as the containing family.

lean.code:
theorem exists_dahlbergInteriorMissingThreeContactDiskR2_at_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsupport : StrictConvexEdgeSupport v) (i : ZMod n) :
    ∃ U : DahlbergInteriorMissingThreeContactDiskR2 v,
      i ∈ circleContactSet v U.center U.radius := by
  rcases exists_edgeThirdVertex_circle_interiorMissesAll_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport
      hn hsupport i with ⟨j, hji, hjnext, hall, hcircle⟩
  have hAB : v i ≠ v (i + 1) :=
    strictConvexEdgeSupport_edge_ne hn hsupport i
  let y := edgeCircumcenterParameter (v i) (v (i + 1)) (v j)
  let O := edgeCircleCenter (v i) (v (i + 1)) y
  let R := normalizedCircleRadius (chordHalfLength (v i) (v (i + 1))) y
  have hmisses : ∀ k : ZMod n, R ≤ dist O (v k) := by
    intro k
    exact (mem_edgeClosedExterior_iff_radius_le_dist hAB y).mp (hall k)
  have hiNext : i ≠ i + 1 := by
    intro h
    exact hAB (congrArg v h)
  have hthree : 3 ≤ (circleContactSet v O R).card := by
    apply three_le_card_circleContactSet hiNext hji.symm hjnext.symm
    · exact hcircle.2.1
    · exact hcircle.2.2.1
    · exact hcircle.2.2.2
  let U : DahlbergInteriorMissingThreeContactDiskR2 v :=
    { center := O
      radius := R
      radius_pos := hcircle.1
      misses := hmisses
      three_contacts := hthree }
  refine ⟨U, ?_⟩
  exact mem_circleContactSet.mpr hcircle.2.1

theorem circleContactSet_subset_of_missingDisk_cutGap
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hgeom : StrictConvexCyclicChordGeometry v)
    (U W : DahlbergInteriorMissingThreeContactDiskR2 v)
    (c : ZMod n) {p k q : ℕ}
    (hpk : p < k) (hkq : k < q) (hqn : q < n)
    (hpU : Gluck.cyclicLift c p ∈ circleContactSet v U.center U.radius)
    (hqU : Gluck.cyclicLift c q ∈ circleContactSet v U.center U.radius)
    (hkNotU : Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∉ circleContactSet v U.center U.radius)
    (hkW : Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∈ circleContactSet v W.center W.radius) :
    circleContactSet v W.center W.radius ⊆
      Gluck.mapCut c (Finset.Icc p q) := by

    U W hqU hpU hkNotU hkW

  exact hgap.2.2.2 x hxE

deps.title: Positive one-turn polygons have strict edge support
deps.label: detail:discrete-edge-support

blocks.tex:
Use the outgoing edge as the chord. All other vertices have positive height
$t$ in its oriented coordinates. Choose the minimum of their finitely many
parameters $y_z$. The inequality $y\le y_z$ is exactly nonnegative circle
power, so every vertex lies outside or on the circle; a minimizing third
vertex supplies the third contact. For localization, subtract the powers of
two circles. The result is affine. At the endpoints of a gap in one contact
set its sign is opposite to the strict sign at the interior contact of the
other circle. If the second circle had a contact outside the gap, strict
convex chord separation would give a chord intersection where the two affine
sign calculations contradict each other. This is the containing argument
with the power inequalities reversed.

blocks.title: Two interior-missing local circumdisks

Under the hypotheses of the preceding containing-disk theorem, there are
also two distinct local circumcircles whose open disks contain no polygon
vertex. The containing and interior-missing pairs give Dahlberg's four-disk
certificate; the pairs are not assumed to have already chosen alternating
indices.

deps.title: Interior-missing disks and their contact gaps
deps.label: mf:core-missing-family

blocks.tex:
Nonconcyclicity makes every contact set proper. Apply the finite contact-gap
descent to the interior-missing family. Its two distinct terminal contact
intervals each contain three consecutive vertices, identifying their unique
local circumcircles. Equal circle data would make the contact sets equal.
Combine this pair with the containing pair. This produces the certificate
rather than assuming its existence as an input.

blocks.label: mf:core-convex
blocks.title: The convex four-vertex theorem
blocks.body:
A simple, locally regular, positively oriented nonconcyclic polygon with
$n\ge4$ has alternating plateau maxima and minima of signed Menger curvature.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.signedMengerProfile_dahlbergFourVertex_of_two_distinct_interiorMissing
lean.code:
theorem signedMengerProfile_dahlbergFourVertex_of_two_distinct_interiorMissing
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hregular : DahlbergRegular v)
    (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v)
    (hnoncircle : ¬ Concyclic v) {i j : ZMod n}
    (hmissi : EdgePrevCurvatureDiskInteriorMissesAll v i)
    (hmissj : EdgePrevCurvatureDiskInteriorMissesAll v j)
    (hdistinct : EdgePrevCurvatureCirclesDistinct v i j) :
    DahlbergFourVertex (SignedMengerProfile v) := by
  let P : ZMod n → Prop := fun z =>
    EdgePrevCurvatureCircleData v z = EdgePrevCurvatureCircleData v i
  let Q : ZMod n → Prop := fun z =>
    EdgePrevCurvatureCircleData v z = EdgePrevCurvatureCircleData v j
  have hij : i ≠ j := by
    intro hij
    apply hdistinct
    rw [hij]
  have hPi : P i := rfl
  have hQj : Q j := rfl
  have hdisjoint : ∀ z, ¬ (P z ∧ Q z) := by
    rintro z ⟨hPz, hQz⟩
    exact hdistinct (hPz.symm.trans hQz)
  have hweakP : ∀ z, P z →
      SignedMengerProfile v (z - 1) ≤ SignedMengerProfile v z ∧
        SignedMengerProfile v (z + 1) ≤ SignedMengerProfile v z := by
    intro z hPz
    apply signedMengerProfile_neighbors_le_of_interiorMissesAll
      hsimple hregular horient
    exact (edgePrevCurvatureDiskInteriorMissesAll_congr_circleData hPz).2 hmissi
  have hweakQ : ∀ z, Q z →
      SignedMengerProfile v (z - 1) ≤ SignedMengerProfile v z ∧
        SignedMengerProfile v (z + 1) ≤ SignedMengerProfile v z := by
    intro z hQz
    apply signedMengerProfile_neighbors_le_of_interiorMissesAll
      hsimple hregular horient
    exact (edgePrevCurvatureDiskInteriorMissesAll_congr_circleData hQz).2 hmissj
  have hpropRight : ∀ {a : ZMod n},
      SignedMengerProfile v a = SignedMengerProfile v (a + 1) →
      EdgePrevCurvatureCircleData v a = EdgePrevCurvatureCircleData v (a + 1) := by
    intro a ha
    exact edgePrevCurvatureCircleData_succ_eq_of_signedMengerProfile_eq
      hsimple hregular horient a ha
  have hpropLeft : ∀ {a : ZMod n},
      SignedMengerProfile v a = SignedMengerProfile v (a - 1) →
      EdgePrevCurvatureCircleData v a = EdgePrevCurvatureCircleData v (a - 1) := by
    intro a ha
    have ha' :
        SignedMengerProfile v (a - 1) =
          SignedMengerProfile v ((a - 1) + 1) := by
      simpa using ha.symm
    have hdata := edgePrevCurvatureCircleData_succ_eq_of_signedMengerProfile_eq
      hsimple hregular horient (a - 1) ha'
    simpa using hdata.symm
  apply dahlbergFourVertex_of_two_disjoint_marked_weakMaxima
    hij hPi hQj hdisjoint hweakP
  · intro z hPz hκ
    exact (hpropRight hκ).symm.trans hPz
  · intro z hPz hκ
    exact (hpropLeft hκ).symm.trans hPz
  -- … (truncated)

deps.title: Constant curvature forces a common circle
deps.label: mf:core-rigidity

deps.title: Two disjoint families of weak maxima
deps.label: mf:core-marked-maxima

blocks.tex:
An interior-missing local circumdisk has radius no greater than the two
neighbouring circumradii: compare the circle powers in each common chord
coordinate system. Positive reciprocal curvature therefore makes it a weak
local maximum. Mark all indices having the first selected circle's complete
center-radius data, and separately those having the second circle's data.
The sets are nonempty and disjoint. Adjacent equal curvature propagates the
entire circle data by rigidity, so the marked sets satisfy equality
propagation. Nonconcyclicity makes the profile nonconstant. Apply the
marked-maxima lemma to obtain the two genuine plateaux and their intervening
minima. This step supplies strict plateau exits even when consecutive
curvatures are equal.

blocks.label: mf:core-two-arcs
blocks.title: The alternative when four extrema are absent
blocks.body:
If a nonconstant cyclic word has no alternating plateau maxima and minima,
choose a global minimum and a global maximum. The word is weakly increasing
on the oriented arc from the minimum to the maximum and weakly decreasing
on the complementary arc. Every nonempty sublevel set $\{i:k_i\le t\}$ is
a cyclic interval, including the nonpositive set at $t=0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.dahlbergFourVertex_of_descent_between_globalMinMax
lean.code:
theorem dahlbergFourVertex_of_descent_between_globalMinMax
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {a b : ℕ}
    (hwrap : b < a + n)
    (hminA : ∀ z : ZMod n, κ (a : ZMod n) ≤ κ z)
    (hmaxB : ∀ z : ZMod n, κ z ≤ κ (b : ZMod n))
    (hdesc : ∃ k : ℕ, a ≤ k ∧ k < b ∧
      κ (k + 1 : ZMod n) < κ (k : ZMod n)) :
    DahlbergFourVertex κ := by
  rcases hdesc with ⟨k, hak, hkb, hdesc⟩
  have hnc : ¬ ∃ c, ∀ z : ZMod n, κ z = c := by
    rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    rw [hc (k + 1 : ZMod n), hc (k : ZMod n)] at hdesc
    exact (lt_irrefl c) hdesc
  have hncNeg : ¬ ∃ c, ∀ z : ZMod n, -κ z = c :=
    not_constant_neg_iff.mpr hnc
  have hA_lt_k : κ (a : ZMod n) < κ (k : ZMod n) :=
    (hminA (k + 1 : ZMod n)).trans_lt hdesc
  have hkp1_lt_B : κ (k + 1 : ZMod n) < κ (b : ZMod n) :=
    hdesc.trans_le (hmaxB (k : ZMod n))
  have hleftA : ∃ t : ℕ, a ≤ t ∧ t ≤ k + 1 ∧
      -κ (t : ZMod n) < -κ (a : ZMod n) :=
    ⟨k, hak, by omega, neg_lt_neg hA_lt_k⟩
  have hleftB : ∃ t : ℕ, a ≤ t ∧ t ≤ k + 1 ∧
      -κ (t : ZMod n) < -κ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) :=
    ⟨k, hak, by omega, by simpa [Nat.cast_add] using neg_lt_neg hdesc⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hap, hpk, hminNeg⟩ :=
    exists_discreteLocalMin_between_of_strictly_below_endpoints
      (κ := fun z => -κ z) (a := a) (b := k + 1)
      (by omega) hleftA hleftB hncNeg
  have hmaxP : DiscreteLocalMax κ (p : ZMod n) :=
    discreteLocalMax_of_neg_localMin hminNeg
  have hrightA : ∃ t : ℕ, k ≤ t ∧ t ≤ b ∧
      κ (t : ZMod n) < κ (k : ZMod n) :=
    ⟨k + 1, by omega, by omega, by simpa [Nat.cast_add] using hdesc⟩
  have hrightB : ∃ t : ℕ, k ≤ t ∧ t ≤ b ∧
      κ (t : ZMod n) < κ (b : ZMod n) :=
    ⟨k + 1, by omega, by omega, by simpa [Nat.cast_add] using hkp1_lt_B⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hkm, hmb, hminM⟩ :=
    exists_discreteLocalMin_between_of_strictly_below_endpoints
      (κ := κ) (a := k) (b := b) hkb hrightA hrightB hnc
  have hminA_local : DiscreteLocalMin κ (a : ZMod n) :=
    discreteLocalMin_of_globalMin_of_not_constant hminA hnc
  have hmaxB_local : DiscreteLocalMax κ (b : ZMod n) :=
    discreteLocalMax_of_globalMax_of_not_constant hmaxB hnc
  have hcast : ((a + n : ℕ) : ZMod n) = (a : ZMod n) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_add, ZMod.natCast_self, add_zero]
  exact ⟨p, m, b, a + n, by omega, hmb, hwrap, by omega,
    hmaxP, hminM, hmaxB_local, by simpa [hcast] using hminA_local⟩
