deps.title: The circular completion when there are at least three contacts
deps.label: mf:contact-three

blocks.tex:
There are at least two contacts. With exactly two, minimality makes them
antipodal, and the required span is $\pi$. With at least three, the contact
orientation and complement-coverage lemmas place all contacts on the ordered
arc from $B$ to $A$. If that arc were shorter than $\pi$, its contacts would
lie in an open semicircle; shifting the center toward that semicircle and
shrinking the radius would still contain the finite polygon. This contradicts
minimality and gives the lower bound $\pi$.

blocks.label: mf:circle-splice
blocks.title: The finite circle splice
blocks.body:
For $q\ge1$ put $L=b-a+3$, $m=L+q$ and
$\delta=(\theta_A-\theta_B)/(q+1)$. The cyclic polygon $w$ first lists
$P_{a-1},\ldots,P_{b+1}$, then the $q$ circle points
$z(\theta_B+j\delta)$ for $j=1,\ldots,q$.
Thus the last circle edge closes at $A=z(\theta_A)$.
The mesh angles are strictly increasing, with exactly the constant step $\delta$.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.circleSplice
lean.code:
noncomputable def circleSplice (q : ℕ) (θB θA : ℝ) :
    ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q) → ℂ := fun i =>
  if i.val < run.chainLength then
    run.point (run.chainStart + i.val)
  else
    circlePoint O R
      (circleMeshAngle q (i.val - run.chainLength + 1) θB θA)

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.spliceVertexCount
lean.code: def spliceVertexCount (q : ℕ) : ℕ := run.chainLength + q

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.circleMeshAngle
lean.code:
noncomputable def circleMeshAngle (q j : ℕ) (θB θA : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  θB + (j : ℝ) / (q + 1 : ℕ) * (θA - θB)

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.circleMeshAngle_succ_sub
lean.code:
theorem circleMeshAngle_succ_sub
    (q j : ℕ) (θB θA : ℝ) :
    circleMeshAngle q (j + 1) θB θA -
        circleMeshAngle q j θB θA =
      (θA - θB) / (q + 1 : ℕ) := by
  have hden : ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  unfold circleMeshAngle
  field_simp
  push_cast
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.circleMeshAngle_strictMono
lean.code:
theorem circleMeshAngle_strictMono {q j k : ℕ} {θB θA : ℝ}
    (hBA : θB < θA) (hjk : j < k) :
    circleMeshAngle q j θB θA < circleMeshAngle q k θB θA := by
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < (q + 1 : ℕ) := by positivity
  have hjkReal : (j : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hjk
  have hfrac : (j : ℝ) / (q + 1 : ℕ) <
      (k : ℝ) / (q + 1 : ℕ) :=
    div_lt_div_of_pos_right hjkReal hden
  unfold circleMeshAngle
  simpa [add_comm] using
    (add_lt_add_left
      (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hfrac (sub_pos.mpr hBA)) θB)

blocks.label: mf:circle-internal-curvature
blocks.title: The splice preserves the interior curvature gap
blocks.body:
Every internal chain triple is unchanged, so its curvature remains greater than
$1/R$. At each inserted vertex, all three neighbouring points lie on the
original circle and are positively oriented, including the first and last
inserted vertices.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.signedMengerProfile_circleSplice_internal_chain
lean.code:
theorem signedMengerProfile_circleSplice_internal_chain
    (q : ℕ) (θB θA : ℝ) {t : ℕ}
    (ht : 0 < t) (htnext : t + 1 < run.chainLength) :
    SignedMengerProfile (run.circleSplice q θB θA)
        (t : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) =
      SignedMengerProfile v
        (Gluck.cyclicLift run.c (run.chainStart + t)) := by
  letI : NeZero (run.spliceVertexCount q) :=
    ⟨(run.spliceVertexCount_pos q).ne'⟩
  rw [SignedMengerProfile_apply, SignedMengerProfile_apply,
    run.circleSplice_chain_prev q θB θA ht (by omega),
    run.circleSplice_natCast_of_lt_chain q θB θA (by omega),
    run.circleSplice_chain_next q θB θA htnext]
  simp only [point]
  rw [cyclicLift_chain_prev run ht, cyclicLift_chain_next run t]

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.circleSplice_chain_next
lean.code:
theorem circleSplice_chain_next (q : ℕ) (θB θA : ℝ)
    {t : ℕ} (htnext : t + 1 < run.chainLength) :
    run.circleSplice q θB θA
        ((t : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) + 1) =
      run.point (run.chainStart + t + 1) := by
  letI : NeZero (run.spliceVertexCount q) :=
    ⟨(run.spliceVertexCount_pos q).ne'⟩
  have hcast :
      (t : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) + 1 =
        (t + 1 : ℕ) := by
    push_cast
    rfl
  rw [hcast, run.circleSplice_natCast_of_lt_chain q θB θA htnext]
  congr 1

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.circleSplice_chain_prev
lean.code:
theorem circleSplice_chain_prev (q : ℕ) (θB θA : ℝ)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : 0 < t) (htlen : t < run.chainLength) :
    run.circleSplice q θB θA
        ((t : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) - 1) =
      run.point (run.chainStart + t - 1) := by
  letI : NeZero (run.spliceVertexCount q) :=
    ⟨(run.spliceVertexCount_pos q).ne'⟩
  have hcast :
      (t : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) - 1 =
        (t - 1 : ℕ) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ t)]
    norm_num
  rw [hcast, run.circleSplice_natCast_of_lt_chain q θB θA (by omega)]
  congr 1
  omega

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.circleSplice_circleMesh_triple_boundary
lean.code:
theorem circleSplice_circleMesh_triple_boundary
    (q : ℕ) (θB θA : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hB : run.point (run.b + 1) = circlePoint O R θB)
    (hA : run.point run.chainStart = circlePoint O R θA)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j < q) :
    OnDiskBoundaryR2 (run.circleSplice q θB θA) O R
        ((run.chainLength + j : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) - 1) ∧
      OnDiskBoundaryR2 (run.circleSplice q θB θA) O R
        (run.chainLength + j : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) ∧
      OnDiskBoundaryR2 (run.circleSplice q θB θA) O R
        ((run.chainLength + j : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨hprev, hself, hnext⟩ :=
    run.circleSplice_circleMesh_triple q θB θA hB hA hj
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change run.circleSplice q θB θA
      ((run.chainLength + j : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) - 1) ∈ Metric.sphere O R
    rw [hprev]
    exact Metric.mem_sphere'.mpr (by rw [dist_circlePoint_center, abs_of_pos hR])
  · change run.circleSplice q θB θA
      (run.chainLength + j : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) ∈ Metric.sphere O R
    rw [hself]
    exact Metric.mem_sphere'.mpr (by rw [dist_circlePoint_center, abs_of_pos hR])
  · change run.circleSplice q θB θA
      ((run.chainLength + j : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) + 1) ∈ Metric.sphere O R
    rw [hnext]
    exact Metric.mem_sphere'.mpr (by rw [dist_circlePoint_center, abs_of_pos hR])

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.signedMengerProfile_circleSplice_internal_chain_gap
lean.code:
theorem signedMengerProfile_circleSplice_internal_chain_gap
    (q : ℕ) (θB θA : ℝ) {t : ℕ}
    (ht : 0 < t) (htnext : t + 1 < run.chainLength) :
    1 / R < SignedMengerProfile (run.circleSplice q θB θA)
      (t : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) := by
  rw [run.signedMengerProfile_circleSplice_internal_chain q θB θA ht htnext]
  apply run.curvature_gap
  · have ha := run.a_pos
    simp only [chainStart]
    omega
  · have ha := run.a_pos
    have hab := run.a_le_b
    simp only [chainStart, chainLength] at htnext ⊢
    omega

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.circleSplice_circleMesh_cross_pos
lean.code:
theorem circleSplice_circleMesh_cross_pos
    (q : ℕ) (θB θA : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hBA : θB < θA) (hspan : θA < θB + 2 * Real.pi)
    (hB : run.point (run.b + 1) = circlePoint O R θB)
    (hA : run.point run.chainStart = circlePoint O R θA)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j < q) :
    0 < crossR2
      (run.circleSplice q θB θA
        ((run.chainLength + j : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) - 1))
      (run.circleSplice q θB θA
        (run.chainLength + j : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)))
      (run.circleSplice q θB θA
        ((run.chainLength + j : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨hprev, hself, hnext⟩ :=
    run.circleSplice_circleMesh_triple q θB θA hB hA hj
  rw [hprev, hself, hnext]
  apply crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_ordered O hR.ne'
  · exact circleMeshAngle_strictMono hBA (by omega)
  · exact circleMeshAngle_strictMono hBA (by omega)
  · have hj0 := circleMeshAngle_mem_Icc (q := q) (j := j)
      hBA.le (by omega)
    have hj2 := circleMeshAngle_mem_Icc (q := q) (j := j + 2)
      hBA.le (by omega)
    have hshift : θB + 2 * Real.pi ≤
        circleMeshAngle q j θB θA + 2 * Real.pi := by
      linarith [hj0.1]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hj2.2
      (hspan.trans_le hshift)

blocks.tex:
For an internal chain index, predecessor and successor still belong to the
chain. At inserted index $j$ they have angular parameters
$\theta_B+j\delta$, $\theta_B+(j+1)\delta$ and
$\theta_B+(j+2)\delta$, interpreting the two ends as $B$ and $A$.
Their parameters are ordered within one turn, which makes the determinant
positive. The cyclic seam identities ensure this reasoning also covers the
last inserted vertex.

blocks.label: mf:circle-chord-support
blocks.title: A fine circle chord supports the entire interior chain
blocks.body:
Let $r_*=\max_{a\le j\le b}|P_j-O|<R$. If
$0<\delta<\pi$ and $r_*<R\cos(\delta/2)$, every nonincident splice vertex
lies strictly left of every circle-mesh edge.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_dist_le_of_innerRadius_lt
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_dist_le_of_innerRadius_lt
    (O P : ℂ) {R θ₀ θ₁ ρ : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (h₀₁ : θ₀ < θ₁) (hspan : θ₁ < θ₀ + Real.pi)
    (hP : dist O P ≤ ρ)
    (hρ : ρ < R * Real.cos ((θ₁ - θ₀) / 2)) :
    0 < crossR2 (circlePoint O R θ₀) (circlePoint O R θ₁) P := by
  exact crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_dist_lt_innerRadius O P hR h₀₁ hspan
    (hP.trans_lt hρ)

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.circleMeshChord_supports_internalChain
lean.code:
theorem circleMeshChord_supports_internalChain
    {q j k : ℕ} {θB θA : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 < R) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hBA : θB < θA) (hspan : θA < θB + 2 * Real.pi)
    (hinner : run.chainInnerRadius <
      R * Real.cos (((θA - θB) / (q + 1 : ℕ)) / 2))
    (_hj : j ≤ q) (hak : run.a ≤ k) (hkb : k ≤ run.b) :
    0 < crossR2
      (circlePoint O R (circleMeshAngle q j θB θA))
      (circlePoint O R (circleMeshAngle q (j + 1) θB θA))
      (run.point k) := by
  apply run.crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_chainInnerRadius_lt hR hak hkb
  · exact circleMeshAngle_succ_lt hBA
  · have hdiff := circleMeshAngle_succ_sub q j θB θA
    have hden : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (q + 1 : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 2 ≤ q + 1)
    have hδ : θA - θB < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith
    have hstep : (θA - θB) / (q + 1 : ℕ) < Real.pi := by
      apply (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (q + 1 : ℕ))).mpr
      nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
    linarith
  · rw [circleMeshAngle_succ_sub]
    exact hinner

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.circleSplice_circleEdge_strictSupport
lean.code:
theorem circleSplice_circleEdge_strictSupport
    {q j : ℕ} {θB θA : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 < R) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hBA : θB < θA) (hspan : θA < θB + 2 * Real.pi)
    (hinner : run.chainInnerRadius <
      R * Real.cos (((θA - θB) / (q + 1 : ℕ)) / 2))
    (hB : run.point (run.b + 1) = circlePoint O R θB)
    (hA : run.point run.chainStart = circlePoint O R θA)
    (hj : j ≤ q) (i : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q))
    (hi0 : i ≠ run.circleSpliceMeshIndex q j)
    (hi1 : i ≠ run.circleSpliceMeshIndex q (j + 1)) :
    0 < crossR2
      (run.circleSplice q θB θA (run.circleSpliceMeshIndex q j))
      (run.circleSplice q θB θA (run.circleSpliceMeshIndex q (j + 1)))
      (run.circleSplice q θB θA i) := by
  have hj' : j ≤ q + 1 := by omega
  have hj1 : j + 1 ≤ q + 1 := by omega
  rw [run.circleSplice_apply_meshIndex q θB θA hB hA hj',
    run.circleSplice_apply_meshIndex q θB θA hB hA hj1]
  rcases run.circleSplice_vertex_internalChain_or_meshIndex q θB θA i with
      ⟨k, hak, hkb, hi⟩ | ⟨ℓ, hℓ, hi⟩
  · rw [hi]
    exact run.circleMeshChord_supports_internalChain hR hq hBA hspan
      hinner hj hak hkb
  · have hℓj : ℓ ≠ j := by
      intro h
      subst ℓ
      exact hi0 hi
    have hℓj1 : ℓ ≠ j + 1 := by
      intro h
      subst ℓ
      exact hi1 hi
    rw [hi, run.circleSplice_apply_meshIndex q θB θA hB hA hℓ]
    exact circleMeshChord_supports_otherCirclePoint (O := O) hR hBA hspan
      hj hℓ hℓj hℓj1

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_circlePoint_eq_midpoint_projection
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_circlePoint_eq_midpoint_projection
    (O P : ℂ) (R θ₀ θ₁ : ℝ) :
    crossR2 (circlePoint O R θ₀) (circlePoint O R θ₁) P =
      2 * R * Real.sin ((θ₁ - θ₀) / 2) *
        (R * Real.cos ((θ₁ - θ₀) / 2) -
          inner ℝ (circlePoint 0 1 ((θ₀ + θ₁) / 2)) (P - O)) := by
  simpa only [show (θ₀ + θ₁) / 2 - (θ₁ - θ₀) / 2 = θ₀ by ring,
    show (θ₀ + θ₁) / 2 + (θ₁ - θ₀) / 2 = θ₁ by ring] using
      crossR2_circlePoint_symmetric_eq_midpoint_projection
        O P R ((θ₀ + θ₁) / 2) ((θ₁ - θ₀) / 2)

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.circleMeshChord_supports_otherCirclePoint
lean.code:
theorem circleMeshChord_supports_otherCirclePoint
    {q j ℓ : ℕ} {θB θA : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 < R) (hBA : θB < θA)
    (hspan : θA < θB + 2 * Real.pi)
    (hj : j ≤ q) (hℓ : ℓ ≤ q + 1)
    (hℓj : ℓ ≠ j) (hℓj1 : ℓ ≠ j + 1) :
    0 < crossR2
      (circlePoint O R (circleMeshAngle q j θB θA))
      (circlePoint O R (circleMeshAngle q (j + 1) θB θA))
      (circlePoint O R (circleMeshAngle q ℓ θB θA)) := by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hℓj with hℓltj | hjltℓ
  · apply crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_ordered_after_wrap O hR.ne'
    · exact circleMeshAngle_strictMono hBA hℓltj
    · exact circleMeshAngle_succ_lt hBA
    · have hj1 := circleMeshAngle_mem_Icc (q := q) (j := j + 1)
        hBA.le (by omega)
      have hℓI := circleMeshAngle_mem_Icc (q := q) (j := ℓ) hBA.le hℓ
      have hshift : θB + 2 * Real.pi ≤
          circleMeshAngle q ℓ θB θA + 2 * Real.pi := by
        simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_left hℓI.1 (2 * Real.pi)
      exact hj1.2.trans_lt (hspan.trans_le hshift)
  · have hj1ltℓ : j + 1 < ℓ := by omega
    apply crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_ordered O hR.ne'
    · exact circleMeshAngle_succ_lt hBA
    · exact circleMeshAngle_strictMono hBA hj1ltℓ
    · have hjI := circleMeshAngle_mem_Icc (q := q) (j := j)
        hBA.le (by omega)
      have hℓI := circleMeshAngle_mem_Icc (q := q) (j := ℓ) hBA.le hℓ
      have hshift : θB + 2 * Real.pi ≤
          circleMeshAngle q j θB θA + 2 * Real.pi := by
        simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_left hjI.1 (2 * Real.pi)
      exact hℓI.2.trans_lt (hspan.trans_le hshift)

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.chainInnerRadius_lt
lean.code:
theorem chainInnerRadius_lt
    (hΔ : MinimalEnclosingDiskR2 v O R) :
    run.chainInnerRadius < R := by
  unfold chainInnerRadius
  rw [Finset.sup'_lt_iff]
  intro k hk
  exact run.internal_dist_lt hΔ (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk).1
    (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk).2

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.chainInnerRadius
lean.code:
noncomputable def chainInnerRadius : ℝ :=
  (Finset.Icc run.a run.b).sup' run.internalIndexSet_nonempty
    (fun k ↦ dist O (run.point k))

blocks.tex:
For $u=e^{i(\theta_0+\theta_1)/2}$ and
$\delta=\theta_1-\theta_0$, direct expansion gives
\[
 [z(\theta_0),z(\theta_1),P]
 =2R\sin(\delta/2)\bigl(R\cos(\delta/2)-\langle u,P-O\rangle\bigr).
\]
For an interior chain vertex, Cauchy--Schwarz bounds its projection by $r_*$,
so both factors are positive. Other circle-mesh vertices are strictly left
by the cyclic orientation of three distinct points on a circle. The finite
maximum is strictly below $R$ because every interior chain point is strictly
inside the original disk.

blocks.label: mf:circle-contact-step
blocks.title: Curvature next to an interior point and a circle contact
blocks.body:
Let $R>0$, $Q=O+Ru$ with $|u|=1$, and $|P-O|<R$.
For sufficiently small positive angular steps, both ordered triples formed
from $P,Q$ and a circle point just before or just after $Q$ have signed
Menger curvature greater than $1/R$.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.endpointSuccessor_cross_eq
lean.code:
theorem endpointSuccessor_cross_eq
    (O P : ℂ) (R θ δ : ℝ) :
    crossR2 P (circlePoint O R θ) (circlePoint O R (θ + δ)) =
      R * (-(1 - Real.cos δ) *
          inner ℝ (circleTangent θ) (P - circlePoint O R θ) -
        Real.sin δ * inner ℝ (circleRadial θ) (P - circlePoint O R θ)) := by
  calc
    crossR2 P (circlePoint O R θ) (circlePoint O R (θ + δ)) =
        -crossR2 (circlePoint O R (θ + δ)) (circlePoint O R θ) P := by
          rw [crossR2_reverse]
    _ = -crossR2 (circlePoint O R (θ - (-δ))) (circlePoint O R θ) P := by
          congr 3
          ring
    _ = -(R * ((1 - Real.cos (-δ)) *
          inner ℝ (circleTangent θ) (P - circlePoint O R θ) -
        Real.sin (-δ) * inner ℝ (circleRadial θ) (P - circlePoint O R θ))) := by
          rw [endpointPredecessor_cross_eq]
    _ = R * (-(1 - Real.cos δ) *
          inner ℝ (circleTangent θ) (P - circlePoint O R θ) -
        Real.sin δ * inner ℝ (circleRadial θ) (P - circlePoint O R θ)) := by
          rw [Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
          ring



















namespace Section4PositiveRunCertificate

variable {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ} {O : ℂ} {R : ℝ}
    (run : Section4PositiveRunCertificate v O R)

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.exists_step_bound_signedMengerR2_circlePoint_successor
lean.code:
theorem exists_step_bound_signedMengerR2_circlePoint_successor
    {O P : ℂ} {R θ : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hP : dist O P < R) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε →
      1 / R < signedMengerR2
        P (circlePoint O R θ) (circlePoint O R (θ + δ)) := by
  have hzero := (inv_radius_lt_endpointCurvatureModel_zero_aux
    (θ := θ) hR hP).2
  have hevent : ∀ᶠ δ : ℝ in nhds 0,
      1 / R < endpointSuccessorCurvatureModel O P R θ δ :=
    (continuousAt_endpointSuccessorCurvatureModel_aux hP).eventually_const_lt hzero
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hevent
  let ε : ℝ := min η (2 * Real.pi)
  have hε : 0 < ε := lt_min hη Real.two_pi_pos
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro δ hδ0 hδε
  rw [signedMengerR2_circlePoint_successor_eq_model_aux hR hP hδ0
    (hδε.trans_le (min_le_right η (2 * Real.pi)))]
  apply hball
  simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hδ0] using
    hδε.trans_le (min_le_left η (2 * Real.pi))

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.endpointPredecessor_cross_eq
lean.code:
theorem endpointPredecessor_cross_eq
    (O P : ℂ) (R θ δ : ℝ) :
    crossR2 (circlePoint O R (θ - δ)) (circlePoint O R θ) P =
      R * ((1 - Real.cos δ) *
          inner ℝ (circleTangent θ) (P - circlePoint O R θ) -
        Real.sin δ * inner ℝ (circleRadial θ) (P - circlePoint O R θ)) := by
  unfold crossR2
  simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, circlePoint_re, circlePoint_im]
  rw [Complex.inner, Complex.inner]
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, Complex.sub_re,
    Complex.sub_im, circlePoint_re, circlePoint_im,
    circleRadial_re, circleRadial_im, circleTangent_re, circleTangent_im]
  rw [Real.cos_sub, Real.sin_sub]
  ring_nf

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.dist_circlePoint_sub_eq_two_mul_sin_half
lean.code:
theorem dist_circlePoint_sub_eq_two_mul_sin_half
    {O : ℂ} {R θ δ : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ2π : δ < 2 * Real.pi) :
    dist (circlePoint O R (θ - δ)) (circlePoint O R θ) =
      2 * R * Real.sin (δ / 2) := by
  have hsin : 0 < Real.sin (δ / 2) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith)
  rw [dist_circlePoint_eq_two_mul_abs_sin_half, show θ - (θ - δ) = δ by ring,
    abs_of_pos hR, abs_of_pos hsin]

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.dist_center_sq_eq_dist_circlePoint_sq_add
lean.code:
theorem dist_center_sq_eq_dist_circlePoint_sq_add (O P : ℂ) (R θ : ℝ) :
    dist O P ^ 2 = dist (circlePoint O R θ) P ^ 2 +
      2 * R * inner ℝ (circleRadial θ) (P - circlePoint O R θ) + R ^ 2 := by
  have hdecomp : P - O =
      (P - circlePoint O R θ) + (R : ℝ) • circleRadial θ := by
    rw [← circlePoint_sub_center O R θ]
    ring
  calc
    dist O P ^ 2 = inner ℝ (P - O) (P - O) := by
      rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev]
    _ = inner ℝ ((P - circlePoint O R θ) + (R : ℝ) • circleRadial θ)
        ((P - circlePoint O R θ) + (R : ℝ) • circleRadial θ) := by rw [hdecomp]
    _ = inner ℝ (P - circlePoint O R θ) (P - circlePoint O R θ) +
        2 * R * inner ℝ (circleRadial θ) (P - circlePoint O R θ) + R ^ 2 := by
      simp only [inner_add_left, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
        inner_circleRadial_self, mul_one]
      rw [real_inner_comm (P - circlePoint O R θ) (circleRadial θ)]
      ring
    _ = dist (circlePoint O R θ) P ^ 2 +
        2 * R * inner ℝ (circleRadial θ) (P - circlePoint O R θ) + R ^ 2 := by
      rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev]

theorem dist_circlePoint_add_eq_two_mul_sin_half
    {O : ℂ} {R θ δ : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ2π : δ < 2 * Real.pi) :
    dist (circlePoint O R θ) (circlePoint O R (θ + δ)) =
      2 * R * Real.sin (δ / 2) := by
  have hsin : 0 < Real.sin (δ / 2) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith)
  rw [dist_circlePoint_eq_two_mul_abs_sin_half, show θ + δ - θ = δ by ring,
    abs_of_pos hR, abs_of_pos hsin]

blocks.tex:
For either endpoint triple, with the neighbouring circle point approaching
$Q$ from its appropriate side, cancellation of the chord factor
$2R\sin(\delta/2)$ extends the signed curvature continuously to $\delta=0$.
The limiting value is
\[
 \frac{-2\langle u,P-Q\rangle}{|P-Q|^2}>\frac1R.
\]
Indeed $|P-O|^2=|P-Q|^2+2R\langle u,P-Q\rangle+R^2<R^2$.
The denominator is positive because $P$ is strictly inside and $Q$ on the
boundary. Continuity therefore gives a positive step bound on each side.
This is a local circle calculation and assumes no selected complementary arc.

theorem exists_oddCircleMeshAngle_supporting_innerRadius_spliceEndpointGaps
    {ρ θB θA : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 < R) (hΔ : MinimalEnclosingDiskR2 v O R) (hρ : ρ < R)
    (hB : run.point (run.b + 1) = circlePoint O R θB)
    (hA : run.point run.chainStart = circlePoint O R θA)
    (hBA : θB < θA) (hspan : θA < θB + 2 * Real.pi) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧
      0 < (θA - θB) / ((2 * k + 1) + 1 : ℕ) ∧
      (θA - θB) / ((2 * k + 1) + 1 : ℕ) < Real.pi ∧
      ρ < R * Real.cos
        (((θA - θB) / ((2 * k + 1) + 1 : ℕ)) / 2) ∧
      1 / R < SignedMengerProfile
        (run.circleSplice (2 * k + 1) θB θA) 0 ∧
      1 / R < SignedMengerProfile
        (run.circleSplice (2 * k + 1) θB θA)
          ((run.chainLength - 1 : ℕ) :
            ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount (2 * k + 1))) := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hstepPos, hstepPi, hinner, hleftRaw, hrightRaw⟩ :=
    exists_oddCircleMeshAngle_supporting_innerRadius_endpointCurvatures_aux
      hR hρ hBA hspan (run.internal_dist_lt hΔ le_rfl run.a_le_b)
        (run.internal_dist_lt hΔ run.a_le_b le_rfl)
  obtain ⟨hleft, hright⟩ := circleSplice_endpoint_gaps_aux run (q := 2 * k + 1)
    (by omega) hB hA hleftRaw hrightRaw
  exact ⟨k, hk, hstepPos, hstepPi, hinner, hleft, hright⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.circleSplice_rightEndpoint_triple
lean.code:
theorem circleSplice_rightEndpoint_triple
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (θB θA : ℝ)
    (hB : run.point (run.b + 1) = circlePoint O R θB) :
    run.circleSplice q θB θA
        (((run.chainLength - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) - 1) =
        run.point run.b ∧
      run.circleSplice q θB θA
        ((run.chainLength - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) =
        circlePoint O R θB ∧
      run.circleSplice q θB θA
        (((run.chainLength - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) + 1) =
        circlePoint O R (θB + (θA - θB) / (q + 1 : ℕ)) := by
  let m : ℕ := run.spliceVertexCount q
  letI : NeZero m := ⟨(run.spliceVertexCount_pos q).ne'⟩
  have hthree := run.three_le_chainLength
  have hlen : 1 ≤ run.chainLength := by omega
  have hprev := run.circleSplice_chain_prev q θB θA
    (t := run.chainLength - 1) (by omega) (by omega)
  have hprevPoint : run.chainStart + (run.chainLength - 1) - 1 = run.b := by
    have ha := run.a_pos
    have hab := run.a_le_b
    simp only [chainStart, chainLength]
    omega
  have hiDef :
      ((run.chainLength - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod m) =
        (run.chainLength : ZMod m) - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hlen]
    norm_num
  constructor
  · rw [hprev, hprevPoint]
  constructor
  · simpa [hiDef] using (run.circleSplice_last_chain q θB θA).trans hB
  · have hnextIndex :
        ((run.chainLength - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod m) + 1 =
          (run.chainLength : ZMod m) := by
      rw [hiDef]
      ring
    rw [hnextIndex]
    have hmesh := run.circleSplice_natCast_circleMesh q θB θA
      (j := 0) hq
    simpa [circleMeshAngle_one_eq_add_step] using hmesh

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.circleSplice_leftEndpoint_triple
lean.code:
theorem circleSplice_leftEndpoint_triple
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (θB θA : ℝ)
    (hA : run.point run.chainStart = circlePoint O R θA) :
    run.circleSplice q θB θA (-1) =
        circlePoint O R (θA - (θA - θB) / (q + 1 : ℕ)) ∧
      run.circleSplice q θB θA 0 = circlePoint O R θA ∧
      run.circleSplice q θB θA 1 = run.point run.a := by
  let m : ℕ := run.spliceVertexCount q
  letI : NeZero m := ⟨(run.spliceVertexCount_pos q).ne'⟩
  have hlast : run.chainLength + (q - 1) < m := by
    dsimp [m, spliceVertexCount]
    omega
  have hprevIndex :
      ((run.chainLength + (q - 1) : ℕ) : ZMod m) = -1 := by
    have heq : run.chainLength + (q - 1) = m - 1 := by
      dsimp [m, spliceVertexCount]
      omega
    rw [heq, Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ m)]
    simp
  constructor
  · rw [← hprevIndex]
    have hmesh := run.circleSplice_natCast_circleMesh q θB θA
      (j := q - 1) (by omega)
    rw [show run.circleSplice q θB θA
        ((run.chainLength + (q - 1) : ℕ) : ZMod m) =
          circlePoint O R (circleMeshAngle q ((q - 1) + 1) θB θA) by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add] using hmesh]
    congr 2
    rw [show q - 1 + 1 = q by omega,
      circleMeshAngle_penultimate_eq_sub_step]
  constructor
  · exact (run.circleSplice_zero q θB θA).trans hA
  · have hone : (1 : ℕ) < run.chainLength := by
      exact run.three_le_chainLength.trans' (by omega)
    have hpoint := run.circleSplice_natCast_of_lt_chain q θB θA hone
    simpa only [Nat.cast_one, run.chainStart_add_one] using hpoint

The explicit seam triples consist of each joining circle point, its interior
chain neighbour, and the immediately neighbouring mesh point. Apply the local
circle-step estimate at both ends. As $k\to\infty$, the odd-mesh step tends
to zero and $R\cos(\delta/2)\to R>r_*$. Choose one $k$ satisfying both
endpoint step bounds and the chord-support bound. This proves a finite mesh

theorem circleSplice_positiveOrientation_of_endpoint_cross_pos
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v) (hR : 0 < R)
    (q : ℕ) (_hq : 1 ≤ q) (θB θA : ℝ)
    (hBA : θB < θA) (hspan : θA < θB + 2 * Real.pi)
    (hB : run.point (run.b + 1) = circlePoint O R θB)
    (hA : run.point run.chainStart = circlePoint O R θA)
    (hleft : 0 < crossR2
      (run.circleSplice q θB θA
        ((0 : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) - 1))
      (run.circleSplice q θB θA 0)
      (run.circleSplice q θB θA
        ((0 : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) + 1)))
    (hright : 0 < crossR2
      (run.circleSplice q θB θA
        (((run.chainLength - 1 : ℕ) :
          ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) - 1))
      (run.circleSplice q θB θA
        ((run.chainLength - 1 : ℕ) :
          ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)))
      (run.circleSplice q θB θA
        (((run.chainLength - 1 : ℕ) :
          ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) + 1))) :
    PositivePolygonOrientation (run.circleSplice q θB θA) := by
  let m : ℕ := run.spliceVertexCount q
  letI : NeZero m := ⟨(run.spliceVertexCount_pos q).ne'⟩
  intro i
  let t : ℕ := i.val
  have htlt : t < m := i.val_lt
  have hit : (t : ZMod m) = i := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val i
  by_cases htChain : t < run.chainLength
  · by_cases htZero : t = 0
    · have hi : i = 0 := by
        calc
          i = (t : ZMod m) := hit.symm
          _ = 0 := by rw [htZero]; norm_num
      simpa [m, hi] using hleft
    · by_cases htLast : t = run.chainLength - 1
      · have hi : i =
            ((run.chainLength - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod m) := by
          calc
            i = (t : ZMod m) := hit.symm
            _ = ((run.chainLength - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod m) := by rw [htLast]
        simpa [m, hi] using hright
      · have htPos : 0 < t := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero htZero
        have htNext : t + 1 < run.chainLength := by omega
        rw [← hit,
          run.circleSplice_chain_prev q θB θA htPos (by omega),
          run.circleSplice_natCast_of_lt_chain q θB θA htChain,
          run.circleSplice_chain_next q θB θA htNext]
        have hcenterLeft : run.a - 1 ≤ run.chainStart + t := by
          have ha := run.a_pos
          simp only [chainStart]
          omega
        have hcenterRight : run.chainStart + t ≤ run.b + 1 := by
          have ha := run.a_pos
          have hab := run.a_le_b
          simp only [chainStart, chainLength] at htNext ⊢
          omega
        have hturn := run.cross_pos hsimple hR hcenterLeft hcenterRight
        have hkPos : 0 < run.chainStart + t := by
  -- … (truncated)

theorem circleSplice_isSimplePolygon
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v) (hΔ : MinimalEnclosingDiskR2 v O R)
    {q : ℕ} {θB θA : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 < R) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hBA : θB < θA) (hspan : θA < θB + 2 * Real.pi)
    (hinner : run.chainInnerRadius <
      R * Real.cos (((θA - θB) / (q + 1 : ℕ)) / 2))
    (hB : run.point (run.b + 1) = circlePoint O R θB)
    (hA : run.point run.chainStart = circlePoint O R θA)
    (hpositive : PositivePolygonOrientation
      (run.circleSplice q θB θA)) :
    IsSimplePolygon (run.circleSplice q θB θA) := by

    run.circleSplice q θB θA

  change PositivePolygonOrientation w at hpositive
  have hforward (i : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) :

  · intro i

              (run.circleSplice q θB θA

        rw [run.circleSplice_retainedEdge_segment q θB θA ht,

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.circleSplice_edge_chain_or_meshIndex
lean.code:
theorem circleSplice_edge_chain_or_meshIndex
    (q : ℕ) (i : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) :
    (∃ t : ℕ, t < run.chainLength - 1 ∧
      i = (t : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q))) ∨
    (∃ j : ℕ, j ≤ q ∧ i = run.circleSpliceMeshIndex q j) := by
  letI : NeZero (run.spliceVertexCount q) :=
    ⟨(run.spliceVertexCount_pos q).ne'⟩
  by_cases hchain : i.val < run.chainLength - 1
  · left
    exact ⟨i.val, hchain, (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val i).symm⟩
  · right
    by_cases hlast : i.val = run.chainLength - 1
    · refine ⟨0, by omega, ?_⟩
      simp only [circleSpliceMeshIndex, if_pos]
      exact (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val i).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun t : ℕ ↦ (t : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q))) hlast)
    · let j : ℕ := i.val - run.chainLength + 1
      have hlenle : run.chainLength ≤ i.val := by omega
      have hjpos : 0 < j := by dsimp [j]; omega
      have hival := ZMod.val_lt i
      have hvaleq : run.chainLength + (i.val - run.chainLength) = i.val :=
        Nat.add_sub_of_le hlenle
      have hdiff : i.val - run.chainLength < q := by
        apply Nat.add_lt_add_iff_left.mp
        rw [hvaleq]
        simpa only [spliceVertexCount] using hival
      have hjq : j ≤ q := by
        dsimp [j]
        omega
      refine ⟨j, hjq, ?_⟩
      have hjzero : j ≠ 0 := by omega
      have hjlast : j ≠ q + 1 := by omega
      rw [circleSpliceMeshIndex, if_neg hjzero, if_neg hjlast]
      calc
        i = (i.val : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) :=
          (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val i).symm
        _ = (run.chainLength + (j - 1) : ℕ) := by
          congr 1
          dsimp [j]
          omega

blocks.tex:
The interior chain triples have positive curvature; circle triples have positive
cyclic orientation; and the two joining triples have curvature greater than
$1/R>0$. Their edges are nonzero, so positive signed curvature implies positive
determinant. For simplicity, split edges into inherited chain edges and mesh
edges. Two inherited edges obey the original polygon's intersection conditions.
Every nonincident vertex lies strictly left of a mesh edge, so a nonadjacent
edge cannot meet it. Consecutive noncollinear edges meet only at their shared
endpoint. The decomposition includes the closing edge and proves all required
intersection conditions, without assuming simplicity of the new polygon.

blocks.title: The mesh itself prevents a smaller containing disk
blocks.body: Every disk containing an odd-mesh splice has radius at least $R$.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.circleSplice_oddMesh_radius_obstruction
lean.code:
theorem circleSplice_oddMesh_radius_obstruction
    (k : ℕ) (θB θA : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hlower : Real.pi ≤ θA - θB)
    (hupper : θA - θB < 2 * Real.pi)
    (hB : run.point (run.b + 1) = circlePoint O R θB)
    (hA : run.point run.chainStart = circlePoint O R θA) :
    ∀ C S, 0 ≤ S →
      PolygonInClosedDiskR2
        (run.circleSplice (2 * k + 1) θB θA) C S → R ≤ S := by
  intro C S hS hcontains
  let q : ℕ := 2 * k + 1
  letI : NeZero (run.spliceVertexCount q) :=
    ⟨(run.spliceVertexCount_pos q).ne'⟩
  have hkq : k < q := by dsimp [q]; omega
  have hpointB :
      run.circleSplice q θB θA
          (run.chainLength - 1 : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) =
        circlePoint O R θB := by
    rw [run.circleSplice_last_chain q θB θA, hB]
  have hpointMid :
      run.circleSplice q θB θA
          (run.chainLength + k : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q)) =
        circlePoint O R ((θB + θA) / 2) := by
    rw [run.circleSplice_natCast_circleMesh q θB θA hkq]
    simp [q]
  have hpointA : run.circleSplice q θB θA 0 =
      circlePoint O R θA := by
    rw [run.circleSplice_zero, hA]
  apply circlePoint_radius_le_of_semicircle_triple_inClosedDisk
    hR hS hlower hupper
  · simpa [q, hpointB] using
      hcontains
        (run.chainLength - 1 : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q))
  · simpa [q, hpointMid] using
      hcontains
        (run.chainLength + k : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q))
  · simpa [q, hpointA] using
      hcontains (0 : ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount q))

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.circlePoint_radius_le_of_semicircle_triple_inClosedDisk
lean.code:
theorem circlePoint_radius_le_of_semicircle_triple_inClosedDisk
    {O C : ℂ} {R S θ₀ θ₂ : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 < R) (hS : 0 ≤ S)
    (hlower : Real.pi ≤ θ₂ - θ₀)
    (hupper : θ₂ - θ₀ < 2 * Real.pi)
    (h₀ : InClosedDiskR2 C S (circlePoint O R θ₀))
    (hm : InClosedDiskR2 C S (circlePoint O R ((θ₀ + θ₂) / 2)))
    (h₂ : InClosedDiskR2 C S (circlePoint O R θ₂)) :
    R ≤ S := by
  obtain ⟨ha, hb, hsum, hcenter⟩ :=
    circlePoint_center_convexCombo_endpoints_midpoint O R θ₀ θ₂
      hlower hupper
  have hcircle : CircumcircleR2
      (circlePoint O R θ₀)
      (circlePoint O R ((θ₀ + θ₂) / 2))
      (circlePoint O R θ₂) O R := by
    refine ⟨hR, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
      simp [dist_circlePoint_center, abs_of_pos hR]
  exact circumcircleR2_radius_le_of_center_convexCombo_three
    hcircle ha hb ha hsum hcenter hS h₀ hm h₂

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.circlePoint_center_convexCombo_endpoints_midpoint
lean.code:
theorem circlePoint_center_convexCombo_endpoints_midpoint
    (O : ℂ) (R θ₀ θ₂ : ℝ)
    (hlower : Real.pi ≤ θ₂ - θ₀)
    (hupper : θ₂ - θ₀ < 2 * Real.pi) :
    let a := semicircleEndpointWeight θ₀ θ₂
    let b := semicircleMidpointWeight θ₀ θ₂
    0 ≤ a ∧ 0 ≤ b ∧ a + b + a = 1 ∧
      O = (a : ℂ) * circlePoint O R θ₀ +
        (b : ℂ) * circlePoint O R ((θ₀ + θ₂) / 2) +
        (a : ℂ) * circlePoint O R θ₂ := by
  obtain ⟨ha, hb, hsum, hcancel⟩ :=
    semicircle_weights hlower hupper
  let a := semicircleEndpointWeight θ₀ θ₂
  let b := semicircleMidpointWeight θ₀ θ₂
  have hweights : 0 ≤ a ∧ 0 ≤ b ∧ a + b + a = 1 :=
    ⟨ha, hb, hsum⟩
  refine ⟨ha, hb, hsum, ?_⟩
  have hcosdiff :
      Real.cos ((θ₀ - θ₂) / 2) = Real.cos ((θ₂ - θ₀) / 2) := by
    rw [show (θ₀ - θ₂) / 2 = -((θ₂ - θ₀) / 2) by ring,
      Real.cos_neg]
  have hcosSum : Real.cos θ₀ + Real.cos θ₂ =
      2 * Real.cos ((θ₀ + θ₂) / 2) *
        Real.cos ((θ₂ - θ₀) / 2) := by
    rw [Real.cos_add_cos, hcosdiff]
  have hsinSum : Real.sin θ₀ + Real.sin θ₂ =
      2 * Real.sin ((θ₀ + θ₂) / 2) *
        Real.cos ((θ₂ - θ₀) / 2) := by
    rw [Real.sin_add_sin, hcosdiff]
  have hcosWeighted :
      semicircleEndpointWeight θ₀ θ₂ * Real.cos θ₀ +
        semicircleMidpointWeight θ₀ θ₂ *
          Real.cos ((θ₀ + θ₂) / 2) +
        semicircleEndpointWeight θ₀ θ₂ * Real.cos θ₂ = 0 := by
    linear_combination
      (semicircleEndpointWeight θ₀ θ₂) * hcosSum +
      Real.cos ((θ₀ + θ₂) / 2) * hcancel
  have hsinWeighted :
      semicircleEndpointWeight θ₀ θ₂ * Real.sin θ₀ +
        semicircleMidpointWeight θ₀ θ₂ *
          Real.sin ((θ₀ + θ₂) / 2) +
        semicircleEndpointWeight θ₀ θ₂ * Real.sin θ₂ = 0 := by
    linear_combination
      (semicircleEndpointWeight θ₀ θ₂) * hsinSum +
      Real.sin ((θ₀ + θ₂) / 2) * hcancel
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero, circlePoint_re]
    linear_combination -O.re * hsum - R * hcosWeighted
  · simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero, circlePoint_im]
    linear_combination -O.im * hsum - R * hsinWeighted

blocks.tex:
An odd mesh includes the angular midpoint of the arc, as well as its two
endpoints. Put $t=(\theta_A-\theta_B)/2\in[\pi/2,\pi)$,
$\alpha=1/(2(1-\cos t))$ and $\beta=-\cos t/(1-\cos t)$.
These are nonnegative and $2\alpha+\beta=1$. The weighted sum of the two
endpoints, with weights $\alpha$, and the midpoint, with weight $\beta$, is $O$.
For any proposed center $C$, the same weighted sum of squared distances to
$C$ is $R^2+|O-C|^2$. If a disk of radius $S\ge0$ contains all three points,
this quantity is at most $S^2$, proving $R\le S$.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.circleSplice_oddMesh_nonconcyclic
lean.code:
theorem circleSplice_oddMesh_nonconcyclic
    (hΔ : MinimalEnclosingDiskR2 v O R) (hR : 0 < R)
    (k : ℕ) (θB θA : ℝ)
    (hBA : θB < θA) (hspan : θA < θB + 2 * Real.pi)
    (hB : run.point (run.b + 1) = circlePoint O R θB)
    (hA : run.point run.chainStart = circlePoint O R θA) :
    ¬ Concyclic (run.circleSplice (2 * k + 1) θB θA) := by
  let q : ℕ := 2 * k + 1
  let m : ℕ := run.spliceVertexCount q
  letI : NeZero m := ⟨(run.spliceVertexCount_pos q).ne'⟩
  have hkq : k < q := by
    dsimp [q]
    omega
  have hmidLeft : θB < (θB + θA) / 2 := by linarith
  have hmidRight : (θB + θA) / 2 < θA := by linarith
  have hcross : 0 < crossR2
      (circlePoint O R θB)
      (circlePoint O R ((θB + θA) / 2))
      (circlePoint O R θA) := by
    exact crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_ordered O hR.ne'
      hmidLeft hmidRight hspan
  have hBM : circlePoint O R θB ≠
      circlePoint O R ((θB + θA) / 2) := by
    intro heq
    rw [heq] at hcross
    simp [crossR2] at hcross
  have hcircleO : CircumcircleR2
      (circlePoint O R θB)
      (circlePoint O R ((θB + θA) / 2))
      (circlePoint O R θA) O R := by
    refine ⟨hR, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
      simp only [dist_circlePoint_center, abs_of_pos hR]
  intro hcyclic
  obtain ⟨C, S, hS, hCS⟩ := hcyclic
  have hpointB :
      run.circleSplice q θB θA
          (run.chainLength - 1 : ZMod m) = circlePoint O R θB := by
    rw [run.circleSplice_last_chain q θB θA, hB]
  have hpointMid :
      run.circleSplice q θB θA
          (run.chainLength + k : ZMod m) =
        circlePoint O R ((θB + θA) / 2) := by
    rw [run.circleSplice_natCast_circleMesh q θB θA hkq]
    simp [q]
  have hpointA : run.circleSplice q θB θA (0 : ZMod m) =
      circlePoint O R θA := by
    rw [run.circleSplice_zero, hA]
  have hcircleC : CircumcircleR2
      (circlePoint O R θB)
      (circlePoint O R ((θB + θA) / 2))
      (circlePoint O R θA) C S := by
    refine ⟨hS, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [m, q, hpointB] using
        hCS (run.chainLength - 1 : ZMod m)
    · simpa [m, q, hpointMid] using
        hCS (run.chainLength + k : ZMod m)
    · simpa [m, q, hpointA] using hCS (0 : ZMod m)
  have hcircleEq : O = C ∧ R = S :=
    circumcircleR2_unique_of_noncollinear hBM hcross.ne' hcircleO hcircleC
  have honeLt : 1 < run.chainLength := run.three_le_chainLength.trans' (by omega)
  -- … (truncated)

blocks.tex:
Its two endpoints and the arc midpoint are three distinct noncollinear points
of the original circle, hence determine that circle uniquely. At least one
original chain vertex remains strictly inside that circle, and so cannot lie
on it. A proposed circle containing the entire splice gives a contradiction.

blocks.label: mf:circle-radius-data
blocks.title: The geometric output needed for the contradiction
blocks.body:
The auxiliary data are a simple positively oriented nonconcyclic polygon with
at least four vertices, no containing disk of radius below $R$, and the
following property at every vertex: either its entire triple is on the
original circle, or its signed Menger curvature exceeds $1/R$.
The constructed odd-mesh splice satisfies all of these properties.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4AuxiliaryRadiusGeometry
lean.code:
structure Section4AuxiliaryRadiusGeometry (O : ℂ) (R : ℝ) where
  m : ℕ
  hne : NeZero m
  w : ZMod m → ℂ
  four_le : 4 ≤ m
  simple : Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon w
  positive : PositivePolygonOrientation w
  nonconcyclic : ¬ Concyclic w
  radius_obstruction : ∀ C S, 0 ≤ S → PolygonInClosedDiskR2 w C S → R ≤ S
  circle_or_curvature_gap : ∀ i : ZMod m,
    (OnDiskBoundaryR2 w O R (i - 1) ∧
      OnDiskBoundaryR2 w O R i ∧
      OnDiskBoundaryR2 w O R (i + 1)) ∨
    1 / R < SignedMengerProfile w i

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.auxiliaryRadiusGeometry_of_oddCircleSplice
lean.code:
noncomputable def auxiliaryRadiusGeometry_of_oddCircleSplice
    (k : ℕ) (θB θA : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hlower : Real.pi ≤ θA - θB)
    (hupper : θA - θB < 2 * Real.pi)
    (hB : run.point (run.b + 1) = circlePoint O R θB)
    (hA : run.point run.chainStart = circlePoint O R θA)
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon
      (run.circleSplice (2 * k + 1) θB θA))
    (hpositive : PositivePolygonOrientation
      (run.circleSplice (2 * k + 1) θB θA))
    (hnoncyclic : ¬ Concyclic
      (run.circleSplice (2 * k + 1) θB θA))
    (hleftGap : 1 / R < SignedMengerProfile
      (run.circleSplice (2 * k + 1) θB θA) 0)
    (hrightGap : 1 / R < SignedMengerProfile
      (run.circleSplice (2 * k + 1) θB θA)
        (run.chainLength - 1 :
          ZMod (run.spliceVertexCount (2 * k + 1)))) :
    Section4AuxiliaryRadiusGeometry O R := by
  let q : ℕ := 2 * k + 1
  let m : ℕ := run.spliceVertexCount q
  let w : ZMod m → ℂ := run.circleSplice q θB θA
  have hmpos : 0 < m := by
    exact run.spliceVertexCount_pos q
  let hneM : NeZero m := ⟨hmpos.ne'⟩
  letI : NeZero m := hneM
  refine {
    m := m
    hne := hneM
    w := w
    four_le := ?_
    simple := by simpa [m, w, q] using hsimple
    positive := by simpa [m, w, q] using hpositive
    nonconcyclic := by simpa [m, w, q] using hnoncyclic
    radius_obstruction := ?_
    circle_or_curvature_gap := ?_ }
  · dsimp [m, q, spliceVertexCount]
    have hlen := run.three_le_chainLength
    omega
  · simpa [m, w, q] using
      run.circleSplice_oddMesh_radius_obstruction k θB θA hR
        hlower hupper hB hA
  · intro i
    let t : ℕ := i.val
    have htlt : t < m := i.val_lt
    have hit : (t : ZMod m) = i := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val i
    by_cases htChain : t < run.chainLength
    · by_cases htZero : t = 0
      · right
        have hi : i = 0 := by
          calc
            i = (t : ZMod m) := hit.symm
            _ = 0 := by rw [htZero]; rfl
        simpa [m, w, q, hi] using hleftGap
      · by_cases htLast : t = run.chainLength - 1
        · right
          have hiNat : i =
              ((run.chainLength - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod m) := by
            calc
              i = (t : ZMod m) := hit.symm
  -- … (truncated)

  ∀ i, EdgePrevCurvatureCircleData w i = (O, R) ∨
    EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile w i < R

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.ContainingCurvatureDisksShareCircle
lean.code:
def ContainingCurvatureDisksShareCircle {n : ℕ} (w : ZMod n → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : ZMod n,
    EdgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll w i →
    EdgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll w j →
    EdgePrevCurvatureCircleData w i = EdgePrevCurvatureCircleData w j

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.containingCurvatureDisksShareCircle_of_radiusGeometry
lean.code:
theorem containingCurvatureDisksShareCircle_of_radiusGeometry
    {O : ℂ} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (aux : Section4AuxiliaryRadiusGeometry O R) :
    ContainingCurvatureDisksShareCircle aux.w := by
  letI : NeZero aux.m := aux.hne
  have hclass : AuxiliaryCurvatureCircleClassification aux.w O R :=
    auxiliaryCurvatureCircleClassification_of_radiusGeometry hR aux
  have heq (i : ZMod aux.m)
      (hcontains : EdgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll aux.w i) :
      EdgePrevCurvatureCircleData aux.w i = (O, R) := by
    rcases hclass i with hcircle | hradius
    · exact hcircle
    · have hminimal : R ≤ EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile aux.w i :=
        aux.radius_obstruction
          (EdgePrevCircleCenterProfile aux.w i)
          (EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile aux.w i)
          (EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_pos aux.simple i).le hcontains
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hminimal hradius).elim
  intro i j hi hj
  exact (heq i hi).trans (heq j hj).symm

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.auxiliaryCurvatureCircleClassification_of_radiusGeometry
lean.code:
theorem auxiliaryCurvatureCircleClassification_of_radiusGeometry
    {O : ℂ} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (aux : Section4AuxiliaryRadiusGeometry O R) :
    AuxiliaryCurvatureCircleClassification aux.w O R := by
  letI : NeZero aux.m := aux.hne
  intro i
  rcases aux.circle_or_curvature_gap i with hcircle | hgap
  · left
    exact edgePrevCurvatureCircleData_eq_of_three_boundaries_of_cross_pos
      aux.simple hR hcircle.1 hcircle.2.1 hcircle.2.2 (aux.positive i)
  · right
    exact edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_lt_of_signedMengerProfile_gap
      hR aux.simple aux.positive hgap

A positively oriented triple on the original circle determines precisely that
circle. In the other case its positive curvature is greater than $1/R$, so
its radius is smaller than $R$. The radius obstruction excludes that second
case for a disk containing the auxiliary polygon. Equality here includes both

theorem dahlbergE2_theorem6_containing_source_contradiction
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) {w : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon w)
    (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation w)
    (hnoncircle : ¬ Concyclic w)
    (hfixed : ContainingCurvatureDisksShareCircle w) : False := by
  exact
    (not_containingCurvatureDisksShareCircle_of_simple_positiveOrientation

theorem not_containingCurvatureDisksShareCircle_of_simple_positiveOrientation
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) {w : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon w)
    (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation w)
    (hnoncircle : ¬ Concyclic w) :
    ¬ ContainingCurvatureDisksShareCircle w := by
  have hsupport : StrictConvexEdgeSupport w :=
    Gluck.Discrete.strictConvexEdgeSupport_of_simple_positiveOrientation
      hsimple horient
  have hgeom : StrictConvexCyclicChordGeometry w :=
    strictConvexCyclicChordGeometry_of_edgeSupport hsupport
  rcases dahlbergE2Theorem6Lemma5ContainingDisks
      hn hsimple horient hsupport hgeom hnoncircle with ⟨cert⟩
  exact not_containingCurvatureDisksShareCircle_of_containingCertificate cert

The containing-disk result used in Dahlberg's Theorem 6 supplies two distinct
curvature disks containing all vertices of any simple, positively oriented,
nonconcyclic polygon with at least four vertices. The preceding classification
forces both to have exactly the same center and radius $(O,R)$, a contradiction.
The source used here requires no separate local-regularity assumption on the
auxiliary polygon: simplicity and positive orientation imply strict edge support,
and the containing half of the theorem applies directly. All five geometric
hypotheses were established for the finite splice above.

blocks.tex:
Assuming the desired four-vertex condition fails, the chain-selection result
produces a positive run either in the given cyclic orientation or after
reversing all labels. Simplicity, local regularity and the same minimal enclosing
disk are preserved under reversal. Apply the complementary arc and splice
contradiction in whichever orientation supplies the run. Combining this with
the already proved strict branch and curvature comparison lemmas gives the
actual theorem-facing source; it is not an assumption of the final theorem.

The converse constructs a polygon from a radius word. This chapter starts
with an actual polygon and its three-line circles and derives the required
sign condition. The circle convention is unchanged: adjacent contacts may lie
on line extensions, and the central contact lies in its open edge.
All indices below are cyclic modulo $n$.

blocks.label: st:forward-chords
blocks.title: Strict edge support orders every vertex triple
blocks.body:
If $Y$ has strict edge support and $a<b<c<a+n$, then
$[Y_a,Y_b,Y_c]>0$. Consequently the chord $Y_aY_b$ is strictly negative
against vertices in the cyclic interval $(a,b)$ and strictly positive against
vertices in $(b,a+n)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.crossR2_cyclic_triple_pos
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_cyclic_triple_pos [NeZero n] {Y : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hY : StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y) (i : ZMod n) {a b : ℕ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b < n) :
    0 < crossR2 (Y i) (Y (i + (a : ZMod n))) (Y (i + (b : ZMod n))) := by
  have hn : 0 < n := NeZero.pos n
  have hfront : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 < j → j < n →
      0 < crossR2 (Y i) (Y (i + 1)) (Y (i + (j : ZMod n))) := by
    intro j hj hjn
    apply hY
    · have h := cast_ne_of_lt hjn hn (by omega : j ≠ 0)
      simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, add_ne_left] using h
    · exact fun heq ↦ cast_ne_of_lt hjn (by omega : 1 < n)
        (by omega : j ≠ 1) (by simpa only [Nat.cast_one] using add_left_cancel heq)
  have hstep : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j + 1 < n →
      0 < crossR2 (Y i) (Y (i + (j : ZMod n)))
        (Y (i + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n))) := by
    intro j hj hjn
    rw [← cross_cycle]
    have h0j : i ≠ i + (j : ZMod n) := by
      intro heq
      have hc : (0 : ZMod n) = (j : ZMod n) := by
        exact add_left_cancel (by simpa only [add_zero] using heq : i + 0 = i + (j : ZMod n))
      exact cast_ne_of_lt hn (by omega : j < n) (by omega : 0 ≠ j)
        (by simpa only [Nat.cast_zero] using hc)
    have h0s : i ≠ (i + (j : ZMod n)) + 1 := by
      intro heq
      have hc : (0 : ZMod n) = ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) := by
        apply add_left_cancel (a := i)
        simpa only [add_zero, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc] using heq
      exact cast_ne_of_lt hn hjn (by omega : 0 ≠ j + 1) (by simpa only [Nat.cast_zero] using hc)
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc] using hY (i + (j : ZMod n)) i h0j h0s
  by_cases ha1 : a = 1
  · subst a
    simpa only [Nat.cast_one] using hfront b hab hb
  · have ha2 : 1 < a := by omega
    induction b, hab using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => exact hstep a ha hb
    | succ k hak ih =>
      have hkn : k < n := by omega
      have hk1 : a < k := by omega
      exact cross_trans_in_halfplane (hfront a ha2 (by omega))
        (hfront k (by omega) hkn) (hfront (k + 1) (by omega) hb)
        (ih hkn) (hstep k (by omega) hb)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.crossR2_lifted_triple_pos
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_lifted_triple_pos [NeZero n] {Y : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hY : StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y) {a b c : ℕ}
    (hab : a < b) (hbc : b < c) (hca : c < a + n) :
    0 < crossR2 (Y (a : ZMod n)) (Y (b : ZMod n)) (Y (c : ZMod n)) := by
  have h := crossR2_cyclic_triple_pos hY (a : ZMod n)
    (a := b - a) (b := c - a) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
  simpa only [← Nat.cast_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le (by omega : a ≤ b),
    Nat.add_sub_of_le (by omega : a ≤ c)] using h

blocks.tex:
Fix the base vertex $A=Y_a$ and its next vertex $B=Y_{a+1}$.
Every other vertex lies in the same open left half-plane of $AB$.
Consecutive radial vectors from $A$ have positive determinants, by applying
edge support to the base vertex. To pass from consecutive to arbitrary radial
vectors, use the two-dimensional determinant identity
\[
 [A,B,V][A,U,W]=[A,B,U][A,V,W]+[A,B,W][A,U,V].
\]
If $U,V,W$ lie in the common open half-plane and the two consecutive radial
determinants are positive, the right side is positive and so is
$[A,U,W]$. Induction gives the result for any ordered pair of radial vectors;
the initial radial vector $B-A$ is handled directly by edge support.
Cyclic lifting and interchange of the last two vertices give the two chord signs.

blocks.label: st:forward-blocks
blocks.title: Absence of four signs gives two weak sign blocks
blocks.body:
Suppose $c$ has both a positive and a negative entry but no four cyclic
entries of signs $+,-,+,-$. There are lifts $a<b<a+n$ with $c_a<0<c_b$,
$c_k\le0$ for $a<k<b$, and $c_k\ge0$ for $b<k<a+n$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.exists_sign_blocks_of_not_dfv
lean.code:
theorem exists_sign_blocks_of_not_dfv [NeZero n] {c : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hpos : ∃ i, 0 < c i) (hneg : ∃ i, c i < 0) (hdfv : ¬ DFV c 0) :
    ∃ a b : ℕ, a < b ∧ b < a + n ∧ c (a : ZMod n) < 0 ∧ 0 < c (b : ZMod n) ∧
      (∀ k, a < k → k < b → c (k : ZMod n) ≤ 0) ∧
      (∀ k, b < k → k < a + n → 0 ≤ c (k : ZMod n)) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hpos
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hneg
  let p := i.val
  have hp : c (p : ZMod n) > 0 := by simpa only [p, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using hi
  let d := (j - i).val
  have hdn : d < n := ZMod.val_lt _
  have hd : 0 < d := by
    by_contra h
    have hz : d = 0 := by omega
    have hij : j = i := by
      have hcast : (d : ZMod n) = j - i := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _
      rw [hz, Nat.cast_zero] at hcast
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hcast.symm
    rw [hij] at hj
    linarith
  have hpd : ((p + d : ℕ) : ZMod n) = j := by
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, p, d, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
    ring
  have hfirst : ∃ k : ℕ, p < k ∧ k < p + n ∧ c (k : ZMod n) < 0 :=
    ⟨p + d, by omega, by omega, by simpa only [hpd] using hj⟩
  let a := Nat.find hfirst
  obtain ⟨hpa, hap, ha⟩ := Nat.find_spec hfirst
  have hwrap : c ((p + n : ℕ) : ZMod n) > 0 := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, ZMod.natCast_self, add_zero] using hp
  have hnext : ∃ k : ℕ, a < k ∧ 0 < c (k : ZMod n) := ⟨p + n, hap, hwrap⟩
  let b := Nat.find hnext
  obtain ⟨hab, hb⟩ := Nat.find_spec hnext
  have hbp : b ≤ p + n := Nat.find_min' hnext ⟨hap, hwrap⟩
  refine ⟨a, b, hab, by omega, ha, hb, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k hak hkb
    apply le_of_not_gt
    intro hk
    exact Nat.find_min hnext hkb ⟨hak, hk⟩
  · intro k hbk hka
    by_cases hkp : k < p + n
    · apply le_of_not_gt
      intro hk
      exact hdfv ⟨p, a, b, k, hpa, hab, hbk, hkp, hp, ha, hb, hk⟩
    · have hnk : n ≤ k := by omega
      have htk : k - n < a := by omega
      have hpt : p ≤ k - n := by omega
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ c ((k - n : ℕ) : ZMod n) := by
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hpt with he | he
        · simpa only [← he] using hp.le
        · apply le_of_not_gt
          intro hk
          exact Nat.find_min hfirst htk ⟨he, by omega, hk⟩
      simpa only [Nat.cast_sub hnk, ZMod.natCast_self, sub_zero] using hnonneg

blocks.tex:
Start at a positive entry $p$, take the first negative entry $a$ after it,
and then the first positive entry $b$ after $a$. The positive entry at
$p+n$ guarantees that this second search ends within a period. Minimality
makes the entries between $a$ and $b$ nonpositive, and those between $p$ and
$a$ nonnegative. A negative entry between $b$ and $p+n$ would combine with
$p,a,b$ to give the forbidden alternating four. The portion after $p+n$
repeats the initial nonnegative interval. These statements retain every zero.

blocks.label: st:forward-affine-balance
blocks.title: Affine balance forces four cyclic sign changes
blocks.body:
Let $n\ge3$ and let $Y$ have strict edge support. If
$\sum_i c_i=0$ and $\sum_i c_iY_i=0$, then either all coefficients vanish or
$\operatorname{DFV}(c,0)$ holds.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.vertex_ne_of_strictSupport
lean.code:
lemma vertex_ne_of_strictSupport [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n) {Y : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hY : StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y) {a b : ZMod n} (hab : a ≠ b) : Y a ≠ Y b := by
  by_cases hb : b = a + 1
  · rw [hb]
    exact (isSimplePolygon_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport hn hY).1 a
  · exact (pairwise_ne_of_crossR2_ne_zero (hY a b hab.symm hb).ne').2.2.symm

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.sum_mul_cross_eq_zero
lean.code:
lemma sum_mul_cross_eq_zero [NeZero n] {c : ZMod n → ℝ} {Y : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsum : ∑ i, c i = 0) (hbalance : ∑ i, c i • Y i = 0) (A B : ℂ) :
    ∑ i, c i * crossR2 A B (Y i) = 0 := by
  have hre : ∑ i, c i * (Y i).re = 0 := by
    simpa using congrArg Complex.re hbalance
  have him : ∑ i, c i * (Y i).im = 0 := by
    simpa using congrArg Complex.im hbalance
  calc
    ∑ i, c i * crossR2 A B (Y i) =
        ∑ i, ((B - A).re * (c i * (Y i).im) - (B - A).im * (c i * (Y i).re) -
          ((B - A).re * A.im - (B - A).im * A.re) * c i) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      simp only [crossR2, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
      ring
    _ = 0 := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hre, him, hsum, mul_zero, sub_self]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.sign_block_chord_classification
lean.code:
lemma sign_block_chord_classification [NeZero n] {c : ZMod n → ℝ} {Y : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hY : StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a < b) (hba : b < a + n)
    (hneg : ∀ k, a < k → k < b → c (k : ZMod n) ≤ 0)
    (hpos : ∀ k, b < k → k < a + n → 0 ≤ c (k : ZMod n)) (j : ZMod n) :
    j = (a : ZMod n) ∨ j = (b : ZMod n) ∨
      (c j ≤ 0 ∧ crossR2 (Y (a : ZMod n)) (Y (b : ZMod n)) (Y j) < 0) ∨
      (0 ≤ c j ∧ 0 < crossR2 (Y (a : ZMod n)) (Y (b : ZMod n)) (Y j)) := by
  let k := a + (j - (a : ZMod n)).val
  have hka : a ≤ k := Nat.le_add_right _ _
  have hkn : k < a + n := Nat.add_lt_add_left (ZMod.val_lt _) a
  have hkj : (k : ZMod n) = j := by
    simp only [k, Nat.cast_add, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
    ring
  by_cases hka' : k = a
  · exact Or.inl (hkj.symm.trans (congrArg (fun x : ℕ ↦ (x : ZMod n)) hka'))
  have hak : a < k := lt_of_le_of_ne hka (Ne.symm hka')
  rcases lt_trichotomy k b with hkb | hkb | hbk
  · apply Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
    refine ⟨by simpa only [hkj] using hneg k hak hkb, ?_⟩
    have hcross := crossR2_lifted_triple_pos hY hak hkb hba
    rw [hkj] at hcross
    rw [crossR2_swap]
    exact neg_neg_of_pos hcross
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (hkj.symm.trans (congrArg (fun x : ℕ ↦ (x : ZMod n)) hkb)))
  · apply Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr
    exact ⟨by simpa only [hkj] using hpos k hbk hkn,
      by simpa only [hkj] using crossR2_lifted_triple_pos hY hab hbk hkn⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.zero_or_dfv_of_strict_affine_balance
lean.code:
theorem zero_or_dfv_of_strict_affine_balance [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    {c : ZMod n → ℝ} {Y : ZMod n → ℂ} (hY : StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y)
    (hsum : ∑ i, c i = 0) (hbalance : ∑ i, c i • Y i = 0) :
    (∀ i, c i = 0) ∨ DFV c 0 := by
  classical
  by_cases hzero : ∀ i, c i = 0
  · exact Or.inl hzero
  apply Or.inr
  by_contra hdfv
  have hpos : ∃ i, 0 < c i := by
    by_contra h
    have hnonpos : ∀ i, c i ≤ 0 := fun i ↦ le_of_not_gt (fun hi ↦ h ⟨i, hi⟩)
    exact hzero (fun i ↦ congrFun ((Fintype.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonpos hnonpos).mp hsum) i)
  have hneg : ∃ i, c i < 0 := by
    by_contra h
    have hnonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i := fun i ↦ le_of_not_gt (fun hi ↦ h ⟨i, hi⟩)
    exact hzero (fun i ↦ congrFun ((Fintype.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hnonneg).mp hsum) i)
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hba, ha, hb, hnegative, hpositive⟩ :=
    exists_sign_blocks_of_not_dfv hpos hneg hdfv
  let F : ZMod n → ℝ := fun i ↦ crossR2 (Y (a : ZMod n)) (Y (b : ZMod n)) (Y i)
  have hclass := sign_block_chord_classification hY hab hba hnegative hpositive
  have hprod : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i * F i := by
    intro i
    rcases hclass i with hi | hi | ⟨hc, hf⟩ | ⟨hc, hf⟩
    · simp [F, hi, crossR2, mul_comm]
    · simp [F, hi, crossR2, mul_comm]
    · exact mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos hc hf.le
    · exact mul_nonneg hc hf.le
  have hprodzero : ∀ i, c i * F i = 0 := fun i ↦ congrFun
    ((Fintype.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hprod).mp
      (sum_mul_cross_eq_zero hsum hbalance (Y (a : ZMod n)) (Y (b : ZMod n)))) i
  have hsupp : ∀ i, i ≠ (a : ZMod n) → i ≠ (b : ZMod n) → c i = 0 := by
    intro i hia hib
    rcases hclass i with hi | hi | ⟨_, hf⟩ | ⟨_, hf⟩
    · exact (hia hi).elim
    · exact (hib hi).elim
    · exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (hprodzero i)).resolve_right hf.ne
    · exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (hprodzero i)).resolve_right hf.ne'
  have hcenter : ∑ i, c i • (Y i - Y (b : ZMod n)) = 0 := by
    simp only [smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_smul, hsum,
      zero_smul, sub_zero, hbalance]
  have hsingle : ∑ i, c i • (Y i - Y (b : ZMod n)) =
      c (a : ZMod n) • (Y (a : ZMod n) - Y (b : ZMod n)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_single (a : ZMod n)
    · intro i hi hia
      by_cases hib : i = (b : ZMod n)
      · simp only [hib, sub_self, smul_zero]
      · rw [hsupp i hia hib, zero_smul]
    · simp
  rw [hsingle] at hcenter
  have habcast : (a : ZMod n) ≠ (b : ZMod n) := by
    intro heq
    rw [heq] at ha
    linarith
  exact (smul_ne_zero ha.ne (sub_ne_zero.mpr (vertex_ne_of_strictSupport hn hY habcast)))
    hcenter

deps.title: Absence of four signs gives two weak sign blocks
deps.label: st:forward-blocks

deps.title: Strict edge support orders every vertex triple
deps.label: st:forward-chords

blocks.tex:
A nonzero zero-sum list has both signs. If no four-sign window exists, use
the two blocks separated by $a,b$. The chord functional
$F_i=[Y_a,Y_b,Y_i]$ has the same weak sign as $c_i$ at every other label,
and vanishes at $a,b$. Thus $c_iF_i\ge0$ for all $i$.
Its sum is zero: expansion of the affine functional leaves only a multiple
of $\sum c_i$ and a linear functional of $\sum c_iY_i$.
Every product therefore vanishes. Strict chord signs force $c_i=0$ away
from the two endpoints. Subtracting $Y_b\sum c_i$ from the vector balance
now gives $c_a(Y_a-Y_b)=0$. This contradicts $c_a<0$ and distinctness of
vertices, which follows from strict edge support. No generic-position or
nonzero-coefficient hypothesis was used.

blocks.label: st:forward-normal-independence
blocks.title: Adjacent outward normals are independent
blocks.body:
For an actual side-tangent realization with $n\ge3$, successive outward
normals have nonzero determinant.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsSideTangentRealization.normal_cross_ne
lean.code:
lemma IsSideTangentRealization.normal_cross_ne (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C) (i : ZMod n) :
    crossR2 0 (N (i - 1)) (N i) ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, he⟩ := h.oriented_edge (i - 1)
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hf⟩ := h.oriented_edge i
  simp only [sub_add_cancel] at he
  have ho := positiveOrientation_of_strictSupport hn h.strict_convex i
  have hid : crossR2 (P (i - 1)) (P i) (P (i + 1)) =
      l * m * crossR2 0 (N (i - 1)) (N i) := by
    have hs : P (i + 1) - P (i - 1) =
        (P i - P (i - 1)) + (P (i + 1) - P i) := by abel
    unfold crossR2
    rw [hs, he, hf]
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im,
      Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, sub_zero]
    ring
  intro hc
  rw [hid, hc, mul_zero] at ho
  exact lt_irrefl 0 ho

blocks.tex:
Write the two incident edges as $\ell iN_{i-1}$ and $m iN_i$ with
$\ell,m>0$. Their determinant is
$\ell m[N_{i-1},N_i]$. Strict support makes the consecutive vertex triple
positive, so the normal determinant cannot vanish.

blocks.label: st:forward-reconstruction
blocks.title: Actual circles reconstruct a closed inverse scaling
blocks.body:
For $n\ge3$ and an actual realization $(P,N,C)$ of positive radii $\rho$, put
$Y_i=(P_i-C_i)/\rho_i$. Then
\[
 \langle N_{i-1},Y_i\rangle=\langle N_i,Y_i\rangle=1,
 \qquad Y_{i+1}-Y_i=\frac{P_{i+1}-P_i}{\rho_i}.
\]
The cyclic polygon $Y$ has strict edge support and
$\sum_i(\rho_{i-1}-\rho_i)Y_i=0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsSideTangentRealization.reconstructed_inner
lean.code:
lemma IsSideTangentRealization.reconstructed_inner
    (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C) (i : ZMod n) :
    ⟪N (i - 1), reconstructedVertex ρ P C i⟫_ℝ = 1 ∧
      ⟪N i, reconstructedVertex ρ P C i⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
  simp only [reconstructedVertex, real_inner_smul_right, (h.circles i).1,
    (h.circles i).2.1, inv_mul_cancel₀ (h.radius_pos i).ne', and_self]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsSideTangentRealization.reconstructed_edge
lean.code:
lemma IsSideTangentRealization.reconstructed_edge (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C) (i : ZMod n) :
    reconstructedVertex ρ P C (i + 1) - reconstructedVertex ρ P C i =
      (ρ i)⁻¹ • (P (i + 1) - P i) := by
  rw [h.reconstructed_next hn, reconstructedVertex, ← smul_sub]
  congr 1
  abel

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.reconstructedVertex
lean.code:
noncomputable def reconstructedVertex (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ) (P C : ZMod n → ℂ)
    (i : ZMod n) : ℂ := (ρ i)⁻¹ • (P i - C i)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.exists_strict_balanced_polygon_of_realization
lean.code:
theorem exists_strict_balanced_polygon_of_realization (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C) :
    ∃ Y : ZMod n → ℂ, StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y ∧
      ∑ i, radiusDifference ρ i • Y i = 0 := by
  let Y := reconstructedVertex ρ P C
  have hY : StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y :=
    strictSupport_of_positive_edge_scaling hn h.strict_convex
      (fun i ↦ (ρ i)⁻¹) (fun i ↦ inv_pos.mpr (h.radius_pos i))
      (h.reconstructed_edge hn)
  refine ⟨Y, hY, ?_⟩
  have he : ∀ i, ρ i • (Y (i + 1) - Y i) = P (i + 1) - P i := by
    intro i
    rw [h.reconstructed_edge hn, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (h.radius_pos i).ne', one_smul]
  rw [show (∑ i, radiusDifference ρ i • Y i) =
      ∑ i, ρ i • (Y (i + 1) - Y i) by
        simpa only [radiusDifference] using (sum_scaled_edges ρ Y).symm]
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.addRight (1 : ZMod n)) P)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsSideTangentRealization.reconstructed_next
lean.code:
lemma IsSideTangentRealization.reconstructed_next (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C) (i : ZMod n) :
    reconstructedVertex ρ P C (i + 1) = (ρ i)⁻¹ • (P (i + 1) - C i) := by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply eq_zero_of_two_inner_eq_zero (h.normal_cross_ne hn (i + 1))
  · rw [inner_sub_right, (h.reconstructed_inner (i + 1)).1,
      real_inner_smul_right]
    have he : ⟪N (i + 1 - 1), P (i + 1) - C i⟫_ℝ = ρ i := by
      rw [add_sub_cancel_right,
        show P (i + 1) - C i = (P (i + 1) - P i) + (P i - C i) by abel,
        inner_add_right, h.normal_edge_orthogonal, (h.circles i).2.1, zero_add]
    rw [he, inv_mul_cancel₀ (h.radius_pos i).ne', sub_self]
  · rw [inner_sub_right, (h.reconstructed_inner (i + 1)).2,
      real_inner_smul_right, (h.circles i).2.2,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ (h.radius_pos i).ne', sub_self]

deps.label: st:outward-normals

deps.label: st:scaled-support

deps.title: Balance is exactly the edge-closure equation
deps.label: st:scaled-closure

blocks.tex:
The first two circle equations give the normalized inner products.
At vertex $i+1$, the vector $(P_{i+1}-C_i)/\rho_i$ has inner product one
with both $N_i$ and $N_{i+1}$. For $N_i$, transport the equation along its
orthogonal edge; for $N_{i+1}$, use the third circle equation directly.
The two normals are independent, so these two equations determine a unique
vector: it equals $Y_{i+1}$. Subtraction proves the inverse edge-scaling law.
The vertices are already a cyclic list, so this positive scaling is closed;
the positive-scaling support lemma supplies strict support. Multiplying by
$\rho_i$, summing the edge equations, and applying cyclic summation by parts
gives the claimed exact balance. Thus the auxiliary geometry is produced
from the input circles, not assumed as a further hypothesis.

blocks.label: st:forward
blocks.title: Wegner's condition for the actual radii
blocks.body:
For $n\ge3$, the radii of any actual side-tangent realization are positive
and are either constant or have four cyclic sign changes in
$c_i=\rho_{i-1}-\rho_i$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.sideTangentForward
lean.code:
theorem sideTangentForward [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n) {ρ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {P N C : ZMod n → ℂ} (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C) :
    SideTangentAdmissible ρ := by
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, hb⟩ := exists_strict_balanced_polygon_of_realization hn h
  refine ⟨h.radius_pos, ?_⟩
  rcases zero_or_dfv_of_strict_affine_balance hn hY (sum_radiusDifference ρ) hb with hz | hd
  · exact Or.inl (constant_of_radiusDifference_eq_zero hz)
  · exact Or.inr hd

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.constant_of_radiusDifference_eq_zero
lean.code:
lemma constant_of_radiusDifference_eq_zero [NeZero n] {ρ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ i, radiusDifference ρ i = 0) : ∃ r, ∀ i, ρ i = r := by
  have hsucc : ∀ i, ρ (i + 1) = ρ i := by
    intro i
    have hi := h (i + 1)
    simp only [radiusDifference, add_sub_cancel_right, sub_eq_zero] at hi
    exact hi.symm
  have hnat : ∀ k : ℕ, ρ (k : ZMod n) = ρ 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp only [Nat.cast_zero]
    | succ k ih =>
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using (hsucc (k : ZMod n)).trans ih
  exact ⟨ρ 0, fun i ↦ by simpa only [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using hnat i.val⟩

deps.label: st:forward-reconstruction

deps.label: st:cyclic-labels

deps.title: Affine balance forces four cyclic sign changes
deps.label: st:forward-affine-balance

blocks.tex:
The radius differences have zero total sum, and the reconstructed strictly
supported polygon gives zero vector sum. Apply the affine-balance lemma.
If all differences vanish, $\rho_{i-1}=\rho_i$ at every label; induction over
one period makes the radius word constant. Otherwise the conclusion is
exactly the required four-sign window. Positivity is part of the actual
realization certificate.

blocks.label: st:iff
blocks.title: Exact characterization of side-tangent radius words
blocks.body:
For $n\ge4$, a cyclic real word is realized by the inward three-supporting-line
circles of a simple strictly convex polygon with open central contacts if and
only if it is positive and is constant or has four sign changes in its cyclic
first differences. For positive nonconstant data the constant alternative is
omitted.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.realizesSideTangent_iff_admissible
lean.code:
theorem realizesSideTangent_iff_admissible [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ) :
    RealizesSideTangent ρ ↔ SideTangentAdmissible ρ := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P, N, C, h⟩
    exact sideTangentForward (by omega) h
  · exact sideTangentConverse hn ρ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.realizesSideTangent_iff_dfv
lean.code:
theorem realizesSideTangent_iff_dfv [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) {ρ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hρ : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i) (hnc : ¬ ∃ r, ∀ i, ρ i = r) :
    RealizesSideTangent ρ ↔ DFV (radiusDifference ρ) 0 := by
  rw [realizesSideTangent_iff_admissible hn]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ h.2.resolve_left hnc, fun h ↦ ⟨hρ, Or.inr h⟩⟩

deps.title: Wegner's condition for the actual radii
deps.label: st:forward

blocks.tex:
Necessity is the preceding theorem; sufficiency is the side-tangent converse.
For nonconstant data, the constant disjunct is impossible. The definition of
admissibility is unchanged on the two sides, so this combines the actual
geometric producer with its actual converse.

The concise existence statement records the polygon and its radii. Curvature
and local nonconcyclicity follow for that same polygon, independently of any
other witness chosen by an existence theorem. The fuller original theorem
and its proof remain in the preceding supporting chapters.

blocks.label: presentation:geometric-converse
blocks.title: A polygon with the prescribed consecutive radii
blocks.body:
For $n\ge4$, a positive cyclic radius word with two distinct plateau maxima
and two distinct plateau minima admits a coherent convex polygon $v$ with
$R_i(v)=r_i$ for every $i$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.tabachnikov_converse_geometric
lean.code:
theorem tabachnikov_converse_geometric [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) {r : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i) (hext : IsPlateauTwoMaxTwoMin r) :
    ∃ v : ZMod n → ℂ, IsCoherentConvexPolygon v ∧
      ∀ i, vertexCircumradius v i = r i :=
  (tabachnikov_converse hn hr hext).imp fun _ h ↦ ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩

blocks.tex:
The full radius converse supplies one such polygon, together with further
curvature and nonconcyclicity conclusions. Retain its coherence and exact
radius equations. No hypothesis or geometric part of the realization changes.

blocks.label: presentation:curvature
blocks.title: Signed curvature of the same polygon
blocks.body:
If $v$ is a coherent convex polygon and $R_i(v)=r_i$ for all $i$, then
its signed Menger curvature at every vertex is $\kappa_i(v)=1/r_i$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.IsCoherentConvexPolygon.signedMengerR2_eq_inv_of_radii
lean.code:

blocks.tex:
Strict positive orientation makes the signed curvature positive.
The circumradius identity is $R_i(v)=1/\kappa_i(v)$. Substitute the
prescribed radius and take reciprocals, using $1/(1/x)=x$.

blocks.label: presentation:four-points
blocks.title: Unequal adjacent radii exclude four concyclic vertices
blocks.body:
For the same polygon, if $r_i\ne r_{i+1}$, the four consecutive vertices
$v_{i-1},v_i,v_{i+1},v_{i+2}$ are not concyclic. No inequality is needed
at any other pair of adjacent radii.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.IsCoherentConvexPolygon.not_concyclic4_of_radius_ne
lean.code:
lemma IsCoherentConvexPolygon.not_concyclic4_of_radius_ne
    {v : ZMod n → ℂ} {r : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : IsCoherentConvexPolygon v)
    (hrad : ∀ i, vertexCircumradius v i = r i) (i : ZMod n)
    (hne : r i ≠ r (i + 1)) :
    ¬ Concyclic4 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1)) (v (i + 2)) :=
  fun hcon ↦ hne ((hrad i).symm.trans
    ((vertexCircumradius_eq_of_concyclic i (h.2.2 i).1 (h.2.2 (i + 1)).1 hcon).trans
      (hrad (i + 1))))

deps.label: detail:discrete-coherence

deps.title: Circumradius is reciprocal absolute Menger curvature
deps.label: detail:discrete-circumradius

blocks.tex:
Each overlapping triple is noncollinear. If all four vertices belonged to
one circle, uniqueness of each triple's circumcircle would make their
circumradii equal. Substituting $R_i(v)=r_i$ and $R_{i+1}(v)=r_{i+1}$
contradicts the assumed inequality.

blocks.label: presentation:local
blocks.title: Local choice from a strict four-vertex window
blocks.body:
A positive cyclic profile with a strict four-vertex window at some level
has a local $C^1$ coherent realization family. Neither an explicit lower
bound on $n$ nor a separate nonconstancy assumption is needed: the four
strictly ordered indices and alternating inequalities already imply them.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.localContinuousRealization_of_dfv
lean.code:
theorem localContinuousRealization_of_dfv
    {κ₀ : ZMod n → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hκ₀ : ∀ i, 0 < κ₀ i) (hdfv : DFV κ₀ c) :
    Nonempty (LocalDiscreteRealizationFamily κ₀) := by
  obtain ⟨A⟩ := nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_dfv hκ₀ hdfv
  exact A.nonempty_localDiscreteRealizationFamily hκ₀

deps.title: Local coherent choice at every nonconstant admissible profile
deps.label: thm:tabachnikov_local_continuity

blocks.tex:
The window produces a regular four-active-edge anchor. The local opening
theorem at that anchor gives an open neighborhood and a $C^1$ choice of
lengths. The developed vertices, exact curvature, moderate arcs, closure,
full turn, and simplicity all belong to the same family.

blocks.label: presentation:hexagon
blocks.title: The hexagon obstruction without an orientation premise
blocks.body:
There is no continuous vertex path on $[0,1]$ whose members are simple
Dahlberg-regular hexagons with the prescribed signed Menger band profile
$\kappa_s$. A separate positive-orientation hypothesis is unnecessary.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.no_continuous_regular_hexagon_path
lean.code:
theorem no_continuous_regular_hexagon_path :
    ¬ ∃ p : ℝ → (ZMod 6 → ℂ), ContinuousOn p (Set.Icc 0 1) ∧
      ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        IsSimplePolygon (p s) ∧ DahlbergRegular (p s) ∧
        SignedMengerProfile (p s) = bandProfile s :=
  fun ⟨p, hp, h⟩ ↦ no_continuous_coherent_hexagon_path
    ⟨p, hp, fun s hs ↦ ⟨(h s hs).1, (h s hs).2.1,
      positivePolygonOrientation_iff_signedMengerProfile_pos.mpr
        (by simpa only [(h s hs).2.2] using bandProfile_pos hs), (h s hs).2.2⟩⟩

deps.title: No continuous choice of the actual polygons
deps.label: detail:hexagon-geometric-obstruction

blocks.tex:
Every value of the band profile is positive. In the signed Menger formula,
positivity forces the oriented determinant of each consecutive triple to be
positive. Thus every purported member satisfies the orientation hypothesis
of the previously proved geometric hexagon obstruction, a contradiction.

entries.label: thm:main
entries.title: thm:main
entries.chapter: Introduction
entries.body:
Let $n\ge 4$ and let $r_1,\dots,r_n>0$ be a cyclic sequence with at least two
distinct plateau maxima and two distinct plateau minima. Then there is a
simple, strictly convex, coherent polygon $x_1,\dots,x_n$, listed
counterclockwise, whose circle through $x_{i-1},x_i,x_{i+1}$ has radius $r_i$
for every $i$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.tabachnikov_converse_geometric
lean.code:
theorem tabachnikov_converse_geometric [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) {r : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i) (hext : IsPlateauTwoMaxTwoMin r) :
    ∃ v : ZMod n → ℂ, IsCoherentConvexPolygon v ∧
      ∀ i, vertexCircumradius v i = r i :=
  (tabachnikov_converse hn hr hext).imp fun _ h ↦ ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩
