entries.title: the fixed-turn chart with a low fourth endpoint
entries.chapter: Repeated maxima and negative terminal corners
entries.body:
Fix $T$ and use the coordinates $x=(S,\alpha,\gamma)$ of
  \cref{def:nfp_split_model} ($\beta=S-\alpha$, $\delta=T-\gamma$).  Let
  $0<p<1$, $0<l<1$, $0<t<q$, $0<h<q$ and strict angles.  Then the
  seam/chord map $\Sigma^T$ has derivative
  \[
    \begin{pmatrix}R&0&0\\ 1&-A&-C\\ 1-B&B&D\end{pmatrix},\qquad
    \det=R\,(BC-AD),
  \]
  i.e.\ \verb|splitDifferential R A B C G| with the excess coefficient
  $G=\operatorname{slope}(h/q,\delta)-1=-D<0$.  If $q>1$, the point is a
  native zero and $AD\ne BC$, then $DN(\operatorname{split}(x))$ is
  surjective.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.hasFDerivAt_splitController_incident
lean.code:
theorem hasFDerivAt_splitController_incident
    {p t q h l T : ℝ} {x : Fin 3 → ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q) (hq : 0 < q) (hh : 0 < h) (hhq : h < q)
    (ha : StrictAngles q h (x 1) (x 0 - x 1) (x 2) (T - x 2)) :
    HasFDerivAt (splitController p t q h l T)
      (splitDifferential (Real.cos (x 0))
        (1 - angleSlope p (x 1)) (1 - angleSlope l (x 0 - x 1))
        (1 - angleSlope (t / q) (x 2)) (angleSlope (h / q) (T - x 2) - 1)) x := by
  have h0 := hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (F' := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0 x
  have h1 := hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (F' := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 1 x
  have h2 := hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (F' := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 2 x
  have hpD := (hasDerivAt_angleDefect hp hp1 ha.1.1 ha.1.2).comp_hasFDerivAt x h1
  have htD := (hasDerivAt_angleDefect (div_pos ht hq) ((div_lt_one hq).2 htq)
    ha.2.2.1.1 ha.2.2.1.2).comp_hasFDerivAt x h2
  have hlD := (hasDerivAt_angleDefect hl hl1 ha.2.1.1 ha.2.1.2).comp_hasFDerivAt x (h0.sub h1)
  have hhD := (hasDerivAt_angleDefect (div_pos hh hq) ((div_lt_one hq).2 hhq)
    ha.2.2.2.1.1 ha.2.2.2.1.2).comp_hasFDerivAt x (h2.const_sub T)
  have hM := ((Real.hasDerivAt_sin (x 0)).comp_hasFDerivAt x h0).sub_const (Real.sin T / q)
  have hLow := (((h0.add_const T).sub_const Real.pi).sub hpD).sub htD
  have hHigh := (((h0.add_const T).sub_const Real.pi).sub hlD).sub hhD
  unfold splitDifferential
  apply hasFDerivAt_pi.mpr
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · convert hM using 1 <;> simp [splitController, chord]
  · convert hLow using 1
    · ext y
      simp [splitController, seamLow, lowTurn, angleDefect, Function.comp_def]
      ring
    · simp
  · convert hHigh using 1
    · ext y
      simp [splitController, seamHigh, highTurn, angleDefect, Function.comp_def]
      ring
    · ext v
      simp
      ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_fixedTurn_minor
lean.code:
theorem fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_fixedTurn_minor
    {p t q h l T : ℝ} {x : Fin 3 → ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q) (hq : 1 < q) (hh : 0 < h) (hhq : h < q)
    (ha : StrictAngles q h (x 1) (x 0 - x 1) (x 2) (T - x 2))
    (hzero : nativeSplitController p t q h l T x = 0)
    (hminor : (1 - angleSlope p (x 1)) * (1 - angleSlope (h / q) (T - x 2)) ≠
      (1 - angleSlope l (x 0 - x 1)) * (1 - angleSlope (t / q) (x 2))) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (nativeLengthController p t q h l)
      (splitHalfLengths q T x)) := by
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hd := differentiableAt_nativeLengthController_of_physical hp ht hq0 hh hl
    (nativeLengthPhysical_splitHalfLengths hp hp1 ht htq hl hl1 hq0 ha)
  have hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (splitHalfLengths q T) x := by
    apply differentiableAt_pi.mpr
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> dsimp [splitHalfLengths] <;> fun_prop
  have hc0 : ContinuousAt (fun z : Fin 3 → ℝ => z 0) x := (continuous_apply 0).continuousAt
  have hc1 : ContinuousAt (fun z : Fin 3 → ℝ => z 1) x := (continuous_apply 1).continuousAt
  have hc2 : ContinuousAt (fun z : Fin 3 → ℝ => z 2) x := (continuous_apply 2).continuousAt
  have heα := hc1.eventually (Ioo_mem_nhds ha.1.1 ha.1.2)
  have heβ := (hc0.sub hc1).eventually (Ioo_mem_nhds ha.2.1.1 ha.2.1.2)
  have heγ := hc2.eventually (Ioo_mem_nhds ha.2.2.1.1 ha.2.2.1.2)
  have heδ := (hc2.const_sub T).eventually (Ioo_mem_nhds ha.2.2.2.1.1 ha.2.2.2.1.2)
  apply native_rank_of_parametric_rank (f := splitHalfLengths q T)
    (g := nativeSplitController p t q h l T) (x := x) hd hf
  · filter_upwards [heα, heβ, heγ, heδ] with z hα hβ hγ hδ
    exact nativeLengthController_splitHalfLengths (ne_of_gt hq0) hα hβ hγ hδ
  · exact fderiv_nativeSplitController_surjective_of_incident_minor hp hp1 hl hl1
      ht htq hq hh hhq ha hzero hminor

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.splitDifferential_surjective_of_det_ne_zero
lean.code:
theorem splitDifferential_surjective_of_det_ne_zero {R A B C G : ℝ}
    (hR : R ≠ 0) (hD : A * G + B * C ≠ 0) :
    Function.Surjective (splitDifferential R A B C G) := by
  intro y
  let u := y 0 / R
  let v := y 1 - u
  let w := y 2 - (1 - B) * u
  refine ⟨![u, (C * w - G * v) / (A * G + B * C),
    (-A * w - B * v) / (A * G + B * C)], ?_⟩
  rw [splitDifferential_apply]
  have hD' : A * G + C * B ≠ 0 := by simpa only [mul_comm C B] using hD
  have hD'' : G * A + B * C ≠ 0 := by simpa only [mul_comm G A] using hD
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [u, v, w]
  all_goals field_simp [hR, hD, hD', hD'']
  all_goals nlinarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.fderiv_nativeSplitController_surjective_of_incident_minor
lean.code:
theorem fderiv_nativeSplitController_surjective_of_incident_minor
    {p t q h l T : ℝ} {x : Fin 3 → ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q) (hq : 1 < q) (hh : 0 < h) (hhq : h < q)
    (ha : StrictAngles q h (x 1) (x 0 - x 1) (x 2) (T - x 2))
    (hzero : nativeSplitController p t q h l T x = 0)
    (hminor : (1 - angleSlope p (x 1)) * (1 - angleSlope (h / q) (T - x 2)) ≠
      (1 - angleSlope l (x 0 - x 1)) * (1 - angleSlope (t / q) (x 2))) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (nativeSplitController p t q h l T) x) := by
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hz := (native_zero_iff_of_strictAngles (l := l) hp.le ht.le hq0 ha).mp
    ⟨congrArg Prod.fst hzero, congrArg Prod.snd hzero⟩
  have hs : splitController p t q h l T x = 0 := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hz.1
    · exact hz.2.1
    · exact hz.2.2
  have hf := hasFDerivAt_splitController_incident hp hp1 hl hl1 ht htq hq0 hh hhq ha
  have hn := hasFDerivAt_nativeSplitController_of_split hf hs
  have hsin : 0 < Real.sin T := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi
    (by linarith [ha.2.2.1.1, ha.2.2.2.1.1])
    (by linarith [ha.2.2.1.2, ha.2.2.2.1.2])
  have hcos := cos_first_sum_neg_of_root hp hp1 ht htq hq ha hz.2.1 hz.1
  rw [hn.fderiv]
  have htarget := closureTargetLinearMap_surjective
    (β := x 0 - x 1) (ne_of_gt (div_pos hsin hq0))
    (Complex.I * (Real.sin (x 0 - x 1) : ℂ) * unitPhase (-(x 0)))
  apply htarget.comp
  apply splitDifferential_surjective_of_det_ne_zero
  · simpa using ne_of_lt hcos
  · intro he
    apply hminor
    nlinarith

entries.body:
Let $0<p<1$, $0<t<q$, $0<l<1$, $0<h<q$, $q>0$, strict angles at
  $x=(S,\alpha,T)$ and $\mathcal N_\gamma(x)=0$.  If
  \[
    R\,(A+B-AD)+W\,(A+B-AB)\ne0,
  \]
  then $DN(\ell_\gamma(x))$ is surjective.  No sign of $R$ or $W$ is
  assumed.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.fderiv_incidentNativeController_surjective_of_minor
lean.code:
theorem fderiv_incidentNativeController_surjective_of_minor
    {p t q h l γ : ℝ} {x : Fin 3 → ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1) (hh : 0 < h) (hhq : h < q) (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : StrictAngles q h (x 1) (x 0 - x 1) γ (x 2 - γ))
    (hzero : incidentNativeController p t q h l γ x = 0)
    (hminor : Real.cos (x 0) *
        ((1 - angleSlope p (x 1)) + (1 - angleSlope l (x 0 - x 1)) -
          (1 - angleSlope p (x 1)) * (1 - angleSlope (h / q) (x 2 - γ))) +
      (Real.cos (x 2) / q) *
        ((1 - angleSlope p (x 1)) + (1 - angleSlope l (x 0 - x 1)) -
          (1 - angleSlope p (x 1)) * (1 - angleSlope l (x 0 - x 1))) ≠ 0) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (incidentNativeController p t q h l γ) x) := by
  have hz := (native_zero_iff_of_strictAngles (l := l) hp.le ht.le hq ha).mp
    ⟨congrArg Prod.fst hzero, congrArg Prod.snd hzero⟩
  have hs : incidentSplitController p t q h l γ x = 0 := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hz.1
    · exact hz.2.1
    · exact hz.2.2
  have hf := hasFDerivAt_incidentSplitController (t := t) hp hp1 hl hl1 hh hhq hq ha
  have hn := hasFDerivAt_incidentNativeController_of_split hf hs
  have hsin : 0 < Real.sin (x 2) := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi
    (by linarith [ha.2.2.1.1, ha.2.2.2.1.1])
    (by linarith [ha.2.2.1.2, ha.2.2.2.1.2])
  rw [hn.fderiv]
  have htarget := closureTargetLinearMap_surjective
    (β := x 0 - x 1) (ne_of_gt (div_pos hsin hq))
    (Complex.I * (Real.sin (x 0 - x 1) : ℂ) * unitPhase (-(x 0)))
  exact htarget.comp (incidentDifferential_surjective_of_det_ne_zero
    (ne_of_gt (lowDefect_derivative_pos hp hp1 ha.1.1 ha.1.2)) hminor)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_fixedHalf_minor
lean.code:
theorem fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_fixedHalf_minor
    {p t q h l γ : ℝ} {x : Fin 3 → ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q)
    (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1) (hh : 0 < h) (hhq : h < q) (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : StrictAngles q h (x 1) (x 0 - x 1) γ (x 2 - γ))
    (hzero : incidentNativeController p t q h l γ x = 0)
    (hminor : Real.cos (x 0) *
        ((1 - angleSlope p (x 1)) + (1 - angleSlope l (x 0 - x 1)) -
          (1 - angleSlope p (x 1)) * (1 - angleSlope (h / q) (x 2 - γ))) +
      (Real.cos (x 2) / q) *
        ((1 - angleSlope p (x 1)) + (1 - angleSlope l (x 0 - x 1)) -
          (1 - angleSlope p (x 1)) * (1 - angleSlope l (x 0 - x 1))) ≠ 0) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (nativeLengthController p t q h l)
      (incidentHalfLengths q γ x)) := by
  have hd := differentiableAt_nativeLengthController_of_physical hp ht hq hh hl
    (nativeLengthPhysical_splitHalfLengths (x := ![x 0, x 1, γ]) (T := x 2)
      hp hp1 ht htq hl hl1 hq ha)
  have hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (incidentHalfLengths q γ) x := by
    apply differentiableAt_pi.mpr
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> dsimp [incidentHalfLengths, splitHalfLengths] <;> fun_prop
  have hc0 : ContinuousAt (fun z : Fin 3 → ℝ => z 0) x := (continuous_apply 0).continuousAt
  have hc1 : ContinuousAt (fun z : Fin 3 → ℝ => z 1) x := (continuous_apply 1).continuousAt
  have hc2 : ContinuousAt (fun z : Fin 3 → ℝ => z 2) x := (continuous_apply 2).continuousAt
  have heα := hc1.eventually (Ioo_mem_nhds ha.1.1 ha.1.2)
  have heβ := (hc0.sub hc1).eventually (Ioo_mem_nhds ha.2.1.1 ha.2.1.2)
  have heδ := (hc2.sub_const γ).eventually (Ioo_mem_nhds ha.2.2.2.1.1 ha.2.2.2.1.2)
  apply native_rank_of_parametric_rank (f := incidentHalfLengths q γ)
    (g := incidentNativeController p t q h l γ) (x := x) hd hf
  · filter_upwards [heα, heβ, heδ] with z hα hβ hδ
    exact nativeLengthController_splitHalfLengths (x := ![z 0, z 1, γ])
      (ne_of_gt hq) hα hβ ha.2.2.1 hδ
  · exact fderiv_incidentNativeController_surjective_of_minor
      hp hp1 ht hl hl1 hh hhq hq ha hzero hminor

entries.label: lem:nrn_minors_vanish
entries.title: rank loss forces both minors to vanish
entries.chapter: Repeated maxima and negative terminal corners
entries.body:
Let $0<p<1$, $0<l<1$, $0<t<q$, $0<h<q$, $q>1$ and strict angles
  $\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta$ with $(E,\text{turn defect})=0$.  If $DN$ is
  not surjective at $(\sin\alpha,\sin\gamma/q,\sin\delta/q,\sin\beta)$, then
  \[
    AD=BC\qquad\text{and}\qquad
    \cos(\alpha+\beta)\,(A+B-AD)+\frac{\cos(\gamma+\delta)}q\,(A+B-AB)=0 .
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.incident_minors_vanish_of_not_surjective
lean.code:
theorem incident_minors_vanish_of_not_surjective
    {p t q h l α β γ δ : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q) (hq : 1 < q) (hh : 0 < h) (hhq : h < q)
    (ha : StrictAngles q h α β γ δ)
    (hzero : (nativeHalfClosure p t q h l α β γ δ,
      turnDefect p t q h l α β γ δ) = 0)
    (hnon : ¬Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (nativeLengthController p t q h l)
      ![Real.sin α, Real.sin γ / q, Real.sin δ / q, Real.sin β])) :
    let A := 1 - angleSlope p α
    let B := 1 - angleSlope l β
    let C := 1 - angleSlope (t / q) γ
    let D := 1 - angleSlope (h / q) δ
    A * D = B * C ∧
      Real.cos (α + β) * (A + B - A * D) +
        (Real.cos (γ + δ) / q) * (A + B - A * B) = 0 := by
  dsimp only
  constructor
  · by_contra hne
    apply hnon
    have hax : StrictAngles q h (![α + β, α, γ] 1)
        (![α + β, α, γ] 0 - ![α + β, α, γ] 1)
        (![α + β, α, γ] 2) ((γ + δ) - ![α + β, α, γ] 2) := by
      simpa using ha
    have hzx : nativeSplitController p t q h l (γ + δ) ![α + β, α, γ] = 0 := by
      simpa [nativeSplitController] using hzero
    have hmx : (1 - angleSlope p (![α + β, α, γ] 1)) *
        (1 - angleSlope (h / q) ((γ + δ) - ![α + β, α, γ] 2)) ≠
        (1 - angleSlope l (![α + β, α, γ] 0 - ![α + β, α, γ] 1)) *
        (1 - angleSlope (t / q) (![α + β, α, γ] 2)) := by simpa using hne
    simpa [splitHalfLengths] using
      fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_fixedTurn_minor
        hp hp1 hl hl1 ht htq hq hh hhq hax hzx hmx
  · by_contra hne
    apply hnon
    have hax : StrictAngles q h (![α + β, α, γ + δ] 1)
        (![α + β, α, γ + δ] 0 - ![α + β, α, γ + δ] 1) γ
        (![α + β, α, γ + δ] 2 - γ) := by simpa using ha
    have hzx : incidentNativeController p t q h l γ ![α + β, α, γ + δ] = 0 := by
      simpa [incidentNativeController] using hzero
    have hs := fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_fixedHalf_minor
      hp hp1 ht htq hl hl1 hh hhq (by linarith : 0 < q) hax hzx
    apply (show Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (nativeLengthController p t q h l)
        (incidentHalfLengths q γ ![α + β, α, γ + δ])) → _ by
      simp [incidentHalfLengths, splitHalfLengths])
    apply hs
    simpa using hne

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.coreHalfLengths_tan_product_gt_one
lean.code:
theorem coreHalfLengths_tan_product_gt_one {u q v : ℝ}
    (hu : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hv : 0 < v) (hv1 : v < 1) :
    let L := orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v
    1 < Real.tan (Real.arcsin (L 0)) * Real.tan (Real.arcsin (q * L 2)) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [(coreHalfLengths_tan_products hu hu1 hq hv hv1).1]
  apply (lt_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hu hv)).mpr
  have huv : u * v < 1 := (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hu1 hv).trans (by simpa using hv1)
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.coreHalfLengths_tan_products
lean.code:
theorem coreHalfLengths_tan_products {u q v : ℝ}
    (hu : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hv : 0 < v) (hv1 : v < 1) :
    let L := orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v
    Real.tan (Real.arcsin (L 0)) * Real.tan (Real.arcsin (q * L 2)) = q / (u * v) ∧
    Real.tan (Real.arcsin (L 3)) * Real.tan (Real.arcsin (q * L 1)) = q / (u * v) := by
  have hp := coreHalfLengths_pos hu hu1 hq hv hv1
  obtain ⟨h0, h3, h1, h2⟩ := coreHalfLengths_tan hu hu1 hq hv hv1
  dsimp only
  rw [h0, h3, h1, h2]
  constructor <;> field_simp [ne_of_gt hu, ne_of_gt hv,
    ne_of_gt (hp 0), ne_of_gt (hp 1), ne_of_gt (hp 2), ne_of_gt (hp 3)]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.coreHalfLengths_sq
lean.code:
theorem coreHalfLengths_sq {u q v : ℝ}
    (hu : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hv : 0 < v) (hv1 : v < 1) :
    let L := orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v
    (L 0) ^ 2 + (v * L 2) ^ 2 = 1 ∧
    (L 3) ^ 2 + (u * L 1) ^ 2 = 1 ∧
    (q * L 1) ^ 2 + (v * L 3) ^ 2 = 1 ∧
    (q * L 2) ^ 2 + (u * L 0) ^ 2 = 1 := by
  have hu2 : 0 ≤ 1 - u ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hv2 : 0 ≤ 1 - v ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hqu : 0 ≤ q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hqv : 0 ≤ q ^ 2 - v ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hd : 0 < q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2 := by
    have h := orthogonal_delta_pos_of_strict_alternation
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) hu (by linarith : 0 < q) hv
      hu1 (by linarith) hv1 (by linarith)
    simpa [orthogonalDelta] using h
  have hdn : q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hd
  have hdn' : q ^ 2 - v ^ 2 * u ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by simpa [mul_comm] using hdn
  dsimp [orderedCoreHalfLengths]
  simp only [r_core_side_a_half_at_one, r_core_side_b_half_at_one,
    r_core_side_c_half_at_one, r_core_side_d_half_at_one,
    mul_pow, div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hu2, Real.sq_sqrt hv2,
    Real.sq_sqrt hqu, Real.sq_sqrt hqv, Real.sq_sqrt hd.le]
  constructor
  · field_simp [hdn, hdn']
    ring
  constructor
  · field_simp [hdn, hdn']
    ring
  constructor
  · field_simp [hdn, hdn']
    ring
  · field_simp [hdn, hdn']
    ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.coreHalfLengths_normalized_cos
lean.code:
theorem coreHalfLengths_normalized_cos {u q v : ℝ}
    (hu : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hv : 0 < v) (hv1 : v < 1) :
    let L := orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v
    let α := Real.arcsin (L 0)
    let β := Real.arcsin (L 3)
    let γ := Real.arcsin (q * L 1)
    let δ := Real.arcsin (q * L 2)
    let P := Real.tan α / Real.tan γ
    let Q := 1 / (Real.tan γ * Real.tan δ)
    Real.cos (α + β) = (Q - P ^ 2) / Q * Real.cos α * Real.cos β ∧
    Real.cos (γ + δ) / q = P * (Q - 1) / Q * Real.cos α * Real.cos β := by
  have hp := coreHalfLengths_pos hu hu1 hq hv hv1
  obtain ⟨h0, h3, h1, h2⟩ := coreHalfLengths_angle_data hu hu1 hq hv hv1
  obtain ⟨t0, t3, t1, t2⟩ := coreHalfLengths_tan hu hu1 hq hv hv1
  dsimp only
  rw [t0, t1, t2, Real.cos_add, Real.cos_add, h0.2, h3.2, h1.2, h2.2,
    Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith [h0.1.1]) h0.1.2.le,
    Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith [h3.1.1]) h3.1.2.le,
    Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith [h1.1.1]) h1.1.2.le,
    Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith [h2.1.1]) h2.1.2.le]
  constructor <;> field_simp [ne_of_gt hu, ne_of_gt hv, ne_of_gt (show 0 < q by linarith),
    ne_of_gt (hp 0), ne_of_gt (hp 1), ne_of_gt (hp 2), ne_of_gt (hp 3)]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.coreHalfLengths_tan
lean.code:
theorem coreHalfLengths_tan {u q v : ℝ}
    (hu : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hv : 0 < v) (hv1 : v < 1) :
    let L := orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v
    Real.tan (Real.arcsin (L 0)) = L 0 / (v * L 2) ∧
    Real.tan (Real.arcsin (L 3)) = L 3 / (u * L 1) ∧
    Real.tan (Real.arcsin (q * L 1)) = q * L 1 / (v * L 3) ∧
    Real.tan (Real.arcsin (q * L 2)) = q * L 2 / (u * L 0) := by
  obtain ⟨h0, h3, h1, h2⟩ := coreHalfLengths_angle_data hu hu1 hq hv hv1
  dsimp only
  constructor
  · rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos, h0.2, Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith [h0.1.1]) h0.1.2.le]
  constructor
  · rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos, h3.2, Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith [h3.1.1]) h3.1.2.le]
  constructor
  · rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos, h1.2, Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith [h1.1.1]) h1.1.2.le]
  · rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos, h2.2, Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith [h2.1.1]) h2.1.2.le]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.coreHalfLengths_angle_data
lean.code:
theorem coreHalfLengths_angle_data {u q v : ℝ}
    (hu : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hv : 0 < v) (hv1 : v < 1) :
    let L := orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v
    (L 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ Real.cos (Real.arcsin (L 0)) = v * L 2) ∧
    (L 3 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ Real.cos (Real.arcsin (L 3)) = u * L 1) ∧
    (q * L 1 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ Real.cos (Real.arcsin (q * L 1)) = v * L 3) ∧
    (q * L 2 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ Real.cos (Real.arcsin (q * L 2)) = u * L 0) := by
  have hp := coreHalfLengths_pos hu hu1 hq hv hv1
  obtain ⟨h0, h3, h1, h2⟩ := coreHalfLengths_sq hu hu1 hq hv hv1
  exact ⟨acute_cos_of_complement (hp 0) (mul_pos hv (hp 2)) h0,
    acute_cos_of_complement (hp 3) (mul_pos hu (hp 1)) h3,
    acute_cos_of_complement (mul_pos (by linarith) (hp 1)) (mul_pos hv (hp 3)) h1,
    acute_cos_of_complement (mul_pos (by linarith) (hp 2)) (mul_pos hu (hp 0)) h2⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.coreHalfLengths_angles_acute
lean.code:
theorem coreHalfLengths_angles_acute {u q v : ℝ}
    (hu : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hv : 0 < v) (hv1 : v < 1) :
    let L := orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v
    Real.arcsin (L 0) ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (Real.pi / 2) ∧
    Real.arcsin (L 3) ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (Real.pi / 2) ∧
    Real.arcsin (q * L 1) ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (Real.pi / 2) ∧
    Real.arcsin (q * L 2) ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (Real.pi / 2) := by
  obtain ⟨h0, h3, h1, h2⟩ := coreHalfLengths_angle_data hu hu1 hq hv hv1
  exact ⟨⟨Real.arcsin_pos.mpr h0.1.1, Real.arcsin_lt_pi_div_two.mpr h0.1.2⟩,
    ⟨Real.arcsin_pos.mpr h3.1.1, Real.arcsin_lt_pi_div_two.mpr h3.1.2⟩,
    ⟨Real.arcsin_pos.mpr h1.1.1, Real.arcsin_lt_pi_div_two.mpr h1.1.2⟩,
    ⟨Real.arcsin_pos.mpr h2.1.1, Real.arcsin_lt_pi_div_two.mpr h2.1.2⟩⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.coreHalfLengths_pos
lean.code:
theorem coreHalfLengths_pos {u q v : ℝ}
    (hu : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hv : 0 < v) (hv1 : v < 1) :
    ∀ i, 0 < orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v i := by
  obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc, hd⟩ := r_core_sides_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
    hu (by linarith : 0 < q) hv hu1 (by linarith) hv1 (by linarith)
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · exact div_pos ha (by norm_num)
  · exact div_pos hb (by norm_num)
  · exact div_pos hc (by norm_num)
  · exact div_pos hd (by norm_num)

entries.label: lem:nrn_projective_coords
entries.title: projective tangent coordinates
entries.chapter: Repeated maxima and negative terminal corners
entries.body:
\begin{enumerate}
    \item Let $\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta\in(0,\pi/2)$ with
      $\gamma+\delta<\pi/2$, $\tan\alpha\tan\delta=\tan\beta\tan\gamma$ and
      $\tan\alpha\tan\delta>1$.  Put
      \[
        P=\frac{\tan\alpha}{\tan\gamma},\qquad
        Q=\frac1{\tan\gamma\tan\delta},\qquad b=\frac1{\tan\delta}.
      \]
      Then $b>0$, $1<Q<P$ and
      \[
        (\tan\alpha,\tan\beta,\tan\gamma,\tan\delta)
        =\Bigl(\frac{Pb}Q,\ \frac Pb,\ \frac bQ,\ \frac1b\Bigr).
      \]
    \item Let $A,B,C,D\in(0,1)$ with $AD=BC$, and put $r=A/2$, $k=C/2$,
      $\tau=A/B$.  Then $0<r,k<\tfrac12$, $2r<\tau$, $2k<\tau$,
      $B=2r/\tau$ and $D=2k/\tau$.
  \end{enumerate}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.incident_projective_parameters
lean.code:
theorem incident_projective_parameters {A B C D : ℝ}
    (hA : A ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hB : B ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hC : C ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hD : D ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hcross : A * D = B * C) :
    0 < A / 2 ∧ A / 2 < 1 / 2 ∧ 0 < C / 2 ∧ C / 2 < 1 / 2 ∧
    2 * (A / 2) < A / B ∧ 2 * (C / 2) < A / B ∧
    B = 2 * (A / 2) / (A / B) ∧ D = 2 * (C / 2) / (A / B) := by
  refine ⟨half_pos hA.1, by linarith [hA.2], half_pos hC.1, by linarith [hC.2], ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (lt_div_iff₀ hB.1).mpr
    nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hB.2 hA.1]
  · apply (lt_div_iff₀ hB.1).mpr
    nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hD.2 hA.1]
  · field_simp [ne_of_gt hA.1, ne_of_gt hB.1]
  · field_simp [ne_of_gt hA.1, ne_of_gt hB.1]
    nlinarith [hcross]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.acute_projective_coordinates
lean.code:
theorem acute_projective_coordinates {α β γ δ : ℝ}
    (hα : α ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (Real.pi / 2))
    (hβ : β ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (Real.pi / 2))
    (hγ : γ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (Real.pi / 2))
    (hδ : δ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (Real.pi / 2))
    (hT : γ + δ < Real.pi / 2)
    (hprod : Real.tan α * Real.tan δ = Real.tan β * Real.tan γ)
    (hprod1 : 1 < Real.tan α * Real.tan δ) :
    let P := Real.tan α / Real.tan γ
    let Q := 1 / (Real.tan γ * Real.tan δ)
    let b := 1 / Real.tan δ
    0 < b ∧ 1 < Q ∧ Q < P ∧
      Real.tan α = P * b / Q ∧ Real.tan β = P / b ∧
      Real.tan γ = b / Q ∧ Real.tan δ = 1 / b := by
  have ha := Real.tan_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi_div_two hα.1 hα.2
  have hb := Real.tan_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi_div_two hβ.1 hβ.2
  have hc := Real.tan_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi_div_two hγ.1 hγ.2
  have hd := Real.tan_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi_div_two hδ.1 hδ.2
  have hcg : 0 < Real.cos γ := Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo
    ⟨by linarith [Real.pi_pos, hγ.1], hγ.2⟩
  have hcd : 0 < Real.cos δ := Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo
    ⟨by linarith [Real.pi_pos, hδ.1], hδ.2⟩
  have hct : 0 < Real.cos (γ + δ) := Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo
    ⟨by linarith [Real.pi_pos, hγ.1, hδ.1], hT⟩
  have htprod : Real.tan γ * Real.tan δ < 1 := by
    rw [Real.cos_add] at hct
    rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos, Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
    rw [div_mul_div_comm, div_lt_one (mul_pos hcg hcd)]
    linarith
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨one_div_pos.mpr hd, (one_lt_div (mul_pos hc hd)).mpr htprod, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (div_lt_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hc hd) hc).mpr
    nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hprod1 hc]
  · field_simp
  · apply (mul_right_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hc))
    field_simp
    nlinarith [hprod]
  · field_simp
  · field_simp

entries.label: lem:nrn_tangent_turns
entries.title: tangent form of the two seams
entries.chapter: Repeated maxima and negative terminal corners
entries.body:
\begin{enumerate}
    \item For $z\in(0,\pi/2)$,
      $\tan\operatorname{atom}(a,z)=\operatorname{slope}(a,z)\tan z$.
    \item If $\cos x,\cos y,\cos z,\cos w\ne0$ and $x+y+z+w=\pi$, then
      \[
        (\tan z\tan w-1)(\tan x+\tan y)=(\tan z+\tan w)(1-\tan x\tan y).
      \]
    \item In the coordinates of \cref{lem:nrn_projective_coords}, the low
      seam $\operatorname{atom}(p,\alpha)+\operatorname{atom}(t/q,\gamma)
      +\beta+\delta=\pi$ implies
      \[
        \mathrm{(T1)}\quad
        Q(P-\mathcal B)\bigl(P(1-2r)+(1-2k)\bigr)
        -(P+1)\bigl(Q^2-P\mathcal B(1-2r)(1-2k)\bigr)=0,
      \]
      and the high seam
      $\operatorname{atom}(h/q,\delta)+\operatorname{atom}(l,\beta)
      +\alpha+\gamma=\pi$ implies
      \[
        \mathrm{(T2)}\quad
        (P\mathcal B-Q^2)\,\tau\,\bigl(\tau-2k+P(\tau-2r)\bigr)
        -Q(P+1)\bigl(\mathcal B\tau^2-P(\tau-2k)(\tau-2r)\bigr)=0 .
      \]
  \end{enumerate}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.tangent_turn_polynomial
lean.code:
theorem tangent_turn_polynomial {x y z w : ℝ}
    (hx : Real.cos x ≠ 0) (hy : Real.cos y ≠ 0)
    (hz : Real.cos z ≠ 0) (hw : Real.cos w ≠ 0)
    (hsum : x + y + z + w = Real.pi) :
    (Real.tan z * Real.tan w - 1) * (Real.tan x + Real.tan y) =
      (Real.tan z + Real.tan w) * (1 - Real.tan x * Real.tan y) := by
  have hs : Real.sin (x + y + z + w) = 0 := by rw [hsum, Real.sin_pi]
  simp only [Real.sin_add, Real.cos_add] at hs
  simp only [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
  field_simp [hx, hy, hz, hw]
  nlinarith [hs]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.second_projective_turn_polynomial
lean.code:
theorem second_projective_turn_polynomial {P Q b r k T : ℝ}
    (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hT : T ≠ 0)
    (hturn : ((P * b / Q) * (b / Q) - 1) *
        ((1 / b) * (1 - 2 * k / T) + (P / b) * (1 - 2 * r / T)) =
      (P * b / Q + b / Q) *
        (1 - ((1 / b) * (1 - 2 * k / T)) * ((P / b) * (1 - 2 * r / T)))) :
    (P * b ^ 2 - Q ^ 2) * T * (T - 2 * k + P * (T - 2 * r)) -
      Q * (P + 1) * (b ^ 2 * T ^ 2 - P * (T - 2 * k) * (T - 2 * r)) = 0 := by
  field_simp [hQ, hb, hT] at hturn
  nlinarith [hturn]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.first_projective_turn_polynomial
lean.code:
theorem first_projective_turn_polynomial {P Q b r k : ℝ}
    (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hturn : ((P / b) * (1 / b) - 1) *
        ((P * b / Q) * (1 - 2 * r) + (b / Q) * (1 - 2 * k)) =
      (P / b + 1 / b) *
        (1 - ((P * b / Q) * (1 - 2 * r)) * ((b / Q) * (1 - 2 * k)))) :
    Q * (P - b ^ 2) * (P * (1 - 2 * r) + (1 - 2 * k)) -
      (P + 1) * (Q ^ 2 - P * b ^ 2 * (1 - 2 * r) * (1 - 2 * k)) = 0 := by
  field_simp [hQ, hb] at hturn
  nlinarith [hturn]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.tan_angleAtom_eq_slope_mul_tan
lean.code:
theorem tan_angleAtom_eq_slope_mul_tan {a z : ℝ}
    (hz : z ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (Real.pi / 2)) :
    Real.tan (angleAtom a z) = angleSlope a z * Real.tan z := by
  have hc : Real.cos z ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt
    (Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by linarith [Real.pi_pos, hz.1], hz.2⟩)
  rw [angleAtom, Real.tan_arcsin, angleSlope, Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
  field_simp [hc]

entries.label: lem:nrn_affine
entries.title: the affine relation from the second minor
entries.chapter: Repeated maxima and negative terminal corners
entries.body:
Let $\lambda\ne0$, $B\ne0$, $R=\lambda(Q-P^2)$, $W=\lambda P(Q-1)$,
  $AD=BC$ and $R(A+B-AD)+W(A+B-AB)=0$.  Then, with $\tau=A/B$, $r=A/2$,
  $k=C/2$,
  \[
    \mathrm{(Aff)}\quad
    -(P+1)(P-Q)(1+\tau)+2(P^2-Q)k-2P(Q-1)r=0 .
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.projective_affine_of_incident_minor
lean.code:
theorem projective_affine_of_incident_minor
    {P Q K A B C D R W : ℝ} (hK : K ≠ 0) (_hA : A ≠ 0) (hB : B ≠ 0)
    (hR : R = K * (Q - P ^ 2)) (hW : W = K * P * (Q - 1))
    (hcross : A * D = B * C)
    (hminor : R * (A + B - A * D) + W * (A + B - A * B) = 0) :
    -(P + 1) * (P - Q) * (1 + A / B) +
      2 * (P ^ 2 - Q) * (C / 2) - 2 * P * (Q - 1) * (A / 2) = 0 := by
  rw [hR, hW] at hminor
  have hm : (Q - P ^ 2) * (A + B - A * D) +
      P * (Q - 1) * (A + B - A * B) = 0 := by
    apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hK)
    nlinarith [hminor]
  field_simp [hB]
  rw [hcross] at hm
  linear_combination hm

entries.label: def:nrn_rank_loss_packet
entries.title: the rank-loss packet
entries.chapter: Repeated maxima and negative terminal corners
entries.body:
An \emph{incident projective rank-loss packet} consists of reals
  $P,Q,\mathcal B,r,k,\tau$ with
  \[
    1<Q<P,\quad \mathcal B>0,\quad 0<r<\tfrac12,\quad 0<k<\tfrac12,\quad
    2r<\tau,\quad 2k<\tau,
  \]
  satisfying (Aff), (T1) and (T2).  The left-hand sides of (T1), (T2),
  (Aff) are the polynomials \verb|turnOne|, \verb|turnTwo|,
  \verb|affineRelation|.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.IncidentProjectiveRankLoss
lean.code:
structure IncidentProjectiveRankLoss where
  P : ℝ
  Q : ℝ
  B : ℝ
  r : ℝ
  k : ℝ
  T : ℝ
  one_lt_Q : 1 < Q
  Q_lt_P : Q < P
  B_pos : 0 < B
  r_pos : 0 < r
  r_half : r < 1 / 2
  k_pos : 0 < k
  k_half : k < 1 / 2
  r_T : 2 * r < T
  k_T : 2 * k < T
  affine : -(P + 1) * (P - Q) * (1 + T) +
    2 * (P ^ 2 - Q) * k - 2 * P * (Q - 1) * r = 0
  turnOne : Q * (P - B) * (P * (1 - 2 * r) + (1 - 2 * k)) -
    (P + 1) * (Q ^ 2 - P * B * (1 - 2 * r) * (1 - 2 * k)) = 0
  turnTwo : (P * B - Q ^ 2) * T * (T - 2 * k + P * (T - 2 * r)) -
    Q * (P + 1) * (B * T ^ 2 - P * (T - 2 * k) * (T - 2 * r)) = 0

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeIncidentProjective.affineRelation
Gluck.Discrete.NativeIncidentProjective.turnTwo

entries.label: lem:nrn_rank_loss_packet
entries.title: native rank loss produces a packet
entries.chapter: Repeated maxima and negative terminal corners
entries.body:
Let $0<p<1$, $0<l<1$, $0<t<q$, $0<h<q$, $q>1$ and strict angles
  $\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta$ with $\gamma+\delta<\pi/2$,
  $\tan\alpha\tan\delta=\tan\beta\tan\gamma>1$, the normalized cosine
  identities of \cref{lem:nrn_core_trig}(5), and $(E,\text{turn
  defect})=0$.  If $DN$ is not surjective at
  $(\sin\alpha,\sin\gamma/q,\sin\delta/q,\sin\beta)$, then a rank-loss
  packet exists.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.incidentProjectiveRankLoss_of_angles
lean.code:
theorem incidentProjectiveRankLoss_of_angles
    {p t q h l α β γ δ : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q) (hq : 1 < q) (hh : 0 < h) (hhq : h < q)
    (ha : StrictAngles q h α β γ δ)
    (hT : γ + δ < Real.pi / 2)
    (hprod : Real.tan α * Real.tan δ = Real.tan β * Real.tan γ)
    (hprod1 : 1 < Real.tan α * Real.tan δ)
    (hcos : let P := Real.tan α / Real.tan γ
      let Q := 1 / (Real.tan γ * Real.tan δ)
      Real.cos (α + β) = (Q - P ^ 2) / Q * Real.cos α * Real.cos β ∧
        Real.cos (γ + δ) / q = P * (Q - 1) / Q * Real.cos α * Real.cos β)
    (hzero : (nativeHalfClosure p t q h l α β γ δ,
      turnDefect p t q h l α β γ δ) = 0)
    (hnon : ¬Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (nativeLengthController p t q h l)
      ![Real.sin α, Real.sin γ / q, Real.sin δ / q, Real.sin β])) :
    Nonempty IncidentProjectiveRankLoss := by
  let P := Real.tan α / Real.tan γ
  let Q := 1 / (Real.tan γ * Real.tan δ)
  let b := 1 / Real.tan δ
  let A := 1 - angleSlope p α
  let B := 1 - angleSlope l β
  let C := 1 - angleSlope (t / q) γ
  let D := 1 - angleSlope (h / q) δ
  let r := A / 2
  let k := C / 2
  let T := A / B
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hb, hQ, hQP, hαtan, hβtan, hγtan, hδtan⟩ :=
    acute_projective_coordinates ha.1 ha.2.1 ha.2.2.1 ha.2.2.2.1 hT hprod hprod1
  change 0 < b at hb
  change 1 < Q at hQ
  change Q < P at hQP
  change Real.tan α = P * b / Q at hαtan
  change Real.tan β = P / b at hβtan
  change Real.tan γ = b / Q at hγtan
  change Real.tan δ = 1 / b at hδtan
  have hA := defectSlope_mem_Ioo hp hp1 ha.1
  have hB := defectSlope_mem_Ioo hl hl1 ha.2.1
  have hC := defectSlope_mem_Ioo (div_pos ht hq0) ((div_lt_one hq0).mpr htq) ha.2.2.1
  have hD := defectSlope_mem_Ioo (div_pos hh hq0) ((div_lt_one hq0).mpr hhq) ha.2.2.2.1
  obtain ⟨hcross, hminor⟩ := incident_minors_vanish_of_not_surjective
    hp hp1 hl hl1 ht htq hq hh hhq ha hzero hnon
  change A * D = B * C at hcross
  change Real.cos (α + β) * (A + B - A * D) +
    (Real.cos (γ + δ) / q) * (A + B - A * B) = 0 at hminor
  obtain ⟨hr0, hr1, hk0, hk1, hrT, hkT, hBT, hDT⟩ :=
    incident_projective_parameters hA hB hC hD hcross
  change 0 < r at hr0
  change r < 1 / 2 at hr1

entries.label: def:nrn_elimination_polys
entries.title: elimination polynomials
entries.chapter: Repeated maxima and negative terminal corners

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeIncidentProjective.polyC
lean.code: def polyC (p q B r : ℝ) : ℝ := B * p * polyD p q r + q * polyA p q r

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeIncidentProjective.projectiveD0
lean.code: def projectiveD0 (p q r : ℝ) : ℝ := p * (p + 1) * r - (p ^ 2 - q)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeIncidentProjective.projectiveH
lean.code: def projectiveH (p q r k : ℝ) : ℝ := 2 * k * projectiveD0 p q r + projectiveN p q r

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeIncidentProjective.projectiveN
lean.code: def projectiveN (p q r : ℝ) : ℝ := (p + 1) * (p - q) + 2 * p * (q - 1) * r

entries.label: lem:nrn_projective_H
entries.title: elimination of $\mathcal B$ and $\tau$
entries.chapter: Repeated maxima and negative terminal corners
entries.body:
Let $1<Q<P$, $0<r<\tfrac12$, $k>0$, $2r<\tau$ and let (T1), (T2), (Aff)
  hold (for any real $\mathcal B$).  Then $\mathsf H=0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeIncidentProjective.projectiveH_eq_zero
lean.code:
theorem projectiveH_eq_zero {p q B r k T : ℝ}
    (hq : 1 < q) (hqp : q < p) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hTr : 2 * r < T)
    (hf1 : turnOne p q B r k = 0) (hf2 : turnTwo p q B r k T = 0)
    (haff : affineRelation p q r k T = 0) : projectiveH p q r k = 0 := by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hp1 : 0 < p + 1 := by linarith
  have hpq : 0 < p - q := by linarith
  have hT : T = affineT p q r k := by
    apply (eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero hp1.ne' hpq.ne')).mpr
    unfold affineRelation at haff
    nlinarith [haff]
  have hres : coeffOne p q r k * constTwo p q r k T -
      constOne p q r k * coeffTwo p q r k T = 0 := by
    unfold turnOne at hf1
    unfold turnTwo at hf2
    unfold coeffOne constOne coeffTwo constTwo
    linear_combination
      (-q * (p * (1 - 2 * r) + (1 - 2 * k)) +
        (p + 1) * p * (1 - 2 * r) * (1 - 2 * k)) * hf2 -
      (p * T * (T - 2 * k + p * (T - 2 * r)) - q * (p + 1) * T ^ 2) * hf1
  have hprod : 8 * p * q * (r - k) *
      (k * (p ^ 2 - q) + p ^ 2 * r * (q - 1)) * projectiveH p q r k = 0 := by
    rw [← elimination_identity hp1.ne' hpq.ne', ← hT, hres, mul_zero]
  have hrk : r - k ≠ 0 := by
    intro heq
    have hkr : k = r := by linarith
    have hid : affineRelation p q r r T = (p + 1) * (p - q) * (2 * r - 1 - T) := by
      unfold affineRelation
      ring
    rw [hkr, hid] at haff
    have ht : 2 * r - 1 - T = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp haff).resolve_left (mul_ne_zero hp1.ne' hpq.ne')
    linarith
  have hbranch : 0 < k * (p ^ 2 - q) + p ^ 2 * r * (q - 1) := by
    have hpsq : 0 < p ^ 2 - q := by nlinarith
    exact add_pos (mul_pos hk hpsq) (mul_pos (mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hp0) hr) (by linarith))
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hprod).resolve_left
    (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hp0.ne') hq0.ne') hrk)
      hbranch.ne')

entries.label: lem:nrn_projective_interval
entries.title: the forced interval
entries.chapter: Repeated maxima and negative terminal corners
entries.body:
Let $1<Q<P$ and $\mathsf H=0$.
  \begin{enumerate}
    \item If (Aff) holds, then $(P-Q)\tau=2kPr$.
    \item If (T1) holds, then $\operatorname{polyC}(r)=0$.
    \item If $r>0$, $0<k<\tfrac12$, $2k<\tau$ and $(P-Q)\tau=2kPr$, then
      \[
        \frac{P-Q}P<r<\frac{Q-1}{P+2Q-1}.
      \]
  \end{enumerate}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeIncidentProjective.projective_polyC_eq_zero
lean.code:
theorem projective_polyC_eq_zero {p q B r k : ℝ} (hp : p + 1 ≠ 0)
    (hf1 : turnOne p q B r k = 0) (hH : projectiveH p q r k = 0) :
    polyC p q B r = 0 := by
  have hid : projectiveD0 p q r * turnOne p q B r k + (p + 1) * polyC p q B r =
      (2 * B * p ^ 2 * r - B * p ^ 2 + 2 * B * p * r - B * p + B * q - p * q) *
        projectiveH p q r k := by
    unfold projectiveH projectiveD0 turnOne polyC polyD polyA projectiveN
    ring
  rw [hf1, hH, mul_zero, mul_zero, zero_add] at hid
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hid).resolve_left hp

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeIncidentProjective.projective_T_relation
lean.code:
theorem projective_T_relation {p q r k T : ℝ} (hp : p + 1 ≠ 0)
    (haff : affineRelation p q r k T = 0) (hH : projectiveH p q r k = 0) :
    (p - q) * T = 2 * k * p * r := by
  have hid : (p + 1) * ((p - q) * T - 2 * k * p * r) +
      projectiveH p q r k + affineRelation p q r k T = 0 := by
    unfold projectiveH projectiveD0 projectiveN affineRelation
    ring
  rw [hH, haff, add_zero, add_zero] at hid
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hid).resolve_left hp)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeIncidentProjective.projective_forced_interval
lean.code:
theorem projective_forced_interval {p q r k T : ℝ}
    (hq : 1 < q) (hqp : q < p) (hr : 0 < r) (hk : 0 < k) (hkhalf : k < 1 / 2)
    (hTk : 2 * k < T) (hH : projectiveH p q r k = 0)
    (hT : (p - q) * T = 2 * k * p * r) :
    (p - q) / p < r ∧ r < (q - 1) / (p + 2 * q - 1) := by
  have hp : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hpq : 0 < p - q := by linarith
  have hden : 0 < p + 2 * q - 1 := by linarith
  have hN : 0 < projectiveN p q r := by
    unfold projectiveN
    exact add_pos (mul_pos (by linarith) hpq)
      (mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) hp) (by linarith)) hr)
  have hD : projectiveD0 p q r < 0 := by
    unfold projectiveH at hH
    by_contra hn
    have := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 2 * k by linarith) (le_of_not_gt hn)
    linarith
  constructor
  · have hscaled := mul_pos hpq (sub_pos.mpr hTk)
    have hprod : 0 < (2 * k) * (p * r - (p - q)) := by nlinarith [hT]
    have hpr : p - q < p * r := sub_pos.mp (pos_of_mul_pos_right hprod (by linarith))
    exact (div_lt_iff₀ hp).mpr (by nlinarith)
  · have hprod : (1 - 2 * k) * projectiveD0 p q r < 0 :=
      mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by linarith) hD
    have hid : projectiveN p q r + projectiveD0 p q r =
        p * (r * (p + 2 * q - 1) - (q - 1)) := by
      unfold projectiveN projectiveD0
      ring
    have hsum : projectiveN p q r + projectiveD0 p q r < 0 := by
      unfold projectiveH at hH
      nlinarith
    rw [hid] at hsum
    have hinner : r * (p + 2 * q - 1) - (q - 1) < 0 :=
      neg_of_mul_neg_right hsum hp.le
    exact (lt_div_iff₀ hden).mpr (by linarith)

entries.label: lem:nrn_poly_signs
entries.title: both quadratics are negative on the forced interval
entries.chapter: Repeated maxima and negative terminal corners
entries.body:
Let $1<Q<P$, $\mathcal B>0$ and
  $r_-=\frac{P-Q}P<r<r_+=\frac{Q-1}{P+2Q-1}$.  Then
  $\operatorname{polyA}(r)<0$, $\operatorname{polyD}(r)<0$ and
  $\operatorname{polyC}(r)<0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeIncidentProjective.polyA_at_left
lean.code:
theorem polyA_at_left {p q : ℝ} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    polyA p q ((p - q) / p) = -p * q * (p - q) := by
  unfold polyA
  field_simp
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeIncidentProjective.polyA_neg_and_polyD_neg_of_interval
lean.code:
theorem polyA_neg_and_polyD_neg_of_interval {p q r : ℝ}
    (hq : 1 < q) (hqp : q < p)
    (hlo : (p - q) / p < r) (hhi : r < (q - 1) / (p + 2 * q - 1)) :
    polyA p q r < 0 ∧ polyD p q r < 0 := by
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hp : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hp1 : 0 < p + 1 := by linarith
  have hden : 0 < p + 2 * q - 1 := by linarith
  have hgap : 0 < p ^ 2 - 2 * q + 1 := by nlinarith
  have hpq : 0 < p + q := by linarith
  have hcross := (div_lt_div_iff₀ hp hden).mp (hlo.trans hhi)
  have hbound : p ^ 2 - 2 * q ^ 2 + q < 0 := by nlinarith
  have hright : (q - 1) / (p + 2 * q - 1) < (p ^ 2 - q) / (p * (p + 1)) := by
    apply (div_lt_div_iff₀ hden (mul_pos hp hp1)).mpr
    nlinarith [mul_pos hpq hgap]
  have hAleft : polyA p q ((p - q) / p) < 0 := by
    rw [polyA_at_left hp.ne']
    have := mul_pos (mul_pos hp hq0) (sub_pos.mpr hqp)
    nlinarith
  have hAright : polyA p q ((p ^ 2 - q) / (p * (p + 1))) < 0 := by
    rw [polyA_at_outer_right hp.ne' hp1.ne']
    exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos
      (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (neg_neg_of_pos hp) hpq) hgap)
      (sq_pos_of_pos hp1)
  have hDleft : polyD p q ((p - q) / p) < 0 := by
    rw [polyD_at_left hp.ne']
    have hinner : p ^ 2 - p * q - 2 * q ^ 2 + q < 0 := by
      nlinarith [mul_pos hp hq0]
    exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (sub_pos.mpr hqp) hinner) hp
  have hDright : polyD p q ((q - 1) / (p + 2 * q - 1)) < 0 := by
    rw [polyD_at_right hden.ne']
    exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos
      (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (neg_neg_of_pos hq0) hpq) hgap)
      (sq_pos_of_pos hden)
  constructor
  · exact quadratic_neg_between (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * p ^ 3)
      hlo (hhi.trans hright) hAleft hAright
  · have hcoeff : 0 ≤ 2 * p ^ 2 + 2 * p * q - 2 * p := by
      have := mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) hp)
        (show 0 < p + q - 1 by linarith)
      nlinarith
    exact quadratic_neg_between hcoeff hlo hhi hDleft hDright

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeIncidentProjective.polyD_at_right
lean.code:
theorem polyD_at_right {p q : ℝ} (hden : p + 2 * q - 1 ≠ 0) :
    polyD p q ((q - 1) / (p + 2 * q - 1)) =
      -q * (p + q) * (p ^ 2 - 2 * q + 1) / (p + 2 * q - 1) ^ 2 := by
  unfold polyD
  field_simp
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeIncidentProjective.polyD_at_left
lean.code:
theorem polyD_at_left {p q : ℝ} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    polyD p q ((p - q) / p) = (p - q) * (p ^ 2 - p * q - 2 * q ^ 2 + q) / p := by
  unfold polyD
  field_simp
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeIncidentProjective.polyA_at_outer_right
lean.code:
theorem polyA_at_outer_right {p q : ℝ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (hp1 : p + 1 ≠ 0) :
    polyA p q ((p ^ 2 - q) / (p * (p + 1))) =
      -p * (p + q) * (p ^ 2 - 2 * q + 1) / (p + 1) ^ 2 := by
  unfold polyA
  field_simp
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeIncidentProjective.polyC_neg_of_interval
lean.code:
theorem polyC_neg_of_interval {p q B r : ℝ} (hq : 1 < q) (hqp : q < p) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hlo : (p - q) / p < r) (hhi : r < (q - 1) / (p + 2 * q - 1)) :
    polyC p q B r < 0 := by
  obtain ⟨hA, hD⟩ := polyA_neg_and_polyD_neg_of_interval hq hqp hlo hhi
  exact add_neg (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (mul_pos hB (by linarith)) hD)
    (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by linarith) hA)

entries.label: thm:nrn_packet_false
entries.title: no rank-loss packet exists
entries.chapter: Repeated maxima and negative terminal corners
entries.body:
There are no reals $P,Q,\mathcal B,r,k,\tau$ with $1<Q<P$,
  $\mathcal B>0$, $0<r,k<\tfrac12$, $2r<\tau$, $2k<\tau$ satisfying (T1),
  (T2) and (Aff).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.IncidentProjectiveRankLoss.false
lean.code:
theorem IncidentProjectiveRankLoss.false (z : IncidentProjectiveRankLoss) : False :=
  NativeIncidentProjective.not_projective_turn_solution z.one_lt_Q z.Q_lt_P z.B_pos
    z.r_pos z.k_pos z.k_half z.r_T z.k_T z.turnOne z.turnTwo z.affine

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeIncidentProjective.not_projective_turn_solution
lean.code:
theorem not_projective_turn_solution {p q B r k T : ℝ}
    (hq : 1 < q) (hqp : q < p) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hk : 0 < k) (hkhalf : k < 1 / 2)
    (hTr : 2 * r < T) (hTk : 2 * k < T)
    (hf1 : turnOne p q B r k = 0) (hf2 : turnTwo p q B r k T = 0)
    (haff : affineRelation p q r k T = 0) : False := by
  have hp : p + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hH := projectiveH_eq_zero hq hqp hr hk hTr hf1 hf2 haff
  have hT := projective_T_relation hp haff hH
  have hC := projective_polyC_eq_zero hp hf1 hH
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := projective_forced_interval hq hqp hr hk hkhalf hTk hH hT
  have hneg := polyC_neg_of_interval hq hqp hB hlo hhi
  rw [hC] at hneg
  exact lt_irrefl _ hneg

entries.label: thm:nrn_acute_rank
entries.title: rank in the acute orthogonal chamber
entries.chapter: Repeated maxima and negative terminal corners
entries.body:
Let $0<p<1$, $0<l<1$, $0<t<q$, $0<h<q$, $q>1$, $u,v\in(0,1)$,
  $L=L^{\mathrm{core}}(u,v)$ physical with $N(L)=0$, and
  $\arcsin(qL_1)+\arcsin(qL_2)<\pi/2$.  Then $DN(L)$ is surjective.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_acute_orthogonal
lean.code:
theorem fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_acute_orthogonal
    {p t q h l u v : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q) (hq : 1 < q) (hh : 0 < h) (hhq : h < q)
    (hu : u ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hv : v ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hphys : NativeLengthPhysical p t q h l (orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v))
    (hzero : nativeLengthController p t q h l (orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v) = 0)
    (hT : Real.arcsin (q * orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v 1) +
      Real.arcsin (q * orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v 2) < Real.pi / 2) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (nativeLengthController p t q h l)
      (orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v)) := by
  let L := orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v
  let α := Real.arcsin (L 0)
  let β := Real.arcsin (L 3)
  let γ := Real.arcsin (q * L 1)
  let δ := Real.arcsin (q * L 2)
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hα, hβ, hγ, hδ⟩ := coreHalfLengths_angles_acute hu.1 hu.2 hq hv.1 hv.2
  obtain ⟨a0, a3, a1, a2⟩ := coreHalfLengths_angle_data hu.1 hu.2 hq hv.1 hv.2
  have hs0 : Real.sin α = L 0 := Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith [a0.1.1]) a0.1.2.le
  have hs3 : Real.sin β = L 3 := Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith [a3.1.1]) a3.1.2.le
  have hs1 : Real.sin γ = q * L 1 := Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith [a1.1.1]) a1.1.2.le
  have hs2 : Real.sin δ = q * L 2 := Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith [a2.1.1]) a2.1.2.le
  have ha : StrictAngles q h α β γ δ := by
    refine ⟨hα, hβ, hγ, hδ, ?_⟩
    rw [hs2]
    have hh2 := hphys.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
    convert hh2 using 1
    field_simp
    rfl
  have hL : ![Real.sin α, Real.sin γ / q, Real.sin δ / q, Real.sin β] = L := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [hs0, hs3, hs1, hs2, ne_of_gt hq0]
  have hx : StrictAngles q h (![α + β, α, γ] 1)
      (![α + β, α, γ] 0 - ![α + β, α, γ] 1)
      (![α + β, α, γ] 2) ((γ + δ) - ![α + β, α, γ] 2) := by simpa using ha
  have hnative := nativeLengthController_splitHalfLengths
    (p := p) (t := t) (h := h) (l := l) (x := ![α + β, α, γ]) (T := γ + δ)
    (ne_of_gt hq0) hx.1 hx.2.1 hx.2.2.1 hx.2.2.2.1
  have hz : (nativeHalfClosure p t q h l α β γ δ,
      turnDefect p t q h l α β γ δ) = 0 := by
    have he : nativeLengthController p t q h l
        ![Real.sin α, Real.sin γ / q, Real.sin δ / q, Real.sin β] =
        (nativeHalfClosure p t q h l α β γ δ, turnDefect p t q h l α β γ δ) := by
      simpa [splitHalfLengths, nativeSplitController] using hnative
    rw [← he, hL]
    exact hzero
  obtain ⟨htan1, htan2⟩ := coreHalfLengths_tan_products hu.1 hu.2 hq hv.1 hv.2
  have htaneq : Real.tan α * Real.tan δ = Real.tan β * Real.tan γ := htan1.trans htan2.symm
  have htan_gt : 1 < Real.tan α * Real.tan δ :=
    coreHalfLengths_tan_product_gt_one hu.1 hu.2 hq hv.1 hv.2
  have hcos := coreHalfLengths_normalized_cos hu.1 hu.2 hq hv.1 hv.2
  by_contra hn
  have hn' : ¬Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (nativeLengthController p t q h l)
      ![Real.sin α, Real.sin γ / q, Real.sin δ / q, Real.sin β]) := by rwa [hL]
  obtain ⟨z⟩ := incidentProjectiveRankLoss_of_angles hp hp1 hl hl1 ht htq hq hh hhq
    ha hT htaneq htan_gt hcos hz hn'
  exact z.false

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_incident_orthogonal
lean.code:
theorem fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_incident_orthogonal
    {p t q h l u v : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q) (hq : 1 < q) (hh : 0 < h) (hhq : h < q)

    (hphys : NativeLengthPhysical p t q h l (orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v))

    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (nativeLengthController p t q h l)

      Real.arcsin (q * orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v 2)

      hl hl1 hh hhq hq.le hphys hzero hT

entries.chapter: Repeated maxima and negative terminal corners
entries.body:
Let $0<p<1$, $0<l<1$, $0<t<q$, $0<h<q$, $q>1$, $\Phi(p,t,q,l)<0$ and
  $\Phi(l,h,q,p)<0$.  Then there is a physical $L$ with $N(L)=0$ and $DN(L)$
  surjective.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.exists_nativeLength_regular_of_negative_corners
lean.code:
theorem exists_nativeLength_regular_of_negative_corners {p t q h l : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q) (hh : 0 < h) (hhq : h < q) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hflag : firstPairFlag p t q l < 0)
    (hreflected : firstPairFlag l h q p < 0) :
    ∃ L : Fin 4 → ℝ, NativeLengthPhysical p t q h l L ∧
      nativeLengthController p t q h l L = 0 ∧
      Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (nativeLengthController p t q h l) L) := by
  obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, hphys, _, hzero⟩ :=
    exists_nativeLength_anchor_of_negative_corners hp hp1 hl hl1 ht htq hh hhq hq hflag hreflected
  exact ⟨orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v, hphys, hzero,
    fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_incident_orthogonal hp hp1 hl hl1
      ht htq hq hh hhq hu hv hphys hzero⟩

entries.label: lem:nrn_repeated_separation
entries.title: separation of two normalized maxima
entries.chapter: Repeated maxima and negative terminal corners
entries.body:
Let $\kappa\colon\ZMod n\to\RR$ with $\kappa_i\ne\kappa_{i+1}$ for all
  $i$, $\kappa_0=1=\kappa_H$ and $H\ne0$.  Then the natural representative
  of $H$ satisfies $2\le H\le n-2$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.repeated_maximum_index_separation
lean.code:
theorem repeated_maximum_index_separation {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {H : ZMod n}
    (hne : ∀ i, κ i ≠ κ (i + 1))
    (hzero : κ 0 = 1) (hH : κ H = 1) (hH0 : H ≠ 0) :
    2 ≤ H.val ∧ H.val + 2 ≤ n := by
  have hv : 0 < H.val := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun hz => hH0 ((ZMod.val_eq_zero H).mp hz))
  have hvn := H.val_lt
  have hnot1 : H.val ≠ 1 := by
    intro hv1
    have he : H = 1 := by simpa [hv1] using (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val H).symm
    have hn := hne 0
    simp only [zero_add, hzero, ← he, hH, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false] at hn
  have hnotlast : H.val + 1 ≠ n := by
    intro he
    have hwrap : H + 1 = 0 := by
      rw [← ZMod.natCast_zmod_val H]
      norm_cast
      rw [he, ZMod.natCast_self]
    have hn := hne H
    rw [hwrap, hH, hzero] at hn
    exact hn rfl
  constructor <;> omega

entries.label: thm:nrn_repeated_anchor
entries.title: anchors at two repeated maxima
entries.chapter: Repeated maxima and negative terminal corners
entries.body:
\begin{enumerate}
    \item If a frame $F$ of $\kappa$ has start $(1,t,1,l)$ and finish
      $(p,1,h,1)$ with $p,t,h,l\in(0,1)$, then $\kappa$ has a regular
      four-edge anchor.
    \item Let $\kappa>0$ be adjacent-unequal with $\kappa\le1$,
      $\kappa_0=1=\kappa_H$ and $H\ne0$.  Then $\kappa$ has a regular
      four-edge anchor on the edges $0,H-1,H,n-1$.
  \end{enumerate}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_repeated_normalized_maximum
lean.code:
theorem nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_repeated_normalized_maximum
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {H : ZMod n}
    (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) (hle : ∀ i, κ i ≤ 1)
    (hne : ∀ i, κ i ≠ κ (i + 1))
    (hzero : κ 0 = 1) (hH : κ H = 1) (hH0 : H ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor κ) := by
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := repeated_maximum_index_separation hne hzero hH hH0
  let F := firstPairFrame hlo hhi
  have hp1 : κ 1 < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hle 1) (by
    intro he
    exact hne 0 (by simpa [hzero] using he.symm))
  have ht1 : κ (H - 1) < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hle (H - 1)) (by
    intro he
    exact hne (H - 1) (by simpa [hH] using he))
  have hh1 : κ (H + 1) < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hle (H + 1)) (by
    intro he
    exact hne H (by rw [hH, he]))
  have hl1 : κ (-1) < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hle (-1)) (by
    intro he
    exact hne (-1) (by simpa [hzero] using he))
  have hpred : ((H.val - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = H - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ H.val), ZMod.natCast_zmod_val, Nat.cast_one]
  have hlast : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = -1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ n), ZMod.natCast_self]
    simp
  have hnext : ((H.val + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = H + 1 := by simp
  have hstart : F.start κ = ![1, κ (H - 1), 1, κ (-1)] := by
    simpa [F, hpred, hlast, hH] using firstPairFrame_start hlo hhi κ hzero
  have hfinish : F.finish κ = ![κ 1, 1, κ (H + 1), 1] := by
    simpa [F, hnext, hH] using firstPairFrame_finish hlo hhi κ hzero
  exact F.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_repeated_maximum hstart hfinish
    (hκ 1) hp1 (hκ (H - 1)) ht1 (hκ (H + 1)) hh1 (hκ (-1)) hl1

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_repeated_maximum
lean.code:
theorem FourActiveSlots.Frame.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_repeated_maximum
    {n : ℕ} (F : Frame n) {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {p t h l : ℝ}
    (hstart : F.start κ = ![1, t, 1, l])
    (hfinish : F.finish κ = ![p, 1, h, 1])
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1) :
    Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor κ) := by
  obtain ⟨u, v, _hu, _hv, hphysical, _hres, hzero⟩ :=
    exists_nativeLength_anchor_of_repeated_maximum hp hp1 ht ht1 hh hh1 hl hl1
  have hregular := fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_equal_pure
    hp hp1 ht ht1 hl hl1 hh hh1 hphysical hzero
  exact ⟨RegularFourAnchor.ofNative F hstart hfinish hphysical hzero hregular⟩

entries.label: thm:nrn_negative_anchor
entries.title: anchors at two negative terminal flags
entries.chapter: Repeated maxima and negative terminal corners
entries.body:
\begin{enumerate}
    \item If a frame $F$ of $\kappa$ has start $(1,t,q,l)$ and finish
      $(p,q,h,1)$ with the hypotheses of \cref{thm:nrn_negative_regular},
      then $\kappa$ has a regular four-edge anchor.
    \item Let $\kappa>0$ be adjacent-unequal, $\kappa_0=1<\kappa_H$,
      $\kappa_i<\kappa_H$ for all $i\ne H$, and let $0$ be a highest
      secondary peak for $H$ (\cref{def:four_active_secondary_peak}).  If
      the forward and backward terminal flags are negative,
      \[
        \Phi(\kappa_1,\kappa_{H-1},\kappa_H,\kappa_{-1})<0,\qquad
        \Phi(\kappa_{-1},\kappa_{H+1},\kappa_H,\kappa_1)<0,
      \]
      then $\kappa$ has a regular four-edge anchor on the edges
      $0,H-1,H,n-1$.
  \end{enumerate}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_negative_terminals
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_negative_terminals
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {H : ZMod n}
    (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H 0)
    (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) (hne : ∀ i, κ i ≠ κ (i + 1))
    (hzero : κ 0 = 1) (hH : 1 < κ H)
    (hglobal : ∀ i, i ≠ H → κ i < κ H)
    (hforward : firstPairFlag (κ 1) (κ (H - 1)) (κ H) (κ (-1)) < 0)
    (hbackward : firstPairFlag (κ (-1)) (κ (H + 1)) (κ H) (κ 1) < 0) :
    Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor κ) := by
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hak, hkb, hbn, _, _, _⟩ :=
    hq.exists_mountain hne (by simpa only [hzero] using hH)
  simp only [sub_zero] at hak hkb
  have hlo : 2 ≤ H.val := by omega
  have hhi : H.val + 2 ≤ n := by omega
  let : Fact (1 < n) := ⟨by omega⟩
  let F := firstPairFrame hlo hhi
  have hp : κ 1 < 1 := by simpa [hzero] using hq.is_peak.2
  have hl : κ (-1) < 1 := by simpa [hzero] using hq.is_peak.1
  have ht : κ (H - 1) < κ H := hglobal _ (by simp)
  have hh : κ (H + 1) < κ H := hglobal _ (by simp)
  have hpred := natPred_val_residue hq.ne_global.symm
  have hlast : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = -1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ n), ZMod.natCast_self]
    simp
  have hstart : F.start κ = ![1, κ (H - 1), κ H, κ (-1)] := by
    simpa [F, hpred, hlast] using firstPairFrame_start hlo hhi κ hzero
  have hfinish : F.finish κ = ![κ 1, κ H, κ (H + 1), 1] := by
    simpa [F] using firstPairFrame_finish hlo hhi κ hzero
  exact F.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_negative_corners hstart hfinish
    (hκ 1) hp (hκ (-1)) hl (hκ (H - 1)) ht (hκ (H + 1)) hh hH hforward hbackward

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_negative_corners
lean.code:
theorem FourActiveSlots.Frame.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_negative_corners
    {n : ℕ} (F : Frame n) {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {p t q h l : ℝ}
    (hstart : F.start κ = ![1, t, q, l])
    (hfinish : F.finish κ = ![p, q, h, 1])
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q) (hh : 0 < h) (hhq : h < q) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hflag : firstPairFlag p t q l < 0)
    (hreflected : firstPairFlag l h q p < 0) : Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor κ) := by
  obtain ⟨L, hphysical, hzero, hregular⟩ :=
    exists_nativeLength_regular_of_negative_corners
      hp hp1 hl hl1 ht htq hh hhq hq hflag hreflected
  exact ⟨RegularFourAnchor.ofNative F hstart hfinish hphysical hzero hregular⟩

entries.label: lem:mt_secondary_exists
entries.title: existence of the highest secondary peak
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
Let $\operatorname{DFV}(\kappa;c)$ hold and $\kappa_i\ne\kappa_{i+1}$ for
  every $i$.  For every $H\in\ZMod n$ there is a highest secondary peak $q$
  for $H$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.exists_highestSecondaryPeak
lean.code:
theorem exists_highestSecondaryPeak {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (hdfv : DFV κ c) (hne : ∀ i, κ i ≠ κ (i + 1)) (H : ZMod n) :
    ∃ q, HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hi, hj⟩ := hdfv.exists_two_strictLocalMax hne
  let s := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : ZMod n => i ≠ H ∧ IsStrictLocalMax κ i)
  have hs : s.Nonempty := by
    by_cases hiH : i = H
    · exact ⟨j, by simp [s, hj, show j ≠ H by intro e; exact hij (hiH.trans e.symm)]⟩
    · exact ⟨i, by simp [s, hiH, hi]⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hmax⟩ := s.exists_max_image κ hs
  have hqm : q ≠ H ∧ IsStrictLocalMax κ q := by simpa [s] using hq
  exact ⟨q, hqm.1, hqm.2, fun i hiH hi => hmax i (by simp [s, hiH, hi])⟩

entries.label: lem:mt_high_step
entries.title: one step of a high path
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
Let $q$ be a highest secondary peak for $H$, and let $i\ne H$ be high,
  $\kappa_q<\kappa_i$.  Then $i$ is not a strict local maximum.  If
  moreover the word is adjacent-unequal, then
  \[
    \kappa_{i-1}<\kappa_i\ \Longrightarrow\ \kappa_i<\kappa_{i+1},
    \qquad
    \kappa_{i+1}<\kappa_i\ \Longrightarrow\ \kappa_i<\kappa_{i-1}.
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.backward_step
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.backward_step {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {H q i : ZMod n} (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q)
    (hne : ∀ j, κ j ≠ κ (j + 1)) (hi : i ≠ H)
    (hhigh : κ q < κ i) (hrise : κ (i + 1) < κ i) :
    κ i < κ (i - 1) := by
  by_contra h
  have hprev : κ (i - 1) ≠ κ i := by simpa using hne (i - 1)
  have hfall : κ (i - 1) < κ i := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h) hprev
  exact hq.not_isStrictLocalMax hi hhigh ⟨hfall, hrise⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.not_isStrictLocalMax
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.not_isStrictLocalMax {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {H q i : ZMod n} (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q)
    (hi : i ≠ H) (hhigh : κ q < κ i) : ¬ IsStrictLocalMax κ i := by
  intro hpeak
  exact (not_le_of_gt hhigh) (hq.maximal i hi hpeak)

omit [NeZero n] in

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.forward_step
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.forward_step {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {H q i : ZMod n} (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q)
    (hne : ∀ j, κ j ≠ κ (j + 1)) (hi : i ≠ H)
    (hhigh : κ q < κ i) (hrise : κ (i - 1) < κ i) :
    κ i < κ (i + 1) := by
  by_contra h
  have hfall : κ (i + 1) < κ i := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h) (hne i).symm
  exact hq.not_isStrictLocalMax hi hhigh ⟨hrise, hfall⟩

omit [NeZero n] in

entries.label: lem:mt_cyclic_distance
entries.title: cyclic distances
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
For $i,H\in\ZMod n$ put $d=\operatorname{val}(H-i)<n$ and
  $d'=\operatorname{val}(i-H)<n$.  Then $i+d=H$ and $i-d'=H$, and
  $i+m\ne H$ for every natural $m<d$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cyclic_offset_ne_of_lt_distance
lean.code:
theorem cyclic_offset_ne_of_lt_distance {i H : ZMod n} {m : ℕ}
    (hm : m < (H - i).val) : i + (m : ZMod n) ≠ H := by
  intro h
  have hcast : (m : ZMod n) = H - i := by
    exact eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr (by simpa [add_comm] using h)
  have hv := congrArg ZMod.val hcast
  rw [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (lt_trans hm (ZMod.val_lt _))] at hv
  omega

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cyclic_distance_endpoints
lean.code:
theorem cyclic_distance_endpoints (i H : ZMod n) :
    i + ((H - i).val : ZMod n) = H ∧ i - ((i - H).val : ZMod n) = H := by
  simp only [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
  constructor <;> ring

entries.label: lem:mt_cyclic_path
entries.title: monotone cyclic paths
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
Let $\lambda\in\RR$, $i,H\in\ZMod n$, $d=\operatorname{val}(H-i)$, and
  assume the propagation rule: for every $j\ne H$ with $\lambda<\kappa_j$
  and $\kappa_{j-1}<\kappa_j$ one has $\kappa_j<\kappa_{j+1}$.  If
  $\lambda<\kappa_i$ and either
  \begin{enumerate}
    \item $\kappa_{i-1}<\kappa_i$ (an incoming rise), or
    \item $\kappa_i<\kappa_{i+1}$ (an outgoing first rise),
  \end{enumerate}
  then $\lambda<\kappa_{i+m}$ for every $m\le d$, and $m\mapsto\kappa_{i+m}$
  is strictly increasing on $\{0,\dots,d\}$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.strictMonoOn_cyclicPath_of_rising
lean.code:
theorem strictMonoOn_cyclicPath_of_rising {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {level : ℝ} {i H : ZMod n}
    (hstep : ∀ j, j ≠ H → level < κ j → κ (j - 1) < κ j → κ j < κ (j + 1))
    (hhigh : level < κ i) (hrise : κ (i - 1) < κ i) :
    (∀ m ≤ (H - i).val, level < κ (i + (m : ZMod n))) ∧
      StrictMonoOn (fun m : ℕ => κ (i + (m : ZMod n))) (Iic (H - i).val) := by
  have hchain : ∀ m, m ≤ (H - i).val →
      level < κ (i + (m : ZMod n)) ∧
      κ (i + (m : ZMod n) - 1) < κ (i + (m : ZMod n)) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => intro _; simpa using And.intro hhigh hrise
    | succ m ih =>
      intro hm
      have hm' : m < (H - i).val := by omega
      obtain ⟨hhighm, hrisem⟩ := ih (by omega)
      have hnext := hstep (i + (m : ZMod n))
        (cyclic_offset_ne_of_lt_distance hm') hhighm hrisem
      constructor
      · simpa [Nat.cast_add, add_assoc] using lt_trans hhighm hnext
      · simpa [Nat.cast_add, ← add_assoc] using hnext
  refine ⟨fun m hm => (hchain m hm).1, ?_⟩
  apply strictMonoOn_Iic_of_lt_succ
  intro m hm
  have hnext := hstep (i + (m : ZMod n))
    (cyclic_offset_ne_of_lt_distance hm) (hchain m hm.le).1 (hchain m hm.le).2
  simpa [Nat.cast_add, add_assoc] using hnext

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.strictMonoOn_cyclicPath_of_first_step
lean.code:
theorem strictMonoOn_cyclicPath_of_first_step {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {level : ℝ} {i H : ZMod n}
    (hstep : ∀ j, j ≠ H → level < κ j → κ (j - 1) < κ j → κ j < κ (j + 1))
    (hhigh : level < κ i) (hrise : κ i < κ (i + 1)) :
    (∀ m ≤ (H - i).val, level < κ (i + (m : ZMod n))) ∧
      StrictMonoOn (fun m : ℕ => κ (i + (m : ZMod n))) (Iic (H - i).val) := by
  have hchain : ∀ m, m ≤ (H - i).val →
      level < κ (i + (m : ZMod n)) ∧
      (m < (H - i).val → κ (i + (m : ZMod n)) < κ (i + (m : ZMod n) + 1)) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => intro _; simpa using And.intro hhigh (fun _ => hrise)
    | succ m ih =>
      intro hm
      have hm' : m < (H - i).val := by omega
      obtain ⟨hhighm, hrisem⟩ := ih hm'.le
      have hnext := hrisem hm'
      have hhigh' : level < κ (i + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n)) := by
        simpa [Nat.cast_add, add_assoc] using lt_trans hhighm hnext
      refine ⟨hhigh', fun hm'' => ?_⟩
      apply hstep _ (cyclic_offset_ne_of_lt_distance hm'') hhigh'
      simpa [Nat.cast_add, ← add_assoc] using hnext
  refine ⟨fun m hm => (hchain m hm).1, ?_⟩
  apply strictMonoOn_Iic_of_lt_succ
  intro m hm
  simpa [Nat.cast_add, add_assoc] using (hchain m hm.le).2 hm

entries.label: lem:mt_high_path
entries.title: every high reading climbs to $H$
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
Let $q$ be a highest secondary peak for $H$ in an adjacent-unequal word
  and $\kappa_q<\kappa_i$.  Then at least one of the following holds:
  \begin{enumerate}
    \item (forward) with $d=\operatorname{val}(H-i)$, all $\kappa_{i+m}$,
      $m\le d$, are high and $m\mapsto\kappa_{i+m}$ is strictly increasing
      on $\{0,\dots,d\}$;
    \item (backward) with $d'=\operatorname{val}(i-H)$, all $\kappa_{i-m}$,
      $m\le d'$, are high and $m\mapsto\kappa_{i-m}$ is strictly increasing
      on $\{0,\dots,d'\}$.
  \end{enumerate}
  In either case the path ends at the literal index $H$
  (\cref{lem:mt_cyclic_distance}).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.high_path_to_global
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.high_path_to_global {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {H q i : ZMod n} (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q)
    (hne : ∀ j, κ j ≠ κ (j + 1)) (hhigh : κ q < κ i) :
    ((∀ m ≤ (H - i).val, κ q < κ (i + (m : ZMod n))) ∧
      StrictMonoOn (fun m : ℕ => κ (i + (m : ZMod n))) (Iic (H - i).val)) ∨
    ((∀ m ≤ (i - H).val, κ q < κ (i - (m : ZMod n))) ∧
      StrictMonoOn (fun m : ℕ => κ (i - (m : ZMod n))) (Iic (i - H).val)) := by
  by_cases hi : i = H
  · subst i
    left
    constructor
    · simpa using hhigh
    · intro a ha b hb hab
      simp only [sub_self, ZMod.val_zero, mem_Iic] at ha hb
      omega
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hne i) with hrise | hfall
    · exact Or.inl (hq.forward_ascent_of_first_step hne hhigh hrise)
    · have hrise : κ i < κ (i - 1) := hq.backward_step hne hi hhigh hfall
      exact Or.inr (hq.backward_ascent_of_first_step hne hhigh hrise)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.backward_ascent
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.backward_ascent {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {H q i : ZMod n} (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q)
    (hne : ∀ j, κ j ≠ κ (j + 1))
    (hhigh : κ q < κ i) (hrise : κ (i + 1) < κ i) :
    (∀ m ≤ (i - H).val, κ q < κ (i - (m : ZMod n))) ∧
      StrictMonoOn (fun m : ℕ => κ (i - (m : ZMod n))) (Iic (i - H).val) := by
  have hstep : ∀ j : ZMod n, j ≠ -H → κ q < κ (-j) →
      κ (-(j - 1)) < κ (-j) → κ (-j) < κ (-(j + 1)) := by
    intro j hj hh hr
    have hj' : -j ≠ H := by intro e; apply hj; simpa using congrArg Neg.neg e
    have hr' : κ (-j + 1) < κ (-j) := by simpa [neg_sub, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hr
    simpa [neg_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hq.backward_step hne hj' hh hr'
  have hp := strictMonoOn_cyclicPath_of_rising (κ := fun j : ZMod n => κ (-j))
    (i := -i) (H := -H) hstep (by simpa using hhigh)
      (by simpa [neg_sub, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hrise)
  simpa [neg_add, neg_sub, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hp

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.forward_ascent_of_first_step
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.forward_ascent_of_first_step {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {H q i : ZMod n} (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q)
    (hne : ∀ j, κ j ≠ κ (j + 1))
    (hhigh : κ q < κ i) (hrise : κ i < κ (i + 1)) :
    (∀ m ≤ (H - i).val, κ q < κ (i + (m : ZMod n))) ∧
      StrictMonoOn (fun m : ℕ => κ (i + (m : ZMod n))) (Iic (H - i).val) :=
  strictMonoOn_cyclicPath_of_first_step (fun _ => hq.forward_step hne) hhigh hrise

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.backward_ascent_of_first_step
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.backward_ascent_of_first_step {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {H q i : ZMod n} (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q)
    (hne : ∀ j, κ j ≠ κ (j + 1))
    (hhigh : κ q < κ i) (hrise : κ i < κ (i - 1)) :
    (∀ m ≤ (i - H).val, κ q < κ (i - (m : ZMod n))) ∧
      StrictMonoOn (fun m : ℕ => κ (i - (m : ZMod n))) (Iic (i - H).val) := by
  have hstep : ∀ j : ZMod n, j ≠ -H → κ q < κ (-j) →
      κ (-(j - 1)) < κ (-j) → κ (-j) < κ (-(j + 1)) := by
    intro j hj hh hr
    have hj' : -j ≠ H := by intro e; apply hj; simpa using congrArg Neg.neg e
    have hr' : κ (-j + 1) < κ (-j) := by simpa [neg_sub, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hr
    simpa [neg_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hq.backward_step hne hj' hh hr'
  have hp := strictMonoOn_cyclicPath_of_first_step (κ := fun j : ZMod n => κ (-j))
    (i := -i) (H := -H) hstep (by simpa using hhigh)
      (by simpa [neg_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hrise)
  simpa [neg_add, neg_sub, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hp

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.forward_ascent
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.forward_ascent {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {H q i : ZMod n} (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q)
    (hne : ∀ j, κ j ≠ κ (j + 1))
    (hhigh : κ q < κ i) (hrise : κ (i - 1) < κ i) :
    (∀ m ≤ (H - i).val, κ q < κ (i + (m : ZMod n))) ∧
      StrictMonoOn (fun m : ℕ => κ (i + (m : ZMod n))) (Iic (H - i).val) :=
  strictMonoOn_cyclicPath_of_rising (fun _ => hq.forward_step hne) hhigh hrise

entries.label: lem:mt_no_wrap
entries.title: high paths do not wrap past $q$
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
Let $r=\operatorname{val}(i-q)$.
  \begin{enumerate}
    \item If $\kappa_q<\kappa_{i+m}$ for all $m\le d=\operatorname{val}(H-i)$,
      then $r+d<n$ and $h=r+d$.
    \item If $\kappa_q<\kappa_{i-m}$ for all $m\le d'=\operatorname{val}(i-H)$,
      then $d'<r$ and $h=r-d'$.
  \end{enumerate}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.high_forward_path_offsets
lean.code:
theorem high_forward_path_offsets {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {H q i : ZMod n}
    (hpath : ∀ m ≤ (H - i).val, κ q < κ (i + (m : ZMod n))) :
    (i - q).val + (H - i).val < n ∧
      (H - q).val = (i - q).val + (H - i).val := by
  have hi_lt := ZMod.val_lt (i - q)
  have hd_lt := ZMod.val_lt (H - i)
  have hsum : (i - q).val + (H - i).val < n := by
    by_contra h
    have hm : n - (i - q).val ≤ (H - i).val := by omega
    have heq : i + ((n - (i - q).val : ℕ) : ZMod n) = q := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hi_lt.le, ZMod.natCast_self, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
      ring
    have hh := hpath (n - (i - q).val) hm
    rw [heq] at hh
    exact lt_irrefl _ hh
  refine ⟨hsum, ?_⟩
  have hval := ZMod.val_add_of_lt hsum
  have heq : (i - q) + (H - i) = H - q := by ring
  rwa [heq] at hval

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.high_backward_path_offsets
lean.code:
theorem high_backward_path_offsets {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {H q i : ZMod n}
    (hpath : ∀ m ≤ (i - H).val, κ q < κ (i - (m : ZMod n))) :
    (i - H).val < (i - q).val ∧
      (H - q).val = (i - q).val - (i - H).val := by
  have hlt : (i - H).val < (i - q).val := by
    by_contra h
    have hh := hpath (i - q).val (le_of_not_gt h)
    have heq : i - ((i - q).val : ZMod n) = q := by
      rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
      ring
    rw [heq] at hh
    exact lt_irrefl _ hh
  refine ⟨hlt, ?_⟩
  have hval := ZMod.val_sub hlt.le
  have heq : (i - q) - (i - H) = H - q := by ring
  rwa [heq] at hval

entries.label: lem:mt_high_interval
entries.title: the high set is an interval of offsets
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
Let $q$ be a highest secondary peak for $H$ in an adjacent-unequal word.
  \begin{enumerate}
    \item If $i$ is high, $r=\operatorname{val}(i-q)$, and $j$ is a natural
      number between $\min(r,h)$ and $\max(r,h)$, then $q+j$ is high.
    \item If $a,b<n$, the readings at $q+a$ and $q+b$ are high, and
      $a\le j\le b$, then $q+j$ is high.
  \end{enumerate}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.high_interval_to_global
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.high_interval_to_global {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {H q i : ZMod n} (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q)
    (hne : ∀ j, κ j ≠ κ (j + 1)) (hhigh : κ q < κ i)
    {j : ℕ} (hjlo : min (i - q).val (H - q).val ≤ j)
    (hjhi : j ≤ max (i - q).val (H - q).val) :
    κ q < κ (q + (j : ZMod n)) := by
  rcases hq.high_path_to_global hne hhigh with ⟨hp, -⟩ | ⟨hp, -⟩
  · obtain ⟨-, hoff⟩ := high_forward_path_offsets hp
    have horder : (i - q).val ≤ (H - q).val := by omega
    rw [min_eq_left horder] at hjlo
    rw [max_eq_right horder] at hjhi
    have hm : j - (i - q).val ≤ (H - i).val := by omega
    have hh := hp (j - (i - q).val) hm
    have heq : i + ((j - (i - q).val : ℕ) : ZMod n) = q + (j : ZMod n) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hjlo, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
      ring
    rwa [heq] at hh
  · obtain ⟨hd, hoff⟩ := high_backward_path_offsets hp
    have horder : (H - q).val ≤ (i - q).val := by omega
    rw [min_eq_right horder] at hjlo
    rw [max_eq_left horder] at hjhi
    have hm : (i - q).val - j ≤ (i - H).val := by omega
    have hh := hp ((i - q).val - j) hm
    have heq : i - (((i - q).val - j : ℕ) : ZMod n) = q + (j : ZMod n) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hjhi, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
      ring
    rwa [heq] at hh

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.high_interval
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.high_interval {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {H q : ZMod n} (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q)
    (hne : ∀ i, κ i ≠ κ (i + 1)) {a b j : ℕ}
    (ha : a < n) (hb : b < n)
    (haHigh : κ q < κ (q + (a : ZMod n)))
    (hbHigh : κ q < κ (q + (b : ZMod n))) (haj : a ≤ j) (hjb : j ≤ b) :
    κ q < κ (q + (j : ZMod n)) := by
  have haoff : (q + (a : ZMod n) - q).val = a := by
    simpa using ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt ha
  have hboff : (q + (b : ZMod n) - q).val = b := by
    simpa using ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hb
  rcases le_total j (H - q).val with hjH | hHj
  · apply hq.high_interval_to_global hne haHigh
    · rw [haoff]; exact (min_le_left _ _).trans haj
    · exact hjH.trans (le_max_right _ _)
  · apply hq.high_interval_to_global hne hbHigh
    · exact (min_le_right _ _).trans hHj
    · rw [hboff]; exact hjb.trans (le_max_left _ _)

entries.label: lem:mt_legs
entries.title: the rising and the falling legs
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
Let $q$ be a highest secondary peak for $H$ in an adjacent-unequal word.
  \begin{enumerate}
    \item If $a<b\le h$ and $q+a$ is high, then
      $\kappa_{q+a}<\kappa_{q+b}$.
    \item If $h\le a<b<n$ and $q+b$ is high, then
      $\kappa_{q+b}<\kappa_{q+a}$.
  \end{enumerate}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.rising_lt
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.rising_lt {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {H q : ZMod n} (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q)
    (hne : ∀ i, κ i ≠ κ (i + 1)) {a b : ℕ}
    (hab : a < b) (hbH : b ≤ (H - q).val)
    (haHigh : κ q < κ (q + (a : ZMod n))) :
    κ (q + (a : ZMod n)) < κ (q + (b : ZMod n)) := by
  have ha : a < n := lt_trans hab (lt_of_le_of_lt hbH (ZMod.val_lt _))
  have haoff : (q + (a : ZMod n) - q).val = a := by
    simpa using ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt ha
  rcases hq.high_path_to_global hne haHigh with ⟨hp, hm⟩ | ⟨hp, -⟩
  · have hoff := (high_forward_path_offsets hp).2
    rw [haoff] at hoff
    have hmd : b - a ≤ (H - (q + (a : ZMod n))).val := by omega
    have hh := hm (show 0 ∈ Iic (H - (q + (a : ZMod n))).val by simp)
      hmd (show 0 < b - a by omega)
    have heq : q + (a : ZMod n) + ((b - a : ℕ) : ZMod n) = q + (b : ZMod n) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hab.le]
      ring
    simpa [heq] using hh
  · have hoff := (high_backward_path_offsets hp).2
    rw [haoff] at hoff
    omega

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.falling_lt
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.falling_lt {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {H q : ZMod n} (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q)
    (hne : ∀ i, κ i ≠ κ (i + 1)) {a b : ℕ}
    (hHa : (H - q).val ≤ a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b < n)
    (hbHigh : κ q < κ (q + (b : ZMod n))) :
    κ (q + (b : ZMod n)) < κ (q + (a : ZMod n)) := by
  have hboff : (q + (b : ZMod n) - q).val = b := by
    simpa using ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hb
  rcases hq.high_path_to_global hne hbHigh with ⟨hp, -⟩ | ⟨hp, hm⟩
  · have hoff := (high_forward_path_offsets hp).2
    rw [hboff] at hoff
    omega
  · obtain ⟨hd, hoff⟩ := high_backward_path_offsets hp
    rw [hboff] at hd hoff
    have hmd : b - a ≤ (q + (b : ZMod n) - H).val := by omega
    have hh := hm (show 0 ∈ Iic (q + (b : ZMod n) - H).val by simp)
      hmd (show 0 < b - a by omega)
    have heq : q + (b : ZMod n) - ((b - a : ℕ) : ZMod n) = q + (a : ZMod n) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hab.le]
      ring
    simpa [heq] using hh
