entries.label: thm:mt_mountain
entries.title: the single mountain above the secondary peak
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
Let $q$ be a highest secondary peak for $H$ in an adjacent-unequal word,
  with $\kappa_q<\kappa_H$, and let $h=\operatorname{val}(H-q)$.  Then there
  are natural numbers $a,b$ with
  \[
    2\le a\le h\le b,\qquad b+2\le n,
  \]
  such that for every $j<n$
  \[
    \kappa_q<\kappa_{q+j}\iff a\le j\le b ,
  \]
  $j\mapsto\kappa_{q+j}$ is strictly increasing on $[a,h]$ and strictly
  decreasing on $[h,b]$.  Consequently, if $\operatorname{DFV}(\kappa;c)$
  holds and $H$ is a strict unique global maximum ($\kappa_i<\kappa_H$ for
  $i\ne H$), then a highest secondary peak with such a mountain exists, and
  every high reading has a high monotone path to $H$ as in
  \cref{lem:mt_high_path}.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.exists_secondaryPeak_with_high_paths
lean.code:
theorem exists_secondaryPeak_with_high_paths {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (hdfv : DFV κ c) (hne : ∀ i, κ i ≠ κ (i + 1))
    (H : ZMod n) (hglobal : ∀ i, i ≠ H → κ i < κ H) :
    ∃ q, HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q ∧ κ q < κ H ∧
      ∀ i, κ q < κ i →
        ((∀ m ≤ (H - i).val, κ q < κ (i + (m : ZMod n))) ∧
          StrictMonoOn (fun m : ℕ => κ (i + (m : ZMod n))) (Iic (H - i).val)) ∨
        ((∀ m ≤ (i - H).val, κ q < κ (i - (m : ZMod n))) ∧
          StrictMonoOn (fun m : ℕ => κ (i - (m : ZMod n))) (Iic (i - H).val)) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_highestSecondaryPeak hdfv hne H
  exact ⟨q, hq, hglobal q hq.ne_global, fun _ => hq.high_path_to_global hne⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.exists_mountain
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.exists_mountain {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {H q : ZMod n} (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q)
    (hne : ∀ i, κ i ≠ κ (i + 1)) (hH : κ q < κ H) :
    ∃ a b : ℕ, 2 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ (H - q).val ∧ (H - q).val ≤ b ∧ b + 2 ≤ n ∧
      (∀ j < n, κ q < κ (q + (j : ZMod n)) ↔ a ≤ j ∧ j ≤ b) ∧
      StrictMonoOn (fun j : ℕ => κ (q + (j : ZMod n))) (Icc a (H - q).val) ∧
      StrictAntiOn (fun j : ℕ => κ (q + (j : ZMod n))) (Icc (H - q).val b) := by
  classical
  let s := (Finset.range n).filter (fun j : ℕ => κ q < κ (q + (j : ZMod n)))
  have hmem : ∀ j, j ∈ s ↔ j < n ∧ κ q < κ (q + (j : ZMod n)) := by
    intro j; simp [s]
  have hHmem : (H - q).val ∈ s := by
    rw [hmem]
    refine ⟨ZMod.val_lt _, ?_⟩
    simpa [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using hH
  have hs : s.Nonempty := ⟨_, hHmem⟩
  let a := s.min' hs
  let b := s.max' hs
  have ha := (hmem a).mp (s.min'_mem hs)
  have hb := (hmem b).mp (s.max'_mem hs)
  have haH : a ≤ (H - q).val := s.min'_le _ hHmem
  have hHb : (H - q).val ≤ b := s.le_max' _ hHmem
  have ha2 : 2 ≤ a := by
    by_contra h
    have ha01 : a = 0 ∨ a = 1 := by omega
    rcases ha01 with ha0 | ha1
    · simpa [ha0] using ha.2
    · have hh : κ q < κ (q + 1) := by simpa [ha1] using ha.2
      exact (not_lt_of_gt hq.is_peak.2) hh
  have hb2 : b + 2 ≤ n := by
    by_contra h
    have hbn : b = n - 1 := by omega
    have hidx : q + (b : ZMod n) = q - 1 := by
      rw [hbn, Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ n), ZMod.natCast_self]
      simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
    have hh : κ q < κ (q - 1) := by simpa [hidx] using hb.2
    exact (not_lt_of_gt hq.is_peak.1) hh
  have hinterval : ∀ j < n, κ q < κ (q + (j : ZMod n)) ↔ a ≤ j ∧ j ≤ b := by
    intro j hj
    constructor
    · intro hh
      have hjmem := (hmem j).mpr ⟨hj, hh⟩
      exact ⟨s.min'_le _ hjmem, s.le_max' _ hjmem⟩
    · rintro ⟨haj, hjb⟩
      exact hq.high_interval hne ha.1 hb.1 ha.2 hb.2 haj hjb
  refine ⟨a, b, ha2, haH, hHb, hb2, hinterval, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi j hj hij
    rcases hi with ⟨hia, hiH⟩
    rcases hj with ⟨hja, hjH⟩
    apply hq.rising_lt hne hij hjH
    exact (hinterval i (by omega)).mpr ⟨hia, by omega⟩
  · intro i hi j hj hij
    rcases hi with ⟨hiH, hib⟩
    rcases hj with ⟨hjH, hjb⟩
    apply hq.falling_lt hne hiH hij (by omega)
    exact (hinterval j (by omega)).mpr ⟨by omega, hjb⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.exists_secondaryPeak_mountain
lean.code:
theorem exists_secondaryPeak_mountain {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (hdfv : DFV κ c) (hne : ∀ i, κ i ≠ κ (i + 1))
    (H : ZMod n) (hglobal : ∀ i, i ≠ H → κ i < κ H) :
    ∃ q : ZMod n, ∃ a b : ℕ, HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q ∧
      2 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ (H - q).val ∧ (H - q).val ≤ b ∧ b + 2 ≤ n ∧
      (∀ j < n, κ q < κ (q + (j : ZMod n)) ↔ a ≤ j ∧ j ≤ b) ∧
      StrictMonoOn (fun j : ℕ => κ (q + (j : ZMod n))) (Icc a (H - q).val) ∧
      StrictAntiOn (fun j : ℕ => κ (q + (j : ZMod n))) (Icc (H - q).val b) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_highestSecondaryPeak hdfv hne H
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hq.exists_mountain hne (hglobal q hq.ne_global)
  exact ⟨q, a, b, hq, hab⟩

entries.label: lem:mt_normalized_entry
entries.title: the normalized low entry
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
If $H\ne0$ in $\ZMod n$ then the cast of the natural number
  $\operatorname{val}(H)-1$ is $H-1$.  Now let $\mu$ be adjacent-unequal,
  let $0$ be a highest secondary peak for $H$, and let $\mu_0=1<\mu_H$.
  Put $h=\operatorname{val}(H)$ and take $a,b$ from \cref{thm:mt_mountain}.
  Then
  \[
    \mu_1<1,\quad \mu_{-1}=\mu_{n-1}<1,\quad
    \mu_{a-1}\le1<\mu_a,\quad 2\le a\le h,\quad h+2\le n,
  \]
  $j\mapsto\mu_j$ is strictly increasing on $[a,h]$, and the forward
  terminal flag $\Phi(\mu_1,\mu_{H-1},\mu_H,\mu_{-1})$ is the flag
  $\Phi(\mu_1,\mu_{h-1},\mu_h,\mu_{n-1})$ at the natural indices.  If this
  flag is nonnegative, then $a<h$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.natPred_val_residue
lean.code:
theorem natPred_val_residue [NeZero n] {j : ZMod n} (hj : j ≠ 0) :
    ((j.val - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = j - 1 := by
  have hv : 1 ≤ j.val := by
    have : j.val ≠ 0 := (ZMod.val_eq_zero j).not.mpr hj
    omega
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hv, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val, Nat.cast_one]

entries.label: lem:mt_scale_identity
entries.title: exact scaling identities
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
For every frame $F$, word $\kappa$, $s\in\RR$ and $L\in\RR^4$,
  \[
    F.\mathrm{turns}(\kappa,sL)=F.\mathrm{turns}(s\kappa,L),\qquad
    C_F^{\kappa}(sL)=\bigl(s\,Z_F^{s\kappa}(L),\ \tau_F^{s\kappa}(L)\bigr).
  \]
  Hence for $s\ne0$ and all $L$,
  $C_F^{s\kappa}(L)=\bigl(s^{-1}Z_F^{\kappa}(sL),\ \tau_F^{\kappa}(sL)\bigr)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.turns_scale_input
lean.code:
theorem turns_scale_input (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    F.turns κ (s • L) = F.turns (fun i => s * κ i) L := by
  funext j
  fin_cases j <;>
    simp [turns, startArc, finishArc, start, finish, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.controller_scale
lean.code:
theorem controller_scale (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ 0) (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    F.controller (fun i => s * κ i) L =
      (((s : ℂ)⁻¹) * (F.controller κ (s • L)).1, (F.controller κ (s • L)).2) := by
  rw [F.controller_scale_input]
  simp [hs]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.controller_scale_input
lean.code:
theorem controller_scale_input (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    F.controller κ (s • L) =
      ((s : ℂ) * (F.controller (fun i => s * κ i) L).1,
        (F.controller (fun i => s * κ i) L).2) := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp only [controller, turns_scale_input, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Complex.ofReal_mul]
    ring
  · simp only [controller, turns_scale_input]

entries.label: lem:mt_scale_deriv
entries.title: derivative under scaling
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
Let $s\ne0$ and let $C_F^\kappa$ be differentiable at $L$.  Then for all
  $v\in\RR^4$
  \[
    DC_F^{s\kappa}(s^{-1}L)\,v=
      \bigl(s^{-1}\,DZ_F^{\kappa}(L)(sv),\ D\tau_F^{\kappa}(L)(sv)\bigr).
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.fderiv_controller_scale
lean.code:
theorem fderiv_controller_scale {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {s : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ 0)
    {L : Fin 4 → ℝ} (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (F.controller κ) L) (v : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (F.controller (fun i => s * κ i)) (s⁻¹ • L) v =
      (((s : ℂ)⁻¹) * (fderiv ℝ (F.controller κ) L (s • v)).1,
        (fderiv ℝ (F.controller κ) L (s • v)).2) := by
  let S : (Fin 4 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 4 → ℝ) := s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Fin 4 → ℝ)
  have hSL : S (s⁻¹ • L) = L := by simp [S, hs]
  have hd' : HasFDerivAt (F.controller κ) (fderiv ℝ (F.controller κ) L)
      (S (s⁻¹ • L)) := by simpa only [hSL] using hd.hasFDerivAt
  have hf := hd'.comp (s⁻¹ • L) S.hasFDerivAt
  have hprod := (hf.fst.const_mul ((s : ℂ)⁻¹)).prodMk hf.snd
  have hfun : (fun X : Fin 4 → ℝ =>
      (((s : ℂ)⁻¹) * (F.controller κ (S X)).1, (F.controller κ (S X)).2)) =
      F.controller (fun i => s * κ i) := by
    funext X
    simpa [S] using (F.controller_scale κ hs X).symm
  change HasFDerivAt (fun X : Fin 4 → ℝ =>
      (((s : ℂ)⁻¹) * (F.controller κ (S X)).1, (F.controller κ (S X)).2)) _ _ at hprod
  rw [hfun] at hprod
  rw [hprod.fderiv]
  simp [S, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, smul_eq_mul]

end FourActiveSlots.Frame

namespace RegularFourAnchor

variable {n : ℕ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}

entries.label: lem:mt_anchor_differentiable
entries.title: surjectivity forces differentiability
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
For every regular four-edge anchor $(F,L)$ of $\kappa$, the controller
  $C_F^\kappa$ is differentiable at $L$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.differentiableAt_controller
lean.code:
theorem differentiableAt_controller (A : RegularFourAnchor κ) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (A.frame.controller κ) A.halfLengths := by
  by_contra h
  have hs := A.regular
  rw [fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt h] at hs
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hs (0, 1)
  have := congrArg Prod.snd hv
  norm_num at this

entries.label: lem:mt_anchor_scale
entries.title: positive rescaling of an anchor
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
If $(F,L)$ is a regular anchor of $\kappa$ and $s>0$, then $(F,s^{-1}L)$ is
  a regular anchor of $s\kappa$.  The four actual edges are unchanged.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.scale
lean.code:
noncomputable def scale (A : RegularFourAnchor κ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    RegularFourAnchor (fun i => s * κ i) where
  frame := A.frame
  halfLengths := s⁻¹ • A.halfLengths
  positive j := mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hs) (A.positive j)
  start_lt := by
    intro j
    have hproduct : A.frame.start (fun i => s * κ i) j * (s⁻¹ • A.halfLengths) j =
        A.frame.start κ j * A.halfLengths j := by
      simp [Frame.start, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hs.ne', mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]
    rw [hproduct]
    exact A.start_lt j
  finish_lt := by
    intro j
    have hproduct : A.frame.finish (fun i => s * κ i) j * (s⁻¹ • A.halfLengths) j =
        A.frame.finish κ j * A.halfLengths j := by
      simp [Frame.finish, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hs.ne', mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]
    rw [hproduct]
    exact A.finish_lt j
  zero := by
    rw [A.frame.controller_scale κ hs.ne']
    simp [hs.ne', A.zero]
  regular := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := A.regular ((s : ℂ) * y.1, y.2)
    refine ⟨s⁻¹ • v, ?_⟩
    rw [A.frame.fderiv_controller_scale hs.ne' A.differentiableAt_controller]
    simp [hs.ne', hv]

entries.label: def:mt_slot_perm
entries.title: slot rotation, reversal and the slot controller
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
For $v\in\alpha^4$ put
  \[
    \operatorname{rot}v=(v_1,v_2,v_3,v_0),\qquad
    \operatorname{rev}v=(v_3,v_2,v_1,v_0).
  \]
  On $\RR^4$ both are continuous linear maps (coordinate permutations).  For
  $L,\theta\in\RR^4$ the \emph{slot controller} is
  \[
    \mathcal S(L,\theta)=\Bigl(L_0+L_1u(\theta_1)+L_2u(\theta_1+\theta_2)
      +L_3u(\theta_1+\theta_2+\theta_3),\
      \theta_0+\theta_1+\theta_2+\theta_3-2\pi\Bigr),
  \]
  so that $C_F^\kappa(L)=\mathcal S(L,F.\mathrm{turns}(\kappa,L))$ by
  definition.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.rotateFourCLM
lean.code:
noncomputable def rotateFourCLM : (Fin 4 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 4 → ℝ) :=
  ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun j =>
    ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 4 => ℝ)
      (![1, 2, 3, 0] j)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.reverseFour
lean.code: def reverseFour {α : Type*} (v : Fin 4 → α) : Fin 4 → α := ![v 3, v 2, v 1, v 0]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.rotateFourCLM_apply
lean.code:
@[simp] theorem rotateFourCLM_apply (v : Fin 4 → ℝ) : rotateFourCLM v = rotateFour v := by
  ext j
  fin_cases j <;> rfl

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.reverseFourCLM
lean.code:
noncomputable def reverseFourCLM : (Fin 4 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 4 → ℝ) :=
  ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun j =>
    ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 4 => ℝ)
      (![3, 2, 1, 0] j)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.reverseFourCLM_apply
lean.code:
@[simp] theorem reverseFourCLM_apply (v : Fin 4 → ℝ) : reverseFourCLM v = reverseFour v := by
  ext j
  fin_cases j <;> rfl

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.slotController
lean.code:
noncomputable def slotController (L θ : Fin 4 → ℝ) : ℂ × ℝ :=
  ((L 0 : ℂ) + (L 1 : ℂ) * unitPhase (θ 1) +
    (L 2 : ℂ) * unitPhase (θ 1 + θ 2) +
    (L 3 : ℂ) * unitPhase (θ 1 + θ 2 + θ 3),
    θ 0 + θ 1 + θ 2 + θ 3 - 2 * Real.pi)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.rotateFour
lean.code: def rotateFour {α : Type*} (v : Fin 4 → α) : Fin 4 → α := ![v 1, v 2, v 3, v 0]

entries.label: lem:mt_slot_identities
entries.title: exact slot identities
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
For all $L,\theta\in\RR^4$, writing $\mathcal S(L,\theta)=(Z,\tau)$,
  \[
    \mathcal S(\operatorname{rot}L,\operatorname{rot}\theta)
      =\Bigl(u(-\theta_1)\bigl[Z+L_0\,(u(\tau)-1)\bigr],\ \tau\Bigr),
  \]
  \[
    \mathcal S\bigl(\operatorname{rev}L,(\theta_0,\theta_3,\theta_2,\theta_1)\bigr)
      =\Bigl(u(\theta_1+\theta_2+\theta_3)\,\overline{Z},\ \tau\Bigr).
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.slotController_reverse
lean.code:
theorem slotController_reverse (L θ : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    slotController (reverseFour L) ![θ 0, θ 3, θ 2, θ 1] =
      (unitPhase (θ 1 + θ 2 + θ 3) * starRingEnd ℂ (slotController L θ).1,
        (slotController L θ).2) := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · have h1 : unitPhase (θ 1 + θ 2 + θ 3) * unitPhase (-(θ 1)) =
        unitPhase (θ 3 + θ 2) := by
      rw [← unitPhase_add]; congr 1; ring
    have h2 : unitPhase (θ 1 + θ 2 + θ 3) * unitPhase (-(θ 1 + θ 2)) =
        unitPhase (θ 3) := by
      rw [← unitPhase_add]; congr 1; ring
    have h3 : unitPhase (θ 1 + θ 2 + θ 3) * unitPhase (-(θ 1 + θ 2 + θ 3)) = 1 := by
      rw [← unitPhase_add]; simp [unitPhase]
    simp only [slotController, reverseFour, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.cons_val, Fin.isValue, map_add, map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal, conjugate_phase]
    rw [show θ 3 + θ 2 + θ 1 = θ 1 + θ 2 + θ 3 by ring]
    linear_combination -(L 1 : ℂ) * h1 - (L 2 : ℂ) * h2 - (L 3 : ℂ) * h3
  · simp only [slotController, reverseFour, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.cons_val, Fin.isValue]
    ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.slotController_rotate
lean.code:
theorem slotController_rotate (L θ : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    slotController (rotateFour L) (rotateFour θ) =
      (unitPhase (-(θ 1)) * ((slotController L θ).1 +
          (L 0 : ℂ) * (unitPhase ((slotController L θ).2) - 1)),
        (slotController L θ).2) := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · have hmul : unitPhase (θ 1) * (slotController (rotateFour L) (rotateFour θ)).1 =
        (slotController L θ).1 +
          (L 0 : ℂ) * (unitPhase ((slotController L θ).2) - 1) := by
      simp only [slotController, rotateFour, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.cons_val, Fin.isValue, unitPhase_sub_period, unitPhase_add]
      ring
    have hh := congrArg (fun z : ℂ => unitPhase (-(θ 1)) * z) hmul
    simpa only [← mul_assoc, unitPhase_neg_cancel, one_mul] using hh
  · simp only [slotController, rotateFour, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.cons_val, Fin.isValue]
    ring

entries.label: lem:mt_frame_identities
entries.title: frame versions with literal endpoints
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
Let $F$ be a frame of size $m$ for $\mu$ and $G$ a frame of size $n$ for
  $\kappa$, and write $\theta=F.\mathrm{turns}(\mu,L)$ and
  $C_F^\mu(L)=(Z,\tau)$.
  \begin{enumerate}
    \item If $\operatorname{start}^G_\kappa=\operatorname{rot}(\operatorname{start}^F_\mu)$
      and $\operatorname{finish}^G_\kappa=\operatorname{rot}(\operatorname{finish}^F_\mu)$,
      then $G.\mathrm{turns}(\kappa,\operatorname{rot}L)=\operatorname{rot}\theta$ and
      \[
        C_G^\kappa(\operatorname{rot}L)
          =\bigl(u(-\theta_1)[Z+L_0(u(\tau)-1)],\ \tau\bigr).
      \]
    \item If $\operatorname{start}^G_\kappa=\operatorname{rev}(\operatorname{finish}^F_\mu)$
      and $\operatorname{finish}^G_\kappa=\operatorname{rev}(\operatorname{start}^F_\mu)$
      (reversed and swapped), then
      $G.\mathrm{turns}(\kappa,\operatorname{rev}L)=(\theta_0,\theta_3,\theta_2,\theta_1)$ and
      \[
        C_G^\kappa(\operatorname{rev}L)
          =\bigl(u(\theta_1+\theta_2+\theta_3)\,\overline{Z},\ \tau\bigr).
      \]
  \end{enumerate}
  Both hold for all $L\in\RR^4$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.controller_reverse_of_endpoints
lean.code:
theorem controller_reverse_of_endpoints {m n : ℕ} {μ : ZMod m → ℝ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {F : Frame m} {G : Frame n}
    (hstart : G.start κ = reverseFour (F.finish μ))
    (hfinish : G.finish κ = reverseFour (F.start μ)) (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    G.controller κ (reverseFour L) =
      (unitPhase ((F.turns μ L) 1 + (F.turns μ L) 2 + (F.turns μ L) 3) *
          starRingEnd ℂ (F.controller μ L).1, (F.controller μ L).2) := by
  change slotController (reverseFour L) (G.turns κ (reverseFour L)) = _
  rw [turns_reverse_of_endpoints hstart hfinish]
  exact slotController_reverse L (F.turns μ L)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.turns_reverse_of_endpoints
lean.code:
theorem turns_reverse_of_endpoints {m n : ℕ} {μ : ZMod m → ℝ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {F : Frame m} {G : Frame n}
    (hstart : G.start κ = reverseFour (F.finish μ))
    (hfinish : G.finish κ = reverseFour (F.start μ)) (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    G.turns κ (reverseFour L) =
      ![(F.turns μ L) 0, (F.turns μ L) 3, (F.turns μ L) 2, (F.turns μ L) 1] := by
  funext j
  fin_cases j <;> simp [turns, startArc, finishArc, hstart, hfinish, reverseFour, add_comm]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.turns_rotate_of_endpoints
lean.code:
theorem turns_rotate_of_endpoints {m n : ℕ} {μ : ZMod m → ℝ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {F : Frame m} {G : Frame n}
    (hstart : G.start κ = rotateFour (F.start μ))
    (hfinish : G.finish κ = rotateFour (F.finish μ)) (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    G.turns κ (rotateFour L) = rotateFour (F.turns μ L) := by
  funext j
  fin_cases j <;> simp [turns, startArc, finishArc, hstart, hfinish, rotateFour]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.controller_rotate_of_endpoints
lean.code:
theorem controller_rotate_of_endpoints {m n : ℕ} {μ : ZMod m → ℝ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {F : Frame m} {G : Frame n}
    (hstart : G.start κ = rotateFour (F.start μ))
    (hfinish : G.finish κ = rotateFour (F.finish μ)) (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    G.controller κ (rotateFour L) =
      (unitPhase (-((F.turns μ L) 1)) * ((F.controller μ L).1 +
          (L 0 : ℂ) * (unitPhase ((F.controller μ L).2) - 1)),
        (F.controller μ L).2) := by
  change slotController (rotateFour L) (G.turns κ (rotateFour L)) = _
  rw [turns_rotate_of_endpoints hstart hfinish]
  exact slotController_rotate L (F.turns μ L)

entries.label: lem:mt_turn_differentiable
entries.title: differentiability of turns and controller
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
Let $L_j>0$, $s_j,t_j>0$, and $s_jL_j<1$, $t_jL_j<1$ for all $j$.  Then each
  turn $X\mapsto F.\mathrm{turns}(\kappa,X)_j$ and the controller $C_F^\kappa$
  are differentiable at $L$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.differentiableAt_turns_of_strict
lean.code:
theorem differentiableAt_turns_of_strict {n : ℕ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (F : Frame n) {L : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ j, 0 < L j)
    (hspos : ∀ j, 0 < F.start κ j) (hfpos : ∀ j, 0 < F.finish κ j)
    (hs : ∀ j, F.start κ j * L j < 1) (hf : ∀ j, F.finish κ j * L j < 1) :
    ∀ j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun X => F.turns κ X j) L := by
  have hsa (j) : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun X => F.startArc κ X j) L := by
    apply (Real.differentiableAt_arcsin.mpr ?_).comp L
      (show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun X : Fin 4 → ℝ => F.start κ j * X j) L by fun_prop)
    exact ⟨by linarith [mul_pos (hspos j) (hL j)], ne_of_lt (hs j)⟩
  have hfa (j) : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun X => F.finishArc κ X j) L := by
    apply (Real.differentiableAt_arcsin.mpr ?_).comp L
      (show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun X : Fin 4 → ℝ => F.finish κ j * X j) L by fun_prop)
    exact ⟨by linarith [mul_pos (hfpos j) (hL j)], ne_of_lt (hf j)⟩
  intro j
  fin_cases j
  · exact (hfa 3).add (hsa 0)
  · exact (hfa 0).add (hsa 1)
  · exact (hfa 1).add (hsa 2)
  · exact (hfa 2).add (hsa 3)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.differentiableAt_controller_of_strict
lean.code:
theorem differentiableAt_controller_of_strict {n : ℕ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (F : Frame n) {L : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ j, 0 < L j)
    (hspos : ∀ j, 0 < F.start κ j) (hfpos : ∀ j, 0 < F.finish κ j)
    (hs : ∀ j, F.start κ j * L j < 1) (hf : ∀ j, F.finish κ j * L j < 1) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (F.controller κ) L := by
  have hd := F.differentiableAt_turns_of_strict hL hspos hfpos hs hf
  unfold controller unitPhase
  fun_prop

entries.label: thm:mt_deriv_transport
entries.title: derivatives of the permuted controllers at a zero
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
In the situation of \cref{lem:mt_frame_identities}, assume $C_F^\mu(L)=0$,
  that $C_F^\mu$ is differentiable at $L$, that $C_G^\kappa$ is
  differentiable at the permuted lengths, and that the turns
  $\theta_1$ (for rotation), respectively $\theta_1,\theta_2,\theta_3$ (for
  reversal), are differentiable at $L$.  Let $v\in\RR^4$ and
  $DC_F^\mu(L)v=(z,t)$.  Then
  \[
    DC_G^\kappa(\operatorname{rot}L)(\operatorname{rot}v)
      =\bigl(u(-\theta_1)\,(z+i\,L_0\,t),\ t\bigr)
  \]
  in case (1), and in case (2)
  \[
    DC_G^\kappa(\operatorname{rev}L)(\operatorname{rev}v)
      =\bigl(u(\theta_1+\theta_2+\theta_3)\,\overline{z},\ t\bigr).
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.fderiv_controller_reverse_of_endpoints
lean.code:
theorem fderiv_controller_reverse_of_endpoints
    {m n : ℕ} {μ : ZMod m → ℝ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {F : Frame m} {G : Frame n} {L : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (hstart : G.start κ = reverseFour (F.finish μ))
    (hfinish : G.finish κ = reverseFour (F.start μ))
    (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (F.controller μ) L)
    (ht : ∀ j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun X => F.turns μ X j) L)
    (hdG : DifferentiableAt ℝ (G.controller κ) (reverseFour L))
    (hz : F.controller μ L = 0) (v : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (G.controller κ) (reverseFour L) (reverseFour v) =
      (unitPhase (F.turns μ L 1 + F.turns μ L 2 + F.turns μ L 3) *
        starRingEnd ℂ ((fderiv ℝ (F.controller μ) L v).1),
        (fderiv ℝ (F.controller μ) L v).2) := by
  have hp := phase_hasFDerivAt (((ht 1).hasFDerivAt.add (ht 2).hasFDerivAt).add
    (ht 3).hasFDerivAt)
  have hconj := Complex.conjCLE.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp L hd.hasFDerivAt.fst
  have he := (hp.mul hconj).prodMk hd.hasFDerivAt.snd
  have hfun : (fun X =>
      (unitPhase (F.turns μ X 1 + F.turns μ X 2 + F.turns μ X 3) *
        starRingEnd ℂ (F.controller μ X).1, (F.controller μ X).2)) =
      fun X => G.controller κ (reverseFour X) := by
    funext X
    exact (controller_reverse_of_endpoints hstart hfinish X).symm
  change HasFDerivAt (fun X =>
      (unitPhase (F.turns μ X 1 + F.turns μ X 2 + F.turns μ X 3) *
        starRingEnd ℂ (F.controller μ X).1, (F.controller μ X).2)) _ L at he
  rw [hfun] at he
  have hrev : HasFDerivAt reverseFour reverseFourCLM L := by
    have hrfun : (reverseFourCLM : (Fin 4 → ℝ) → (Fin 4 → ℝ)) = reverseFour :=
      funext reverseFourCLM_apply
    rw [← hrfun]
    exact reverseFourCLM.hasFDerivAt
  have hc := hdG.hasFDerivAt.comp L hrev
  have hdEq := he.unique hc
  have hh := congrArg (fun D : (Fin 4 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℂ × ℝ) => D v) hdEq
  symm at hh
  simpa [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hz, mul_assoc] using hh

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.fderiv_controller_rotate_of_endpoints
lean.code:
theorem fderiv_controller_rotate_of_endpoints
    {m n : ℕ} {μ : ZMod m → ℝ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    {F : Frame m} {G : Frame n} {L : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (hstart : G.start κ = rotateFour (F.start μ))
    (hfinish : G.finish κ = rotateFour (F.finish μ))
    (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (F.controller μ) L)
    (ht : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun X => F.turns μ X 1) L)
    (hdG : DifferentiableAt ℝ (G.controller κ) (rotateFour L))
    (hz : F.controller μ L = 0) (v : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (G.controller κ) (rotateFour L) (rotateFour v) =
      (unitPhase (-(F.turns μ L 1)) *
        ((fderiv ℝ (F.controller μ) L v).1 +
          (L 0 : ℂ) * Complex.I * ((fderiv ℝ (F.controller μ) L v).2 : ℂ)),
        (fderiv ℝ (F.controller μ) L v).2) := by
  have hp := phase_hasFDerivAt ht.hasFDerivAt.neg
  have hτ := phase_hasFDerivAt hd.hasFDerivAt.snd
  have hL0 := Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp L
    (hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (F' := fun _ : Fin 4 => ℝ) 0 L)
  have he := (hp.mul (hd.hasFDerivAt.fst.add (hL0.mul (hτ.sub_const 1)))).prodMk
    hd.hasFDerivAt.snd
  have hfun : (fun X =>
      (unitPhase (-(F.turns μ X 1)) * ((F.controller μ X).1 +
        (X 0 : ℂ) * (unitPhase ((F.controller μ X).2) - 1)),
        (F.controller μ X).2)) = fun X => G.controller κ (rotateFour X) := by
    funext X
    exact (controller_rotate_of_endpoints hstart hfinish X).symm
  change HasFDerivAt (fun X =>
      (unitPhase (-(F.turns μ X 1)) * ((F.controller μ X).1 +
        (X 0 : ℂ) * (unitPhase ((F.controller μ X).2) - 1)),
        (F.controller μ X).2)) _ L at he
  rw [hfun] at he
  have hrot : HasFDerivAt rotateFour rotateFourCLM L := by
    have hrfun : (rotateFourCLM : (Fin 4 → ℝ) → (Fin 4 → ℝ)) = rotateFour :=
      funext rotateFourCLM_apply
    rw [← hrfun]
    exact rotateFourCLM.hasFDerivAt
  have hc := hdG.hasFDerivAt.comp L hrot
  have hdEq := he.unique hc
  have hh := congrArg (fun D : (Fin 4 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℂ × ℝ) => D v) hdEq
  symm at hh
  simpa [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hz, unitPhase, mul_assoc, mul_add] using hh

deps.label: def:mt_slot_perm

entries.label: thm:mt_reembed
entries.title: reembedding under rotated or reflected endpoints
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
Let $(F,L)$ be a regular anchor of a positive word $\mu$ and let $G$ be a
  frame of size $n$ for $\kappa$.
  \begin{enumerate}
    \item If $G$ has rotated endpoints as in \cref{lem:mt_frame_identities}(1),
      then $(G,\operatorname{rot}L)$ is a regular anchor of $\kappa$.
    \item If $G$ has reversed and swapped endpoints as in
      \cref{lem:mt_frame_identities}(2), then $(G,\operatorname{rev}L)$ is a
      regular anchor of $\kappa$.
  \end{enumerate}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.reverseReembed
lean.code:
noncomputable def reverseReembed {m n : ℕ} {μ : ZMod m → ℝ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (A : RegularFourAnchor μ) (hμ : ∀ i, 0 < μ i) (G : Frame n)
    (hstart : G.start κ = reverseFour (A.frame.finish μ))
    (hfinish : G.finish κ = reverseFour (A.frame.start μ)) :
    RegularFourAnchor κ := by
  have hL : ∀ j, 0 < reverseFour A.halfLengths j := by
    intro j
    fin_cases j <;> exact A.positive _
  have hs : ∀ j, G.start κ j * reverseFour A.halfLengths j < 1 := by
    intro j
    rw [hstart]
    fin_cases j <;> exact A.finish_lt _
  have hf : ∀ j, G.finish κ j * reverseFour A.halfLengths j < 1 := by
    intro j
    rw [hfinish]
    fin_cases j <;> exact A.start_lt _
  have hspos : ∀ j, 0 < G.start κ j := by
    intro j
    rw [hstart]
    fin_cases j <;> exact hμ _
  have hfpos : ∀ j, 0 < G.finish κ j := by
    intro j
    rw [hfinish]
    fin_cases j <;> exact hμ _
  have hdG := G.differentiableAt_controller_of_strict hL hspos hfpos hs hf
  have ht := A.frame.differentiableAt_turns_of_strict A.positive
    (fun j => hμ _) (fun j => hμ _) A.start_lt A.finish_lt
  refine ⟨G, reverseFour A.halfLengths, hL, hs, hf, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Frame.controller_reverse_of_endpoints hstart hfinish, A.zero]
    simp
  · intro y
    let θ := A.frame.turns μ A.halfLengths 1 + A.frame.turns μ A.halfLengths 2 +
      A.frame.turns μ A.halfLengths 3
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := A.regular (starRingEnd ℂ (unitPhase (-θ) * y.1), y.2)
    refine ⟨reverseFour v, ?_⟩
    rw [Frame.fderiv_controller_reverse_of_endpoints hstart hfinish
      A.differentiableAt_controller ht hdG A.zero, hv]
    have hc : unitPhase θ * unitPhase (-θ) = 1 := by
      rw [← unitPhase_add]
      simp [unitPhase]
    apply Prod.ext
    · change unitPhase θ * starRingEnd ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ (unitPhase (-θ) * y.1)) = y.1
      simp only [starRingEnd_apply, star_star]
      rw [← mul_assoc, hc, one_mul]
    · rfl

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.rotateReembed
lean.code:
noncomputable def rotateReembed {m n : ℕ} {μ : ZMod m → ℝ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (A : RegularFourAnchor μ) (hμ : ∀ i, 0 < μ i) (G : Frame n)
    (hstart : G.start κ = rotateFour (A.frame.start μ))
    (hfinish : G.finish κ = rotateFour (A.frame.finish μ)) :
    RegularFourAnchor κ := by
  have hL : ∀ j, 0 < rotateFour A.halfLengths j := by
    intro j
    fin_cases j <;> exact A.positive _
  have hs : ∀ j, G.start κ j * rotateFour A.halfLengths j < 1 := by
    intro j
    rw [hstart]
    fin_cases j <;> exact A.start_lt _
  have hf : ∀ j, G.finish κ j * rotateFour A.halfLengths j < 1 := by
    intro j
    rw [hfinish]
    fin_cases j <;> exact A.finish_lt _
  have hspos : ∀ j, 0 < G.start κ j := by
    intro j
    rw [hstart]
    fin_cases j <;> exact hμ _
  have hfpos : ∀ j, 0 < G.finish κ j := by
    intro j
    rw [hfinish]
    fin_cases j <;> exact hμ _
  have hdG := G.differentiableAt_controller_of_strict hL hspos hfpos hs hf
  have ht := A.frame.differentiableAt_turns_of_strict A.positive
    (fun j => hμ _) (fun j => hμ _) A.start_lt A.finish_lt
  refine ⟨G, rotateFour A.halfLengths, hL, hs, hf, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Frame.controller_rotate_of_endpoints hstart hfinish, A.zero]
    simp [unitPhase]
  · intro y
    let θ := A.frame.turns μ A.halfLengths 1
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := A.regular
      (unitPhase θ * y.1 - (A.halfLengths 0 : ℂ) * Complex.I * (y.2 : ℂ), y.2)
    refine ⟨rotateFour v, ?_⟩
    rw [Frame.fderiv_controller_rotate_of_endpoints hstart hfinish
      A.differentiableAt_controller (ht 1) hdG A.zero, hv]
    have hc : unitPhase (-θ) * unitPhase θ = 1 := by
      rw [← unitPhase_add]
      simp [unitPhase]
    apply Prod.ext
    · change unitPhase (-θ) *
        ((unitPhase θ * y.1 - (A.halfLengths 0 : ℂ) * Complex.I * (y.2 : ℂ)) +
          (A.halfLengths 0 : ℂ) * Complex.I * (y.2 : ℂ)) = y.1
      rw [sub_add_cancel, ← mul_assoc, hc, one_mul]
    · rfl

deps.label: thm:mt_deriv_transport

entries.label: lem:mt_frame_shift
entries.title: one-step shifts of a sorted frame
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
Let $F$ have edges $e_0<e_1<e_2<e_3<n$ and residues $r_j$, and let
  $\kappa'(i)=\kappa(i+1)$ be the shifted word.
  \begin{enumerate}
    \item If $e_0>0$, then $(e_0-1,e_1-1,e_2-1,e_3-1)$ is a frame with
      residues $r_j-1$, and its start and finish vectors for $\kappa'$ equal
      those of $F$ for $\kappa$.
    \item If $e_0=0$, then $(e_1-1,e_2-1,e_3-1,n-1)$ is a frame with residues
      $\operatorname{rot}(r)_j-1$, and its start and finish vectors for
      $\kappa'$ are $\operatorname{rot}(\operatorname{start}^F_\kappa)$ and
      $\operatorname{rot}(\operatorname{finish}^F_\kappa)$.
  \end{enumerate}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.shiftOneOfZero_finish
lean.code:
theorem shiftOneOfZero_finish (h0 : F.edge 0 = 0) (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) :
    (F.shiftOneOfZero h0).finish (fun i => κ (i + 1)) = rotateFour (F.finish κ) := by
  funext j
  simp only [finish, F.shiftOneOfZero_residue h0, sub_add_cancel]
  fin_cases j <;> rfl

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.edge_pos_of_zero_pos
lean.code:
lemma edge_pos_of_zero_pos (h0 : 0 < F.edge 0) (j : Fin 4) : 0 < F.edge j :=
  lt_of_lt_of_le h0 (F.edge_zero_le j)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.shiftOneOfZero
lean.code:
def shiftOneOfZero (h0 : F.edge 0 = 0) : Frame n where
  edge := ![F.edge 1 - 1, F.edge 2 - 1, F.edge 3 - 1, n - 1]
  strictMono := by
    have h01 := F.strictMono (show (0 : Fin 4) < 1 by decide)
    have h12 := F.strictMono (show (1 : Fin 4) < 2 by decide)
    have h23 := F.strictMono (show (2 : Fin 4) < 3 by decide)
    have h3 := F.lt_n 3
    apply Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.mpr
    intro j
    fin_cases j <;> simp <;> omega
  lt_n := by
    intro j
    have hn : 0 < n := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) (F.lt_n 0)
    fin_cases j
    · change F.edge 1 - 1 < n
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) (F.lt_n 1)
    · change F.edge 2 - 1 < n
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) (F.lt_n 2)
    · change F.edge 3 - 1 < n
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) (F.lt_n 3)
    · change n - 1 < n
      omega

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.edge_zero_le
lean.code:
lemma edge_zero_le (j : Fin 4) : F.edge 0 ≤ F.edge j :=
  F.strictMono.monotone (Fin.zero_le j)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.shiftOneOfPos_start
lean.code:
theorem shiftOneOfPos_start (h0 : 0 < F.edge 0) (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) :
    (F.shiftOneOfPos h0).start (fun i => κ (i + 1)) = F.start κ := by
  funext j
  simp [start]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.shiftOneOfZero_residue
lean.code:
theorem shiftOneOfZero_residue (h0 : F.edge 0 = 0) :
    (F.shiftOneOfZero h0).residue = fun j => rotateFour F.residue j - 1 := by
  have h01 := F.strictMono (show (0 : Fin 4) < 1 by decide)
  have h02 := F.strictMono (show (0 : Fin 4) < 2 by decide)
  have h03 := F.strictMono (show (0 : Fin 4) < 3 by decide)
  have h1 : 1 ≤ F.edge 1 := by omega
  have h2 : 1 ≤ F.edge 2 := by omega
  have h3 : 1 ≤ F.edge 3 := by omega
  have hn : 1 ≤ n := by have := F.lt_n 0; omega
  funext j
  fin_cases j <;>
    simp [residue, shiftOneOfZero, rotateFour, h0, Nat.cast_sub h1,
      Nat.cast_sub h2, Nat.cast_sub h3, Nat.cast_sub hn]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.shiftOneOfZero_start
lean.code:
theorem shiftOneOfZero_start (h0 : F.edge 0 = 0) (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) :
    (F.shiftOneOfZero h0).start (fun i => κ (i + 1)) = rotateFour (F.start κ) := by
  funext j
  simp only [start, F.shiftOneOfZero_residue h0, sub_add_cancel]
  fin_cases j <;> rfl

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.shiftOneOfPos_finish
lean.code:
theorem shiftOneOfPos_finish (h0 : 0 < F.edge 0) (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) :
    (F.shiftOneOfPos h0).finish (fun i => κ (i + 1)) = F.finish κ := by
  funext j
  simp [finish]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.shiftOneOfPos_residue
lean.code:
@[simp] theorem shiftOneOfPos_residue (h0 : 0 < F.edge 0) (j : Fin 4) :
    (F.shiftOneOfPos h0).residue j = F.residue j - 1 := by
  have hj : 1 ≤ F.edge j := F.edge_pos_of_zero_pos h0 j
  simp [residue, shiftOneOfPos, Nat.cast_sub hj]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.shiftOneOfPos
lean.code:
def shiftOneOfPos (h0 : 0 < F.edge 0) : Frame n where
  edge j := F.edge j - 1
  strictMono := by
    intro i j hij
    have hi := F.edge_pos_of_zero_pos h0 i
    have hj := F.strictMono hij
    change F.edge i - 1 < F.edge j - 1
    omega
  lt_n j := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) (F.lt_n j)

deps.label: def:mt_slot_perm

entries.label: lem:mt_frame_reverse
entries.title: reflection of a sorted frame
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
For a frame $F$, the list $(n-1-e_3,\,n-1-e_2,\,n-1-e_1,\,n-1-e_0)$ is a
  frame, with residues $-1-\operatorname{rev}(r)_j$.  For the reflected word
  $\kappa^-(i)=\kappa(-i)$ its start vector is
  $\operatorname{rev}(\operatorname{finish}^F_\kappa)$ and its finish vector
  is $\operatorname{rev}(\operatorname{start}^F_\kappa)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.reverse_start
lean.code:
theorem reverse_start (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) :
    F.reverse.start (fun i => κ (-i)) = reverseFour (F.finish κ) := by
  funext j
  simp only [start, F.reverse_residue]
  fin_cases j <;> simp [reverseFour, finish, neg_sub]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.reverse_finish
lean.code:
theorem reverse_finish (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) :
    F.reverse.finish (fun i => κ (-i)) = reverseFour (F.start κ) := by
  funext j
  simp only [finish, F.reverse_residue]
  fin_cases j <;> simp [reverseFour, start]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.reverse_residue
lean.code:
theorem reverse_residue :
    F.reverse.residue = fun j => -1 - reverseFour F.residue j := by
  have hn : 1 ≤ n := by have := F.lt_n 0; omega
  have hj (j : Fin 4) : F.edge j ≤ n - 1 := by have := F.lt_n j; omega
  funext j
  fin_cases j <;>
    simp [residue, reverse, reverseFour, Nat.cast_sub (hj _),
      Nat.cast_sub hn]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.reverse
lean.code:
def reverse : Frame n where
  edge j := n - 1 - reverseFour F.edge j
  strictMono := by
    have h01 := F.strictMono (show (0 : Fin 4) < 1 by decide)
    have h12 := F.strictMono (show (1 : Fin 4) < 2 by decide)
    have h23 := F.strictMono (show (2 : Fin 4) < 3 by decide)
    have h3 := F.lt_n 3
    apply Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.mpr
    intro j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [reverseFour] <;> omega
  lt_n := by
    intro j
    have hn : 0 < n := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) (F.lt_n 0)
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) (by omega)

deps.title: slot rotation, reversal and the slot controller
deps.label: def:mt_slot_perm

entries.label: thm:mt_cyclic_anchor
entries.title: cyclic transport of anchors
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
Let $\kappa>0$.  A regular anchor of $\kappa$ gives a regular anchor of
  $i\mapsto\kappa(i+a)$ for every $a\in\ZMod n$, and conversely.  Thus
  $\kappa$ and each cyclic shift of $\kappa$ have regular anchors
  simultaneously.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.comp_add
lean.code:
noncomputable def comp_add (A : RegularFourAnchor κ) (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i)
    (a : ZMod n) : RegularFourAnchor (fun i => κ (i + a)) := by
  have hn : n ≠ 0 := by have := A.frame.lt_n 0; omega
  letI : NeZero n := ⟨hn⟩
  simpa only [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using A.comp_add_nat hκ a.val

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.nonempty_comp_add_iff
lean.code:
theorem nonempty_comp_add_iff (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) (a : ZMod n) :
    Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor (fun i => κ (i + a))) ↔ Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor κ) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨A⟩
    exact ⟨of_comp_add a hκ A⟩
  · rintro ⟨A⟩
    exact ⟨A.comp_add hκ a⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.comp_add_nat
lean.code:
noncomputable def comp_add_nat (A : RegularFourAnchor κ) (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i)
    (k : ℕ) : RegularFourAnchor (fun i => κ (i + (k : ZMod n))) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using A
  | succ k ih =>
      have B := ih.comp_add_one (fun i => hκ _)
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using B

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.comp_add_one
lean.code:
noncomputable def comp_add_one (A : RegularFourAnchor κ) (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) :
    RegularFourAnchor (fun i => κ (i + 1)) := by
  by_cases h0 : A.frame.edge 0 = 0
  · exact A.rotateReembed hκ (A.frame.shiftOneOfZero h0)
      (A.frame.shiftOneOfZero_start h0 κ) (A.frame.shiftOneOfZero_finish h0 κ)
  · have hp : 0 < A.frame.edge 0 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h0
    exact A.reembed (A.frame.shiftOneOfPos hp)
      (A.frame.shiftOneOfPos_start hp κ) (A.frame.shiftOneOfPos_finish hp κ)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.of_comp_add
lean.code:
noncomputable def of_comp_add (a : ZMod n) (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i)
    (A : RegularFourAnchor (fun i => κ (i + a))) : RegularFourAnchor κ := by
  have B := A.comp_add (fun i => hκ _) (-a)
  simpa only [neg_add_cancel_right] using B

entries.label: thm:mt_reflected_anchor
entries.title: reflected transport of anchors
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
Let $\kappa>0$.  Then $\kappa$ has a regular anchor if and only if
  $i\mapsto\kappa(-i)$ has one.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.nonempty_comp_neg_iff
lean.code:
theorem nonempty_comp_neg_iff (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) :
    Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor (fun i => κ (-i))) ↔ Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor κ) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨A⟩
    exact ⟨of_comp_neg hκ A⟩
  · rintro ⟨A⟩
    exact ⟨A.comp_neg hκ⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.comp_neg
lean.code:
noncomputable def comp_neg (A : RegularFourAnchor κ) (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) :
    RegularFourAnchor (fun i => κ (-i)) :=
  A.reverseReembed hκ A.frame.reverse (A.frame.reverse_start κ) (A.frame.reverse_finish κ)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.of_comp_neg
lean.code:
noncomputable def of_comp_neg (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i)
    (A : RegularFourAnchor (fun i => κ (-i))) : RegularFourAnchor κ := by
  have B := A.comp_neg (fun i => hκ _)
  simpa only [neg_neg] using B

entries.label: def:mt_normalized
entries.title: normalization at an index
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
For $\kappa\colon\ZMod n\to\RR$ and $q\in\ZMod n$ put
  $\operatorname{normalizedAt}(\kappa,q)_i=\kappa_{i+q}/\kappa_q$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.normalizedAt
lean.code:
noncomputable def normalizedAt (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (q : ZMod n) (i : ZMod n) : ℝ :=
  κ (i + q) / κ q

entries.label: lem:mt_peak_symmetry
entries.title: symmetries of the selected peak
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.comp_neg
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.comp_neg {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {H q : ZMod n}
    (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q) :
    HighestSecondaryPeak (fun i => κ (-i)) (-H) (-q) := by
  refine ⟨fun h => hq.ne_global (neg_injective h), ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · simpa [neg_sub, add_comm] using hq.is_peak.2
    · simpa [neg_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hq.is_peak.1
  · intro i hi hpeak
    have hi' : -i ≠ H := by intro e; apply hi; simpa using congrArg Neg.neg e
    have hpeak' : IsStrictLocalMax κ (-i) := by
      constructor
      · simpa [neg_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hpeak.2
      · simpa [neg_sub, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hpeak.1
    simpa using hq.maximal (-i) hi' hpeak'

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.div_pos
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.div_pos {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {H q : ZMod n}
    (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    HighestSecondaryPeak (fun i => κ i / s) H q := by
  refine ⟨hq.ne_global, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨div_lt_div_of_pos_right hq.is_peak.1 hs,
      div_lt_div_of_pos_right hq.is_peak.2 hs⟩
  · intro i hi hpeak
    have hpeak' : IsStrictLocalMax κ i :=
      ⟨(div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hs).mp hpeak.1,
        (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hs).mp hpeak.2⟩
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hq.maximal i hi hpeak') hs.le

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.comp_add
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.comp_add {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {H q : ZMod n}
    (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q) (a : ZMod n) :
    HighestSecondaryPeak (fun i => κ (i + a)) (H - a) (q - a) := by
  refine ⟨fun h => hq.ne_global (by simpa using congrArg (fun x => x + a) h), ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using hq.is_peak.1
    · simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using hq.is_peak.2
  · intro i hi hpeak
    have hi' : i + a ≠ H := by intro e; apply hi; exact eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr e
    have hpeak' : IsStrictLocalMax κ (i + a) := by
      constructor
      · simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using hpeak.1
      · simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using hpeak.2
    simpa using hq.maximal (i + a) hi' hpeak'

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.normalizedAt_pos
lean.code:
theorem normalizedAt_pos {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) (q : ZMod n) :
    ∀ i, 0 < normalizedAt κ q i := fun i => div_pos (hκ (i + q)) (hκ q)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.adjacent_ne_comp_neg
lean.code:
theorem adjacent_ne_comp_neg {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hne : ∀ i, κ i ≠ κ (i + 1)) :
    ∀ i, κ (-i) ≠ κ (-(i + 1)) := by
  intro i
  simpa [neg_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc]
    using (hne (-i - 1)).symm

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.normalizedAt
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.normalizedAt {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {H q : ZMod n}
    (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H q) (hpos : 0 < κ q) :
    HighestSecondaryPeak (normalizedAt κ q) (H - q) 0 := by
  change HighestSecondaryPeak (fun i => κ (i + q) / κ q) (H - q) 0
  simpa only [sub_self] using (hq.comp_add q).div_pos hpos

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.normalizedAt_adjacent_ne
lean.code:
theorem normalizedAt_adjacent_ne {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hne : ∀ i, κ i ≠ κ (i + 1)) {q : ZMod n} (hpos : 0 < κ q) :
    ∀ i, normalizedAt κ q i ≠ normalizedAt κ q (i + 1) := by
  intro i hh
  have heq := (div_left_inj' hpos.ne').mp hh
  apply hne (i + q)
  simpa [add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using heq

entries.label: thm:mt_restore_normalization
entries.title: restoring scale and origin
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
Let $\kappa>0$ and $q\in\ZMod n$.  If $\operatorname{normalizedAt}(\kappa,q)$
  has a regular anchor, so does $\kappa$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_normalizedAt
lean.code:
theorem nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_normalizedAt
    {n : ℕ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {q : ZMod n}
    (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i)
    (hA : Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor (normalizedAt κ q))) :
    Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor κ) := by
  obtain ⟨A⟩ := hA
  have B := A.scale (hκ q)
  have B' : RegularFourAnchor (fun i => κ (i + q)) := by
    convert B using 1
    funext i
    dsimp only [Gluck.Discrete.normalizedAt]
    field_simp [(hκ q).ne']
  exact ⟨RegularFourAnchor.of_comp_add q hκ B'⟩

entries.label: thm:mt_forward_terminal
entries.title: the forward terminal branch
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
Let $\mu>0$ be adjacent-unequal, $0$ a highest secondary peak for $H$,
  $\mu_0=1<\mu_H$, and
  $\Phi(\mu_1,\mu_{H-1},\mu_H,\mu_{-1})\ge0$ (equality included).  Then $\mu$
  has a regular anchor.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_forward_terminal
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_forward_terminal
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {H : ZMod n}
    (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H 0)
    (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) (hne : ∀ i, κ i ≠ κ (i + 1))
    (hzero : κ 0 = 1) (hH : 1 < κ H)
    (hflag : 0 ≤ firstPairFlag (κ 1) (κ (H - 1)) (κ H) (κ (-1))) :
    Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor κ) := by
  apply hq.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_rising_terminal hκ hne hzero hH
  simpa only [natPred_val_residue hq.ne_global.symm] using hflag

entries.label: thm:mt_backward_terminal
entries.title: the backward terminal branch
entries.chapter: The secondary mountain and the transport of regular anchors
entries.body:
Let $\mu>0$ be adjacent-unequal, $0$ a highest secondary peak for $H$,
  $\mu_0=1<\mu_H$, and $\Phi(\mu_{-1},\mu_{H+1},\mu_H,\mu_1)\ge0$.  Then $\mu$
  has a regular anchor.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HighestSecondaryPeak.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_backward_terminal
lean.code:
theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_backward_terminal
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {H : ZMod n}
    (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H 0)
    (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) (hne : ∀ i, κ i ≠ κ (i + 1))
    (hzero : κ 0 = 1) (hH : 1 < κ H)
    (hflag : 0 ≤ firstPairFlag (κ (-1)) (κ (H + 1)) (κ H) (κ 1)) :
    Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor κ) := by
  have hq' : HighestSecondaryPeak (fun i => κ (-i)) (-H) 0 := by
    simpa using hq.comp_neg
  apply (RegularFourAnchor.nonempty_comp_neg_iff hκ).mp
  apply hq'.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_forward_terminal (fun i => hκ (-i))
    (adjacent_ne_comp_neg hne) (by simpa using hzero) (by simpa using hH)
  simpa [neg_sub, add_comm] using hflag

entries.label: lem:discrete_parametric_correction
entries.title: Parametric constraint correction
entries.chapter: Local continuous choice of coherent realizations
entries.body:
Let $P,E,F$ be real Banach spaces, let $f\colon P\times E\to F$ be $C^1$
near $(p_0,x_0)$, and suppose $R\colon F\to E$ is a continuous linear
right inverse of $D_xf(p_0,x_0)$. There is a local $C^1$ correction
$Q(p,x)$ with $Q(p_0,x_0)=x_0$ such that
\[
 Q(p,x)-x\in\operatorname{range}R,\qquad
 f(p,Q(p,x))=f(p_0,x_0).
\]
The correction fixes nearby points already on this level.

lean.name: ContDiffAt.exists_parametricConstraintCorrection
lean.code:
theorem ContDiffAt.exists_parametricConstraintCorrection
    {n : ℕ∞ω} {f : P × E → F} {p₀ : P} {x₀ : E}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ n f (p₀, x₀)) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (R : F →L[ℝ] E)
    (hR : (fderiv ℝ f (p₀, x₀) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ P E) ∘L R =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F) :
    ∃ Q : P × E → E,
      ContDiffAt ℝ n Q (p₀, x₀) ∧ Q (p₀, x₀) = x₀ ∧
      (∀ q, Q q - q.2 ∈ R.range) ∧
      (∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (p₀, x₀), f (q.1, Q q) = f (p₀, x₀)) ∧
      (∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (p₀, x₀), f q = f (p₀, x₀) → Q q = q.2) := by
  let L : (P × E) × F →L[ℝ] P × E :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (P × E) F +
      ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ P E ∘L R ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (P × E) F
  have hL : ∀ q a, L (q, a) = (q.1, q.2 + R a) := by
    intro q a
    ext <;> simp [L]
  have hL₀ : L ((p₀, x₀), 0) = (p₀, x₀) := by simp [hL]
  have hG : ContDiffAt ℝ n (fun v => f (L v)) ((p₀, x₀), (0 : F)) := by
    exact (hL₀ ▸ hf).comp _ L.contDiff.contDiffAt
  have hd : fderiv ℝ (fun v => f (L v)) ((p₀, x₀), (0 : F)) =
      fderiv ℝ f (p₀, x₀) ∘L L := by
    have hf' : HasStrictFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f (p₀, x₀)) (L ((p₀, x₀), 0)) := by
      simpa only [hL₀] using hf.hasStrictFDerivAt hn
    have h := hf'.comp ((p₀, x₀), (0 : F))
      L.hasStrictFDerivAt
    exact h.hasFDerivAt.fderiv
  have hinr : (fderiv ℝ f (p₀, x₀) ∘L L) ∘L
      ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (P × E) F = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F := by
    rw [← hR]
    ext a
    simp [L]
  have hinv : (fderiv ℝ (fun v => f (L v)) ((p₀, x₀), (0 : F)) ∘L
      ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (P × E) F).IsInvertible := by
    rw [hd, hinr]
    exact ⟨ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ F, rfl⟩
  let ψ := hG.implicitFunction hn hinv
  have hψ₀ : ψ (p₀, x₀) = 0 := hG.implicitFunction_apply_self hn hinv
  have hψcd : ContDiffAt ℝ n ψ (p₀, x₀) := hG.contDiffAt_implicitFunction hn hinv
  refine ⟨fun q => q.2 + R (ψ q), contDiffAt_snd.add (R.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp _ hψcd),
    by simp [hψ₀], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro q
    exact ⟨ψ q, by simp⟩
  · filter_upwards [hG.eventually_apply_implicitFunction hn hinv] with q hq
    change f (L (q, ψ q)) = f (L ((p₀, x₀), 0)) at hq
    rw [hL, hL₀] at hq
    exact hq
  · have ht : Tendsto (fun q : P × E => (q, (0 : F)))
        (𝓝 (p₀, x₀)) (𝓝 ((p₀, x₀), 0)) := continuousAt_id.prodMk continuousAt_const
    have he := ht.eventually (hG.eventually_apply_eq_iff_implicitFunction hn hinv)
    filter_upwards [he] with q hq
    intro hsol
    have hz : ψ q = 0 := hq.mp (by simpa [hL] using hsol)
    simp [hz]

end

entries.label: thm:discrete_positive_section
entries.title: Positive sections from active-supported surjectivity
entries.chapter: Local continuous choice of coherent realizations
entries.body:
Let $P$ be a real Banach space and $F$ a finite-dimensional real normed
space. Suppose $f\colon P\times\RR^N\to F$ is $C^1$ near $(p_0,x_0)$,
where every coordinate of $x_0$ is nonnegative. Suppose that for every
$y\in F$ there is $b\in\RR^N$ with
\[
 D_x f(p_0,x_0)b=y,\qquad b_i=0\text{ whenever }(x_0)_i=0.
\]
For every open set $V\subseteq P\times\RR^N$ containing $(p_0,x_0)$,
there is an open neighborhood $U$ of $p_0$ and a $C^1$ map
$s\colon U\to\RR^N$ such that, for all $p\in U$,
\[
 (p,s(p))\in V,\qquad s_i(p)>0\ (1\le i\le N),\qquad
 f(p,s(p))=f(p_0,x_0).
\]
No equality $s(p_0)=x_0$ is asserted when $x_0$ has zero coordinates.

lean.name: ContDiffAt.exists_localSection_pos_of_active_surjective
lean.code:
theorem ContDiffAt.exists_localSection_pos_of_active_surjective
    {f : P × (ι → ℝ) → F} {p₀ : P} {x₀ : ι → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 f (p₀, x₀)) (hx₀ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x₀ i)
    (hactive : ∀ y : F, ∃ b : ι → ℝ,
      (fderiv ℝ f (p₀, x₀) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ P (ι → ℝ)) b = y ∧
        ∀ i, x₀ i = 0 → b i = 0)
    {V : Set (P × (ι → ℝ))} (hV : IsOpen V) (hV₀ : (p₀, x₀) ∈ V) :
    ∃ (U : Set P) (s : P → (ι → ℝ)), IsOpen U ∧ p₀ ∈ U ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 s U ∧
      ∀ p ∈ U, (p, s p) ∈ V ∧ (∀ i, 0 < s p i) ∧ f (p, s p) = f (p₀, x₀) := by
  classical
  have : CompleteSpace F := FiniteDimensional.complete ℝ F
  let D : Submodule ℝ (ι → ℝ) :=
    { carrier := {b | ∀ i, x₀ i = 0 → b i = 0}
      zero_mem' := by simp
      add_mem' := by intro a b ha hb i hi; simp [ha i hi, hb i hi]
      smul_mem' := by intro c b hb i hi; simp [hb i hi] }
  let A := fderiv ℝ f (p₀, x₀) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ P (ι → ℝ)
  let B : D →L[ℝ] F := A ∘L D.subtypeL
  have hB : B.range = ⊤ := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top]
    intro y
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbs⟩ := hactive y
    exact ⟨⟨b, hbs⟩, hb⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := B.exists_rightInverse_of_surjective hB
  let R : F →L[ℝ] (ι → ℝ) := D.subtypeL ∘L g
  have hR : A ∘L R = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F := by
    rw [show A ∘L R = B ∘L g from rfl]
    exact hg
  obtain ⟨Q, hQcd, hQ₀, hQrange, hQeq, -⟩ :=
    hf.exists_parametricConstraintCorrection one_ne_zero R hR
  have hfixed : ∀ q i, x₀ i = 0 → Q q i = q.2 i := by
    intro q i hi
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hQrange q
    have hz : (R a) i = 0 := (g a).property i hi
    have hai : R a i = Q q i - q.2 i := congrFun ha i
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hai.symm.trans hz)
  have hQpair : ContinuousAt (fun q : P × (ι → ℝ) => (q.1, Q q)) (p₀, x₀) :=
    continuousAt_fst.prodMk hQcd.continuousAt
  have hQV : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (p₀, x₀), (q.1, Q q) ∈ V := by
    apply hQpair.preimage_mem_nhds
    simpa [hQ₀] using hV.mem_nhds hV₀
  have hQpos : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (p₀, x₀), ∀ i, x₀ i ≠ 0 → 0 < Q q i := by
    apply eventually_all.mpr
    intro i
    by_cases hi : x₀ i = 0
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (by simp [hi])
    · have hp : 0 < Q (p₀, x₀) i := by rw [hQ₀]; exact lt_of_le_of_ne (hx₀ i) (Ne.symm hi)
      have hc := (continuous_apply i).continuousAt.comp hQcd.continuousAt
      exact (hc.eventually (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds hp)).mono (fun _ h _ => h)
  have hgood : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (p₀, x₀), ContDiffAt ℝ 1 Q q ∧
      (q.1, Q q) ∈ V ∧ (∀ i, x₀ i ≠ 0 → 0 < Q q i) ∧
        f (q.1, Q q) = f (p₀, x₀) := by
    filter_upwards [hQcd.eventually (by norm_num), hQV, hQpos, hQeq] with q h1 h2 h3 h4
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
  obtain ⟨W, hWgood, hWopen, hW₀⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hgood
  let d : ι → ℝ := fun i => if x₀ i = 0 then 1 else 0
  have ht : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (p₀, x₀ + t • d)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (p₀, x₀)) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => (p₀, x₀ + t • d)) := by fun_prop
    simpa using hc.tendsto 0
  -- … (truncated)

entries.label: lem:discrete_joint_smoothness
entries.title: Joint smoothness inside the strict walls
entries.chapter: Local continuous choice of coherent realizations
entries.body:
The turning angles, headings, labelled vertices and closure controller
\[
 G(\kappa,\ell)=(E(\kappa,\ell),T(\kappa,\ell)-2\pi)
\]
are smooth jointly in the curvature and length vectors whenever
$|\kappa_i\ell_{i-1}/2|<1$ and $|\kappa_i\ell_i/2|<1$ at every index.
Zero lengths are permitted in this assertion. The length partial
derivative of $G$ equals the derivative of the native length-only map.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.contDiffAt_closureMapR3_joint
lean.code:
theorem contDiffAt_closureMapR3_joint
    (hw : ∀ i, |κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧ |κ i * (ℓ i / 2)| < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ r closureMapR3 (κ, ℓ) := by
  have ht : ContDiffAt ℝ r (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) =>
      turningSum p.1 p.2) (κ, ℓ) := by
    unfold turningSum
    exact ContDiffAt.sum fun i _ => contDiffAt_turningAngle_joint _ (hw i).1 (hw i).2
  exact (contDiffAt_vertexR2_joint n hw).prodMk (ht.sub contDiffAt_const)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.contDiffAt_turningAngle_joint
lean.code:
theorem contDiffAt_turningAngle_joint (i : ZMod n)
    (hw₁ : |κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)| < 1)
    (hw₂ : |κ i * (ℓ i / 2)| < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ r (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) =>
      turningAngle 0 p.1 p.2 i) (κ, ℓ) := by
  rw [abs_lt] at hw₁ hw₂
  have h₁ : ContDiffAt ℝ r
      (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) => p.1 i * (p.2 (i - 1) / 2))
      (κ, ℓ) := by fun_prop
  have h₂ : ContDiffAt ℝ r
      (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) => p.1 i * (p.2 i / 2))
      (κ, ℓ) := by fun_prop
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, turningAngle, tK_zero] using
    ((Real.contDiffAt_arcsin (ne_of_gt hw₁.1) (ne_of_lt hw₁.2)).comp (κ, ℓ) h₁).add
      ((Real.contDiffAt_arcsin (ne_of_gt hw₂.1) (ne_of_lt hw₂.2)).comp (κ, ℓ) h₂)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.fderiv_closureMapR3_inr
lean.code:
theorem fderiv_closureMapR3_inr
    (hw : ∀ i, |κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧ |κ i * (ℓ i / 2)| < 1) :
    fderiv ℝ closureMapR3 (κ, ℓ) ∘L
        ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (ZMod n → ℝ) (ZMod n → ℝ) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun L => closureMapR3 (κ, L)) ℓ := by
  have hf := (contDiffAt_closureMapR3_joint (r := 1) hw).hasStrictFDerivAt one_ne_zero
  have hi : HasFDerivAt (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => (κ, L))
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (ZMod n → ℝ) (ZMod n → ℝ)) ℓ := by
    rw [show ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (ZMod n → ℝ) (ZMod n → ℝ) =
        (0 : (ZMod n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ZMod n → ℝ)).prod
          (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (ZMod n → ℝ)) by ext L <;> rfl]
    exact (hasFDerivAt_const κ ℓ).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_id ℓ)
  exact (hf.hasFDerivAt.comp ℓ hi).fderiv.symm

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.contDiffAt_polygonR2_joint
lean.code:
theorem contDiffAt_polygonR2_joint
    (hw : ∀ i, |κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧ |κ i * (ℓ i / 2)| < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ r (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) => polygonR2 p.1 p.2)
      (κ, ℓ) :=
  contDiffAt_pi.mpr fun i => contDiffAt_vertexR2_joint i.val hw

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.contDiffAt_vertexR2_joint
lean.code:
theorem contDiffAt_vertexR2_joint (j : ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ i, |κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧ |κ i * (ℓ i / 2)| < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ r (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) => vertexR2 p.1 p.2 j)
      (κ, ℓ) := by
  unfold vertexR2
  apply ContDiffAt.sum
  intro k _
  have hl : ContDiffAt ℝ r (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) =>
      (p.2 (k : ZMod n) : ℂ)) (κ, ℓ) :=
    Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp (κ, ℓ) (by fun_prop)
  have hh : ContDiffAt ℝ r (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) =>
      (heading p.1 p.2 k : ℂ)) (κ, ℓ) :=
    Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp (κ, ℓ) (contDiffAt_heading_joint k hw)
  exact hl.mul ((hh.mul contDiffAt_const).cexp)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.contDiffAt_heading_joint
lean.code:
theorem contDiffAt_heading_joint (j : ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ i, |κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧ |κ i * (ℓ i / 2)| < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ r (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) => heading p.1 p.2 j)
      (κ, ℓ) := by
  unfold heading
  exact ContDiffAt.sum fun i _ => contDiffAt_turningAngle_joint _ (hw _).1 (hw _).2

entries.label: def:discrete_local_family
entries.title: A local coherent realization family
entries.chapter: Local continuous choice of coherent realizations
entries.body:
A local family at $\kappa_0$ consists of an open neighborhood
$U\subseteq\RR^n$ containing $\kappa_0$ and a $C^1$ length map
$\ell\colon U\to\RR^n$ such that every $\kappa\in U$ is positive,
$\operatorname{ModerateArc}(0,\kappa,\ell(\kappa))$ holds,
$E(\kappa,\ell(\kappa))=0$, $T(\kappa,\ell(\kappa))=2\pi$,
and the developed polygon is simple. The same developed labelled vertex
tuple depends $C^1$ on $\kappa$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.LocalDiscreteRealizationFamily
lean.code:
structure LocalDiscreteRealizationFamily (κ₀ : ZMod n → ℝ) where
  neighborhood : Set (ZMod n → ℝ)
  isOpen_neighborhood : IsOpen neighborhood
  base_mem : κ₀ ∈ neighborhood
  lengths : (ZMod n → ℝ) → (ZMod n → ℝ)
  contDiffOn_lengths : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 lengths neighborhood
  positive : ∀ κ ∈ neighborhood, ∀ i, 0 < κ i
  moderate : ∀ κ ∈ neighborhood, ModerateArc 0 κ (lengths κ)
  closure : ∀ κ ∈ neighborhood, closureGap κ (lengths κ) = 0
  fullTurn : ∀ κ ∈ neighborhood, turningSum κ (lengths κ) = 2 * Real.pi
  simple : ∀ κ ∈ neighborhood, IsSimplePolygon (polygonR2 κ (lengths κ))
  contDiffOn_vertices : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun κ => polygonR2 κ (lengths κ)) neighborhood

namespace LocalDiscreteRealizationFamily

variable {κ₀ : ZMod n → ℝ} (S : LocalDiscreteRealizationFamily κ₀)

entries.label: thm:tabachnikov_local_continuity
entries.title: Local coherent choice at every nonconstant admissible profile
entries.chapter: Local continuous choice of coherent realizations
entries.body:
Let $n\ge4$ and let $\kappa_0$ satisfy
$\operatorname{DiscreteFourVertexPos}(\kappa_0)$ and be nonconstant.
Then there is a local coherent realization family at $\kappa_0$.
Equivalently, positivity and any strict four-vertex window suffice;
there is no regularity hypothesis on the profile, and adjacent equal
readings are permitted.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.tabachnikovProblem2_local_continuity
lean.code:
theorem tabachnikovProblem2_local_continuity (_hn : 4 ≤ n)
    {κ₀ : ZMod n → ℝ} (hκ₀ : DiscreteFourVertexPos κ₀)
    (hnonconstant : ¬ ∃ c, ∀ i, κ₀ i = c) :
    Nonempty (LocalDiscreteRealizationFamily κ₀) := by
  obtain ⟨hp, hc | ⟨c, _, hd⟩⟩ := hκ₀
  · exact (hnonconstant hc).elim
  · exact localContinuousRealization_of_dfv hp hd

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.nonempty_localDiscreteRealizationFamily
lean.code:
theorem RegularFourAnchor.nonempty_localDiscreteRealizationFamily
    {κ₀ : ZMod n → ℝ} (A : RegularFourAnchor κ₀) (hκ₀ : ∀ i, 0 < κ₀ i) :
    Nonempty (LocalDiscreteRealizationFamily κ₀) := by
  have hb := A.frame.lengths_nonneg_lt_edgeCap κ₀ A.halfLengths hκ₀
    A.positive A.start_lt A.finish_lt
  have hzero : closureMapR3 (κ₀, A.frame.lengths A.halfLengths) = 0 := by
    unfold closureMapR3
    rw [A.frame.closureGap_eq_controller, A.frame.turningSum_eq_controller, A.zero]
    simp
  have h01 := A.frame.strictMono (show (0 : Fin 4) < 1 by decide)
  have h12 := A.frame.strictMono (show (1 : Fin 4) < 2 by decide)
  have h23 := A.frame.strictMono (show (2 : Fin 4) < 3 by decide)
  have h3n := A.frame.lt_n 3
  exact nonempty_localDiscreteRealizationFamily_of_active_surjective (by omega)
    hκ₀ hb hzero (A.frame.active_surj_of_controller_regular hκ₀ A.positive hb A.zero A.regular)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.localContinuousRealization_of_dfv
lean.code:
theorem localContinuousRealization_of_dfv
    {κ₀ : ZMod n → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hκ₀ : ∀ i, 0 < κ₀ i) (hdfv : DFV κ₀ c) :
    Nonempty (LocalDiscreteRealizationFamily κ₀) := by
  obtain ⟨A⟩ := nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_dfv hκ₀ hdfv
  exact A.nonempty_localDiscreteRealizationFamily hκ₀

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.nonempty_localDiscreteRealizationFamily_of_active_surjective
lean.code:
theorem nonempty_localDiscreteRealizationFamily_of_active_surjective
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ₀ ℓ₀ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hκ₀ : ∀ i, 0 < κ₀ i)
    (hℓ₀ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ℓ₀ i ∧ ℓ₀ i < edgeCap κ₀ i)
    (hzero : closureMapR3 (κ₀, ℓ₀) = 0)
    (hactive : ∀ y : ℂ × ℝ, ∃ b : ZMod n → ℝ,
      fderiv ℝ (fun L => closureMapR3 (κ₀, L)) ℓ₀ b = y ∧
        ∀ i, ℓ₀ i = 0 → b i = 0) :
    Nonempty (LocalDiscreteRealizationFamily κ₀) := by
  let V : Set ((ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ)) :=
    {p | ∀ i, 0 < p.1 i ∧
      |p.1 i * (p.2 (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧ |p.1 i * (p.2 i / 2)| < 1}
  have hV : IsOpen V := by
    have hVe : V = ⋂ i : ZMod n, {p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) |
      0 < p.1 i ∧ |p.1 i * (p.2 (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧
        |p.1 i * (p.2 i / 2)| < 1} := by ext p; simp [V]
    rw [hVe]
    apply isOpen_iInter_of_finite
    intro i
    have hk : Continuous (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) => p.1 i) := by fun_prop
    have hl : Continuous (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) =>
        |p.1 i * (p.2 (i - 1) / 2)|) := by fun_prop
    have hr : Continuous (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) =>
        |p.1 i * (p.2 i / 2)|) := by fun_prop
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const hk).inter
      ((isOpen_lt hl continuous_const).inter (isOpen_lt hr continuous_const))
  have hw := strict_arc_walls_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap hκ₀ hℓ₀
  have hpartial := fderiv_closureMapR3_inr hw
  obtain ⟨U, s, hUopen, hU₀, hscd, hgood⟩ :=
    (contDiffAt_closureMapR3_joint (r := 1) hw).exists_localSection_pos_of_active_surjective
      (fun i => (hℓ₀ i).1) (by simpa only [hpartial] using hactive) hV
      (fun i => ⟨hκ₀ i, hw i⟩)
  have hpos : ∀ κ ∈ U, ∀ i, 0 < κ i := fun κ hκ i => (hgood κ hκ).1 i |>.1
  have hmod : ∀ κ ∈ U, ModerateArc 0 κ (s κ) := by
    intro κ hκ
    apply moderateArc_zero_iff.mpr
    intro i
    have hi := (hgood κ hκ).1 i
    have hl := (hgood κ hκ).2.1
    refine ⟨hl i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (half_pos (hl (i - 1)))] using hi.2.1
    · simpa only [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (half_pos (hl i))] using hi.2.2
  have heq : ∀ κ ∈ U, closureMapR3 (κ, s κ) = 0 :=
    fun κ hκ => (hgood κ hκ).2.2.trans hzero
  have hclose : ∀ κ ∈ U, closureGap κ (s κ) = 0 :=
    fun κ hκ => congrArg Prod.fst (heq κ hκ)
  have hturn : ∀ κ ∈ U, turningSum κ (s κ) = 2 * Real.pi := by
    intro κ hκ
    have ht := congrArg Prod.snd (heq κ hκ)
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ht
  refine ⟨⟨U, hUopen, hU₀, s, hscd, hpos, hmod, hclose, hturn,
    fun κ hκ => isSimplePolygon_of_turningPositive hn (hmod κ hκ) (hpos κ hκ)
      (hclose κ hκ) (hturn κ hκ), ?_⟩⟩
  intro κ hκ
  exact (contDiffAt_polygonR2_joint (fun i => ((hgood κ hκ).1 i).2)).comp_contDiffWithinAt κ
    (contDiffWithinAt_id.prodMk (hscd κ hκ))
