entries.label: thm:realizesR2_constant
entries.title: constant positive profiles are realized
entries.chapter: Convexity and simplicity (Euclidean, positive)
entries.body:
For $n \ge 3$ and $c > 0$, the constant profile $\kappa \equiv c$ satisfies
  $\mathrm{RealizesR2}\,(\lambda\,\_.\,c)$, witnessed by the regular $n$-gon of
  edge length $\tfrac{2}{c}\sin(\pi/n)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.realizesR2_const
lean.code:
theorem realizesR2_const [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    RealizesR2 (fun _ : ZMod n => c) := by
  obtain ⟨hMA, _, hsum, hclose⟩ := regularGon_closes hn hc
  exact ⟨fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n), hMA, hclose, hsum,
    isSimplePolygon_of_turningPositive hn hMA (fun _ => hc) hclose hsum⟩

entries.label: def:circumcenter_r2
entries.title: circumcenter of a plane triple
entries.chapter: Local regularity (Dahlberg admissibility)
entries.body:
\textit{Source: Dahlberg, discrete circle of curvature $\rho(P)$, p.~2.}
  For $p, q, r \in \mathbb{C}$ with $u = q - p$, $w = r - p$, set
  \[
    \mathrm{circumcenterR2}\,p\,q\,r
      \;=\; p + \frac{\mathrm{i}\,\bigl(|w|^2 u - |u|^2 w\bigr)}
                     {2\,\mathrm{crossR2}\,u\,w},
  \]
  where $\mathrm{crossR2}\,u\,w = \mathrm{Im}(\overline{u}\,w)$ is the
  in-tree cross product (\cref{def:cross_r2}). A total function; its
  characterizing properties hold under the non-collinearity guard
  $\mathrm{crossR2}\,u\,w \ne 0$. (Center of Dahlberg's discrete circle of
  curvature $\rho(P)$ through the triple.)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.circumcenterR2
lean.code:
noncomputable def circumcenterR2 (p q r : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  p + Complex.I * ((normSq (r - p) : ℝ) * (q - p) - (normSq (q - p) : ℝ) * (r - p))
      / (2 * (crossR2 p q r : ℂ))

entries.label: lem:cross_r2_im_conj_mul
entries.title: the cross product is the imaginary part of the Hermitian product
entries.chapter: Local regularity (Dahlberg admissibility)
entries.body:
For $u, w \in \mathbb{C}$,
  $\mathrm{crossR2}\,u\,w = \mathrm{Im}\bigl(\overline{u}\,w\bigr)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_eq_im_conj_mul
lean.code:
lemma crossR2_eq_im_conj_mul (A B C : ℂ) :
    crossR2 A B C = ((starRingEnd ℂ) (B - A) * (C - A)).im := by
  simp only [crossR2, Complex.mul_im, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im]
  ring

entries.label: lem:circumcenter_dot
entries.title: perpendicular-bisector identities
entries.chapter: Local regularity (Dahlberg admissibility)
entries.body:
Let $c = \mathrm{circumcenterR2}\,p\,q\,r$ and suppose
  $\mathrm{crossR2}\,(q-p)\,(r-p) \ne 0$. Then
  \[
    \mathrm{Re}\bigl(\overline{(q-p)}\,(c - p)\bigr) = \tfrac12\,|q-p|^2,
    \qquad
    \mathrm{Re}\bigl(\overline{(r-p)}\,(c - p)\bigr) = \tfrac12\,|r-p|^2 .
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.re_conj_circumcenterR2_sub
lean.code:
lemma re_conj_circumcenterR2_sub {p q r : ℂ} (h : crossR2 p q r ≠ 0) :
    ((starRingEnd ℂ) (q - p) * (circumcenterR2 p q r - p)).re = normSq (q - p) / 2 ∧
      ((starRingEnd ℂ) (r - p) * (circumcenterR2 p q r - p)).re = normSq (r - p) / 2 := by
  have hζ : circumcenterR2 p q r - p
      = (Complex.I * ((normSq (r - p) : ℝ) * (q - p) - (normSq (q - p) : ℝ) * (r - p)))
          / (2 * (crossR2 p q r : ℂ)) := by
    rw [circumcenterR2]; ring
  have hden : (2 * (crossR2 p q r : ℂ)) = ((2 * crossR2 p q r : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
  have hne : (2 * crossR2 p q r : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0; exact h (by linarith)
  constructor <;>
  · rw [hζ, hden, mul_div_assoc', Complex.div_ofReal_re]
    rw [div_eq_div_iff hne two_ne_zero]
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.normSq_apply, crossR2]
    ring

entries.label: lem:circumcenter_equidist
entries.title: the circumcenter is equidistant
entries.chapter: Local regularity (Dahlberg admissibility)
entries.body: Under the same guard, $|c - p| = |c - q| = |c - r|$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.circumcenterR2_equidist
lean.code:
lemma circumcenterR2_equidist {p q r : ℂ} (h : crossR2 p q r ≠ 0) :
    dist (circumcenterR2 p q r) q = dist (circumcenterR2 p q r) p ∧
      dist (circumcenterR2 p q r) r = dist (circumcenterR2 p q r) p := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := re_conj_circumcenterR2_sub h
  have key : ∀ x : ℂ,
      ((starRingEnd ℂ) (x - p) * (circumcenterR2 p q r - p)).re = normSq (x - p) / 2 →
        dist (circumcenterR2 p q r) x = dist (circumcenterR2 p q r) p := by
    intro x hx
    have hxp : circumcenterR2 p q r - x = (circumcenterR2 p q r - p) - (x - p) := by ring
    have hsq : normSq (circumcenterR2 p q r - x) = normSq (circumcenterR2 p q r - p) := by
      rw [hxp, normSq_sub' _ _, hx]; ring
    rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm,
      ← Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg (circumcenterR2 p q r - x)),
      ← Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg (circumcenterR2 p q r - p)),
      ← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, ← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, hsq]
  exact ⟨key q h1, key r h2⟩

/-! ## Vertex sectors and local regularity -/

entries.label: def:vertex_sector
entries.title: vertex sector
entries.chapter: Local regularity (Dahlberg admissibility)
entries.body:
\textit{Source: Dahlberg, sector $\mathcal{A}(P)$, p.~2.}
  For a cyclic vertex map $v : \ZMod n \to \mathbb{C}$ and $i \in \ZMod n$,
  \[
    \mathrm{vertexSector}\,v\,i \;=\;
    \bigl\{\, v_i + s\,(v_{i-1} - v_i) + t\,(v_{i+1} - v_i)
      \;:\; s, t \ge 0 \,\bigr\}
  \]
  --- the closed convex cone at $v_i$ spanned by the two incident edge
  directions. (For a non-reflex vertex, interior angle $< \pi$, this is
  exactly Dahlberg's closed convex sector $\mathcal{A}$; every vertex of a
  positively-turning moderate-arc development is non-reflex. The $k = 0$
  half-plane convention is out of scope per the chapter preamble.)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.vertexSector

entries.label: def:locally_regular
entries.title: locally regular polygon
entries.chapter: Local regularity (Dahlberg admissibility)
entries.body:
\textit{Source: Dahlberg, Definition 1, p.~3.}
  $\mathrm{LocallyRegularR2}\,v$ holds when for every $i \in \ZMod n$ the
  consecutive triple is non-collinear,
  $\mathrm{crossR2}\,(v_{i-1} - v_i)\,(v_{i+1} - v_i) \ne 0$, and
  \[
    \mathrm{circumcenterR2}\,v_i\,v_{i-1}\,v_{i+1}
      \;\in\; \mathrm{vertexSector}\,v\,i .
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.LocallyRegularR2
lean.code:
def LocallyRegularR2 (v : ZMod n → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : ZMod n, crossR2 (v i) (v (i - 1)) (v (i + 1)) ≠ 0 ∧
    circumcenterR2 (v i) (v (i - 1)) (v (i + 1)) ∈ vertexSector v i

/-! ## Dahlberg's Proposition 1 (non-reflex case) -/

entries.label: def:plateau_local_max
entries.title: plateau local extrema on a cyclic profile
entries.chapter: Local regularity (Dahlberg admissibility)
entries.body:
\textit{Source: Dahlberg, $I(f,P)/\hat I$ vocabulary, p.~2.}
  For $f : \ZMod n \to \mathbb{R}$ and $i \in \ZMod n$:
  $\mathrm{IsPlateauLocalMax}\,f\,i$ holds when there are an
  $\mathbb{N}$-lift $a$ and a length $k < n$ with
  $i \in \{a, a+1, \dots, a+k\}$ (as residues), $f$ constant $= f(i)$ on
  that run, and $f(a - 1) < f(i)$, $f(a + k + 1) < f(i)$.
  $\mathrm{IsPlateauLocalMin}$ is the same with reversed inequalities
  (its own block below). Two
  plateau extrema are \emph{distinct} when their defining runs are disjoint.
  (Existential form of Dahlberg's definition: a run with strict drops at
  both extended ends is automatically the maximal plateau $I(f,i)$, since a
  constant run cannot cross a strict drop; so this is equivalent to his
  ``$f(Q) < f(P)$ on $\hat I \setminus I$'' and avoids formalizing the
  maximality of $I(f,P)$.)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.IsPlateauLocalMax
lean.code:
def IsPlateauLocalMax (f : ZMod n → ℝ) (i : ZMod n) : Prop :=
  ∃ a k : ℕ, k < n ∧ PlateauMaxRun f a k ∧ ∃ m ≤ k, i = ((a + m : ℕ) : ZMod n)

entries.label: def:plateau_local_min
entries.title: plateau local minimum
entries.chapter: Local regularity (Dahlberg admissibility)
entries.body:
As in \cref{def:plateau_local_max} with the strict inequalities reversed:
  $f(a-1) > f(i)$ and $f(a+k+1) > f(i)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.IsPlateauLocalMin
lean.code:
def IsPlateauLocalMin (f : ZMod n → ℝ) (i : ZMod n) : Prop :=
  ∃ a k : ℕ, k < n ∧ PlateauMinRun f a k ∧ ∃ m ≤ k, i = ((a + m : ℕ) : ZMod n)

deps.title: plateau local extrema on a cyclic profile
deps.label: def:plateau_local_max

entries.label: def:plateau_max_run
entries.title: explicit plateau maximum run
entries.chapter: Local regularity (Dahlberg admissibility)
entries.body:
$\mathrm{PlateauMaxRun}\,f\,a\,k$ packages the run-level data of
  \cref{def:plateau_local_max}: $f$ constant on the residues of
  $\{a, \dots, a+k\}$, and $f(a-1) < f(a)$, $f(a+k+1) < f(a)$. (The bound
  $k < n$ is \emph{not} part of the predicate --- it is carried alongside it
  by every consumer, e.g.\ \cref{def:plateau_local_max} and
  \cref{cor:dfv_plateau_extrema_window}; it is in fact forced, since a run of
  length $\ge n-1$ would wrap and contradict the strict drop at $a-1$. The bridge
  theorem's conclusion is phrased with these explicit runs, which carry the
  disjointness data two abstract point-form extrema would lose.)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.PlateauMaxRun
lean.code:
def PlateauMaxRun (f : ZMod n → ℝ) (a k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ m ≤ k, f ((a + m : ℕ) : ZMod n) = f (a : ZMod n)) ∧
    f ((a : ZMod n) - 1) < f (a : ZMod n) ∧
    f ((a + k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) < f (a : ZMod n)

deps.title: plateau local extrema on a cyclic profile
deps.label: def:plateau_local_max

entries.label: def:plateau_min_run
entries.title: explicit plateau minimum run
entries.chapter: Local regularity (Dahlberg admissibility)
entries.body: As \cref{def:plateau_max_run} with the strict inequalities reversed.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.PlateauMinRun
lean.code:
def PlateauMinRun (f : ZMod n → ℝ) (a k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ m ≤ k, f ((a + m : ℕ) : ZMod n) = f (a : ZMod n)) ∧
    f (a : ZMod n) < f ((a : ZMod n) - 1) ∧
    f (a : ZMod n) < f ((a + k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n)

entries.label: lem:plateau_max_run_isMax
entries.title: a maximum run is a plateau local maximum
entries.chapter: Local regularity (Dahlberg admissibility)
entries.body:
If $\mathrm{PlateauMaxRun}\,f\,a\,k$ then every residue of
  $\{a, \dots, a+k\}$ satisfies $\mathrm{IsPlateauLocalMax}\,f$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.PlateauMaxRun.isPlateauLocalMax
lean.code:
lemma PlateauMaxRun.isPlateauLocalMax {f : ZMod n → ℝ} {a k : ℕ} (hk : k < n)
    (h : PlateauMaxRun f a k) : IsPlateauLocalMax f (a : ZMod n) :=
  ⟨a, k, hk, h, 0, Nat.zero_le k, by rw [Nat.add_zero]⟩

deps.title: plateau local extrema on a cyclic profile
deps.label: def:plateau_local_max

entries.label: lem:plateau_min_run_isMin
entries.title: a minimum run is a plateau local minimum
entries.chapter: Local regularity (Dahlberg admissibility)
entries.body:
If $\mathrm{PlateauMinRun}\,f\,a\,k$ then every residue of
  $\{a, \dots, a+k\}$ satisfies $\mathrm{IsPlateauLocalMin}\,f$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.PlateauMinRun.isPlateauLocalMin
lean.code:
lemma PlateauMinRun.isPlateauLocalMin {f : ZMod n → ℝ} {a k : ℕ} (hk : k < n)
    (h : PlateauMinRun f a k) : IsPlateauLocalMin f (a : ZMod n) :=
  ⟨a, k, hk, h, 0, Nat.zero_le k, by rw [Nat.add_zero]⟩

/-! ## The DFV window yields Dahlberg's conclusion class -/

entries.label: thm:dfv_plateau_bridge
entries.title: the DFV window yields Dahlberg's conclusion class
entries.chapter: Local regularity (Dahlberg admissibility)
entries.body:
If $\mathrm{DFV}(\kappa; c)$ (\cref{def:discrete_fourvertex}), then
  $\kappa$ has two distinct plateau local maxima and two distinct plateau
  local minima (in the sense of \cref{def:plateau_local_max,def:plateau_local_min}).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.dfv_plateau_extrema
lean.code:
theorem dfv_plateau_extrema {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {c : ℝ} {i₁ i₂ i₃ i₄ : ℕ}
    (h12 : i₁ < i₂) (h23 : i₂ < i₃) (h34 : i₃ < i₄) (h41 : i₄ < i₁ + n)
    (hκ1 : c < κ ((i₁ : ℕ) : ZMod n)) (hκ2 : κ ((i₂ : ℕ) : ZMod n) < c)
    (hκ3 : c < κ ((i₃ : ℕ) : ZMod n)) (hκ4 : κ ((i₄ : ℕ) : ZMod n) < c) :
    (∃ a₁ k₁ a₂ k₂ : ℕ, k₁ < n ∧ k₂ < n ∧
        PlateauMaxRun κ a₁ k₁ ∧ PlateauMaxRun κ a₂ k₂ ∧
        ∀ m₁, m₁ ≤ k₁ → ∀ m₂, m₂ ≤ k₂ →
          ((a₁ + m₁ : ℕ) : ZMod n) ≠ ((a₂ + m₂ : ℕ) : ZMod n)) ∧
    (∃ a₁ k₁ a₂ k₂ : ℕ, k₁ < n ∧ k₂ < n ∧
        PlateauMinRun κ a₁ k₁ ∧ PlateauMinRun κ a₂ k₂ ∧
        ∀ m₁, m₁ ≤ k₁ → ∀ m₂, m₂ ≤ k₂ →
          ((a₁ + m₁ : ℕ) : ZMod n) ≠ ((a₂ + m₂ : ℕ) : ZMod n)) := by
  -- the two period-shifted window values
  have e1 : ((i₁ + n : ℕ) : ZMod n) = ((i₁ : ℕ) : ZMod n) := by
    push_cast [ZMod.natCast_self]; ring
  have e2 : ((i₂ + n : ℕ) : ZMod n) = ((i₂ : ℕ) : ZMod n) := by
    push_cast [ZMod.natCast_self]; ring
  constructor
  · -- MAXIMA: arcs (i₂, i₄) through i₃ and (i₄, i₂+n) through i₁+n
    obtain ⟨a, b, hA1, hA2, hA3, hAc, hAL, hAR⟩ :=
      exists_max_run (fun m : ℕ => κ ((m : ℕ) : ZMod n)) h23.le h34.le
        (lt_trans hκ2 hκ3) (lt_trans hκ4 hκ3)
    obtain ⟨a', b', hB1, hB2, hB3, hBc, hBL, hBR⟩ :=
      exists_max_run (fun m : ℕ => κ ((m : ℕ) : ZMod n)) h41.le
        (show i₁ + n ≤ i₂ + n by omega)
        (by simp only [e1]; exact lt_trans hκ4 hκ1)
        (by simp only [e1, e2]; exact lt_trans hκ2 hκ1)
    have hk1 : b - a < n := by omega
    have hk2 : b' - a' < n := by omega
    refine ⟨a, b - a, a', b' - a', hk1, hk2,
      plateauMaxRun_of_natRun (by omega) hA2 hAc hAL hAR,
      plateauMaxRun_of_natRun (by omega) hB2 hBc hBL hBR, ?_⟩
    intro m₁ hm₁ m₂ hm₂
    exact natCast_zmod_ne (by omega) (by omega)
  · -- MINIMA: arcs (i₁, i₃) through i₂ and (i₃, i₁+n) through i₄
    obtain ⟨a, b, hA1, hA2, hA3, hAc, hAL, hAR⟩ :=
      exists_max_run (fun m : ℕ => -κ ((m : ℕ) : ZMod n)) h12.le h23.le
        (by simpa using lt_trans hκ2 hκ1)
        (by simpa using lt_trans hκ2 hκ3)
    obtain ⟨a', b', hB1, hB2, hB3, hBc, hBL, hBR⟩ :=
      exists_max_run (fun m : ℕ => -κ ((m : ℕ) : ZMod n)) h34.le
        (show i₄ ≤ i₁ + n by omega)
        (by simpa using lt_trans hκ4 hκ3)
        (by simp only [e1]; simpa using lt_trans hκ4 hκ1)
    have hk1 : b - a < n := by omega
    have hk2 : b' - a' < n := by omega
    refine ⟨a, b - a, a', b' - a', hk1, hk2,
      plateauMinRun_of_natRun (by omega) hA2
        (fun x h1 h2 => neg_inj.1 (hAc x h1 h2)) (by simpa using hAL)
        (by simpa using hAR),
      plateauMinRun_of_natRun (by omega) hB2
        (fun x h1 h2 => neg_inj.1 (hBc x h1 h2)) (by simpa using hBL)
        (by simpa using hBR), ?_⟩
    intro m₁ hm₁ m₂ hm₂
    exact natCast_zmod_ne (by omega) (by omega)

entries.label: def:discrete_fourvertex
entries.title: discrete four-vertex window
entries.chapter: The discrete converse (Euclidean, positive)
entries.body:
For $c \in \mathbb{R}$, the profile $\kappa : \ZMod n \to \mathbb{R}$ satisfies
  $\mathrm{DFV}(\kappa; c)$ when there exist four cyclically ordered indices —
  represented by $\mathbb{N}$-lifts $i_1 < i_2 < i_3 < i_4 < i_1 + n$ — with
  \[
    \kappa_{i_2},\ \kappa_{i_4} \;<\; c \;<\; \kappa_{i_1},\ \kappa_{i_3}.
  \]
  (Two ``high'' values separated by two ``low'' values, alternating across the
  window level $c$.)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.DFV
lean.code:
def DFV (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ i₁ i₂ i₃ i₄ : ℕ, i₁ < i₂ ∧ i₂ < i₃ ∧ i₃ < i₄ ∧ i₄ < i₁ + n ∧
    c < κ ((i₁ : ℕ) : ZMod n) ∧ κ ((i₂ : ℕ) : ZMod n) < c ∧
    c < κ ((i₃ : ℕ) : ZMod n) ∧ κ ((i₄ : ℕ) : ZMod n) < c

entries.label: def:discrete_fourvertex_pos
entries.title: positive discrete four-vertex hypothesis
entries.chapter: The discrete converse (Euclidean, positive)
entries.body:
$\mathrm{DiscreteFourVertexPos}\,\kappa$ holds when $\kappa_i > 0$ for all $i$
  and either $\kappa$ is constant or $\mathrm{DFV}(\kappa; c)$ holds for some
  $c > 0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.DiscreteFourVertexPos

entries.label: cor:dfv_plateau_extrema_window
entries.title: the DFV window meets Dahlberg's conclusion class --- wrapped form
entries.chapter: The discrete converse (Euclidean, positive)
entries.body:
If $\mathrm{DFV}(\kappa; c)$ then $\kappa$ has two disjoint plateau maximum
  runs and two disjoint plateau minimum runs (the conclusion of
  \cref{thm:dfv_plateau_bridge}).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.DFV.plateau_extrema
lean.code:
theorem DFV.plateau_extrema {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (h : DFV κ c) :
    (∃ a₁ k₁ a₂ k₂ : ℕ, k₁ < n ∧ k₂ < n ∧
        PlateauMaxRun κ a₁ k₁ ∧ PlateauMaxRun κ a₂ k₂ ∧
        ∀ m₁, m₁ ≤ k₁ → ∀ m₂, m₂ ≤ k₂ →
          ((a₁ + m₁ : ℕ) : ZMod n) ≠ ((a₂ + m₂ : ℕ) : ZMod n)) ∧
    (∃ a₁ k₁ a₂ k₂ : ℕ, k₁ < n ∧ k₂ < n ∧
        PlateauMinRun κ a₁ k₁ ∧ PlateauMinRun κ a₂ k₂ ∧
        ∀ m₁, m₁ ≤ k₁ → ∀ m₂, m₂ ≤ k₂ →
          ((a₁ + m₁ : ℕ) : ZMod n) ≠ ((a₂ + m₂ : ℕ) : ZMod n)) := by
  obtain ⟨i₁, i₂, i₃, i₄, h12, h23, h34, h41, hκ1, hκ2, hκ3, hκ4⟩ := h
  exact dfv_plateau_extrema h12 h23 h34 h41 hκ1 hκ2 hκ3 hκ4

entries.label: def:collar_solution_data
entries.title: Closed solutions and their strict interior
entries.chapter: The implicit-function opening lemmas
entries.body:
Let \(D \subseteq X\) be a set of \emph{closed solutions} and \(U \subseteq D\)
its \emph{strict interior} (the solutions all of whose moderate-arc walls are
strictly satisfied).

entries.label: thm:compact_collared_continuation
entries.title: Compact collared continuation
entries.chapter: The implicit-function opening lemmas

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.compact_collared_continuation
lean.code:
theorem compact_collared_continuation
    {X K : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace K]
    [T2Space K] [PreconnectedSpace K]
    {D U : Set X} {π : X → K}
    (hD : IsCompact D) (hne : D.Nonempty) (hUD : U ⊆ D)
    (hπ : ContinuousOn π D)
    (hcollar : ∀ x ∈ D, ∃ y ∈ U, π y = π x)
    (hlocal : ∀ x ∈ U, π '' U ∈ 𝓝 (π x)) :
    π '' U = Set.univ := by
  exact closedImage_collared_continuation
    (hD.image_of_continuousOn hπ).isClosed hne hUD hcollar hlocal

entries.label: thm:regularWallZero_entersInterior
entries.title: Regular wall zero enters the interior
entries.chapter: The implicit-function opening lemmas
entries.body:
Let \(f : E \to F\) be a closure map with a surjective strict derivative \(f'\)
at a configuration \(a\), let \(w\) be an active wall functional with derivative
\(w'\), and let \(v \in \ker f'\) be a tangent direction that is strictly inward
for \(w\) (i.e.\ \(w'(v) > 0\)).  Then there is an exact level-set curve
\(\gamma\) with \(\gamma(0)=a\), \(\gamma'(0)=v\), staying on \(\{f = f(a)\}\) and
strictly increasing \(w\) for all small \(t>0\).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.regularWallZero_entersInterior
lean.code:
theorem regularWallZero_entersInterior
    {E F : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    {f : E → F} {f' : E →L[ℝ] F} {a v : E}
    {w : E → ℝ} {w' : E →L[ℝ] ℝ}
    (hf : HasStrictFDerivAt f f' a)
    (hsurj : f'.range = ⊤)
    (hv : v ∈ f'.ker)
    (hw : HasFDerivAt w w' a)
    (hpos : 0 < w' v) :
    ∃ (γ : ℝ → E) (ε : ℝ),
      0 < ε ∧
      γ 0 = a ∧
      HasDerivAt γ v 0 ∧
      Tendsto γ (𝓝 0) (𝓝 a) ∧
      ∀ t, 0 < t → t < ε →
        f (γ t) = f a ∧ w a < w (γ t) := by
  let q : f'.ker := ⟨v, hv⟩
  let γ : ℝ → E := fun t =>
    hf.implicitFunction f f' hsurj (f a) (t • q)
  have hγ0 : γ 0 = a := by
    simp [γ, hf.implicitFunction_apply_image hsurj]
  have hq_deriv : HasStrictDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t • q) q 0 := by
    simpa using ((hasStrictDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) (0 : ℝ)).smul_const q)
  have hq_tendsto : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t • q) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [ContinuousAt, zero_smul] using hq_deriv.hasDerivAt.continuousAt
  have hγ_tendsto : Tendsto γ (𝓝 0) (𝓝 a) := by
    simpa [γ] using
      (hf.tendsto_implicitFunction hsurj
        (g₁ := fun _ : ℝ => f a) (g₂ := fun t : ℝ => t • q)
        tendsto_const_nhds hq_tendsto)
  have hγ_deriv : HasDerivAt γ v 0 := by
    simpa [γ, q, Function.comp_def] using
      ((hf.to_implicitFunction hsurj).comp_hasStrictDerivAt_of_eq 0 hq_deriv (by simp)).hasDerivAt
  have hlevel : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, f (γ t) = f a := by
    have hp : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (f a, t • q)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (f a, 0)) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds.prodMk_nhds hq_tendsto
    simpa [γ] using hp.eventually (hf.map_implicitFunction_eq hsurj)
  have hwall : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => w (γ t)) (w' v) 0 := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using
      hw.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hγ_deriv hγ0.symm
  have hslope :
      Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹ * (w (γ t) - w (γ 0)))
        (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (w' v)) := by
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using hwall.tendsto_slope_zero_right
  have hgood :
      ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), f (γ t) = f a ∧ w a < w (γ t) := by
    filter_upwards [hlevel.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds,
      hslope.eventually_const_lt hpos, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t hft hs ht
    refine ⟨hft, ?_⟩
    have hinv : 0 < t⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr ht
    have hdiff : 0 < w (γ t) - w (γ 0) :=
      pos_of_mul_pos_right hs hinv.le
    rw [hγ0] at hdiff
    exact sub_pos.mp hdiff
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεsub⟩ :=
    mem_nhdsGT_iff_exists_Ioo_subset.mp hgood
  refine ⟨γ, ε, hε, hγ0, hγ_deriv, hγ_tendsto, ?_⟩
  intro t ht0 htε
  -- … (truncated)

entries.label: lem:collar_proj_submersion
entries.title: Joint submersion at a solution opens the parameter image
entries.chapter: The implicit-function opening lemmas
entries.body:
Let \(E\) be a complete real normed space, \(F\) and \(K\) complete real normed
spaces, \(G : E \to F\), \(\pi : E \to K\), and let \(x \in E\) satisfy
\(G(x) = 0\).  Suppose \(G\) and \(\pi\) are strictly differentiable at \(x\)
with derivatives \(G'\) and \(\pi'\), and that the \emph{joint} derivative
\[
  v \;\longmapsto\; \bigl(G'(v),\,\pi'(v)\bigr) \;\in\; F \times K
\]
is surjective.  Let \(V\) be a neighbourhood of \(x\) and let \(U \subseteq E\)
be any set with \(\{G = 0\} \cap V \subseteq U\).  Then \(\pi(U)\) is a
neighbourhood of \(\pi(x)\).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.projImage_mem_nhds_of_jointSubmersion
lean.code:
theorem projImage_mem_nhds_of_jointSubmersion
    {E F K : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [NormedSpace ℝ K] [CompleteSpace K]
    {G : E → F} {π : E → K} {G' : E →L[ℝ] F} {π' : E →L[ℝ] K} {x : E}
    (hGx : G x = 0)
    (hG : HasStrictFDerivAt G G' x) (hπ : HasStrictFDerivAt π π' x)
    (hsurj : (G'.prod π').range = ⊤)
    {V : Set E} (hV : V ∈ 𝓝 x)
    {U : Set E} (hU : {y | G y = 0} ∩ V ⊆ U) :
    π '' U ∈ 𝓝 (π x) := by
  have hH : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun y => (G y, π y)) (G'.prod π') x := hG.prodMk hπ
  have hmap : Filter.map (fun y => (G y, π y)) (𝓝 x) = 𝓝 (G x, π x) :=
    hH.map_nhds_eq_of_surj hsurj
  have hHV : (fun y => (G y, π y)) '' V ∈ 𝓝 ((0 : F), π x) := by
    rw [← hGx, ← hmap]
    exact Filter.image_mem_map hV
  have hWnhds : (fun k : K => ((0 : F), k)) ⁻¹' ((fun y => (G y, π y)) '' V)
      ∈ 𝓝 (π x) :=
    (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds hHV
  refine Filter.mem_of_superset hWnhds ?_
  rintro k hkW
  obtain ⟨y, hyV, hy⟩ := hkW
  have hyG : G y = 0 := (Prod.ext_iff.mp hy).1
  have hyπ : π y = k := (Prod.ext_iff.mp hy).2
  exact ⟨y, hU ⟨hyG, hyV⟩, hyπ⟩

entries.label: lem:collar_hlocal_from_submersion
entries.title: Interior submersion $\Rightarrow$ local openness
entries.chapter: The implicit-function opening lemmas
entries.body:
Let \(U\) be a set of solutions of \(G = 0\) that is \emph{relatively open} among
solutions (every \(x \in U\) has a neighbourhood \(V_x\) with
\(\{G = 0\} \cap V_x \subseteq U\)) and at each of whose points the joint
derivative \((G',\pi')\) is surjective.  Then hypothesis~(4) of
\Cref{thm:compact_collared_continuation} holds: \(\pi(U) \in \mathcal N(\pi x)\)
for every \(x \in U\).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.collar_hlocal_of_openSolutionSet
lean.code:
theorem collar_hlocal_of_openSolutionSet
    {E F K : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [NormedSpace ℝ K] [CompleteSpace K]
    {G : E → F} {π : E → K} {U : Set E}
    (hsol : ∀ x ∈ U, G x = 0)
    (hopen : ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ V ∈ 𝓝 x, {y | G y = 0} ∩ V ⊆ U)
    (hreg : ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ (G' : E →L[ℝ] F) (π' : E →L[ℝ] K),
      HasStrictFDerivAt G G' x ∧ HasStrictFDerivAt π π' x ∧
      (G'.prod π').range = ⊤) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, π '' U ∈ 𝓝 (π x) := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hVU⟩ := hopen x hx
  obtain ⟨G', π', hG, hπ, hsurj⟩ := hreg x hx
  exact projImage_mem_nhds_of_jointSubmersion (hsol x hx) hG hπ hsurj hV hVU

entries.label: def:collar_solution_sets
entries.title: Configuration space, closure map, parameter projection
entries.chapter: The implicit-function opening lemmas
entries.body:
Fix \(n \geq 3\).  A \emph{configuration} is a pair
\(p = (\kappa, \ell) \in (\mathbb{Z}/n \to \mathbb{R}) \times
(\mathbb{Z}/n \to \mathbb{R})\).  Define
\[
  G(p) \;=\; \bigl(\,\mathrm{closureGap}\,\kappa\,\ell,\;
                    \mathrm{turningSum}\,\kappa\,\ell - 2\pi \,\bigr)
  \;\in\; \mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{R},
  \qquad
  \pi(p) \;=\; \kappa .
\]
Thus \(G(p) = 0\) says exactly that the development of \((\kappa,\ell)\) closes
with total turning \(2\pi\), and \(\pi\) is the parameter (curvature-profile)
projection.  Given a set \(S\) of admissible profiles we write
\begin{align*}
  U &= \{\,p \;:\; \pi(p) \in S,\ \mathrm{ModerateArc}\,0\,\kappa\,\ell,\
        G(p) = 0\,\}, \\
  D &\supseteq U \quad\text{a compact set of closed configurations with
        saturated (\(\leq\)) moderate-arc walls.}
\end{align*}
\(U\) is the \emph{strict interior}: the moderate-arc predicate
\(\mathrm{ModerateArc}\,0\) is an open condition
(\(0 < \ell_i\) and \(|\kappa_i|\,\ell_{i\pm}/2 < 1\)), so \(U\) is relatively
open among solutions, which is exactly the hypothesis of
\Cref{lem:collar_hlocal_from_submersion}.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.closureMapR3
lean.code:
noncomputable def closureMapR3 [NeZero n]
    (p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ)) : ℂ × ℝ :=
  (closureGap p.1 p.2, turningSum p.1 p.2 - 2 * Real.pi)

deps.title: Closed solutions and their strict interior
deps.label: def:collar_solution_data

entries.label: lem:collar_realizes_of_mem
entries.title: Membership of \texorpdfstring{$U$}{U} gives realizability
entries.chapter: The implicit-function opening lemmas
entries.body:
If \(n \geq 3\), \(p = (\kappa,\ell) \in U\) and \(\kappa_i > 0\) for all \(i\),
then \(\mathrm{RealizesR2}\,\kappa\).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.realizesR2_of_mem_collarInterior
lean.code:
theorem realizesR2_of_mem_collarInterior [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    {S : Set (ZMod n → ℝ)} {p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ)}
    (hp : p ∈ collarInterior S) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < p.1 i) :
    RealizesR2 p.1 := by
  obtain ⟨-, hMA, hG⟩ := hp
  rw [closureMapR3, Prod.ext_iff] at hG
  have hE : closureGap p.1 p.2 = 0 := hG.1
  have hT : turningSum p.1 p.2 = 2 * Real.pi := by
    have h2 : turningSum p.1 p.2 - 2 * Real.pi = 0 := hG.2
    linarith
  exact ⟨p.2, hMA, hE, hT,
    isSimplePolygon_of_turningPositive hn hMA hpos hE hT⟩

entries.label: def:collar_interior
entries.title: The collar interior as a set
entries.chapter: The implicit-function opening lemmas
entries.body:
For a chamber \(S\) of profiles,
\[
  \mathrm{collarInterior}(S)
  \;=\;
  \bigl\{\,p = (\kappa,\ell) \;\bigm|\;
     \kappa \in S,\ \ \mathrm{ModerateArc}\,0\,\kappa\,\ell,\ \
     G(p) = 0 \,\bigr\},
\]
the set \(U\) of \Cref{def:collar_solution_sets} written as a subset of
\((\mathbb{Z}/n \to \mathbb{R})^2\).

entries.label: def:gap_angle
entries.title: gap angle of an edge
entries.chapter: Edge-gap coordinates
entries.body:
For $t \in \mathbb{R}$ put
  \[
    \gamma_e(t) \;=\;
      \arcsin\!\Bigl(\frac{\kappa_e\, t}{2}\Bigr)
      \;+\;
      \arcsin\!\Bigl(\frac{\kappa_{e+1}\, t}{2}\Bigr).
  \]
  This is the \emph{gap function} of edge $e$: the total turn contributed by an
  edge of length $t$ sitting between the two curvatures $\kappa_e,
  \kappa_{e+1}$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.gapAngleAt
lean.code:
noncomputable def gapAngleAt (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (e : ZMod n) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.arcsin (κ e * (t / 2)) + Real.arcsin (κ (e + 1) * (t / 2))

entries.label: def:gap_of_config
entries.title: gap of a configuration
entries.chapter: Edge-gap coordinates
entries.body:
The \emph{gap} of edge $e$ in the configuration $(\kappa,\ell)$ is
  $\beta_e = \gamma_e(\ell_e)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.gapAngle
lean.code:
noncomputable def gapAngle (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) (e : ZMod n) : ℝ :=
  gapAngleAt κ e (ℓ e)

entries.label: def:edge_cap
entries.title: edge cap
entries.chapter: Edge-gap coordinates
entries.body:
For a curvature profile $\kappa$ set
  \[
    C_e \;=\; \frac{2}{\max(\kappa_e,\kappa_{e+1})} .
  \]
  This is the \emph{edge cap}: the supremum of the lengths edge $e$ may take
  inside the strict moderate-arc domain (\cref{lem:moderate_arc_edge}).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.edgeCap
lean.code:
noncomputable def edgeCap (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (e : ZMod n) : ℝ :=
  2 / max (κ e) (κ (e + 1))

entries.label: def:edge_wall
entries.title: edge wall
entries.chapter: Edge-gap coordinates
entries.body:
For a curvature profile $\kappa$ set
  \[
    U_e \;=\; \frac{\pi}{2}
      \;+\; \arcsin\frac{\min(\kappa_e,\kappa_{e+1})}
                        {\max(\kappa_e,\kappa_{e+1})} .
  \]
  This is the \emph{edge wall}: the supremum of the gaps edge $e$ may take
  (\cref{lem:gap_wall_value_cap}).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.edgeWall
lean.code:
noncomputable def edgeWall (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (e : ZMod n) : ℝ :=
  Real.pi / 2 + Real.arcsin (min (κ e) (κ (e + 1)) / max (κ e) (κ (e + 1)))

entries.label: lem:gap_sum
entries.title: the turning sum is the sum of the gaps
entries.chapter: Edge-gap coordinates
entries.body:
For $n \ge 1$ and any $\kappa, \ell$,
  \[
    \sum_{e \in \mathbb{Z}/n} \beta_e \;=\; T(\kappa,\ell).
  \]
  \begin{proof}
    
    By \cref{def:turning_angle},
    $T = \sum_i \bigl[\arcsin(\kappa_i \ell_{i-1}/2)
       + \arcsin(\kappa_i \ell_i/2)\bigr]$,
    which splits as $A + B$ with
    $A = \sum_i \arcsin(\kappa_i \ell_{i-1}/2)$ and
    $B = \sum_i \arcsin(\kappa_i \ell_i/2)$. Reindex $A$ by the bijection
    $i = e+1$ of $\mathbb{Z}/n$: it becomes
    $\sum_e \arcsin(\kappa_{e+1} \ell_e/2)$. Adding term by term,
    $A + B = \sum_e \bigl[\arcsin(\kappa_{e+1}\ell_e/2)
        + \arcsin(\kappa_e \ell_e/2)\bigr] = \sum_e \beta_e$.
  \end{proof}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.sum_gapAngle
lean.code:
lemma sum_gapAngle [NeZero n] (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) :
    ∑ e : ZMod n, gapAngle κ ℓ e = turningSum κ ℓ := by
  unfold turningSum turningAngle gapAngle gapAngleAt
  simp only [tK_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_comm]
  congr 1
  exact Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.addRight (1 : ZMod n)) _ _
    (fun x => by simp [add_sub_cancel_right])

/-! ## The strict domain in edge coordinates -/

entries.label: lem:moderate_arc_edge
entries.title: the moderate-arc domain is a box in $\ell$
entries.chapter: Edge-gap coordinates
entries.body:
Assume $\kappa_i > 0$ for every $i$. Then
  \[
    \mathrm{ModerateArc}\,0\,\kappa\,\ell
    \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
    \forall e,\; 0 < \ell_e < C_e .
  \]
  \begin{proof}
    
    By \cref{lem:moderate_arc_zero}, $\mathrm{ModerateArc}\,0\,\kappa\,\ell$
    unfolds to: for every vertex $i$, $\ell_i > 0$,
    $|\kappa_i|\,\ell_{i-1}/2 < 1$ and $|\kappa_i|\,\ell_i/2 < 1$. Since
    $\kappa > 0$ we may drop the absolute values.

    ($\Rightarrow$) Fix $e$. Then $\ell_e > 0$; the right wall at vertex $e$
    gives $\kappa_e \ell_e/2 < 1$, and the left wall at vertex $e+1$ gives
    $\kappa_{e+1}\ell_e / 2 < 1$. Hence
    $\max(\kappa_e, \kappa_{e+1})\,\ell_e/2 < 1$, i.e.\ $\ell_e < C_e$
    (the max is positive, so the division is legitimate).

    ($\Leftarrow$) Fix a vertex $i$. Positivity of $\ell_i$ is immediate. The
    hypothesis at $e = i$ gives $\ell_i < C_i \le 2/\kappa_i$, so
    $\kappa_i \ell_i/2 < 1$; the hypothesis at $e = i-1$ gives
    $\ell_{i-1} < C_{i-1} \le 2/\kappa_{i}$ (because $\kappa_i$ is one of the
    two curvatures entering $C_{i-1}$, namely the one at $(i-1)+1 = i$), so
    $\kappa_i \ell_{i-1}/2 < 1$.
  \end{proof}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.moderateArc_zero_iff_edge
lean.code:
lemma moderateArc_zero_iff_edge {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) :
    ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ ↔ ∀ e : ZMod n, 0 < ℓ e ∧ ℓ e < edgeCap κ e := by
  rw [moderateArc_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h e
    have hmax : 0 < max (κ e) (κ (e + 1)) := lt_max_iff.2 (Or.inl (hκ e))
    obtain ⟨hpos, -, hr⟩ := h e
    obtain ⟨-, hl', -⟩ := h (e + 1)
    rw [abs_of_pos (hκ e)] at hr
    rw [abs_of_pos (hκ (e + 1)), add_sub_cancel_right] at hl'
    exact ⟨hpos, lt_edgeCap_of_walls hmax hr hl'⟩
  · intro h i
    have hpos : 0 < ℓ i := (h i).1
    have hpos' : 0 < ℓ (i - 1) := (h (i - 1)).1
    refine ⟨hpos, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [abs_of_pos (hκ i)]
      exact mul_half_lt_one_of_lt_edgeCap (hκ i)
        (by rw [sub_add_cancel]; exact le_max_right _ _) hpos'.le (h (i - 1)).2
    · rw [abs_of_pos (hκ i)]
      exact mul_half_lt_one_of_lt_edgeCap (hκ i) (le_max_left _ _) hpos.le
        (h i).2

/-! ## The gap function is a bijection onto `(0, U_e)` -/

entries.label: lem:edge_cap_pos
entries.title: cap positivity
entries.chapter: Edge-gap coordinates
entries.body:
If $\kappa_e > 0$ and $\kappa_{e+1} > 0$ then $C_e > 0$, and moreover
  $\kappa_e\,C_e/2 \le 1$ and $\kappa_{e+1}\,C_e/2 \le 1$ with equality in at
  least one of the two.
  \begin{proof}
    
    $\max(\kappa_e,\kappa_{e+1}) > 0$, so $C_e = 2/\max > 0$. For each of the
    two curvatures $\kappa \in \{\kappa_e,\kappa_{e+1}\}$ we have
    $\kappa \le \max$, hence $\kappa\, C_e/2 = \kappa/\max \le 1$, with
    equality for whichever attains the maximum.
  \end{proof}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.edgeCap_pos
lean.code:
lemma edgeCap_pos {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {e : ZMod n} (h : 0 < κ e)
    (h' : 0 < κ (e + 1)) :
    0 < edgeCap κ e ∧ κ e * (edgeCap κ e / 2) ≤ 1 ∧
      κ (e + 1) * (edgeCap κ e / 2) ≤ 1 ∧
      (κ e * (edgeCap κ e / 2) = 1 ∨ κ (e + 1) * (edgeCap κ e / 2) = 1) := by
  have hmax : 0 < max (κ e) (κ (e + 1)) := lt_max_iff.2 (Or.inl h)
  have hhalf : edgeCap κ e / 2 = (max (κ e) (κ (e + 1)))⁻¹ := by
    rw [edgeCap]
    field_simp
  refine ⟨div_pos two_pos hmax, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hhalf, ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_le_one hmax]
    exact le_max_left _ _
  · rw [hhalf, ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_le_one hmax]
    exact le_max_right _ _
  · rcases le_total (κ e) (κ (e + 1)) with hle | hle
    · exact Or.inr (by rw [hhalf, max_eq_right hle, mul_inv_cancel₀ h'.ne'])
    · exact Or.inl (by rw [hhalf, max_eq_left hle, mul_inv_cancel₀ h.ne'])

entries.label: lem:gap_strict_mono
entries.title: the gap function is strictly increasing up to the cap
entries.chapter: Edge-gap coordinates
entries.body:
Assume $\kappa_e, \kappa_{e+1} > 0$. Then $\gamma_e$ is strictly increasing
  on $[0, C_e]$ and continuous on $\mathbb{R}$.
  \begin{proof}
    
    Continuity is that of $\arcsin$ (a continuous function on all of
    $\mathbb{R}$ in the clamped convention) composed with linear maps.

    For strict monotonicity take $0 \le s < t \le C_e$ and let
    $\kappa \in \{\kappa_e, \kappa_{e+1}\}$. Then
    $\kappa s/2 < \kappa t/2$ (as $\kappa > 0$),
    $-1 \le 0 \le \kappa s/2$, and $\kappa t/2 \le \kappa\,C_e/2 \le 1$ by
    \cref{lem:edge_cap_pos}. Strict monotonicity of $\arcsin$ on $[-1,1]$
    therefore gives $\arcsin(\kappa s/2) < \arcsin(\kappa t/2)$ for each of the
    two curvatures, and $\gamma_e(s) < \gamma_e(t)$ follows by adding.
  \end{proof}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.gapAngleAt_strictMonoOn
lean.code:
lemma gapAngleAt_strictMonoOn {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {e : ZMod n} (h : 0 < κ e)
    (h' : 0 < κ (e + 1)) :
    StrictMonoOn (gapAngleAt κ e) (Set.Icc 0 (edgeCap κ e)) := by
  obtain ⟨-, hcl1, hcl2, -⟩ := edgeCap_pos h h'
  intro s hs t ht hst
  exact add_lt_add (arcsin_summand_lt h hcl1 hs.1 hst ht.2)
    (arcsin_summand_lt h' hcl2 hs.1 hst ht.2)

entries.label: lem:gap_wall_value_zero
entries.title: the gap function vanishes at zero length
entries.chapter: Edge-gap coordinates

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.gapAngleAt_zero
lean.code:
lemma gapAngleAt_zero (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (e : ZMod n) : gapAngleAt κ e 0 = 0 := by
  simp [gapAngleAt]

entries.label: lem:gap_wall_value_cap
entries.title: the gap function reaches the wall at the cap
entries.chapter: Edge-gap coordinates
entries.body:
Assume $\kappa_e, \kappa_{e+1} > 0$. Then $\gamma_e(C_e) = U_e$.
  \begin{proof}
    
    Write $M = \max(\kappa_e,\kappa_{e+1})$ and
    $m = \min(\kappa_e,\kappa_{e+1})$, so that $M > 0$ and $C_e = 2/M$; then
    $\kappa_e\,C_e/2 = \kappa_e/M$ and $\kappa_{e+1}\,C_e/2 = \kappa_{e+1}/M$.
    In the case $\kappa_e \le \kappa_{e+1}$ we have $M = \kappa_{e+1}$,
    $m = \kappa_e$, and the two arguments are $m/M$ and $1$; in the case
    $\kappa_{e+1} \le \kappa_e$ they are $1$ and $m/M$. Either way, since
    addition is commutative,
    $\gamma_e(C_e) = \arcsin 1 + \arcsin(m/M) = \pi/2 + \arcsin(m/M) = U_e$.
  \end{proof}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.gapAngleAt_edgeCap
lean.code:
lemma gapAngleAt_edgeCap {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {e : ZMod n} (h : 0 < κ e)
    (h' : 0 < κ (e + 1)) : gapAngleAt κ e (edgeCap κ e) = edgeWall κ e := by
  rcases le_total (κ e) (κ (e + 1)) with hle | hle
  · rw [gapAngleAt, edgeCap, edgeWall, max_eq_right hle, min_eq_left hle]
    have h1 : κ e * (2 / κ (e + 1) / 2) = κ e / κ (e + 1) := by
      field_simp
    have h2 : κ (e + 1) * (2 / κ (e + 1) / 2) = 1 := by
      field_simp
    rw [h1, h2, Real.arcsin_one]
    ring
  · rw [gapAngleAt, edgeCap, edgeWall, max_eq_left hle, min_eq_right hle]
    have h1 : κ e * (2 / κ e / 2) = 1 := by
      field_simp
    have h2 : κ (e + 1) * (2 / κ e / 2) = κ (e + 1) / κ e := by
      field_simp
    rw [h1, h2, Real.arcsin_one]

entries.label: lem:gap_surjective
entries.title: every admissible gap is attained, uniquely
entries.chapter: Edge-gap coordinates
entries.body:
Assume $\kappa_e, \kappa_{e+1} > 0$ and $0 < \beta < U_e$. Then there is a
  unique $t$ with $0 < t < C_e$ and $\gamma_e(t) = \beta$.
  \begin{proof}
    
    \emph{Existence.} $\gamma_e$ is continuous on $[0, C_e]$ and
    $0 \le C_e$ by \cref{lem:edge_cap_pos}, so the intermediate value theorem
    on an open interval gives
    $\bigl(\gamma_e(0),\, \gamma_e(C_e)\bigr) \subseteq \gamma_e\bigl((0,
    C_e)\bigr)$. By \cref{lem:gap_wall_value_zero,lem:gap_wall_value_cap} the left-hand side is
    $(0, U_e)$, which contains $\beta$.

    \emph{Uniqueness.} $\gamma_e$ is strictly increasing on $[0, C_e]$
    (\cref{lem:gap_strict_mono}), hence injective there, and $(0,C_e)
    \subseteq [0,C_e]$.
  \end{proof}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.exists_unique_length_of_gap
lean.code:
lemma exists_unique_length_of_gap {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {e : ZMod n} (h : 0 < κ e)
    (h' : 0 < κ (e + 1)) {β : ℝ} (hβ0 : 0 < β) (hβU : β < edgeWall κ e) :
    ∃! t, t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (edgeCap κ e) ∧ gapAngleAt κ e t = β := by
  have hC : (0 : ℝ) ≤ edgeCap κ e := (edgeCap_pos h h').1.le
  have hsub := intermediate_value_Ioo hC
    ((gapAngleAt_continuous κ e).continuousOn
      (s := Set.Icc 0 (edgeCap κ e)))
  rw [gapAngleAt_zero, gapAngleAt_edgeCap h h'] at hsub
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hval⟩ := hsub ⟨hβ0, hβU⟩
  refine ⟨t, ⟨ht, hval⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro s ⟨hs, hsval⟩
  exact (gapAngleAt_strictMonoOn h h').injOn (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hs)
    (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht) (hsval.trans hval.symm)

entries.label: def:gap_length
entries.title: the inverse: length of a prescribed gap
entries.chapter: Edge-gap coordinates
entries.body:
For $\kappa$, an edge $e$ and a real $\beta$, let
  $\mathrm{gapLength}\,\kappa\,e\,\beta$ be the length produced by
  \cref{lem:gap_surjective} when $\kappa_e,\kappa_{e+1} > 0$ and
  $0 < \beta < U_e$, chosen arbitrarily (junk) otherwise.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.gapLength
lean.code:
noncomputable def gapLength (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (e : ZMod n) (β : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if h : 0 < κ e ∧ 0 < κ (e + 1) ∧ 0 < β ∧ β < edgeWall κ e then
    (exists_unique_length_of_gap h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2).exists.choose
  else 0

entries.title: the inverse inverts
entries.chapter: Edge-gap coordinates
entries.body:
If $\kappa_e, \kappa_{e+1} > 0$ and $0 < \beta < U_e$ then
  $\gamma_e\bigl(\mathrm{gapLength}\,\kappa\,e\,\beta\bigr) = \beta$.
  \begin{proof}
    
    This is one of the two defining properties of the element chosen in
    \cref{def:gap_length} from the existence statement of
    \cref{lem:gap_surjective}.
  \end{proof}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.gapLength_spec
lean.code:
lemma gapLength_spec {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {e : ZMod n} {β : ℝ} (h : 0 < κ e)
    (h' : 0 < κ (e + 1)) (hβ0 : 0 < β) (hβU : β < edgeWall κ e) :
    gapAngleAt κ e (gapLength κ e β) = β := by
  rw [gapLength, dif_pos ⟨h, h', hβ0, hβU⟩]
  exact (exists_unique_length_of_gap h h' hβ0 hβU).exists.choose_spec.2

lemma gapLength_mem_Ioo {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {e : ZMod n} {β : ℝ} (h : 0 < κ e)

The external four-gap notes work with the osculating radii `r_i = 1/κ_i`;
inversion is order-reversing on `(0, ∞)`, so it swaps `min` and `max` and
leaves the wall ratio unchanged. -/

entries.label: lem:gap_radius_cap
entries.title: radius form of the cap
entries.chapter: Edge-gap coordinates
entries.body:
Assume $\kappa_e, \kappa_{e+1} > 0$ and set $r_i = 1/\kappa_i$. Then
  $C_e = 2\,\min(r_e,\, r_{e+1})$.
  \begin{proof}
    
    Inversion $x \mapsto 1/x$ is order-reversing on $(0,\infty)$, so
    $\min(r_e, r_{e+1}) = 1/\max(\kappa_e,\kappa_{e+1})$; the claim is then
    $C_e = 2/\max(\kappa_e,\kappa_{e+1})$ restated.
  \end{proof}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.edgeCap_eq_radius
lean.code:
lemma edgeCap_eq_radius {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {e : ZMod n} (h : 0 < κ e)
    (h' : 0 < κ (e + 1)) :
    edgeCap κ e = 2 * min (1 / κ e) (1 / κ (e + 1)) := by
  rcases le_total (κ e) (κ (e + 1)) with hle | hle
  · rw [edgeCap, max_eq_right hle,
      min_eq_right (one_div_le_one_div_of_le h hle)]
    ring
  · rw [edgeCap, max_eq_left hle,
      min_eq_left (one_div_le_one_div_of_le h' hle)]
    ring

entries.label: lem:gap_radius_wall
entries.title: radius form of the wall
entries.chapter: Edge-gap coordinates

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.edgeWall_eq_radius
lean.code:
lemma edgeWall_eq_radius {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {e : ZMod n} (h : 0 < κ e)
    (h' : 0 < κ (e + 1)) :
    edgeWall κ e = Real.pi / 2 +
      Real.arcsin (min (1 / κ e) (1 / κ (e + 1)) /
        max (1 / κ e) (1 / κ (e + 1))) := by
  rcases le_total (κ e) (κ (e + 1)) with hle | hle
  · rw [edgeWall, max_eq_right hle, min_eq_left hle,
      min_eq_right (one_div_le_one_div_of_le h hle),
      max_eq_left (one_div_le_one_div_of_le h hle)]
    have harg : (1 : ℝ) / κ (e + 1) / (1 / κ e) = κ e / κ (e + 1) := by
      field_simp [h.ne', h'.ne']
    rw [harg]
  · rw [edgeWall, max_eq_left hle, min_eq_right hle,
      min_eq_left (one_div_le_one_div_of_le h' hle),
      max_eq_right (one_div_le_one_div_of_le h' hle)]
    have harg : (1 : ℝ) / κ e / (1 / κ (e + 1)) = κ (e + 1) / κ e := by
      field_simp [h.ne', h'.ne']
    rw [harg]

/-! ## Repackaging a gap vector as a realization -/

entries.label: thm:realizes_of_gap_data
entries.title: realizability from edge-coordinate data
entries.chapter: Edge-gap coordinates
entries.body:
Let $n \ge 3$, let $\kappa_i > 0$ for every $i$, and let $\ell$ satisfy
  \[
    \forall e,\; 0 < \ell_e < C_e,
    \qquad E(\kappa,\ell) = 0,
    \qquad \sum_{e} \beta_e = 2\pi .
  \]
  Then $\mathrm{RealizesR2}\,\kappa$.
  \begin{proof}
    
    The first hypothesis is $\mathrm{ModerateArc}\,0\,\kappa\,\ell$ by
    \cref{lem:moderate_arc_edge}; the third is $T(\kappa,\ell) = 2\pi$ by
    \cref{lem:gap_sum}. With the closure hypothesis and positivity of $\kappa$
    in hand, \cref{thm:convex_simple} supplies
    $\mathrm{IsSimplePolygon}\,(P(\kappa,\ell))$. The four conjuncts of
    \cref{def:discrete_realizes} are then exactly what we have, witnessed by
    $\ell$.
  \end{proof}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.realizesR2_of_gapData
lean.code:
theorem realizesR2_of_gapData [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) (hℓ : ∀ e : ZMod n, 0 < ℓ e ∧ ℓ e < edgeCap κ e)
    (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0)
    (hsum : ∑ e : ZMod n, gapAngle κ ℓ e = 2 * Real.pi) :
    RealizesR2 κ := by
  have hMA : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ := (moderateArc_zero_iff_edge hκ).2 hℓ
  have hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi := by
    rw [← sum_gapAngle]
    exact hsum
  exact ⟨ℓ, hMA, hE, hT, isSimplePolygon_of_turningPositive hn hMA hκ hE hT⟩

deps.label: lem:gap_sum

deps.label: lem:moderate_arc_edge

entries.label: thm:realizes_of_gap_vector
entries.title: realizability from a gap vector
entries.chapter: Edge-gap coordinates
entries.body:
Let $n \ge 3$ and $\kappa_i > 0$ for every $i$, and let
  $\beta \colon \mathbb{Z}/n \to \mathbb{R}$ satisfy
  \[
    \forall k,\; 0 < \beta_k < U_k,
    \qquad \sum_k \beta_k = 2\pi,
    \qquad E\bigl(\kappa,\ \mathrm{gapLength}\,\kappa\,\cdot\,\beta_\cdot\bigr)
             = 0 .
  \]
  Then $\mathrm{RealizesR2}\,\kappa$, realized by the edge lengths
  $\ell_e = \mathrm{gapLength}\,\kappa\,e\,\beta_e$, and those lengths are
  strictly positive.
  \begin{proof}
    
    Put $\ell_e = \mathrm{gapLength}\,\kappa\,e\,\beta_e$. By
    \cref{lem:gap_length_spec,lem:gap_length_mem} each $\ell_e$ lies in $(0, C_e)$ --- in
    particular every edge length is strictly positive --- and
    $\gamma_e(\ell_e) = \beta_e$, i.e.\ the gaps of the configuration
    $(\kappa,\ell)$ are the prescribed $\beta$. So
    $\sum_e \beta_e = 2\pi$ is the third hypothesis of
    \cref{thm:realizes_of_gap_data} and the assumed vanishing of the closure
    gap is its second. Apply \cref{thm:realizes_of_gap_data}.
  \end{proof}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.realizesR2_of_gapVector
lean.code:
theorem realizesR2_of_gapVector [NeZero n] {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) {β : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hβ : ∀ k : ZMod n, 0 < β k ∧ β k < edgeWall κ k)
    (hsum : ∑ k : ZMod n, β k = 2 * Real.pi)
    (hE : closureGap κ (fun e => gapLength κ e (β e)) = 0) :
    RealizesR2 κ := by
  have hmem : ∀ e : ZMod n, 0 < gapLength κ e (β e) ∧
      gapLength κ e (β e) < edgeCap κ e := fun e =>
    gapLength_mem_Ioo (hκ e) (hκ (e + 1)) (hβ e).1 (hβ e).2
  refine realizesR2_of_gapData hn hκ hmem hE ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ =>
    show gapAngle κ (fun e' => gapLength κ e' (β e')) e = β e from
      gapLength_spec (hκ e) (hκ (e + 1)) (hβ e).1 (hβ e).2]
  exact hsum

/-! ## The global step of the zigzag argument

Purely order-theoretic — no curvature, no closure, no geometry. The local
consequence feeding `exists_of_high_neighbour` is an explicit hypothesis,
precisely so that this file takes on none of the risk of the unaudited
external local certificates. -/

entries.label: lem:high_neighbour_cyclic
entries.title: a cyclic family cannot beat both neighbours everywhere
entries.chapter: Edge-gap coordinates
entries.body:
Let $m \ge 1$ and $H \colon \mathbb{Z}/m \to \mathbb{R}$. Then there is an
  index $i$ with
  \[
    H_{i+1} \le H_i \qquad\text{and}\qquad H_{i+1} \le H_{i+2}.
  \]
  \begin{proof}
    
    $\mathbb{Z}/m$ is a nonempty finite type, so $H$ attains its minimum at
    some $j$. Take $i = j - 1$, so that $i + 1 = j$ and $i + 2 = j + 1$. Then
    $H_{i+1} = H_j \le H_{i}$ and $H_{i+1} = H_j \le H_{j+1} = H_{i+2}$, both
    by minimality.
  \end{proof}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.exists_le_both_neighbours
lean.code:
lemma exists_le_both_neighbours {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (H : ZMod m → ℝ) :
    ∃ i : ZMod m, H (i + 1) ≤ H i ∧ H (i + 1) ≤ H (i + 2) := by
  obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_min_image Finset.univ H Finset.univ_nonempty
  have h1 : j - 1 + 1 = j := sub_add_cancel j 1
  have h2 : j - 1 + 2 = j + 1 := by ring
  exact ⟨j - 1, by rw [h1]; exact hj _ (Finset.mem_univ _),
    by rw [h1, h2]; exact hj _ (Finset.mem_univ _)⟩

entries.label: lem:high_neighbour_global
entries.title: global step: some carrier has opposite endpoint defects
entries.chapter: Edge-gap coordinates
entries.body:
Let $m \ge 1$, let $H \colon \mathbb{Z}/m \to \mathbb{R}$, and let
  $P \colon \mathbb{Z}/m \to \mathrm{Prop}$ be any predicate. Assume the
  \emph{high-neighbour consequence}
  \[
    \forall i,\quad \neg P\,i \;\Longrightarrow\;
      \bigl(H_{i+1} > H_i \ \text{ or }\ H_{i+1} > H_{i+2}\bigr).
  \]
  Then $P\,i$ holds for some $i$.
  \begin{proof}
    
    Suppose not, so $\neg P\,i$ for every $i$ and hence
    $H_{i+1} > H_i$ or $H_{i+1} > H_{i+2}$ for every $i$. Apply
    \cref{lem:high_neighbour_cyclic} to get an index $i$ with
    $H_{i+1} \le H_i$ and $H_{i+1} \le H_{i+2}$; both disjuncts at that $i$
    are contradicted.
  \end{proof}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.exists_of_high_neighbour
lean.code:
lemma exists_of_high_neighbour {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {H : ZMod m → ℝ}
    {P : ZMod m → Prop}
    (hloc : ∀ i : ZMod m, ¬P i → H i < H (i + 1) ∨ H (i + 2) < H (i + 1)) :
    ∃ i, P i := by
  by_contra hall
  rw [not_exists] at hall
  obtain ⟨i, h1, h2⟩ := exists_le_both_neighbours H
  rcases hloc i (hall i) with hlt | hlt
  · exact absurd h1 (not_le.2 hlt)
  · exact absurd h2 (not_le.2 hlt)

deps.title: a cyclic family cannot beat both neighbours everywhere
deps.label: lem:high_neighbour_cyclic

entries.label: def:zz_local_max
entries.title: strict local maximum
entries.chapter: Local extrema of cyclic words
entries.body:
For $w : \ZMod n \to \mathbb{R}$ and $i \in \ZMod n$, say $i$ is a \emph{strict local
  maximum} of $w$, written $\mathrm{IsStrictLocalMax}\,w\,i$, when
  $w_{i-1} < w_i$ and $w_{i+1} < w_i$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.IsStrictLocalMax
lean.code:
def IsStrictLocalMax (w : ZMod n → ℝ) (i : ZMod n) : Prop :=
  w (i - 1) < w i ∧ w (i + 1) < w i

entries.label: def:n4c_four_profile
entries.title: four-point profile
entries.chapter: The four-point converse: orthogonal diagonals, scaling, and cap bases
entries.body:
For $x_0,x_1,x_2,x_3\in\mathbb{R}$, $\mathrm{fourProfile}(x_0,x_1,x_2,x_3)$
  is the function $\ZMod 4\to\mathbb{R}$ sending $i$ to $x_{i}$, read through
  the canonical representative $i.\mathrm{val}\in\{0,1,2,3\}$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.fourProfile
lean.code:
def fourProfile (x₀ x₁ x₂ x₃ : ℝ) : ZMod 4 → ℝ := fun i =>
  ![x₀, x₁, x₂, x₃] ⟨i.val, i.val_lt⟩

entries.label: def:n4c_orthogonal_quad
entries.title: orthogonal-diagonal quadrilateral
entries.chapter: The four-point converse: orthogonal diagonals, scaling, and cap bases
entries.body:
For $a,b,c,d>0$ let $\mathrm{orthogonalQuad}(a,b,c,d):\ZMod 4\to\mathbb{C}$
  be the vertex map
  \[
    0\mapsto a,\qquad 1\mapsto b\,i,\qquad 2\mapsto -c,\qquad 3\mapsto -d\,i .
  \]
  Its two diagonals are the segments $[-c,a]$ of the real axis and
  $[-d\,i,b\,i]$ of the imaginary axis, so they meet orthogonally at the
  origin, and $a,b,c,d$ are the four half-diagonals.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.orthogonalQuad
lean.code:
def orthogonalQuad (a b c d : ℝ) : ZMod 4 → ℂ := fun i =>
  ![(a : ℂ), (b : ℂ) * Complex.I, -(c : ℂ), -(d : ℂ) * Complex.I]
    ⟨i.val, i.val_lt⟩

entries.label: lem:n4c_quad_simple
entries.title: the orthogonal quadrilateral is simple
entries.chapter: The four-point converse: orthogonal diagonals, scaling, and cap bases
entries.body:
For $a,b,c,d>0$ the polygon $\mathrm{orthogonalQuad}(a,b,c,d)$ is simple:
  consecutive vertices are distinct, consecutive closed edges meet exactly in
  their shared vertex, and non-adjacent closed edges are disjoint.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.isSimplePolygon_orthogonalQuad
lean.code:
theorem isSimplePolygon_orthogonalQuad {a b c d : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d) :
    IsSimplePolygon (orthogonalQuad a b c d) :=
  ⟨orthogonalQuad_edge_ne ha hb hc hd,
    orthogonalQuad_consecutive_inter ha hb hc hd,
    orthogonalQuad_nonadjacent_disjoint ha hb hc hd⟩

entries.label: lem:n4c_realizes_menger_orthogonal
entries.title: curvature of the orthogonal quadrilateral
entries.chapter: The four-point converse: orthogonal diagonals, scaling, and cap bases
entries.body:
Let $a,b,c,d>0$ and $A,B,C,D>0$ satisfy the four Pythagorean relations
  \[
    A^2=a^2+b^2,\quad B^2=b^2+c^2,\quad C^2=c^2+d^2,\quad D^2=d^2+a^2 ,
  \]
  and put
  \[
    \kappa_0=\frac{2a}{AD},\quad \kappa_1=\frac{2b}{AB},\quad
    \kappa_2=\frac{2c}{BC},\quad \kappa_3=\frac{2d}{CD} .
  \]
  Then $\mathrm{RealizesMenger}\,\mathrm{fourProfile}(\kappa_0,\dots,\kappa_3)$,
  witnessed by $\mathrm{orthogonalQuad}(a,b,c,d)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.realizesMenger_fourProfile_of_orthogonal
lean.code:
theorem realizesMenger_fourProfile_of_orthogonal
    {k₀ k₁ k₂ k₃ a b c d A B C D : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hA : 0 < A) (hB : 0 < B) (hC : 0 < C) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hAsq : A ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) (hBsq : B ^ 2 = b ^ 2 + c ^ 2)
    (hCsq : C ^ 2 = c ^ 2 + d ^ 2) (hDsq : D ^ 2 = d ^ 2 + a ^ 2)
    (hk₀ : 2 * a / (A * D) = k₀) (hk₁ : 2 * b / (A * B) = k₁)
    (hk₂ : 2 * c / (B * C) = k₂) (hk₃ : 2 * d / (C * D) = k₃) :
    RealizesMenger (fourProfile k₀ k₁ k₂ k₃) := by
  refine ⟨orthogonalQuad a b c d, isSimplePolygon_orthogonalQuad ha hb hc hd, ?_⟩
  intro i
  rcases zmod4_cases i with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · change signedMengerR2 (orthogonalQuad a b c d 3) (orthogonalQuad a b c d 0)
        (orthogonalQuad a b c d 1) = k₀
    rw [orthogonalQuad_three, orthogonalQuad_zero, orthogonalQuad_one,
      signedMenger_orthogonal_zero ha hb hd hA hD hAsq (by nlinarith), hk₀]
  · change signedMengerR2 (orthogonalQuad a b c d 0) (orthogonalQuad a b c d 1)
        (orthogonalQuad a b c d 2) = k₁
    rw [orthogonalQuad_zero, orthogonalQuad_one, orthogonalQuad_two,
      signedMenger_orthogonal_one ha hb hc hA hB hAsq hBsq, hk₁]
  · change signedMengerR2 (orthogonalQuad a b c d 1) (orthogonalQuad a b c d 2)
        (orthogonalQuad a b c d 3) = k₂
    rw [orthogonalQuad_one, orthogonalQuad_two, orthogonalQuad_three,
      signedMenger_orthogonal_two hb hc hd hB hC hBsq hCsq, hk₂]
  · change signedMengerR2 (orthogonalQuad a b c d 2) (orthogonalQuad a b c d 3)
        (orthogonalQuad a b c d 0) = k₃
    rw [orthogonalQuad_two, orthogonalQuad_three, orthogonalQuad_zero,
      signedMenger_orthogonal_three ha hc hd hC hD hCsq hDsq, hk₃]

entries.label: def:n4c_delta
entries.title: alternation discriminant
entries.chapter: The four-point converse: orthogonal diagonals, scaling, and cap bases
entries.body: $\Delta(\kappa) = \kappa_0^2\kappa_2^2 - \kappa_1^2\kappa_3^2$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.orthogonalDelta
lean.code:
def orthogonalDelta (k₀ k₁ k₂ k₃ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  k₀ ^ 2 * k₂ ^ 2 - k₁ ^ 2 * k₃ ^ 2

entries.label: def:n4c_squareA

entries.chapter: The four-point converse: orthogonal diagonals, scaling, and cap bases
entries.body: $\mathcal A = 4(\kappa_2^2-\kappa_3^2)/\Delta$, intended as $A^2$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.orthogonalA2
lean.code:
noncomputable def orthogonalA2 (k₀ k₁ k₂ k₃ : ℝ) : ℝ :=

entries.label: def:n4c_squareB

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.orthogonalB2
lean.code:
noncomputable def orthogonalB2 (k₀ k₁ k₂ k₃ : ℝ) : ℝ :=

entries.label: def:n4c_squareC
entries.title: third squared side length
entries.chapter: The four-point converse: orthogonal diagonals, scaling, and cap bases
entries.body: $\mathcal C = 4(\kappa_0^2-\kappa_1^2)/\Delta$, intended as $C^2$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.orthogonalC2
lean.code:

entries.label: def:n4c_squareD
entries.title: fourth squared side length
entries.chapter: The four-point converse: orthogonal diagonals, scaling, and cap bases
entries.body: $\mathcal D = 4(\kappa_2^2-\kappa_1^2)/\Delta$, intended as $D^2$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.orthogonalD2

noncomputable def orthogonalD2 (k₀ k₁ k₂ k₃ : ℝ) : ℝ :=

entries.label: lem:n4c_identityA
entries.title: first Pythagorean identity
entries.chapter: The four-point converse: orthogonal diagonals, scaling, and cap bases
entries.body:
If $\Delta\ne 0$ then
  $\mathcal A = \tfrac14\kappa_0^2\,\mathcal A\mathcal D
     + \tfrac14\kappa_1^2\,\mathcal A\mathcal B$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.orthogonalA2_identity
lean.code:
lemma orthogonalA2_identity {k₀ k₁ k₂ k₃ : ℝ}
    (hΔ : orthogonalDelta k₀ k₁ k₂ k₃ ≠ 0) :
    orthogonalA2 k₀ k₁ k₂ k₃ =
      k₀ ^ 2 * orthogonalA2 k₀ k₁ k₂ k₃ *
          orthogonalD2 k₀ k₁ k₂ k₃ / 4 +
        k₁ ^ 2 * orthogonalA2 k₀ k₁ k₂ k₃ *
          orthogonalB2 k₀ k₁ k₂ k₃ / 4 := by
  unfold orthogonalA2 orthogonalB2 orthogonalD2
  field_simp [hΔ]
  unfold orthogonalDelta
  ring

entries.label: thm:n4c_realization_data
entries.title: the orthogonal quadrilateral is a moderate development
entries.chapter: The four-point converse: orthogonal diagonals, scaling, and cap bases
entries.body:
Under the hypotheses of \cref{lem:n4c_realizes_menger_orthogonal}, the
  length vector $\ell=\mathrm{fourProfile}(A,B,C,D)$ satisfies
  \[
    \mathrm{ModerateArc}\,0\,\kappa\,\ell,\qquad
    \mathrm{closureGap}\,\kappa\,\ell = 0,\qquad
    \mathrm{turningSum}\,\kappa\,\ell = 2\pi,
  \]
  and the development $\mathrm{polygonR2}\,\kappa\,\ell$ is simple.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.orthogonal_realization_data
lean.code:
theorem orthogonal_realization_data
    {k₀ k₁ k₂ k₃ a b c d A B C D : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hA : 0 < A) (hB : 0 < B) (hC : 0 < C) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hAsq : A ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) (hBsq : B ^ 2 = b ^ 2 + c ^ 2)
    (hCsq : C ^ 2 = c ^ 2 + d ^ 2) (hDsq : D ^ 2 = d ^ 2 + a ^ 2)
    (hk₀ : 2 * a / (A * D) = k₀) (hk₁ : 2 * b / (A * B) = k₁)
    (hk₂ : 2 * c / (B * C) = k₂) (hk₃ : 2 * d / (C * D) = k₃) :
    ModerateArc 0 (fourProfile k₀ k₁ k₂ k₃) (fourProfile A B C D) ∧
      closureGap (fourProfile k₀ k₁ k₂ k₃) (fourProfile A B C D) = 0 ∧
      turningSum (fourProfile k₀ k₁ k₂ k₃) (fourProfile A B C D) =
        2 * Real.pi ∧
      IsSimplePolygon
        (polygonR2 (fourProfile k₀ k₁ k₂ k₃) (fourProfile A B C D)) := by
  let ℓ : ZMod 4 → ℝ := fourProfile A B C D
  have hk₀pos : 0 < k₀ := by rw [← hk₀]; positivity
  have hk₁pos : 0 < k₁ := by rw [← hk₁]; positivity
  have hk₂pos : 0 < k₂ := by rw [← hk₂]; positivity
  have hk₃pos : 0 < k₃ := by rw [← hk₃]; positivity
  have haA : a < A := by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hb]
  have hbA : b < A := by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos ha]
  have hbB : b < B := by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hc]
  have hcB : c < B := by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hb]
  have hcC : c < C := by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hd]
  have hdC : d < C := by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hc]
  have hdD : d < D := by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos ha]
  have haD : a < D := by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hd]
  have hMA : ModerateArc 0 (fourProfile k₀ k₁ k₂ k₃) ℓ := by
    rw [moderateArc_zero_iff]
    intro i
    rcases zmod4_cases i with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · simp only [ℓ, fourProfile_zero]
      rw [abs_of_pos hk₀pos, ← hk₀]
      refine ⟨hA, ?_, ?_⟩
      · calc
          2 * a / (A * D) * (D / 2) = a / A := by field_simp
          _ < 1 := (div_lt_one hA).2 haA
      · calc
          2 * a / (A * D) * (A / 2) = a / D := by field_simp
          _ < 1 := (div_lt_one hD).2 haD
    · simp only [ℓ, fourProfile_one]
      rw [abs_of_pos hk₁pos, ← hk₁]
      refine ⟨hB, ?_, ?_⟩
      · calc
          2 * b / (A * B) * (A / 2) = b / B := by field_simp
          _ < 1 := (div_lt_one hB).2 hbB
      · calc
          2 * b / (A * B) * (B / 2) = b / A := by field_simp
          _ < 1 := (div_lt_one hA).2 hbA
    · simp only [ℓ, fourProfile_two]
      rw [abs_of_pos hk₂pos, ← hk₂]
      refine ⟨hC, ?_, ?_⟩
      · calc
          2 * c / (B * C) * (B / 2) = c / C := by field_simp
          _ < 1 := (div_lt_one hC).2 hcC
      · calc
          2 * c / (B * C) * (C / 2) = c / B := by field_simp
          _ < 1 := (div_lt_one hB).2 hcB
    · simp only [ℓ, fourProfile_three]
      rw [abs_of_pos hk₃pos, ← hk₃]
  -- … (truncated)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.fourArcSquareX_eq_one_of_right
lean.code:
lemma fourArcSquareX_eq_one_of_right {t : unitInterval}
    (ht : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 8 ∨ 7 / 8 ≤ (t : ℝ)) :
    fourArcSquareX t = 1 := by
  rcases ht with ht | ht
  · unfold fourArcSquareX
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith [t.2.1])]
    rw [min_eq_left (by linarith), max_eq_right (by norm_num)]
  · unfold fourArcSquareX

entries.title: the four open faces avoid the far edge
entries.chapter: The four-arc rectangle: boundary loops, sign windings, and interior zeros
entries.body:
On the \emph{open} right arc ($t\le\tfrac18$ or $t>\tfrac78$) one has
  $Y(t)>-1$; and cyclically for the other three arcs
  ($\mathrm{neg\_one\_lt\_fourArcSquareX\_of\_top}$,
  $\mathrm{fourArcSquareY\_lt\_one\_of\_left}$,
  $\mathrm{fourArcSquareX\_lt\_one\_of\_bottom}$).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.neg_one_lt_fourArcSquareY_of_right
lean.code:
lemma neg_one_lt_fourArcSquareY_of_right {t : unitInterval}
    (ht : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 8 ∨ 7 / 8 < (t : ℝ)) :
    -1 < fourArcSquareY t := by
  rcases ht with ht | ht
  · unfold fourArcSquareY
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
    rw [show 2 - -(8 * (t : ℝ) - 2) = 8 * (t : ℝ) by ring]
    have hinner : max (8 * (t : ℝ)) (8 * (t : ℝ) - 8) = 8 * (t : ℝ) :=
      max_eq_left (by linarith)
    rw [hinner, min_eq_right (by linarith), max_eq_right (by linarith [t.2.1])]
    norm_num at ht ⊢
    linarith [t.2.1]
  · unfold fourArcSquareY
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
    rw [show 2 - (8 * (t : ℝ) - 2) = 4 - 8 * (t : ℝ) by ring]
    have hinner : max (4 - 8 * (t : ℝ)) (8 * (t : ℝ) - 8) =
        8 * (t : ℝ) - 8 := max_eq_right (by linarith)
    rw [hinner, min_eq_right (by linarith [t.2.2]), max_eq_right (by linarith)]
    norm_num at ht ⊢
    linarith

entries.body:

  $t\mapsto\bigl(\mathrm{mid}(u_1,u_2;X(t)),\ \mathrm{mid}(v_1,v_2;Y(t))\bigr)$,
  where $\mathrm{mid}(a,b;s)$ is the affine reparameterization of $[-1,1]$

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.fourArcRectangleBoundary
lean.code:
noncomputable def fourArcRectangleBoundary
    (u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ : ℝ) : C(unitInterval, ℝ × ℝ) :=
  ⟨fun t ↦
      ((u₁ + u₂) / 2 + (u₂ - u₁) / 2 * fourArcSquareX t,
        (v₁ + v₂) / 2 + (v₂ - v₁) / 2 * fourArcSquareY t),
    (continuous_const.add
      (continuous_const.mul continuous_fourArcSquareX)).prodMk
      (continuous_const.add
        (continuous_const.mul continuous_fourArcSquareY))⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.fourArcRectangleBoundary_snd_gt_bottom_of_right
lean.code:
lemma fourArcRectangleBoundary_snd_gt_bottom_of_right
    {u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ : ℝ} (hv : v₁ < v₂) {t : unitInterval}
    (ht : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 8 ∨ 7 / 8 < (t : ℝ)) :

entries.label: lem:fad_rect_mem
entries.title: the loop stays in the closed rectangle
entries.chapter: The four-arc rectangle: boundary loops, sign windings, and interior zeros
entries.body:
If $u_1\le u_2$ and $v_1\le v_2$ then the boundary loop takes values in
  $[u_1,u_2]\times[v_1,v_2]$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.fourArcRectangleBoundary_mem
lean.code:
theorem fourArcRectangleBoundary_mem
    {u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ : ℝ} (hu : u₁ ≤ u₂) (hv : v₁ ≤ v₂)
    (t : unitInterval) :
    fourArcRectangleBoundary u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ t ∈
      Set.Icc u₁ u₂ ×ˢ Set.Icc v₁ v₂ := by
  have hx := fourArcSquareX_mem_Icc t
  have hy := fourArcSquareY_mem_Icc t
  have hdu : 0 ≤ u₂ - u₁ := sub_nonneg.mpr hu
  have hdv : 0 ≤ v₂ - v₁ := sub_nonneg.mpr hv
  have hxlo : 0 ≤ (u₂ - u₁) * (1 + fourArcSquareX t) :=
    mul_nonneg hdu (by linarith [hx.1])
  have hxhi : 0 ≤ (u₂ - u₁) * (1 - fourArcSquareX t) :=
    mul_nonneg hdu (by linarith [hx.2])
  have hylo : 0 ≤ (v₂ - v₁) * (1 + fourArcSquareY t) :=
    mul_nonneg hdv (by linarith [hy.1])
  have hyhi : 0 ≤ (v₂ - v₁) * (1 - fourArcSquareY t) :=
    mul_nonneg hdv (by linarith [hy.2])
  constructor
  · constructor <;>
      simp only [fourArcRectangleBoundary, ContinuousMap.coe_mk] <;>
      nlinarith
  · constructor <;>
      simp only [fourArcRectangleBoundary, ContinuousMap.coe_mk] <;>
      nlinarith

entries.label: def:fad_crossed_pattern
entries.title: crossed four-arc sign pattern
entries.chapter: The four-arc rectangle: boundary loops, sign windings, and interior zeros
entries.body:
A loop $\gamma$ in $\mathbb{C}$ has the \emph{crossed four-arc signs} when
  \begin{align*}
    \Im\gamma(t)&<0 &&\text{for } t\le\tfrac18 \text{ or } \tfrac78<t,\\
    \Re\gamma(t)&<0 &&\text{for } \tfrac18\le t<\tfrac38,\\
    \Re\gamma(t)&>0 &&\text{for } \tfrac38<t\le\tfrac58,\\
    \Im\gamma(t)&>0 &&\text{for } \tfrac58\le t<\tfrac78,
  \end{align*}
  together with the two corner conditions $\Im\gamma(\tfrac38)<0$ and
  $\Re\gamma(\tfrac78)<0$.

entries.label: thm:fad_ne_zero
entries.title: crossed signs exclude the origin
entries.chapter: The four-arc rectangle: boundary loops, sign windings, and interior zeros
entries.body: A loop with the crossed four-arc signs is nowhere zero.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.ne_zero_of_crossed_fourArcs
lean.code:
theorem ne_zero_of_crossed_fourArcs
    (gamma : C(unitInterval, ℂ))
    (hright : ∀ t : unitInterval,
      ((t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 8 ∨ 7 / 8 < (t : ℝ)) → (gamma t).im < 0)
    (htop : ∀ t : unitInterval,
      1 / 8 ≤ (t : ℝ) → (t : ℝ) < 3 / 8 → (gamma t).re < 0)
    (hleft : ∀ t : unitInterval,
      3 / 8 < (t : ℝ) → (t : ℝ) ≤ 5 / 8 → 0 < (gamma t).re)
    (hbottom : ∀ t : unitInterval,
      5 / 8 ≤ (t : ℝ) → (t : ℝ) < 7 / 8 → 0 < (gamma t).im)
    (htopLeft : ∀ t : unitInterval, (t : ℝ) = 3 / 8 → (gamma t).im < 0)
    (hbottomRight : ∀ t : unitInterval, (t : ℝ) = 7 / 8 → (gamma t).re < 0) :
    ∀ t, gamma t ≠ 0 := by
  intro t hzero
  have hre : (gamma t).re = 0 := by simpa using congrArg Complex.re hzero
  have him : (gamma t).im = 0 := by simpa using congrArg Complex.im hzero
  by_cases h1 : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 8
  · linarith [hright t (Or.inl h1)]
  by_cases h3 : (t : ℝ) < 3 / 8
  · linarith [htop t (by linarith) h3]
  by_cases he3 : (t : ℝ) = 3 / 8
  · linarith [htopLeft t he3]
  have ht3 : 3 / 8 < (t : ℝ) :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h3) (Ne.symm he3)
  by_cases h5 : (t : ℝ) ≤ 5 / 8
  · linarith [hleft t ht3 h5]
  by_cases h7 : (t : ℝ) < 7 / 8
  · linarith [hbottom t (by linarith) h7]
  by_cases he7 : (t : ℝ) = 7 / 8
  · linarith [hbottomRight t he7]
  · have ht7 : 7 / 8 < (t : ℝ) :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h7) (Ne.symm he7)
    linarith [hright t (Or.inr ht7)]

entries.label: thm:fad_winding_one
entries.title: crossed signs give winding number one
entries.chapter: The four-arc rectangle: boundary loops, sign windings, and interior zeros
entries.body:
A nowhere-zero loop $\gamma$ with $\gamma(0)=\gamma(1)$ and the crossed
  four-arc signs has $\mathrm{windingNumberC}\,\gamma = 1$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.windingNumberC_eq_one_of_crossed_fourArcs
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberC_eq_one_of_crossed_fourArcs
    (gamma : C(unitInterval, ℂ)) (hgamma : ∀ t, gamma t ≠ 0)
    (hloop : gamma 0 = gamma 1)
    (hright : ∀ t : unitInterval,
      ((t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 8 ∨ 7 / 8 < (t : ℝ)) → (gamma t).im < 0)
    (htop : ∀ t : unitInterval,
      1 / 8 ≤ (t : ℝ) → (t : ℝ) < 3 / 8 → (gamma t).re < 0)
    (hleft : ∀ t : unitInterval,
      3 / 8 < (t : ℝ) → (t : ℝ) ≤ 5 / 8 → 0 < (gamma t).re)
    (hbottom : ∀ t : unitInterval,
      5 / 8 ≤ (t : ℝ) → (t : ℝ) < 7 / 8 → 0 < (gamma t).im)
    (htopLeft : ∀ t : unitInterval, (t : ℝ) = 3 / 8 → (gamma t).im < 0)
    (hbottomRight : ∀ t : unitInterval, (t : ℝ) = 7 / 8 → (gamma t).re < 0) :
    Gluck.windingNumberC gamma hgamma = 1 := by
  let H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, ℂ) :=
    ⟨fun st ↦ crossedFourArcModel st.2 +
      (st.1 : ℝ) • (gamma st.2 - crossedFourArcModel st.2), by fun_prop⟩
  have hH : ∀ st, H st ≠ 0 := fun st ↦ crossed_four_arc_line_homotopy_ne_aux
    gamma hright htop hleft hbottom htopLeft hbottomRight st.1 st.2
  have hzero : ∀ t, H (0, t) = crossedFourArcModel t := by
    intro t
    simp [H]
  have hone : ∀ t, H (1, t) = gamma t := by
    intro t
    simp [H]
  have hHloop : ∀ s, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1) := by
    intro s
    simp only [H, ContinuousMap.coe_mk]
    rw [crossed_four_arc_model_loop_aux, hloop]
  have hwind := Gluck.windingNumberC_eq_of_homotopy crossedFourArcModel gamma
    crossed_four_arc_model_ne_aux hgamma H hH hzero hone hHloop
  exact hwind ▸ crossed_four_arc_model_winding_aux

entries.label: thm:fad_exists_zero
entries.title: nonzero winding forces an interior zero
entries.chapter: The four-arc rectangle: boundary loops, sign windings, and interior zeros
entries.body:
Let $u_1<u_2$, $v_1<v_2$ and let $F$ be continuous on the closed rectangle.
  If the boundary loop of $F$ is nowhere zero and has nonzero winding number,
  then $F$ has a zero in the \emph{open} rectangle.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.exists_zero_of_fourArcRectangleBoundary_winding
lean.code:
theorem exists_zero_of_fourArcRectangleBoundary_winding
    {u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ : ℝ} (hu : u₁ < u₂) (hv : v₁ < v₂)
    {F : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ}
    (hF : ContinuousOn F (Set.Icc u₁ u₂ ×ˢ Set.Icc v₁ v₂))
    (gamma : C(unitInterval, ℂ)) (hgamma : ∀ t, gamma t ≠ 0)
    (hgammaEq : ∀ t, gamma t =
      F (fourArcRectangleBoundary u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ t))
    (hwind : Gluck.windingNumberC gamma hgamma ≠ 0) :
    ∃ z ∈ Set.Ioo u₁ u₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo v₁ v₂, F z = 0 := by
  by_contra hnot
  push Not at hnot
  exact hwind (windingNumberC_eq_zero_of_no_interior_zero_aux
    hu hv hF gamma hgamma hgammaEq hnot)

entries.label: thm:wc_enters_all
entries.title: one curve enters all active walls at once
entries.chapter: Opening dormant edges
entries.body:
With finitely many walls and a single $v\in\ker f'$ which is strictly inward
  for every one of them, one curve on the exact fibre enters all of them
  simultaneously.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.regularWallZero_entersAllInteriors
lean.code:
theorem regularWallZero_entersAllInteriors
    {ι E F : Type*} [Finite ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    {f : E → F} {f' : E →L[ℝ] F} {a v : E}
    {w : ι → E → ℝ} {w' : ι → E →L[ℝ] ℝ}
    (hf : HasStrictFDerivAt f f' a)
    (hsurj : f'.range = ⊤)
    (hv : v ∈ f'.ker)
    (hw : ∀ i, HasFDerivAt (w i) (w' i) a)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < w' i v) :
    ∃ (γ : ℝ → E) (ε : ℝ),
      0 < ε ∧
      γ 0 = a ∧
      HasDerivAt γ v 0 ∧
      Tendsto γ (𝓝 0) (𝓝 a) ∧
      ∀ t, 0 < t → t < ε →
        f (γ t) = f a ∧ ∀ i, w i a < w i (γ t) := by
  let q : f'.ker := ⟨v, hv⟩
  let γ : ℝ → E := fun t =>
    hf.implicitFunction f f' hsurj (f a) (t • q)
  have hγ0 : γ 0 = a := by
    simp [γ, hf.implicitFunction_apply_image hsurj]
  have hq_deriv : HasStrictDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t • q) q 0 := by
    simpa using ((hasStrictDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) (0 : ℝ)).smul_const q)
  have hq_tendsto : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t • q) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [ContinuousAt, zero_smul] using hq_deriv.hasDerivAt.continuousAt
  have hγ_tendsto : Tendsto γ (𝓝 0) (𝓝 a) := by
    simpa [γ] using
      (hf.tendsto_implicitFunction hsurj
        (g₁ := fun _ : ℝ => f a) (g₂ := fun t : ℝ => t • q)
        tendsto_const_nhds hq_tendsto)
  have hγ_deriv : HasDerivAt γ v 0 := by
    simpa [γ, q, Function.comp_def] using
      ((hf.to_implicitFunction hsurj).comp_hasStrictDerivAt_of_eq 0 hq_deriv (by simp)).hasDerivAt
  have hlevel : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, f (γ t) = f a := by
    have hp : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (f a, t • q)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (f a, 0)) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds.prodMk_nhds hq_tendsto
    simpa [γ] using hp.eventually (hf.map_implicitFunction_eq hsurj)
  have hwall : ∀ i, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => w i (γ t)) (w' i v) 0 := by
    intro i
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using
      (hw i).comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hγ_deriv hγ0.symm
  have hwall_good : ∀ i, ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), w i a < w i (γ t) := by
    intro i
    have hslope :
        Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹ * (w i (γ t) - w i (γ 0)))
          (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (w' i v)) := by
      simpa [smul_eq_mul] using (hwall i).tendsto_slope_zero_right
    filter_upwards [hslope.eventually_const_lt (hpos i), self_mem_nhdsWithin]
      with t hs ht
    have hinv : 0 < t⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr ht
    have hdiff : 0 < w i (γ t) - w i (γ 0) :=
      pos_of_mul_pos_right hs hinv.le
    rw [hγ0] at hdiff
    exact sub_pos.mp hdiff
  have hgood :
      ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), f (γ t) = f a ∧ ∀ i, w i a < w i (γ t) := by
    filter_upwards [hlevel.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds,
      Filter.eventually_all.2 hwall_good] with t hft hwt
  -- … (truncated)

entries.label: thm:wc_purification
entries.title: active-wall purification
entries.chapter: Opening dormant edges
entries.body:
Suppose all slacks are nonnegative at $a$ and the inward condition
  $0<w'_i v$ is imposed \emph{only} for the walls with $w_i(a)=0$.  Then the
  same conclusion holds: one exact-fibre curve makes \emph{every} slack
  strictly positive for small positive time.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.regularActiveWallZero_entersStrictDomain
lean.code:
theorem regularActiveWallZero_entersStrictDomain
    {ι E F : Type*} [Finite ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    {f : E → F} {f' : E →L[ℝ] F} {a v : E}
    {w : ι → E → ℝ} {w' : ι → E →L[ℝ] ℝ}
    (hf : HasStrictFDerivAt f f' a)
    (hsurj : f'.range = ⊤)
    (hv : v ∈ f'.ker)
    (hw : ∀ i, HasFDerivAt (w i) (w' i) a)
    (hclosed : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i a)
    (hinward : ∀ i, w i a = 0 → 0 < w' i v) :
    ∃ (γ : ℝ → E) (ε : ℝ),
      0 < ε ∧
      γ 0 = a ∧
      HasDerivAt γ v 0 ∧
      Tendsto γ (𝓝 0) (𝓝 a) ∧
      ∀ t, 0 < t → t < ε →
        f (γ t) = f a ∧ ∀ i, 0 < w i (γ t) := by
  let q : f'.ker := ⟨v, hv⟩
  let γ : ℝ → E := fun t =>
    hf.implicitFunction f f' hsurj (f a) (t • q)
  have hγ0 : γ 0 = a := by
    simp [γ, hf.implicitFunction_apply_image hsurj]
  have hq_deriv : HasStrictDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t • q) q 0 := by
    simpa using ((hasStrictDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) (0 : ℝ)).smul_const q)
  have hq_tendsto : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t • q) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [ContinuousAt, zero_smul] using hq_deriv.hasDerivAt.continuousAt
  have hγ_tendsto : Tendsto γ (𝓝 0) (𝓝 a) := by
    simpa [γ] using
      (hf.tendsto_implicitFunction hsurj
        (g₁ := fun _ : ℝ => f a) (g₂ := fun t : ℝ => t • q)
        tendsto_const_nhds hq_tendsto)
  have hγ_deriv : HasDerivAt γ v 0 := by
    simpa [γ, q, Function.comp_def] using
      ((hf.to_implicitFunction hsurj).comp_hasStrictDerivAt_of_eq 0 hq_deriv (by simp)).hasDerivAt
  have hlevel : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, f (γ t) = f a := by
    have hp : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (f a, t • q)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (f a, 0)) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds.prodMk_nhds hq_tendsto
    simpa [γ] using hp.eventually (hf.map_implicitFunction_eq hsurj)
  have hstrict : ∀ i, ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), 0 < w i (γ t) := by
    intro i
    rcases eq_or_ne (w i a) 0 with hactive | hinactive
    · have hwall : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => w i (γ t)) (w' i v) 0 := by
        simpa [Function.comp_def] using
          (hw i).comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hγ_deriv hγ0.symm
      have hslope :
          Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹ * (w i (γ t) - w i (γ 0)))
            (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (w' i v)) := by
        simpa [smul_eq_mul] using hwall.tendsto_slope_zero_right
      filter_upwards [hslope.eventually_const_lt (hinward i hactive),
        self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t hs ht
      have hinv : 0 < t⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr ht
      have hdiff : 0 < w i (γ t) - w i (γ 0) :=
        pos_of_mul_pos_right hs hinv.le
      rw [hγ0, hactive] at hdiff
      simpa using hdiff
    · have hbase : 0 < w i a := lt_of_le_of_ne (hclosed i) (Ne.symm hinactive)
      have hcont : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => w i (γ t)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (w i a)) := by
        have hwcont : ContinuousAt (w i) a := (hw i).continuousAt
  -- … (truncated)

entries.label: lem:wc_dormant_walls
entries.title: sub-cap lengths satisfy the arcsine walls
entries.chapter: Opening dormant edges
entries.body:
If $\kappa$ is positive and $0\le\ell_i<\mathrm{edgeCap}(\kappa)_i$ for every
  $i$, then $|\kappa_i\ell_{i-1}/2|<1$ and $|\kappa_i\ell_i/2|<1$ for every $i$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.strict_arc_walls_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap
lean.code:
lemma strict_arc_walls_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap [NeZero n]
    {kappa ell : ZMod n → ℝ} (hkappa : ∀ i, 0 < kappa i)
    (hell : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ell i ∧ ell i < edgeCap kappa i) :
    ∀ i, |kappa i * (ell (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧
      |kappa i * (ell i / 2)| < 1 := by
  intro i
  constructor
  · have hraw := endpoint_wall_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap
      (e := i - 1) (c := kappa i) (t := ell (i - 1)) (hkappa i)
      (by simp) (hell (i - 1)).1 (hell (i - 1)).2
    rw [abs_of_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (hkappa i).le (div_nonneg (hell (i - 1)).1 zero_le_two))]
    exact hraw
  · have hraw := endpoint_wall_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap
      (e := i) (c := kappa i) (t := ell i) (hkappa i)
      (le_max_left (kappa i) (kappa (i + 1))) (hell i).1 (hell i).2
    rw [abs_of_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (hkappa i).le (div_nonneg (hell i).1 zero_le_two))]
    exact hraw

entries.label: thm:wc_dormant_deriv
entries.title: the length controller is strictly differentiable at zero lengths
entries.chapter: Opening dormant edges
entries.body:
Under the same hypotheses, $L\mapsto\mathrm{closureMapR3}(\kappa,L)$ has a
  strict derivative at $\ell$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.lengthClosureMap_hasStrictFDerivAt_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap
lean.code:
theorem lengthClosureMap_hasStrictFDerivAt_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap [NeZero n]
    {kappa ell : ZMod n → ℝ} (hkappa : ∀ i, 0 < kappa i)
    (hell : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ell i ∧ ell i < edgeCap kappa i) :
    HasStrictFDerivAt (fun L ↦ closureMapR3 (kappa, L))
      (fderiv ℝ (fun L ↦ closureMapR3 (kappa, L)) ell) ell := by
  have hw := strict_arc_walls_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap hkappa hell
  have hE := contDiffAt_closureGap_lengths (κ := kappa) (ℓ := ell) hw
  have hT := contDiffAt_turningSum_lengths (κ := kappa) (ℓ := ell) hw
  have hC : ContDiffAt ℝ 1
      (fun L ↦ (closureGap kappa L, turningSum kappa L - 2 * Real.pi)) ell :=
    hE.prodMk (hT.sub contDiffAt_const)
  simpa only [closureMapR3] using hC.hasStrictFDerivAt one_ne_zero
