entries.label: thm:wc_dormant_opens
entries.title: a regular dormant anchor opens
entries.chapter: Opening dormant edges
entries.body:
Let $n\ge3$, $\kappa$ positive, $0\le\ell<\mathrm{edgeCap}$, and
  $\mathrm{closureMapR3}(\kappa,\ell)=0$.  If the controller derivative at
  $\ell$ is surjective and some kernel vector $v$ has $v_i>0$ at every
  collapsed coordinate $\ell_i=0$, then $\mathrm{RealizesR2}\,\kappa$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.realizesR2_of_regular_dormant_anchor
lean.code:
theorem realizesR2_of_regular_dormant_anchor [NeZero n]
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) {kappa ell v : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hkappa : ∀ i, 0 < kappa i)
    (hell : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ell i ∧ ell i < edgeCap kappa i)
    (hzero : closureMapR3 (kappa, ell) = 0)
    {F' : (ZMod n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℂ × ℝ}
    (hF : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun L ↦ closureMapR3 (kappa, L)) F' ell)
    (hsurj : F'.range = ⊤) (hv : v ∈ F'.ker)
    (hvinward : ∀ i, ell i = 0 → 0 < v i) :
    RealizesR2 kappa := by
  let w : (ZMod n ⊕ ZMod n) → (ZMod n → ℝ) → ℝ
    | Sum.inl i => fun L ↦ L i
    | Sum.inr i => fun L ↦ edgeCap kappa i - L i
  let w' : (ZMod n ⊕ ZMod n) → (ZMod n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ
    | Sum.inl i => ContinuousLinearMap.proj i
    | Sum.inr i => -(ContinuousLinearMap.proj i)
  have hw : ∀ i, HasFDerivAt (w i) (w' i) ell := by
    intro i
    rcases i with i | i
    · simpa [w, w'] using (hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) i ell)
    · simpa [w, w'] using
        (hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) i ell).const_sub (edgeCap kappa i)
  have hclosed : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i ell := by
    intro i
    rcases i with i | i
    · simpa [w] using (hell i).1
    · simpa [w] using (sub_nonneg.mpr (hell i).2.le)
  have hinward : ∀ i, w i ell = 0 → 0 < w' i v := by
    intro i
    rcases i with i | i
    · intro hi
      simpa [w, w'] using hvinward i (by simpa [w] using hi)
    · intro hi
      have hi' : edgeCap kappa i - ell i = 0 := by simpa [w] using hi
      exfalso
      linarith [(hell i).2]
  obtain ⟨gamma, eps, heps, _hgamma0, _hgammaDeriv, _hgammaLim, hgood⟩ :=
    regularActiveWallZero_entersStrictDomain
      (ι := ZMod n ⊕ ZMod n) hF hsurj hv hw hclosed hinward
  have ht : eps / 2 ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) eps :=
    ⟨half_pos heps, half_lt_self heps⟩
  obtain ⟨hlevel, hwalls⟩ := hgood (eps / 2) ht.1 ht.2
  have hbounds : ∀ i, 0 < gamma (eps / 2) i ∧
      gamma (eps / 2) i < edgeCap kappa i := by
    intro i
    have hlow := hwalls (Sum.inl i)
    have hupp := hwalls (Sum.inr i)
    change 0 < gamma (eps / 2) i at hlow
    change 0 < edgeCap kappa i - gamma (eps / 2) i at hupp
    exact ⟨hlow, sub_pos.mp hupp⟩
  have hMA : ModerateArc 0 kappa (gamma (eps / 2)) :=
    (moderateArc_zero_iff_edge hkappa).2 hbounds
  have hzero' : closureMapR3 (kappa, gamma (eps / 2)) = 0 :=
    hlevel.trans hzero
  exact realizesR2_of_mem_collarInterior hn
    (S := Set.univ) ⟨Set.mem_univ _, hMA, hzero'⟩ hkappa

entries.label: cor:wc_dormant_active_surj
entries.title: surjectivity away from the collapsed coordinates suffices
entries.chapter: Opening dormant edges
entries.body:
It is enough that every controller target be produced by a correction
  supported away from the collapsed coordinates.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.realizesR2_of_regular_dormant_anchor_of_active_surj
lean.code:
theorem realizesR2_of_regular_dormant_anchor_of_active_surj [NeZero n]
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) {kappa ell : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hkappa : ∀ i, 0 < kappa i)
    (hell : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ell i ∧ ell i < edgeCap kappa i)
    (hzero : closureMapR3 (kappa, ell) = 0)
    (hactive : ∀ y : ℂ × ℝ, ∃ b : ZMod n → ℝ,
      fderiv ℝ (fun L ↦ closureMapR3 (kappa, L)) ell b = y ∧
        ∀ i, ell i = 0 → b i = 0) :
    RealizesR2 kappa := by
  let F' := fderiv ℝ (fun L ↦ closureMapR3 (kappa, L)) ell
  have hF : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun L ↦ closureMapR3 (kappa, L)) F' ell :=
    lengthClosureMap_hasStrictFDerivAt_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap hkappa hell
  have hsurj : F'.range = ⊤ := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top]
    intro y
    obtain ⟨b, hb, _⟩ := hactive y
    exact ⟨b, by simpa [F'] using hb⟩
  let d : ZMod n → ℝ := fun i ↦ if ell i = 0 then 1 else 0
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbzero⟩ := hactive (-F' d)
  let v := d + b
  have hv : v ∈ F'.ker := by
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
    change F' (d + b) = 0
    rw [map_add]
    change F' b = -F' d at hb
    rw [hb, add_neg_cancel]
  have hvinward : ∀ i, ell i = 0 → 0 < v i := by
    intro i hi
    change 0 < d i + b i
    rw [show d i = 1 by simp [d, hi], hbzero i hi]
    norm_num
  exact realizesR2_of_regular_dormant_anchor hn hkappa hell hzero
    hF hsurj hv hvinward

entries.label: def:tab_problem2
entries.title: Tabachnikov's Problem 2 at length $n$
entries.chapter: Tabachnikov's Problem 2 as one named proposition
entries.body:
For $n$ with $\mathrm{NeZero}\,n$,
  \[
    \mathrm{TP2}(n) \;:\equiv\;
      \forall \kappa : \mathbb{Z}/n \to \mathbb{R},\
        \operatorname{DiscreteFourVertexPos}(\kappa)
        \Rightarrow \operatorname{RealizesR2}(\kappa) .
  \]
  In words: every positive cyclic curvature word of length $n$ which is
  constant or admits a strict four-vertex window at a positive level is
  realized by a simple moderate-arc Euclidean $n$-gon with those signed
  Menger curvatures.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.TabachnikovProblem2
lean.code:
def TabachnikovProblem2 (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] : Prop :=
  ∀ κ : ZMod n → ℝ, DiscreteFourVertexPos κ → RealizesR2 κ

entries.label: def:tab_two_max_runs
entries.title: two distinct plateau maxima
entries.chapter: Tabachnikov's Problem 2 as one named proposition
entries.body:
$\mathrm{HasTwoPlateauMaxRuns}\,\kappa$ holds when there are $\mathbb{N}$-lifts
  $a_1, k_1, a_2, k_2$ with $k_1 < n$, $k_2 < n$,
  $\mathrm{PlateauMaxRun}\,\kappa\,a_1\,k_1$,
  $\mathrm{PlateauMaxRun}\,\kappa\,a_2\,k_2$, and the two runs disjoint as
  residues: $(a_1 + m_1) \ne (a_2 + m_2)$ in $\ZMod n$ for all $m_1 \le k_1$
  and $m_2 \le k_2$.  This is Dahlberg's ``$\kappa$ has at least two distinct
  local maxima'', transcribed.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HasTwoPlateauMaxRuns
lean.code:
def HasTwoPlateauMaxRuns (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ a₁ k₁ a₂ k₂ : ℕ, k₁ < n ∧ k₂ < n ∧
    PlateauMaxRun κ a₁ k₁ ∧ PlateauMaxRun κ a₂ k₂ ∧
    ∀ m₁, m₁ ≤ k₁ → ∀ m₂, m₂ ≤ k₂ →
      ((a₁ + m₁ : ℕ) : ZMod n) ≠ ((a₂ + m₂ : ℕ) : ZMod n)

entries.label: def:tab_two_min_runs
entries.title: two distinct plateau minima
entries.chapter: Tabachnikov's Problem 2 as one named proposition
entries.body:
As \cref{def:tab_two_max_runs} with $\mathrm{PlateauMinRun}$ in place of
  $\mathrm{PlateauMaxRun}$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HasTwoPlateauMinRuns
lean.code:
def HasTwoPlateauMinRuns (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ a₁ k₁ a₂ k₂ : ℕ, k₁ < n ∧ k₂ < n ∧
    PlateauMinRun κ a₁ k₁ ∧ PlateauMinRun κ a₂ k₂ ∧
    ∀ m₁, m₁ ≤ k₁ → ∀ m₂, m₂ ≤ k₂ →
      ((a₁ + m₁ : ℕ) : ZMod n) ≠ ((a₂ + m₂ : ℕ) : ZMod n)

entries.label: def:tab_extrema_class
entries.title: the extremum-form hypothesis class
entries.chapter: Tabachnikov's Problem 2 as one named proposition
entries.body:
$\mathrm{DiscreteFourVertexExtrema}\,\kappa$ holds when $\kappa_i > 0$ for
  all $i$ and either $\kappa$ is constant, or $\kappa$ has two distinct
  plateau maxima \emph{and} two distinct plateau minima.  This is the
  positive-curvature form of the conclusion class of Dahlberg's Theorem 1,
  used as a hypothesis.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.DiscreteFourVertexExtrema

entries.label: lem:tab_dfv_level_pos
entries.title: a window level of a positive profile is positive
entries.chapter: Tabachnikov's Problem 2 as one named proposition
entries.body: If $\mathrm{DFV}(\kappa; c)$ and $\kappa_i > 0$ for all $i$, then $c > 0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.DFV.pos_of_pos
lean.code:
theorem DFV.pos_of_pos {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (h : DFV κ c)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < κ i) : 0 < c := by
  obtain ⟨_, i₂, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, h2, _, _⟩ := h
  exact lt_trans (hpos ((i₂ : ℕ) : ZMod n)) h2

entries.label: thm:tab_dfv_of_two_max_runs
entries.title: two distinct plateau maxima produce a window level
entries.chapter: Tabachnikov's Problem 2 as one named proposition
entries.body:
Let $n \ne 0$ and let $\kappa : \ZMod n \to \mathbb{R}$ satisfy
  $\mathrm{HasTwoPlateauMaxRuns}\,\kappa$.  Then $\mathrm{DFV}(\kappa; c)$
  holds for some $c$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.exists_dfv_of_two_plateauMaxRun
lean.code:
theorem exists_dfv_of_two_plateauMaxRun [NeZero n] {κ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (h : HasTwoPlateauMaxRuns κ) : ∃ c, DFV κ c := by
  obtain ⟨a₁, k₁, a₂, k₂, -, -, h₁, h₂, hdisj⟩ := h
  rcases le_total (κ (a₁ : ZMod n)) (κ (a₂ : ZMod n)) with hle | hle
  · exact exists_dfv_of_two_plateauMaxRun_aux h₁ hdisj hle
  · exact exists_dfv_of_two_plateauMaxRun_aux h₂
      (fun m₂ hm₂ m₁ hm₁ => (hdisj m₁ hm₁ m₂ hm₂).symm) hle

entries.label: thm:tab_pos_iff_extrema
entries.title: the level form and the extremum form define the same class
entries.chapter: Tabachnikov's Problem 2 as one named proposition
entries.body:
For $n \ne 0$ and any $\kappa : \ZMod n \to \mathbb{R}$,
  \[
    \mathrm{DiscreteFourVertexPos}\,\kappa
    \iff
    \mathrm{DiscreteFourVertexExtrema}\,\kappa .
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.discreteFourVertexPos_iff_extrema
lean.code:
theorem discreteFourVertexPos_iff_extrema [NeZero n] {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} :
    DiscreteFourVertexPos κ ↔ DiscreteFourVertexExtrema κ := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hpos, hconst | ⟨c, -, hdfv⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨hpos, Or.inl hconst⟩
    · exact ⟨hpos, Or.inr ⟨hdfv.plateau_extrema.1, hdfv.plateau_extrema.2⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨hpos, hconst | ⟨hmax, -⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨hpos, Or.inl hconst⟩
    · obtain ⟨c, hdfv⟩ := exists_dfv_of_two_plateauMaxRun hmax
      exact ⟨hpos, Or.inr ⟨c, hdfv.pos_of_pos hpos, hdfv⟩⟩

entries.label: cor:tab_problem2_extrema_form
entries.title: Problem 2 in Dahlberg's extremum form
entries.chapter: Tabachnikov's Problem 2 as one named proposition
entries.body:
For $n \ne 0$,
  \[
    \mathrm{TP2}(n)
    \iff
    \bigl(\forall \kappa,\ \mathrm{DiscreteFourVertexExtrema}\,\kappa
      \Rightarrow \mathrm{RealizesR2}\,\kappa \bigr).
  \]
  So the named proposition of this chapter is the literature's problem, not a
  value-separated approximation to it.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.tabachnikovProblem2_iff_extrema_form
lean.code:
theorem tabachnikovProblem2_iff_extrema_form [NeZero n] :
    TabachnikovProblem2 n ↔
      ∀ κ : ZMod n → ℝ, DiscreteFourVertexExtrema κ → RealizesR2 κ := by
  constructor
  · exact fun h κ hκ => h κ (discreteFourVertexPos_iff_extrema.mpr hκ)
  · exact fun h κ hκ => h κ (discreteFourVertexPos_iff_extrema.mp hκ)

entries.label: lem:n6mr_max_run_len_zero
entries.title: an adjacent-unequal word has no nontrivial plateau maximum
entries.chapter: Plateau and strict extrema
entries.body:
If $f_i \ne f_{i+1}$ for every $i$ and $\mathrm{PlateauMaxRun}\,f\,a\,k$
  holds, then $k = 0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.PlateauMaxRun.eq_zero_of_ne_succ
lean.code:
lemma PlateauMaxRun.eq_zero_of_ne_succ {n : ℕ} {f : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hne : ∀ i, f i ≠ f (i + 1)) {a k : ℕ} (h : PlateauMaxRun f a k) :
    k = 0 := by
  by_contra hk
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hk
  have hc := h.1 1 hk1
  rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hc
  exact hne (a : ZMod n) hc.symm

entries.label: lem:n6mr_max_run_strict
entries.title: a plateau maximum of an adjacent-unequal word is strict
entries.chapter: Plateau and strict extrema
entries.body:
If $f_i \ne f_{i+1}$ for every $i$ and $\mathrm{PlateauMaxRun}\,f\,a\,k$
  holds, then the residue of $a$ is a strict local maximum of $f$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.PlateauMaxRun.isStrictLocalMax_of_ne_succ
lean.code:
lemma PlateauMaxRun.isStrictLocalMax_of_ne_succ {n : ℕ} {f : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hne : ∀ i, f i ≠ f (i + 1)) {a k : ℕ} (h : PlateauMaxRun f a k) :
    IsStrictLocalMax f (a : ZMod n) := by
  have hk := h.eq_zero_of_ne_succ hne
  subst k
  exact ⟨h.2.1, by simpa [Nat.cast_add] using h.2.2⟩

entries.label: thm:n6mr_two_strict_max
entries.title: a window gives two distinct strict local maxima
entries.chapter: Plateau and strict extrema
entries.body:
Let $\mathrm{DFV}(w; c)$ hold and let $w_i \ne w_{i+1}$ for every $i$.
  Then there are $i \ne j$ in $\ZMod n$, both strict local maxima of $w$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.DFV.exists_two_strictLocalMax
lean.code:
theorem DFV.exists_two_strictLocalMax {n : ℕ} {w : ZMod n → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (h : DFV w c) (hne : ∀ i, w i ≠ w (i + 1)) :
    ∃ i j, i ≠ j ∧ IsStrictLocalMax w i ∧ IsStrictLocalMax w j := by
  obtain ⟨a, k, b, l, _hk, _hl, ha, hb, hab⟩ := h.plateau_extrema.1
  have hk0 := ha.eq_zero_of_ne_succ hne
  have hl0 := hb.eq_zero_of_ne_succ hne
  subst k
  subst l
  refine ⟨(a : ZMod n), (b : ZMod n), ?_,
    ha.isStrictLocalMax_of_ne_succ hne, hb.isStrictLocalMax_of_ne_succ hne⟩
  simpa using hab 0 (by omega) 0 (by omega)

entries.label: detail:discrete-controller-smooth
entries.title: Smoothness of the development inside the strict walls
entries.chapter: Polygon geometry and the radius formulation
entries.body:
Fix a curvature vector $\kappa$ and a length vector $\ell$. If every incident
arcsine argument has absolute value less than one, then the turning angles,
cumulative headings, total turn, and complex closure gap are $C^1$ in $\ell$
near this vector, even when some entries of $\ell$ vanish.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.contDiffAt_turningAngle_lengths
lean.code:
theorem contDiffAt_turningAngle_lengths [NeZero n]
    {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (i : ZMod n)
    (hw1 : |κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)| < 1)
    (hw2 : |κ i * (ℓ i / 2)| < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => turningAngle 0 κ L i) ℓ := by
  rw [abs_lt] at hw1 hw2
  have hlin1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1
      (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => κ i * (L (i - 1) / 2)) ℓ := by
    fun_prop
  have hlin2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1
      (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => κ i * (L i / 2)) ℓ := by
    fun_prop
  have ha1 := (Real.contDiffAt_arcsin (ne_of_gt hw1.1)
    (ne_of_lt hw1.2)).comp ℓ hlin1
  have ha2 := (Real.contDiffAt_arcsin (ne_of_gt hw2.1)
    (ne_of_lt hw2.2)).comp ℓ hlin2
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, turningAngle, tK_zero] using ha1.add ha2

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.contDiffAt_closureGap_lengths
lean.code:
theorem contDiffAt_closureGap_lengths [NeZero n]
    {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ i : ZMod n,
      |κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧ |κ i * (ℓ i / 2)| < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => closureGap κ L) ℓ := by
  unfold closureGap vertexR2
  apply ContDiffAt.sum
  intro j hj
  have hheading : ContDiffAt ℝ 1
      (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => heading κ L j) ℓ := by
    apply contDiffAt_heading_lengths j
    intro m hm
    exact hw (m : ZMod n)
  have hlength : ContDiffAt ℝ 1
      (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => (L (j : ZMod n) : ℂ)) ℓ :=
    Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp ℓ (by fun_prop)
  have hheadingC : ContDiffAt ℝ 1
      (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => (heading κ L j : ℂ)) ℓ :=
    Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp ℓ hheading
  exact hlength.mul ((hheadingC.mul contDiffAt_const).cexp)

/-! ## The opening theorem -/

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.contDiffAt_turningSum_lengths
lean.code:
theorem contDiffAt_turningSum_lengths [NeZero n]
    {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ i : ZMod n,
      |κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧ |κ i * (ℓ i / 2)| < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => turningSum κ L) ℓ := by
  unfold turningSum
  exact ContDiffAt.sum fun i _ =>
    contDiffAt_turningAngle_lengths i (hw i).1 (hw i).2

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.contDiffAt_heading_lengths
lean.code:
theorem contDiffAt_heading_lengths [NeZero n]
    {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (j : ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ m ∈ Finset.range (j + 1),
      |κ (m : ZMod n) * (ℓ ((m : ZMod n) - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧
        |κ (m : ZMod n) * (ℓ (m : ZMod n) / 2)| < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => heading κ L j) ℓ := by
  unfold heading
  exact ContDiffAt.sum fun m hm =>
    contDiffAt_turningAngle_lengths (m : ZMod n) (hw m hm).1 (hw m hm).2

entries.label: detail:discrete-secant-square
entries.title: Hopf's secant-square identity
entries.chapter: Polygon geometry and the radius formulation
entries.body:
For two disjoint closed segments $AB$ and $CD$, write
$\operatorname{turn}(u,w)=\arg(w/u)$. Then
\[
 \operatorname{turn}(C-A,D-A)+\operatorname{turn}(D-A,D-B)
 =\operatorname{turn}(C-A,C-B)+\operatorname{turn}(C-B,D-B).
\]
This is an equality of real principal angles, not only modulo $2\pi$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.principalTurn
lean.code:
noncomputable def principalTurn (u w : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  Complex.arg (w / u)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.principalTurn_secant_square_of_disjoint_segments
lean.code:
theorem principalTurn_secant_square_of_disjoint_segments
    {A B C D : ℂ}
    (hdisj : Disjoint (segment ℝ A B) (segment ℝ C D)) :
    principalTurn (C - A) (D - A) +
        principalTurn (D - A) (D - B) =
      principalTurn (C - A) (C - B) +
        principalTurn (C - B) (D - B) := by
  let Q : Set ℂ := segment ℝ C D - segment ℝ A B
  have hQconvex : Convex ℝ Q :=
    (convex_segment C D).sub (convex_segment A B)
  have hQcompact : IsCompact Q := by
    dsimp [Q]
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
    exact (isCompact_segment_complex C D).add
      (isCompact_segment_complex A B).neg
  have hzeroQ : (0 : ℂ) ∉ Q := by
    intro hzero
    rcases Set.mem_sub.mp hzero with ⟨c, hc, a, ha, hca⟩
    have hEq : c = a := sub_eq_zero.mp hca
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj ha (hEq ▸ hc)
  obtain ⟨f, u, hfu, hsep⟩ :=
    RCLike.geometric_hahn_banach_point_closed (𝕜 := ℂ)
      hQconvex hQcompact.isClosed hzeroQ
  have hu : 0 < u := by
    simpa using hfu
  let c : ℂ := f 1
  have hf_apply (q : ℂ) : f q = q * c := by
    change f q = q * f 1
    calc
      f q = f (q • (1 : ℂ)) := by simp
      _ = q • f 1 := f.map_smul q 1
      _ = q * f 1 := by simp [smul_eq_mul]
  have hright {q : ℂ} (hq : q ∈ Q) : 0 < (c * q).re := by
    have h := hu.trans (hsep q hq)
    rw [hf_apply, mul_comm] at h
    exact h
  have hCA : C - A ∈ Q :=
    Set.sub_mem_sub (left_mem_segment ℝ C D) (left_mem_segment ℝ A B)
  have hDA : D - A ∈ Q :=
    Set.sub_mem_sub (right_mem_segment ℝ C D) (left_mem_segment ℝ A B)
  have hCB : C - B ∈ Q :=
    Set.sub_mem_sub (left_mem_segment ℝ C D) (right_mem_segment ℝ A B)
  have hDB : D - B ∈ Q :=
    Set.sub_mem_sub (right_mem_segment ℝ C D) (right_mem_segment ℝ A B)
  rw [principalTurn_eq_sub_arg_after_common_multiplier
      (hright hCA) (hright hDA),
    principalTurn_eq_sub_arg_after_common_multiplier
      (hright hDA) (hright hDB),
    principalTurn_eq_sub_arg_after_common_multiplier
      (hright hCA) (hright hCB),
    principalTurn_eq_sub_arg_after_common_multiplier
      (hright hCB) (hright hDB)]
  ring

/-! ## Finite Hopf-grid cancellation -/

entries.label: detail:discrete-umlaufsatz
entries.title: The positive polygonal turning theorem
entries.chapter: Polygon geometry and the radius formulation
entries.body:
For a simple cyclic polygon whose successive triples all have positive signed
area, each principal edge turn lies in $(0,\pi)$ and their sum is exactly
$2\pi$. Thus the canonical lifted edge heading advances once per period.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.HasPositiveTurningNumberOne
lean.code:
def HasPositiveTurningNumberOne (v : ZMod n → ℂ) : Prop :=
  cyclicEdgeHeading v n = cyclicEdgeHeading v 0 + 2 * Real.pi

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cyclicEdgeHeading
lean.code:
noncomputable def cyclicEdgeHeading (v : ZMod n → ℂ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => Complex.arg (cyclicEdge v 0)
  | k + 1 => cyclicEdgeHeading v k + cyclicEdgeTurn v k

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.hasPositiveTurningNumberOne_of_simple_positiveOrientation
lean.code:
theorem hasPositiveTurningNumberOne_of_simple_positiveOrientation [NeZero n]
    {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (horient : ∀ i : ZMod n,
      0 < crossR2 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1))) :
    HasPositiveTurningNumberOne v :=
  positivePolygonalUmlaufsatz n v hsimple horient

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.positivePolygonalUmlaufsatz
lean.code:
theorem positivePolygonalUmlaufsatz : PositivePolygonalUmlaufsatz := by
  intro n _ v hsimple horient
  obtain ⟨a, hminIm, hminReOnTie⟩ := shift_zero_min_im_then_re v
  let w := shiftPolygon v a
  have hsimpleW : IsSimplePolygon w := by
    exact isSimplePolygon_shift hsimple a
  have horientW : ∀ i : ZMod n,
      0 < crossR2 (w (i - 1)) (w i) (w (i + 1)) := by
    exact positiveOrientation_shift horient a
  have hsumW :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, cyclicEdgeTurn w i) = 2 * Real.pi :=
    sum_cyclicEdgeTurn_eq_two_pi_of_lex_min hsimpleW horientW
      hminIm hminReOnTie
  have hsumV :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, cyclicEdgeTurn v i) = 2 * Real.pi := by
    rw [← sum_cyclicEdgeTurn_shift v a]
    exact hsumW
  exact (hasPositiveTurningNumberOne_iff_sum v).2 hsumV

entries.label: detail:discrete-edge-support
entries.title: Positive one-turn polygons have strict edge support
entries.chapter: Polygon geometry and the radius formulation
entries.body:
For such a polygon, every vertex other than an edge's endpoints lies strictly
in the left half-plane of that oriented edge. The same conclusion holds for
a closed positive moderate-arc development with total turn $2\pi$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.strictConvexEdgeSupport_of_turningNumberOne
lean.code:
theorem strictConvexEdgeSupport_of_turningNumberOne [NeZero n]
    {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (horient : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < crossR2 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1)))
    (hone : HasPositiveTurningNumberOne v) :
    StrictConvexEdgeSupport v := by
  intro a c hca hca1
  set t := (c - a).val
  have hb : ((t : ℕ) : ZMod n) = c - a :=
    ZMod.natCast_rightInverse (c - a)
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, Nat.cast_zero] at hb
    exact hca (sub_eq_zero.1 hb.symm)
  have ht1 : t ≠ 1 := by
    intro h1
    rw [h1, Nat.cast_one] at hb
    exact hca1 (by linear_combination hb.symm)
  have htn : t < n := ZMod.val_lt (c - a)
  have hc : cyclicVertex v (a.val + t) = v c :=
    cyclicVertex_sub_val v a c
  have hleft :
      0 < (Complex.exp (((-cyclicEdgeHeading v a.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        (v c - v a)).im := by
    rw [← hc, show v a = cyclicVertex v a.val by simp [cyclicVertex]]
    exact support_left_pos_of_turningNumberOne hsimple horient hone a.val
      (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [cyclicEdgeVector_at_val hsimple, crossR2_cyclicEdgeVector]
  exact mul_pos (cyclicEdgeLength_pos hsimple a.val) hleft

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.strictConvexEdgeSupport_of_simple_positiveOrientation
lean.code:
theorem strictConvexEdgeSupport_of_simple_positiveOrientation [NeZero n]
    {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (horient : ∀ i : ZMod n,
      0 < crossR2 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1))) :
    StrictConvexEdgeSupport v :=
  strictConvexEdgeSupport_of_turningNumberOne hsimple horient
    (hasPositiveTurningNumberOne_of_simple_positiveOrientation
      hsimple horient)

/-! ## The integral period defect -/

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.convexEdgeSupport_of_turningNumberOne
lean.code:
theorem convexEdgeSupport_of_turningNumberOne [NeZero n]
    {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (horient : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < crossR2 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1)))
    (hone : HasPositiveTurningNumberOne v) :
    ConvexEdgeSupport v := by
  intro a c
  set t := (c - a).val
  have htlt : t < n := ZMod.val_lt (c - a)
  have hc : cyclicVertex v (a.val + t) = v c :=
    cyclicVertex_sub_val v a c
  have hleft :
      0 ≤ (Complex.exp (((-cyclicEdgeHeading v a.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        (v c - v a)).im := by
    rw [← hc, show v a = cyclicVertex v a.val by simp [cyclicVertex]]
    exact support_left_nonneg_of_turningNumberOne hsimple horient hone a.val
      (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [cyclicEdgeVector_at_val hsimple, crossR2_cyclicEdgeVector]
  exact mul_nonneg (cyclicEdgeLength_pos hsimple a.val).le hleft

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_polygonR2_edge_vertex_pos
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_polygonR2_edge_vertex_pos [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ) (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i)
    (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0) (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi)
    (a c : ZMod n) (hca : c ≠ a) (hca1 : c ≠ a + 1) :
    0 < crossR2 (polygonR2 κ ℓ a) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (a + 1))
      (polygonR2 κ ℓ c) := by
  have hleft := support_pos_cyclic h hκ hE hT a c hca hca1
  rw [polygonR2_edgeVector hE hT, crossR2_edgeVector]
  exact mul_pos (h.length_pos a) hleft

entries.label: detail:discrete-coherence
entries.title: Moderate arcs give coherence and exact Menger curvature
entries.chapter: Polygon geometry and the radius formulation
entries.body:
A positive moderate-arc development whose closure gap is zero and total turn
is $2\pi$ has signed Menger curvature $\kappa_i$ at each vertex, and the
circumcenter of its consecutive triple lies in the open vertex cone.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.coherent_development_moderate
lean.code:
theorem coherent_development_moderate [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ) (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i)
    (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0) (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) :
    CoherentR2 (polygonR2 κ ℓ) := by
  intro i
  obtain ⟨ψ, ψ', hd, hem, hep⟩ := polygon_edges hE hT i
  have hl1 := h.length_pos (i - 1)
  have hl2 := h.length_pos i
  have hκi := hκ i
  have hθpos : 0 < turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i := turningAngle_pos h hκi
  have hθlt : turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i < Real.pi := by
    have := abs_turningAngle_lt_pi h i
    rw [abs_lt] at this
    exact this.2
  have hsinθ : 0 < Real.sin (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hθpos hθlt
  have hprod := conj_edge_mul_edge hE hT i
  have hre_eq : ((starRingEnd ℂ) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)
        * (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).re
      = -(ℓ (i - 1) * ℓ i) * Real.cos (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i) := by
    rw [hprod, Complex.re_ofReal_mul, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re]
  have him_eq : ((starRingEnd ℂ) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)
        * (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im
      = -(ℓ (i - 1) * ℓ i) * Real.sin (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i) := by
    rw [hprod, Complex.im_ofReal_mul, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im]
  have hcross : crossR2 (polygonR2 κ ℓ i) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1))
      (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [crossR2_eq_im_conj_mul, him_eq]
    have : -(ℓ (i - 1) * ℓ i) * Real.sin (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i) < 0 := by
      nlinarith [mul_pos (mul_pos hl1 hl2) hsinθ]
    exact ne_of_lt this
  refine ⟨hcross, ?_⟩
  set A := Real.arcsin (κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)) with hA
  set B := Real.arcsin (κ i * (ℓ i / 2)) with hB
  have hθAB : turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i = A + B := by
    rw [turningAngle, hA, hB, tK_zero, tK_zero]
  have hargl : κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2) < 1 := by
    have := h.wall_left i
    rwa [tK_zero, abs_of_pos hκi] at this
  have hargr : κ i * (ℓ i / 2) < 1 := by
    have := h.wall_right i
    rwa [tK_zero, abs_of_pos hκi] at this
  have hargl0 : 0 < κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2) := mul_pos hκi (half_pos hl1)
  have hargr0 : 0 < κ i * (ℓ i / 2) := mul_pos hκi (half_pos hl2)
  have hsinA : Real.sin A = κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2) := by
    rw [hA]; exact Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith) hargl.le
  have hsinB : Real.sin B = κ i * (ℓ i / 2) := by
    rw [hB]; exact Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith) hargr.le
  have hcosA : 0 < Real.cos A := by
    rw [hA, Real.cos_arcsin]
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by nlinarith)
  have hcosB : 0 < Real.cos B := by
    rw [hB, Real.cos_arcsin]
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by nlinarith)
  have htrig := neg_sin_mul_cos_add_lt (hsinA ▸ hargl0) (hsinB ▸ hargr0)
    hcosA hcosB (by rw [← hθAB]; exact hsinθ)
  rw [hsinA, hsinB, lt_min_iff] at htrig
  have hnu : normSq (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i) = ℓ (i - 1) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hem, Complex.normSq_neg, normSq_scaled_exp]
  have hnw : normSq (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i) = ℓ i ^ 2 := by
  -- … (truncated)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.signedMengerR2_polygonR2
lean.code:
theorem signedMengerR2_polygonR2 [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hMA : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ) (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0)
    (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) (i : ZMod n) :
    signedMengerR2 (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1)) (polygonR2 κ ℓ i) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1)) =
      κ i := by
  have hpos : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n)
  set k : ℕ := i.val + (n - 1) with hk
  have hn1 : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = -1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hpos, ZMod.natCast_self, Nat.cast_one, zero_sub]
  have hiv : ((i.val : ℕ) : ZMod n) = i := ZMod.natCast_rightInverse i
  have hc0 : ((k : ℕ) : ZMod n) = i - 1 := by
    rw [hk, Nat.cast_add, hiv, hn1]; ring
  have hc1 : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = i := by
    rw [hk, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, hiv, hn1]; ring
  have hc2 : ((k + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = i + 1 := by
    rw [hk, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, hiv, hn1]; ring
  have e0 : vertexR2 κ ℓ k = polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1) := by
    rw [vertexR2_eq_polygon hE hT k, hc0]
  have e1 : vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1) = polygonR2 κ ℓ i := by
    rw [vertexR2_eq_polygon hE hT (k + 1), hc1]
  have e2 : vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1 + 1) = polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1) := by
    rw [vertexR2_eq_polygon hE hT (k + 1 + 1), hc2]
  rw [← e0, ← e1, ← e2, signedMengerR2_development hMA k, hc1]

entries.label: detail:discrete-circumradius
entries.title: Circumradius is reciprocal absolute Menger curvature
entries.chapter: Polygon geometry and the radius formulation
entries.body:
For three noncollinear points, put $\Delta=(q-p)\times(r-p)$ and let $R$ be
their circumradius. Then
\[
 2|\Delta|R=|p-q|\,|q-r|\,|r-p|,\qquad
 R=\frac1{|\kappa_{\rm Menger}|}.
\]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.vertexCircumradius
lean.code:
noncomputable def vertexCircumradius (v : ZMod n → ℂ) (i : ZMod n) : ℝ :=
  dist (circumcenterR2 (v i) (v (i - 1)) (v (i + 1))) (v i)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.dist_circumcenterR2_mul
lean.code:
theorem dist_circumcenterR2_mul {p q r : ℂ} (h : crossR2 p q r ≠ 0) :
    dist (circumcenterR2 p q r) p * (2 * |crossR2 p q r|) =
      dist p q * dist q r * dist r p := by
  set δ := crossR2 p q r with hδ
  set u := q - p with hu
  set w := r - p with hw
  set num : ℂ := (normSq w : ℂ) * u - (normSq u : ℂ) * w with hnum
  have hζ : (circumcenterR2 p q r - p) * (2 * (δ : ℂ)) = Complex.I * num := by
    have h2 : (2 * (δ : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.2 h)
    rw [circumcenterR2, add_sub_cancel_left, div_mul_cancel₀ _ h2]
  have hsq : normSq (circumcenterR2 p q r - p) * (4 * δ ^ 2) =
      normSq u * normSq w * normSq (w - u) := by
    have := congrArg normSq hζ
    simp only [map_mul, Complex.normSq_I, Complex.normSq_ofReal, one_mul] at this
    have h2 : normSq (2 : ℂ) = 4 := by norm_num [Complex.normSq_apply]
    rw [h2] at this
    have hn : normSq num = normSq u * normSq w * normSq (w - u) := by
      simp only [hnum, Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_re,
        Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
      ring
    rw [← hn, ← this]
    ring
  have hL : 0 ≤ dist (circumcenterR2 p q r) p * (2 * |δ|) := by positivity
  have hR : 0 ≤ dist p q * dist q r * dist r p := by positivity
  refine (pow_left_inj₀ hL hR two_ne_zero).1 ?_
  have e1 : dist (circumcenterR2 p q r) p ^ 2 = normSq (circumcenterR2 p q r - p) := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  have e2 : dist p q ^ 2 = normSq u := by
    rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  have e3 : dist q r ^ 2 = normSq (w - u) := by
    rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, hw, hu, sub_sub_sub_cancel_right]
  have e4 : dist r p ^ 2 = normSq w := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  calc (dist (circumcenterR2 p q r) p * (2 * |δ|)) ^ 2
      = dist (circumcenterR2 p q r) p ^ 2 * (4 * δ ^ 2) := by
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, sq_abs]; ring
    _ = (dist p q * dist q r * dist r p) ^ 2 := by
        rw [e1, hsq, mul_pow, mul_pow, e2, e3, e4]; ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.dist_circumcenterR2_eq_inv_abs_signedMenger
lean.code:
theorem dist_circumcenterR2_eq_inv_abs_signedMenger {A B C : ℂ}
    (h : crossR2 B A C ≠ 0) :
    dist (circumcenterR2 B A C) B = 1 / |signedMengerR2 A B C| := by
  have hABC : crossR2 A B C = -crossR2 B A C := by
    rw [← crossR2_cycle A B C]; exact crossR2_swap B A C
  obtain ⟨hBA, hAC, hCB⟩ := pairwise_ne_of_crossR2_ne_zero h
  have hd1 : 0 < dist A B := dist_pos.2 (Ne.symm hBA)
  have hd2 : 0 < dist B C := dist_pos.2 (Ne.symm hCB)
  have hd3 : 0 < dist C A := dist_pos.2 (Ne.symm hAC)
  have hδ : 0 < |crossR2 B A C| := abs_pos.2 h
  have key := dist_circumcenterR2_mul h
  rw [signedMengerR2, hABC, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_two,
    abs_of_pos hd1, abs_of_pos hd2, abs_of_pos hd3, one_div_div]
  rw [eq_div_iff (by positivity)]
  rw [dist_comm B A, dist_comm C B, dist_comm A C] at key
  linarith [key]

entries.label: detail:discrete-radius-extrema
entries.title: Reciprocation exchanges extrema and preserves the hypothesis
entries.chapter: Polygon geometry and the radius formulation
entries.body:
For a positive cyclic radius word, taking reciprocals preserves every maximal
constant run and exchanges its strict maximum and minimum comparisons.
Consequently two distinct plateau maxima and two distinct plateau minima of
$r$ give the discrete four-vertex hypothesis for $\kappa_i=1/r_i$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.discreteFourVertexExtrema_inv
lean.code:
lemma discreteFourVertexExtrema_inv {r : ZMod n → ℝ} (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (h : IsPlateauTwoMaxTwoMin r) : DiscreteFourVertexExtrema (fun i => 1 / r i) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨a₁, k₁, a₂, k₂, hk₁, hk₂, hM₁, hM₂, hd⟩, ⟨b₁, j₁, b₂, j₂, hj₁, hj₂, hm₁, hm₂, he⟩⟩ := h
  exact ⟨fun i => one_div_pos.2 (hr i), Or.inr
    ⟨⟨b₁, j₁, b₂, j₂, hj₁, hj₂, plateauMinRun_inv hr hm₁, plateauMinRun_inv hr hm₂, he⟩,
     ⟨a₁, k₁, a₂, k₂, hk₁, hk₂, plateauMaxRun_inv hr hM₁, plateauMaxRun_inv hr hM₂, hd⟩⟩⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.IsPlateauTwoMaxTwoMin
lean.code:
def IsPlateauTwoMaxTwoMin (r : ZMod n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  HasTwoPlateauMaxRuns r ∧ HasTwoPlateauMinRuns r

entries.label: detail:discrete-radius-converse
entries.title: Tabachnikov's radius formulation
entries.chapter: Polygon geometry and the radius formulation
entries.body:
Let $n\ge4$. Every positive cyclic radius word with two plateau maxima and two
plateau minima is the consecutive circumradius word of a simple strictly
convex coherent polygon. Its signed Menger curvatures are $1/r_i$.
If all adjacent radii differ, no four consecutive vertices are concyclic.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.tabachnikov_converse
lean.code:
theorem tabachnikov_converse [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) {r : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i) (hext : IsPlateauTwoMaxTwoMin r) :
    ∃ v : ZMod n → ℂ, IsCoherentConvexPolygon v ∧
      (∀ i, vertexCircumradius v i = r i) ∧
      (∀ i, signedMengerR2 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1)) = 1 / r i) ∧
      ((∀ i, r i ≠ r (i + 1)) →
        ∀ i, ¬ Concyclic4 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1)) (v (i + 2))) := by
  set κ : ZMod n → ℝ := fun i => 1 / r i with hκdef
  have hκ : ∀ i, 0 < κ i := fun i => one_div_pos.2 (hr i)
  have hreal : RealizesR2 κ :=
    tabachnikovProblem2_iff_extrema_form.mp (tabachnikovProblem2_all hn) κ
      (discreteFourVertexExtrema_inv hr hext)
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hMA, hE, hT, hsimple⟩ := hreal
  have hn3 : 3 ≤ n := by omega
  have hcoh := coherent_development_moderate hMA hκ hE hT
  have hmenger := signedMengerR2_polygonR2 hMA hE hT
  have hrad : ∀ i, vertexCircumradius (polygonR2 κ ℓ) i = r i := by
    intro i
    rw [vertexCircumradius, dist_circumcenterR2_eq_inv_abs_signedMenger (hcoh i).1,
      hmenger i, abs_of_pos (hκ i), hκdef, one_div_one_div]
  refine ⟨polygonR2 κ ℓ,
    ⟨hsimple, fun a c hca hca1 => crossR2_polygonR2_edge_vertex_pos hMA hκ hE hT a c hca hca1,
      hcoh⟩, hrad, hmenger, ?_⟩
  intro hne i hcon
  apply hne i
  rw [← hrad i, ← hrad (i + 1)]
  exact vertexCircumradius_eq_of_concyclic i (hcoh i).1 (hcoh (i + 1)).1 hcon

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.IsCoherentConvexPolygon
lean.code:
def IsCoherentConvexPolygon (v : ZMod n → ℂ) : Prop :=
  IsSimplePolygon v ∧
    (∀ a c : ZMod n, c ≠ a → c ≠ a + 1 → 0 < crossR2 (v a) (v (a + 1)) (v c)) ∧
    CoherentR2 v

entries.label: detail:hexagon-radius-continuous
entries.title: The smallest enclosing radius is continuous
entries.chapter: The enclosing-circle obstruction in detail
entries.body:
Every nonempty finite vertex set has a smallest enclosing disk. Its radius
$R(v)$ satisfies
\[
 |R(v)-R(w)|\le\max_i|v_i-w_i|.
\]
For a simple polygon $R(v)>0$. Consequently $c(v)=1/R(v)$ is continuous
on the space of simple polygons.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.enclosingDisk_minimal
lean.code:
theorem enclosingDisk_minimal {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (v : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    MinimalEnclosingDiskR2 v (enclosingCenter v) (enclosingRadius v) :=
  (exists_minimalEnclosingDiskR2 v).choose_spec.choose_spec

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.enclosingRadius_lipschitz
lean.code:
theorem enclosingRadius_lipschitz {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] :
    LipschitzWith 1 (enclosingRadius (n := n)) := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro v w
  rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_le]
  have hv := enclosingRadius_le_add_dist v w
  have hw := enclosingRadius_le_add_dist w v
  simp only [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul]
  constructor <;> linarith [dist_comm v w]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.enclosingRadius_le_add_dist
lean.code:
theorem enclosingRadius_le_add_dist {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (v w : ZMod n → ℂ) : enclosingRadius v ≤ enclosingRadius w + dist v w := by
  have hv := enclosingDisk_minimal v
  have hw := enclosingDisk_minimal w
  apply hv.2.2 (enclosingCenter w) _ (add_nonneg hw.1 dist_nonneg)
  intro i
  apply Metric.mem_closedBall'.mpr
  calc
    dist (enclosingCenter w) (v i) ≤
        dist (enclosingCenter w) (w i) + dist (w i) (v i) := dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ enclosingRadius w + dist v w := add_le_add
      (Metric.mem_closedBall'.mp (hw.2.1 i))
      (by simpa [dist_comm] using dist_le_pi_dist w v i)

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.exists_minimalEnclosingDiskR2
lean.code:
theorem exists_minimalEnclosingDiskR2 {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (v : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    ∃ O R, MinimalEnclosingDiskR2 v O R := by
  obtain ⟨O, hmin⟩ :=
    (continuous_finiteEnclosingRadius v).exists_forall_le
      (tendsto_finiteEnclosingRadius_cocompact_atTop v)
  refine ⟨O, finiteEnclosingRadius v O, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact dist_nonneg.trans
      (Finset.le_sup' (fun i : ZMod n => dist O (v i)) (Finset.mem_univ 0))
  · exact polygonInClosedDiskR2_finiteEnclosingRadius v O
  · intro O' R' _hR' hpoly
    exact (hmin O').trans
      (Finset.sup'_le Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i : ZMod n => dist O' (v i))
        (fun i _hi => Metric.mem_closedBall'.mp (hpoly i)))

entries.label: detail:hexagon-contact-minimality
entries.title: The contacts determine the minimum radius
entries.chapter: The enclosing-circle obstruction in detail
entries.body:
Let $\overline B(O,R)$ be a smallest enclosing disk of a finite vertex set.
If $\rho\ge0$ and $\overline B(C,\rho)$ contains every boundary contact of
that disk, then $R\le\rho$.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.minimalEnclosingDiskR2_le_of_boundaryContactsInClosedDiskR2
lean.code:
theorem minimalEnclosingDiskR2_le_of_boundaryContactsInClosedDiskR2
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ} {O C : ℂ} {R ρ : ℝ}
    (hΔ : MinimalEnclosingDiskR2 v O R) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hcontains : ∀ i : ZMod n, OnDiskBoundaryR2 v O R i →
      InClosedDiskR2 C ρ (v i)) :
    R ≤ ρ := by
  classical
  by_contra hRρ
  have hρR : ρ < R := lt_of_not_ge hRρ
  let slack : ZMod n → ℝ := fun i =>
    if OnDiskBoundaryR2 v O R i then 1 else R - dist O (v i)
  have hslack_pos : ∀ i, 0 < slack i := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : OnDiskBoundaryR2 v O R i
    · dsimp only [slack]
      rw [if_pos hi]
      norm_num
    · dsimp only [slack]
      rw [if_neg hi]
      have hle_i : dist O (v i) ≤ R := Metric.mem_closedBall'.mp (hΔ.2.1 i)
      have hne_i : dist O (v i) ≠ R := fun hdist ↦ hi (Metric.mem_sphere'.mpr hdist)
      have hlt_i : dist O (v i) < R := lt_of_le_of_ne hle_i hne_i
      linarith
  let ε : ℝ := (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod n)).inf'
    Finset.univ_nonempty slack
  have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by
    exact (Finset.lt_inf'_iff Finset.univ_nonempty).2
      (fun i _hi => hslack_pos i)
  have hε_le (i : ZMod n) : ε ≤ slack i := by
    exact Finset.inf'_le slack (Finset.mem_univ i)
  let d : ℝ := dist O C
  let g : ℝ := R - ρ
  have hd_nonneg : 0 ≤ d := by positivity
  have hg_pos : 0 < g := by dsimp [g]; linarith
  have hdg_pos : 0 < d + g := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos hd_nonneg hg_pos
  let t : ℝ := min (1 / 2 : ℝ) (ε / (2 * (d + g)))
  have ht_pos : 0 < t := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact lt_min (by norm_num)
      (div_pos hε_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) hdg_pos))
  have ht_le_half : t ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have ht_le_one : t ≤ 1 := ht_le_half.trans (by norm_num)
  have ht_nonneg : 0 ≤ t := ht_pos.le
  have ht_dg : t * (d + g) ≤ ε / 2 := by
    have ht_ratio : t ≤ ε / (2 * (d + g)) := min_le_right _ _
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht_ratio hdg_pos.le
    calc
      t * (d + g) ≤ (ε / (2 * (d + g))) * (d + g) := hmul
      _ = ε / 2 := by field_simp [hdg_pos.ne']
  let O' : ℂ := AffineMap.lineMap O C t
  let R' : ℝ := (1 - t) * R + t * ρ
  have hR'_nonneg : 0 ≤ R' := by
    dsimp [R']
    exact add_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht_le_one) hΔ.1)
      (mul_nonneg ht_nonneg hρ)
  have hR'_lt : R' < R := by
    dsimp [R', g] at *
    nlinarith
  have hdist_convex (X : ℂ) :

entries.label: detail:hexagon-contact-curvature
entries.title: Curvature at an enclosing-circle contact
entries.chapter: The enclosing-circle obstruction in detail
entries.body:
For a simple coherent polygon with positive consecutive orientation, every
contact $v_i$ of its smallest enclosing disk satisfies $\kappa_i\ge1/R$.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.signedMengerProfile_inv_radius_le_of_minimal_boundary_of_cross_pos
lean.code:
theorem signedMengerProfile_inv_radius_le_of_minimal_boundary_of_cross_pos
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ} {OΔ : ℂ} {R : ℝ}
    (hsimple : Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hregular : DahlbergRegular v)
    (hΔ : MinimalEnclosingDiskR2 v OΔ R)
    {i : ZMod n} (hboundary : OnDiskBoundaryR2 v OΔ R i)
    (hcross : 0 < Gluck.Discrete.crossR2 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1))) :
    1 / R ≤ SignedMengerProfile v i := by
  rcases hregular i with hcol | ⟨O, ρ, hcircle, hcone⟩
  · exact False.elim ((ne_of_gt hcross) hcol.1)
  · have hcircle' : CircumcircleR2 (v i) (v (i - 1)) (v (i + 1)) O ρ :=
      ⟨hcircle.1, hcircle.2.2.1, hcircle.2.1, hcircle.2.2.2⟩
    have hρR : ρ ≤ R :=
      circumcircleR2_radius_le_of_inVertexCone_of_boundary
        hcircle' hcone hΔ.1 (Metric.mem_sphere'.mp hboundary)
          (hΔ.2.1 (i - 1)) (hΔ.2.1 (i + 1))
    have hAB : v (i - 1) ≠ v i := by
      simpa using hsimple.1 (i - 1)
    have hcircle'' : CircumcircleR2 (v (i + 1)) (v (i - 1)) (v i) O ρ :=
      ⟨hcircle.1, hcircle.2.2.2, hcircle.2.1, hcircle.2.2.1⟩
    have hκ : SignedMengerProfile v i = 1 / ρ := by
      simpa [SignedMengerProfile] using
        signedMengerR2_eq_inv_circumradius_of_pos hAB hcross hcircle''
    rw [hκ]
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hcircle.1 hρR

entries.label: detail:hexagon-triple
entries.title: Contacts confined to three consecutive vertices
entries.chapter: The enclosing-circle obstruction in detail
entries.body:
For a simple positively oriented polygon, if all contacts of a smallest
enclosing disk belong to $\{v_{i-1},v_i,v_{i+1}\}$, then $\kappa_i\le1/R$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.curvature_le_level_of_contacts_in_triple
lean.code:
theorem curvature_le_level_of_contacts_in_triple
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ} {O : ℂ} {R : ℝ}
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v) (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v)
    (hD : MinimalEnclosingDiskR2 v O R) (i : ZMod n)
    (hsub : ∀ j, OnDiskBoundaryR2 v O R j →
      j = i - 1 ∨ j = i ∨ j = i + 1) :
    SignedMengerProfile v i ≤ 1 / R := by
  have hr := EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_pos hsimple i
  have hR := radius_pos_of_minimalEnclosingDiskR2_of_isSimplePolygon hD hsimple
  have hle : R ≤ EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile v i := by
    apply minimalEnclosingDiskR2_le_of_boundaryContactsInClosedDiskR2 hD hr.le
    intro j hj
    apply Metric.mem_closedBall'.mpr
    rcases hsub j hj with h | h | h
    · rw [h]
      exact (edgePrevCircle_dist_prev_eq_radius_of_positiveOrientation
        hsimple horient i).le
    · rw [h]
      exact (edgePrevCircle_dist_self_eq_radius_of_positiveOrientation
        hsimple horient i).le
    · rw [h]
      exact (edgePrevCircle_dist_next_eq_radius_of_positiveOrientation
        hsimple horient i).le
  rw [signedMengerProfile_eq_inv_edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_of_positiveOrientation
    hsimple horient i, ← one_div]
  exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hR hle

entries.label: detail:hexagon-containing-minimum
entries.title: A containing local circle is a curvature minimum
entries.chapter: The enclosing-circle obstruction in detail
entries.body:
If a local circumdisk of a simple coherent positively oriented polygon
contains every vertex, then
$\kappa_i\le\kappa_{i-1}$ and $\kappa_i\le\kappa_{i+1}$.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_neighbors_le_of_containsAll_of_positiveOrientation
lean.code:
theorem edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_neighbors_le_of_containsAll_of_positiveOrientation
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hregular : DahlbergRegular v)
    (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v) {i : ZMod n}
    (hcontains : EdgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll v i) :
    EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile v (i - 1) ≤ EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile v i ∧
      EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile v (i + 1) ≤ EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile v i := by
  exact ⟨
    edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_pred_le_of_containsAll_of_positiveOrientation
      hsimple hregular horient hcontains,
    edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_succ_le_of_containsAll_of_positiveOrientation
      hsimple hregular horient hcontains⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.containing_curvature_le_neighbors
lean.code:
theorem containing_curvature_le_neighbors
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v) (hregular : DahlbergRegular v)
    (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v) {i : ZMod n}
    (hi : EdgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll v i) :
    SignedMengerProfile v i ≤ SignedMengerProfile v (i - 1) ∧
      SignedMengerProfile v i ≤ SignedMengerProfile v (i + 1) := by
  have hh := edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_neighbors_le_of_containsAll_of_positiveOrientation
    hsimple hregular horient hi
  simp only [signedMengerProfile_eq_inv_edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_of_positiveOrientation
    hsimple horient]
  constructor
  · exact inv_anti₀ (EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_pos hsimple (i - 1)) hh.1
  · exact inv_anti₀ (EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_pos hsimple (i + 1)) hh.2

entries.label: detail:hexagon-three-contact
entries.title: Containing three-contact disks through every vertex
entries.chapter: The enclosing-circle obstruction in detail
entries.body:
If $n\ge4$ and a polygon has strict convex edge support, every vertex belongs
to a containing circle with at least three distinct contact vertices.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.exists_dahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2_at_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport
lean.code:
theorem exists_dahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2_at_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsupport : StrictConvexEdgeSupport v) (i : ZMod n) :
    ∃ U : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v,
      i ∈ circleContactSet v U.center U.radius := by
  rcases exists_edgeThirdVertex_circle_containsAll_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport
      hn hsupport i with ⟨j, hji, hjnext, hall, hcircle⟩
  have hAB : v i ≠ v (i + 1) :=
    strictConvexEdgeSupport_edge_ne hn hsupport i
  let y := edgeCircumcenterParameter (v i) (v (i + 1)) (v j)
  let O := edgeCircleCenter (v i) (v (i + 1)) y
  let R := normalizedCircleRadius (chordHalfLength (v i) (v (i + 1))) y
  have hcontains : PolygonInClosedDiskR2 v O R := by
    intro k
    exact Metric.mem_closedBall'.mpr ((mem_edgeClosedDisk_iff_dist_le hAB y).mp (hall k))
  have hiNext : i ≠ i + 1 := by
    intro h
    exact hAB (congrArg v h)
  have hthree : 3 ≤ (circleContactSet v O R).card := by
    apply three_le_card_circleContactSet hiNext hji.symm hjnext.symm
    · exact hcircle.2.1
    · exact hcircle.2.2.1
    · exact hcircle.2.2.2
  let U : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v :=
    { center := O
      radius := R
      radius_pos := hcircle.1
      contains := hcontains
      three_contacts := hthree }
  refine ⟨U, ?_⟩
  exact mem_circleContactSet.mpr hcircle.2.1

entries.label: detail:hexagon-contact-gap
entries.title: Localization to a gap in the contacts
entries.chapter: The enclosing-circle obstruction in detail
entries.body:
For a strictly convex cyclically indexed polygon, let $U,W$ be containing disks with at
least three contacts each. In a cyclic cut, let $p<k<q<n$. If $p,q$ are
contacts of $U$, $k$ is not a contact of $U$, and $k$ is a contact of $W$,
then every contact of $W$ lies in the closed cyclic interval $[p,q]$.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.circleContactSet_subset_of_containingDisk_cutGap
lean.code:
theorem circleContactSet_subset_of_containingDisk_cutGap
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hgeom : StrictConvexCyclicChordGeometry v)
    (U W : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v)
    (c : ZMod n) {p k q : ℕ}
    (hpk : p < k) (hkq : k < q) (hqn : q < n)
    (hpU : Gluck.cyclicLift c p ∈ circleContactSet v U.center U.radius)
    (hqU : Gluck.cyclicLift c q ∈ circleContactSet v U.center U.radius)
    (hkNotU : Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∉ circleContactSet v U.center U.radius)
    (hkW : Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∈ circleContactSet v W.center W.radius) :
    circleContactSet v W.center W.radius ⊆
      Gluck.mapCut c (Finset.Icc p q) := by
  have hgap := hgeom.gap c p k q hpk hkq hqn
  let a := Gluck.cyclicLift c q
  let b := Gluck.cyclicLift c p
  let z := Gluck.cyclicLift c k
  let E := Gluck.mapCut c (Finset.Icc p q)
  have habIndex : a ≠ b := by
    intro h
    have hcast : (q : ZMod n) = (p : ZMod n) := by
      exact add_left_cancel h
    have hmod : q ≡ p [MOD n] :=
      (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff q p n).mp hcast
    exact (Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_trans hpk hkq))
      (hmod.eq_of_lt_of_lt hqn (lt_trans (lt_trans hpk hkq) hqn))
  apply circleContactSet_subset_of_containingDisk_gap U W hqU hpU hkNotU hkW
    hgap.1
  · intro d hdU hda hdb
    exact hgeom.noncollinear a b d habIndex hda hdb
  · exact hgap.2.1
  · intro x hx
    exact hgap.2.2.1 x ((mem_edgeHalfPlane_iff_crossR2_nonneg hgap.1).mp hx)

entries.label: detail:hexagon-terminal-intervals
entries.title: Two terminal contact intervals
entries.chapter: The enclosing-circle obstruction in detail
entries.body:
Suppose a nonempty family of disks has contact sets of cardinality at least
three, none equal to the whole cyclic index set. Suppose also that every
index is a contact of some member and that the gap-localization property
holds. There exist two members with distinct contact sets, each a cyclic
interval.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.exists_two_cyclicInterval_contacts_ne_of_cutGap_shrink
lean.code:
theorem exists_two_cyclicInterval_contacts_ne_of_cutGap_shrink
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {Disk : Type*}
    (contacts : Disk → Finset (ZMod n))
    (hthree : ∀ U : Disk, 3 ≤ (contacts U).card)
    (hproper : ∀ U : Disk, contacts U ≠ Finset.univ)
    (hchoose : ∀ i : ZMod n, ∃ W : Disk, i ∈ contacts W)
    (hlocalize : ∀ (U W : Disk) (c : ZMod n) {p k q : ℕ},
      p < k → k < q → q < n →
      Gluck.cyclicLift c p ∈ contacts U →
      Gluck.cyclicLift c q ∈ contacts U →
      Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∉ contacts U →
      Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∈ contacts W →
      contacts W ⊆ Gluck.mapCut c (Finset.Icc p q))
    (U₀ : Disk) :
    ∃ U W : Disk,
      Gluck.IsCyclicInterval (contacts U) ∧
      Gluck.IsCyclicInterval (contacts W) ∧
      contacts U ≠ contacts W := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, hUinterval⟩ :=
    exists_cyclicInterval_contacts_of_cutGap_shrink
      contacts hthree hproper hchoose hlocalize U₀
  obtain ⟨c, p, k, q, hcU, hp0, hpk, hkq, hqn, hpU, hqU, hkNotU⟩ :=
    hUinterval.exists_cutGap_in_complement (hthree U) (hproper U)
  obtain ⟨W, hWinterval, hWsub⟩ :=
    exists_cyclicInterval_contacts_subset_cutGap_of_shrink
      contacts hthree hchoose hlocalize U c hp0 hpk hkq hqn hpU hqU hkNotU
  have hIr : Finset.Icc p q ⊆ Finset.range n := by
    intro r hr
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hr
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt hr.2 hqn)
  have hcNotW : c ∉ contacts W := by
    intro hcW
    have hzeroCut : 0 ∈ Gluck.cutFinset c (contacts W) := by
      exact Gluck.mem_cutFinset.mpr
        ⟨Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n), by simpa [Gluck.cyclicLift] using hcW⟩
    have hcutWsub : Gluck.cutFinset c (contacts W) ⊆ Finset.Icc p q :=
      (Gluck.cutFinset_subset_iff c hIr).mpr hWsub
    have hzeroI := Finset.mem_Icc.mp (hcutWsub hzeroCut)
    omega
  refine ⟨U, W, hUinterval, hWinterval, ?_⟩
  intro hUW
  exact hcNotW (hUW ▸ hcU)

entries.label: detail:hexagon-two-containing
entries.title: Two distinct containing curvature circles
entries.chapter: The enclosing-circle obstruction in detail
entries.body:
A simple positively oriented strictly convex polygon with $n\ge4$ that is
not concyclic has two distinct local circumcircles whose disks contain all
its vertices.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.exists_edgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll_of_containing_contacts_interval
lean.code:
theorem exists_edgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll_of_containing_contacts_interval
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon v)
    (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v)
    (U : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v)
    (hinterval : Gluck.IsCyclicInterval
      (circleContactSet v U.center U.radius)) :
    ∃ i : ZMod n,
      EdgePrevCurvatureCircleData v i = (U.center, U.radius) ∧
      EdgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll v i := by
  obtain ⟨i, hprev, hself, hnext⟩ :=
    hinterval.exists_three_consecutive U.three_contacts
  have hprev' : OnDiskBoundaryR2 v U.center U.radius (i - 1) :=
    Metric.mem_sphere'.mpr (mem_circleContactSet.mp hprev)
  have hself' : OnDiskBoundaryR2 v U.center U.radius i :=
    Metric.mem_sphere'.mpr (mem_circleContactSet.mp hself)
  have hnext' : OnDiskBoundaryR2 v U.center U.radius (i + 1) :=
    Metric.mem_sphere'.mpr (mem_circleContactSet.mp hnext)
  have hdata := edgePrevCurvatureCircleData_eq_of_three_boundaries_of_cross_pos
    hsimple U.radius_pos hprev' hself' hnext' (horient i)
  refine ⟨i, hdata, ?_⟩
  have hcenter : EdgePrevCircleCenterProfile v i = U.center :=
    congrArg Prod.fst hdata
  have hradius : EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile v i = U.radius :=
    congrArg Prod.snd hdata
  simp only [EdgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll]
  intro j
  rw [hcenter, hradius]
  exact U.contains j

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.dahlbergE2Theorem6Lemma5ContainingDisks
lean.code:
theorem dahlbergE2Theorem6Lemma5ContainingDisks
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon v)
    (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v)
    (hsupport : StrictConvexEdgeSupport v)
    (hgeom : StrictConvexCyclicChordGeometry v)
    (hnoncircle : ¬ Concyclic v) :
    Nonempty (DahlbergE2Theorem6ContainingDisksCertificate v) := by
  classical
  let contacts : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v → Finset (ZMod n) :=
    fun U => circleContactSet v U.center U.radius
  have hthree : ∀ U : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v,
      3 ≤ (contacts U).card := by
    intro U
    exact U.three_contacts
  have hproper : ∀ U : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v,
      contacts U ≠ Finset.univ := by
    intro U
    exact circleContactSet_ne_univ_of_not_concyclic U.radius_pos hnoncircle
  have hchoose : ∀ i : ZMod n,
      ∃ W : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v, i ∈ contacts W := by
    intro i
    exact exists_dahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2_at_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport
      hn hsupport i
  have hlocalize :
      ∀ (U W : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v) (c : ZMod n)
        {p k q : ℕ},
        p < k → k < q → q < n →
        Gluck.cyclicLift c p ∈ contacts U →
        Gluck.cyclicLift c q ∈ contacts U →
        Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∉ contacts U →
        Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∈ contacts W →
        contacts W ⊆ Gluck.mapCut c (Finset.Icc p q) := by
    intro U W c p k q hpk hkq hqn hpU hqU hkNotU hkW
    exact circleContactSet_subset_of_containingDisk_cutGap
      hgeom U W c hpk hkq hqn hpU hqU hkNotU hkW
  obtain ⟨U₀, _h0⟩ := hchoose 0
  obtain ⟨U, W, hUinterval, hWinterval, hcontactsNe⟩ :=
    exists_two_cyclicInterval_contacts_ne_of_cutGap_shrink
      contacts hthree hproper hchoose hlocalize U₀
  obtain ⟨i, hdataU, hcontainsU⟩ :=
    exists_edgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll_of_containing_contacts_interval
      hsimple horient U hUinterval
  obtain ⟨j, hdataW, hcontainsW⟩ :=
    exists_edgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll_of_containing_contacts_interval
      hsimple horient W hWinterval
  have hdistinct : EdgePrevCurvatureCirclesDistinct v i j := by
    intro hij
    apply hcontactsNe
    apply circleContactSet_eq_of_circleData_eq
    exact hdataU.symm.trans (hij.trans hdataW)
  exact ⟨⟨i, j, hcontainsU, hcontainsW, hdistinct⟩⟩

entries.label: detail:hexagon-profile
entries.title: An admissible hexagon path
entries.chapter: The enclosing-circle obstruction in detail
entries.body:
For $0\le s\le1$, put
\[
 \kappa_s=(14,11,10+3s,5,7-3s,3).
\]
This is a continuous path of positive nonconstant admissible profiles.
Its four-vertex levels are exactly
\[
 (5,7-3s)\ \cup\ (11,10+3s),
\]
where an interval is empty if its upper endpoint is no larger than its lower.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.bandProfile
lean.code:
def bandProfile (s : ℝ) : ZMod 6 → ℝ :=
  ![14, 11, 10 + 3 * s, 5, 7 - 3 * s, 3]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.bandProfile_pos
lean.code:
theorem bandProfile_pos {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∀ i, 0 < bandProfile s i := by
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [bandProfile] <;> linarith [hs.1, hs.2]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.bandProfile_admissible
lean.code:
theorem bandProfile_admissible {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    DiscreteFourVertexPos (bandProfile s) := by
  refine ⟨bandProfile_pos hs, Or.inr ?_⟩
  by_cases h : s < 2 / 3
  · refine ⟨(5 + (7 - 3 * s)) / 2, by linarith, ?_⟩
    exact (bandProfile_dfv_iff hs).2 (Or.inl ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
  · refine ⟨(11 + (10 + 3 * s)) / 2, by linarith, ?_⟩
    exact (bandProfile_dfv_iff hs).2 (Or.inr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.continuous_bandProfile
lean.code:
theorem continuous_bandProfile : Continuous bandProfile := by
  apply continuous_pi
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [bandProfile] <;> fun_prop

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.bandProfile_nonconstant
lean.code:
theorem bandProfile_nonconstant (s : ℝ) :
    ¬ ∃ c, ∀ i, bandProfile s i = c := by
  rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
  have h0 := hc 0
  have h5 := hc 5
  norm_num [bandProfile] at h0 h5
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.bandProfile_dfv_iff
lean.code:
theorem bandProfile_dfv_iff {s c : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    DFV (bandProfile s) c ↔
      (5 < c ∧ c < 7 - 3 * s) ∨ (11 < c ∧ c < 10 + 3 * s) := by
  constructor
  · intro hd
    obtain ⟨b₁, b₂, b₃, b₄, h₁₂, h₂₃, h₃₄, h₄, ht⟩ := hd.exists_increasing
    have hb₁ : b₁ ≤ 2 := by omega
    have hb₂ : b₂ ≤ 3 := by omega
    have hb₃ : b₃ ≤ 4 := by omega
    rcases ht with ⟨h1,h2,h3,h4⟩ | ⟨h1,h2,h3,h4⟩
    all_goals
      interval_cases b₁ <;> interval_cases b₂ <;> try omega
    all_goals
      interval_cases b₃ <;> interval_cases b₄ <;> try omega
    all_goals
      norm_num [bandProfile] at h1 h2 h3 h4
      first
      | exact Or.inl ⟨by linarith [hs.1, hs.2], by linarith [hs.1, hs.2]⟩
      | exact Or.inr ⟨by linarith [hs.1, hs.2], by linarith [hs.1, hs.2]⟩
  · rintro (⟨hl, hu⟩ | ⟨hl, hu⟩)
    · refine ⟨0, 3, 4, 5, by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
      norm_num [bandProfile]
      exact ⟨by linarith [hs.1], hl, hu, by linarith⟩
    · refine ⟨0, 1, 2, 5, by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
      norm_num [bandProfile]
      exact ⟨by linarith [hs.2], hl, hu, by linarith⟩

entries.label: detail:hexagon-no-nine
entries.title: The separating level is impossible
entries.chapter: The enclosing-circle obstruction in detail
entries.body:
For any simple coherent positively oriented realization of $\kappa_s$,
with $0\le s\le1$, the enclosing level $c=1/R$ is different from $9$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.band_enclosing_level_ne_nine
lean.code:
theorem band_enclosing_level_ne_nine {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    {v : ZMod 6 → ℂ} (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hregular : DahlbergRegular v) (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v)
    (hκ : SignedMengerProfile v = bandProfile s) :
    1 / enclosingRadius v ≠ 9 := by
  intro heq
  have hD := enclosingDisk_minimal v
  have hcontacts : ∀ j, OnDiskBoundaryR2 v (enclosingCenter v) (enclosingRadius v) j →
      j = 0 ∨ j = 1 ∨ j = 2 := by
    intro j hj
    have hh := signedMengerProfile_inv_radius_le_of_minimal_boundary_of_cross_pos
      hsimple hregular hD hj (horient j)
    rw [hκ, heq] at hh
    fin_cases j
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)
    · norm_num [bandProfile] at hh
    · change (9 : ℝ) ≤ 7 - 3 * s at hh
      linarith [hs.1]
    · norm_num [bandProfile] at hh
  have hh := curvature_le_level_of_contacts_in_triple hsimple horient hD 1
    (by simpa only [show (1 : ZMod 6) - 1 = 0 by decide,
      show (1 : ZMod 6) + 1 = 2 by decide] using hcontacts)
  rw [hκ, heq] at hh
  norm_num [bandProfile] at hh

entries.title: The first endpoint is below the gap

entries.body: Every such realization of $\kappa_0=(14,11,10,5,7,3)$ has $c\le7$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.band_zero_enclosing_level_le_seven
lean.code:
theorem band_zero_enclosing_level_le_seven
    {v : ZMod 6 → ℂ} (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hregular : DahlbergRegular v) (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v)
    (hκ : SignedMengerProfile v = bandProfile 0) :
    1 / enclosingRadius v ≤ 7 := by
  by_contra hnot
  have hgt : 7 < 1 / enclosingRadius v := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  simp only [one_div] at hgt
  have hD := enclosingDisk_minimal v
  have hc (j) (hj : OnDiskBoundaryR2 v (enclosingCenter v) (enclosingRadius v) j) :
      1 / enclosingRadius v ≤ bandProfile 0 j := by
    rw [← hκ]
    exact signedMengerProfile_inv_radius_le_of_minimal_boundary_of_cross_pos
      hsimple hregular hD hj (horient j)
  have hsub : ∀ j, OnDiskBoundaryR2 v (enclosingCenter v) (enclosingRadius v) j →
      j = 0 ∨ j = 1 ∨ j = 2 := by
    intro j hj
    have hh := hc j hj
    fin_cases j
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)
    all_goals norm_num [bandProfile] at hh; linarith
  have h11 := curvature_le_level_of_contacts_in_triple hsimple horient hD 1
    (by simpa only [show (1 : ZMod 6) - 1 = 0 by decide,
      show (1 : ZMod 6) + 1 = 2 by decide] using hsub)
  rw [hκ] at h11
  norm_num [bandProfile] at h11
  have hsub' : ∀ j, OnDiskBoundaryR2 v (enclosingCenter v) (enclosingRadius v) j →
      j = 0 ∨ j = 1 := by
    intro j hj
    have hh := hc j hj
    fin_cases j
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr rfl
    all_goals norm_num [bandProfile] at hh; linarith
  have h14 := curvature_le_level_of_contacts_in_triple hsimple horient hD 0 (by
    intro j hj
    rcases hsub' j hj with rfl | rfl <;> simp)
  rw [hκ] at h14
  norm_num [bandProfile] at h14
  have hsingle : ∀ j, OnDiskBoundaryR2 v (enclosingCenter v) (enclosingRadius v) j →
      j = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    have hh := hc j hj
    fin_cases j
    · rfl
    all_goals norm_num [bandProfile] at hh; linarith
  have hRle : enclosingRadius v ≤ 0 := by
    apply minimalEnclosingDiskR2_le_of_boundaryContactsInClosedDiskR2
      (C := v 0) hD le_rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [hsingle j hj]
    exact Metric.mem_closedBall'.mpr (by simp)
  exact (not_le_of_gt
    (radius_pos_of_minimalEnclosingDiskR2_of_isSimplePolygon hD hsimple)) hRle

entries.label: detail:hexagon-endpoint-one
entries.title: The last endpoint is above the gap
entries.chapter: The enclosing-circle obstruction in detail
entries.body: Every such realization of $\kappa_1=(14,11,13,5,4,3)$ has $c\ge11$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.band_one_enclosing_level_ge_eleven
lean.code:
theorem band_one_enclosing_level_ge_eleven
    {v : ZMod 6 → ℂ} (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hregular : DahlbergRegular v) (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v)
    (hκ : SignedMengerProfile v = bandProfile 1) :
    11 ≤ 1 / enclosingRadius v := by
  have hnoncircle : ¬ Concyclic v := by
    intro hcircle
    have hconst := exists_constant_signedMengerProfile_of_concyclic_positiveOrientation
      hsimple hcircle horient
    exact bandProfile_nonconstant 1 (by simpa [hκ] using hconst)
  have hsupport : StrictConvexEdgeSupport v :=
    strictConvexEdgeSupport_of_simple_positiveOrientation hsimple horient
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := dahlbergE2Theorem6Lemma5ContainingDisks
    (by norm_num : 4 ≤ 6) hsimple horient hsupport
    (strictConvexCyclicChordGeometry_of_edgeSupport hsupport) hnoncircle
  by_contra hnot
  have hlt : 1 / enclosingRadius v < 11 := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  simp only [one_div] at hlt
  have hi (i : ZMod 6) (hcontains : EdgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll v i) : i = 5 := by
    have hn := containing_curvature_le_neighbors hsimple hregular horient hcontains
    have hl := signedMengerProfile_le_inv_minimalRadius_of_curvatureDiskContainsAll
      hsimple (enclosingDisk_minimal v) hcontains (horient i)
    rw [hκ] at hn hl
    fin_cases i
    · change (14 : ℝ) ≤ 3 ∧ 14 ≤ 11 at hn
      norm_num at hn
    · norm_num [bandProfile] at hl
      linarith
    · change (10 + 3 * (1 : ℝ)) ≤ 11 ∧ (10 + 3 * (1 : ℝ)) ≤ 5 at hn
      norm_num at hn
    · change (5 : ℝ) ≤ 10 + 3 * 1 ∧ 5 ≤ 7 - 3 * 1 at hn
      norm_num at hn
    · change (7 - 3 * (1 : ℝ)) ≤ 5 ∧ (7 - 3 * (1 : ℝ)) ≤ 3 at hn
      norm_num at hn
    · rfl
  have heq : D.i = D.j := (hi D.i D.contains_i).trans (hi D.j D.contains_j).symm
  exact D.distinct (congrArg (EdgePrevCurvatureCircleData v) heq)

entries.title: No continuous choice of the actual polygons
entries.chapter: The enclosing-circle obstruction in detail
entries.body:
There is no continuous vertex path $s\mapsto v(s)$ on $[0,1]$ such that
each $v(s)$ is a simple coherent positively oriented hexagon with signed
Menger curvature $\kappa_s$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.no_continuous_coherent_hexagon_path
lean.code:
theorem no_continuous_coherent_hexagon_path :
    ¬ ∃ p : ℝ → (ZMod 6 → ℂ), ContinuousOn p (Set.Icc 0 1) ∧
      ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        IsSimplePolygon (p s) ∧ DahlbergRegular (p s) ∧
        PositivePolygonOrientation (p s) ∧ SignedMengerProfile (p s) = bandProfile s := by
  rintro ⟨p, hp, hphysical⟩
  let c : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => 1 / enclosingRadius (p s)
  have hc : ContinuousOn c (Set.Icc 0 1) := by
    apply continuousOn_const.div (enclosingRadius_lipschitz.continuous.comp_continuousOn hp)
    intro s hs
    exact (radius_pos_of_minimalEnclosingDiskR2_of_isSimplePolygon
      (enclosingDisk_minimal (p s)) (hphysical s hs).1).ne'
  obtain ⟨hS0,hR0,hO0,hK0⟩ := hphysical 0 (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨hS1,hR1,hO1,hK1⟩ := hphysical 1 (by norm_num)
  have h0 : c 0 ≤ 7 := band_zero_enclosing_level_le_seven hS0 hR0 hO0 hK0
  have h1 : 11 ≤ c 1 := band_one_enclosing_level_ge_eleven hS1 hR1 hO1 hK1
  obtain ⟨s, hs, heq⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) hc
    (show (9 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (c 0) (c 1) from ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
  obtain ⟨hS,hR,hO,hK⟩ := hphysical s hs
  exact band_enclosing_level_ne_nine hs hS hR hO hK heq

entries.label: detail:hexagon-tabachnikov-obstruction
entries.title: Pointwise realization without global continuous selection
entries.chapter: The enclosing-circle obstruction in detail
entries.body:
Each $\kappa_s$ has a realization in the moderate-arc, closed, full-turn,
simple-polygon sense of the discrete converse. There is nevertheless no
choice of lengths giving these properties for every $s\in[0,1]$ whose
realized vertices depend continuously on $s$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.no_continuous_tabachnikov_hexagon_path
lean.code:
theorem no_continuous_tabachnikov_hexagon_path :
    ¬ ∃ lengths : ℝ → (ZMod 6 → ℝ),
      ContinuousOn (fun s => polygonR2 (bandProfile s) (lengths s)) (Set.Icc 0 1) ∧
      ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ModerateArc 0 (bandProfile s) (lengths s) ∧
        closureGap (bandProfile s) (lengths s) = 0 ∧
        turningSum (bandProfile s) (lengths s) = 2 * Real.pi ∧
        IsSimplePolygon (polygonR2 (bandProfile s) (lengths s)) := by
  rintro ⟨lengths, hp, hreal⟩
  apply no_continuous_coherent_hexagon_path
  refine ⟨fun s => polygonR2 (bandProfile s) (lengths s), hp, ?_⟩
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hMA,hE,hT,hS⟩ := hreal s hs
  have hK : SignedMengerProfile (polygonR2 (bandProfile s) (lengths s)) = bandProfile s := by
    funext i
    let k := (i - 1).val
    have hk : (k : ZMod 6) = i - 1 := ZMod.natCast_rightInverse _
    have hh := signedMengerR2_development hMA k
    simpa only [SignedMengerProfile, vertexR2_eq_polygon hE hT,
      Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, hk, sub_add_cancel] using hh
  exact ⟨hS, dahlbergRegular_of_locallyRegular hS
      (locallyRegular_development_moderate hMA (bandProfile_pos hs) hE hT),
    positiveOrientation_of_signedMengerProfile_pos hS
      (by rw [hK]; exact bandProfile_pos hs), hK⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.dahlbergRegular_of_locallyRegular
lean.code:
theorem dahlbergRegular_of_locallyRegular
    {n : ℕ} {v : ZMod n → ℂ} (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hlocal : LocallyRegularR2 v) : DahlbergRegular v := by
  intro i
  obtain ⟨hcross, hcone⟩ := hlocal i
  let C := circumcenterR2 (v i) (v (i - 1)) (v (i + 1))
  have heq := circumcenterR2_equidist hcross
  have hCne : C ≠ v i := by
    intro h
    have hp : dist C (v (i - 1)) = dist C (v i) := heq.1
    rw [h, dist_self] at hp
    exact hsimple.1 (i - 1) (by simpa using (dist_eq_zero.mp hp).symm)
  right
  refine ⟨C, dist C (v i), ⟨dist_pos.mpr hCne, heq.1, rfl, heq.2⟩, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a,b,ha,hb,he⟩ := hcone
  refine ⟨a,b,ha,hb,?_⟩
  dsimp [C]
  rw [he]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.bandProfile_pointwise_realizable
lean.code:
theorem bandProfile_pointwise_realizable {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    RealizesR2 (bandProfile s) :=
  tabachnikovProblem2_all (by norm_num : 4 ≤ 6) _ (bandProfile_admissible hs)

entries.label: st:tangent-intersection
entries.title: Tangent normals and intersections
entries.chapter: Projective geometry of the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
Put $u(\theta)=\cos\theta+i\sin\theta$ and, for unit vectors $u,v$ with
$1+\langle u,v\rangle\ne0$, put
\[
 T(u,v)=\frac{u+v}{1+\langle u,v\rangle}.
\]
Thus $|u(\theta)|=1$, $\langle u(\alpha),u(\beta)\rangle=\cos(\beta-\alpha)$,
and $[u(\alpha),u(\beta)]=\sin(\beta-\alpha)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal
lean.code: noncomputable abbrev normal (θ : ℝ) : ℂ := circlePoint 0 1 θ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cross_normal
lean.code:
lemma cross_normal (α β : ℝ) :
    crossR2 0 (normal α) (normal β) = Real.sin (β - α) := by
  simp [crossR2, Real.sin_sub]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_im
lean.code: @[simp] lemma normal_im (θ : ℝ) : (normal θ).im = Real.sin θ := by simp [normal]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_re
lean.code: @[simp] lemma normal_re (θ : ℝ) : (normal θ).re = Real.cos θ := by simp [normal]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.norm_normal
lean.code:
@[simp] lemma norm_normal (θ : ℝ) : ‖normal θ‖ = 1 := by
  simp [normal]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.inner_normal
lean.code:
lemma inner_normal (α β : ℝ) : ⟪normal α, normal β⟫_ℝ = Real.cos (β - α) := by
  simp [Complex.inner, Real.cos_sub]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.tangentIntersection
lean.code:
noncomputable def tangentIntersection (u v : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ)⁻¹ • (u + v)

entries.label: st:tangent-equations
entries.title: The two tangent equations and their continuous extension
entries.chapter: Projective geometry of the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
The intersection is symmetric and satisfies
$\langle u,T(u,v)\rangle=\langle v,T(u,v)\rangle=1$.
For $0\le\beta-\alpha<\pi$ its denominator is positive.
The normal map is continuous, and $T$ is jointly continuous wherever its
denominator is nonzero, including $T(u,u)=u$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.inner_tangentIntersection_right
lean.code:
lemma inner_tangentIntersection_right {u v : ℂ} (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) : ⟪v, tangentIntersection u v⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
  rw [tangentIntersection_comm]
  exact inner_tangentIntersection_left hv (by rwa [real_inner_comm])

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.inner_tangentIntersection_left
lean.code:
lemma inner_tangentIntersection_left {u v : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) : ⟪u, tangentIntersection u v⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
  simp only [tangentIntersection, real_inner_smul_right, inner_add_right,
    real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu, one_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hd]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_denominator_pos
lean.code:
lemma normal_denominator_pos {α β : ℝ} (h₀ : α ≤ β) (hπ : β - α < Real.pi) :
    0 < 1 + ⟪normal α, normal β⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [inner_normal]
  have h := Real.cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (sub_nonneg.mpr h₀) le_rfl hπ
  rw [Real.cos_pi] at h
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.continuousAt_tangentIntersection
lean.code:
lemma continuousAt_tangentIntersection {u v : ℂ} (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousAt (fun p : ℂ × ℂ ↦ tangentIntersection p.1 p.2) (u, v) := by
  have hc : ContinuousAt (fun p : ℂ × ℂ ↦ 1 + ⟪p.1, p.2⟫_ℝ) (u, v) :=
    continuousAt_const.add (continuous_fst.inner continuous_snd).continuousAt
  exact (hc.inv₀ hd).smul (continuous_fst.add continuous_snd).continuousAt

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.continuous_normal
lean.code:
lemma continuous_normal : Continuous normal := by
  change Continuous (circleMap 0 1)
  fun_prop

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.tangentIntersection_comm
lean.code:
lemma tangentIntersection_comm (u v : ℂ) :
    tangentIntersection u v = tangentIntersection v u := by
  simp only [tangentIntersection, real_inner_comm u v, add_comm u v]

entries.label: st:fan-support
entries.title: Ordered circle points and strict tangent support
entries.chapter: Projective geometry of the side-tangent construction
entries.body:
For unit $u,v$ and nonzero tangent denominator,
\[
 [u,v,w]=[u,v]\bigl(1-\langle w,T(u,v)\rangle\bigr).
\]
For $\alpha<\beta<\gamma<\alpha+2\pi$ and $\beta-\alpha<\pi$,
$\langle u(\gamma),T(u(\alpha),u(\beta))\rangle<1$.
The same holds when $\gamma<\alpha<\beta<\gamma+2\pi$.
More generally, for $z(\theta)=c+Re^{i\theta}$,
\[
 [z(\alpha),z(\beta),z(\gamma)]
 =4R^2\sin\frac{\beta-\alpha}{2}\sin\frac{\gamma-\beta}{2}
       \sin\frac{\gamma-\alpha}{2}>0
\]
when $R\ne0$ and the three angles have the first cyclic ordering.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.circlePoint
lean.code: noncomputable abbrev circlePoint (O : ℂ) (R θ : ℝ) : ℂ := circleMap O R θ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_ordered
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_ordered
    (O : ℂ) {R θ₀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ} (hR : R ≠ 0)
    (h₀₁ : θ₀ < θ₁) (h₁₂ : θ₁ < θ₂) (hspan : θ₂ < θ₀ + 2 * Real.pi) :
    0 < crossR2 (circlePoint O R θ₀) (circlePoint O R θ₁)
      (circlePoint O R θ₂) := by
  have hsin₀₁ : 0 < Real.sin ((θ₁ - θ₀) / 2) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hsin₁₂ : 0 < Real.sin ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hsin₀₂ : 0 < Real.sin ((θ₂ - θ₀) / 2) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith)
  rw [crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_half]
  positivity

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_sub
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_sub
    (O : ℂ) (R θ₀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ) :
    crossR2 (circlePoint O R θ₀) (circlePoint O R θ₁) (circlePoint O R θ₂) =
      R ^ 2 * (Real.sin (θ₁ - θ₀) + Real.sin (θ₂ - θ₁) -
        Real.sin (θ₂ - θ₀)) := by
  change crossR2 (circleMap O R θ₀) (circleMap O R θ₁) (circleMap O R θ₂) = _
  unfold crossR2
  simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, circlePoint_re, circlePoint_im]
  rw [Real.sin_sub, Real.sin_sub, Real.sin_sub]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cross_eq_tangent_support
lean.code:
lemma cross_eq_tangent_support {u v : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) (w : ℂ) :
    crossR2 u v w = crossR2 0 u v * (1 - ⟪w, tangentIntersection u v⟫_ℝ) := by
  have hu' : u.re ^ 2 + u.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := Complex.sq_norm u
    rw [hu, Complex.normSq_apply] at h
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hv' : v.re ^ 2 + v.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := Complex.sq_norm v
    rw [hv, Complex.normSq_apply] at h
    nlinarith only [h]
  simp only [tangentIntersection, real_inner_smul_right, inner_add_right]
  field_simp
  simp [crossR2, Complex.inner]
  linear_combination (u.re * w.im - u.im * w.re) * hv' -
    (v.re * w.im - v.im * w.re) * hu'

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.circlePoint_im
lean.code:
@[simp] theorem circlePoint_im (O : ℂ) (R θ : ℝ) :
    (circlePoint O R θ).im = O.im + R * Real.sin θ := by
  change (circleMap O R θ).im = _
  simp [circleMap]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_half
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_half
    (O : ℂ) (R θ₀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ) :
    crossR2 (circlePoint O R θ₀) (circlePoint O R θ₁) (circlePoint O R θ₂) =
      4 * R ^ 2 * Real.sin ((θ₁ - θ₀) / 2) *
        Real.sin ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) * Real.sin ((θ₂ - θ₀) / 2) := by
  rw [crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_sub]
  have hsum : θ₂ - θ₀ = (θ₁ - θ₀) + (θ₂ - θ₁) := by ring
  rw [hsum, sin_add_sin_sub_sin_add]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.circlePoint_add_two_pi
lean.code:
@[simp] theorem circlePoint_add_two_pi (O : ℂ) (R θ : ℝ) :
    circlePoint O R (θ + 2 * Real.pi) = circlePoint O R θ := by
  change circleMap O R (θ + 2 * Real.pi) = circleMap O R θ
  exact periodic_circleMap O R θ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.circlePoint_re
lean.code:
@[simp] theorem circlePoint_re (O : ℂ) (R θ : ℝ) :
    (circlePoint O R θ).re = O.re + R * Real.cos θ := by
  change (circleMap O R θ).re = _
  simp [circleMap]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_support_lt_of_wrapped
lean.code:
lemma normal_support_lt_of_wrapped {α β γ : ℝ} (hγα : γ < α)
    (hαβ : α < β) (hgap : β - α < Real.pi) (hspan : β < γ + 2 * Real.pi) :
    ⟪normal γ, tangentIntersection (normal α) (normal β)⟫_ℝ < 1 := by
  have h := normal_support_lt_of_ordered hαβ hgap hspan
    (by linarith : γ + 2 * Real.pi < α + 2 * Real.pi)
  simpa only [normal, circlePoint_add_two_pi] using h

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_support_lt_of_ordered
lean.code:
lemma normal_support_lt_of_ordered {α β γ : ℝ} (hαβ : α < β)
    (hgap : β - α < Real.pi) (hβγ : β < γ) (hspan : γ < α + 2 * Real.pi) :
    ⟪normal γ, tangentIntersection (normal α) (normal β)⟫_ℝ < 1 := by
  have h := crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_ordered 0 (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
    hαβ hβγ hspan
  rw [cross_eq_tangent_support (norm_normal α) (norm_normal β)
    (normal_denominator_pos hαβ.le hgap).ne', cross_normal] at h
  have hs := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (sub_pos.mpr hαβ) hgap
  nlinarith
